products.name: cargo_segment
products.description: This association product represents the operational segment-level tracking of air waybill shipments on specific flight legs. It captures the core operational reality of air cargo routing: multi-leg shipments travel on multiple flight_legs, and each flight_leg carries multiple AWBs. Each record links one flight_leg to one AWB with segment-specific attributes including weight carried per leg, proration factors for revenue sharing, transfer handling details, and segment sequencing. This is the atomic unit of cargo operations and revenue accounting.. Existence Justification: In airline cargo operations, multi-leg shipments routinely travel on multiple flight_legs (e.g., LAX→LHR via JFK requires two flight_legs), and each flight_leg carries multiple AWBs. This is the fundamental operational reality of air cargo routing. Airlines actively manage segment-level data including weight carried per leg, proration factors for revenue sharing among carriers, transfer handling at intermediate stations, and segment sequencing for operational coordination.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: cargo_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this cargo segment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: awb_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the air waybill being transported on this segment

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific flight leg on which this cargo segment was transported

attributes.name: compartment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific cargo compartment or hold position where this AWB was loaded on this flight leg (e.g., FWD, AFT, BULK). Used for weight and balance calculations.

attributes.name: handling_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the station where this cargo was handled for this segment (loading, transfer, or offloading). May differ from flight origin/destination for transfer cargo.

attributes.name: loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this AWB was physically loaded onto the aircraft for this flight leg. Used for operational performance tracking and load reconciliation.

attributes.name: loading_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for loading this AWB on this specific flight leg, which may differ from overall AWB priority based on connection times, special handling requirements, or operational constraints.

attributes.name: manifested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this AWB was added to the cargo manifest for this specific flight leg. Used for operational cutoff tracking and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: offloaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this AWB was physically offloaded from the aircraft after this flight leg. Used for transfer coordination and delivery tracking.

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Revenue allocation factor for this segment, used to distribute total AWB revenue across multiple flight legs for interline and codeshare accounting. Typically based on segment distance or weight-distance.

attributes.name: segment_chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: Chargeable weight for this specific segment, used for proration calculations and revenue allocation to this flight leg.

attributes.name: segment_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of this flight leg within the AWB's complete routing (1 for first leg, 2 for second leg, etc.). Critical for multi-leg shipment tracking and transfer coordination.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this cargo segment within its lifecycle: booked (reserved on flight), manifested (included in flight manifest), loaded (physically loaded on aircraft), departed (flight departed), arrived (flight arrived), offloaded (cargo removed from aircraft), transferred (handed over to next segment).

attributes.name: segment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight of this AWB carried on this specific flight leg, in kilograms. May differ from total AWB weight if shipment is split or consolidated during transit.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this AWB was transferred between flight legs at an intermediate station. Null for origin and final destination segments. Critical for tracking transfer performance and connection integrity.

attributes.name: uld_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the Unit Load Device (container or pallet) on which this AWB was loaded for this flight leg. Null for bulk cargo. Used for load planning and tracking.

products.name: dispatch_exemption_invocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational invocation of regulatory exemptions and waivers within specific dispatch release documents. Each record captures when a dispatcher explicitly invokes a regulatory relief instrument to authorize a flight departure under non-standard conditions, including the dispatcher's acknowledgment of conditions, verification of applicability, and compliance attestation required for FAA/EASA audit trails per 14 CFR Part 121.. Existence Justification: In airline dispatch operations, a single dispatch release can invoke multiple regulatory exemptions simultaneously (e.g., ETOPS diversion time relief + MEL extension + special airport procedure waiver), and each exemption applies to many dispatch releases over its validity period. Dispatchers actively manage which exemptions are invoked per release, documenting acknowledgment of conditions, verification of applicability, and compliance attestation to create an auditable regulatory trail required by FAA 14 CFR Part 121.687.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: dispatch_exemption_invocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this specific invocation of an exemption within a dispatch release. Primary key.

attributes.name: dispatch_release_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dispatch Exemption Invocation - Dispatch Release Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the dispatch release document that invokes this exemption

attributes.name: exemption_waiver_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dispatch Exemption Invocation - Exemption Waiver Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory exemption or waiver being invoked

attributes.name: applicability_justification
attributes.description: Dispatcher's explanation of why this specific exemption is applicable to this flight (e.g., 'ETOPS diversion time waiver applies due to North Atlantic routing with limited alternate airports'). Required for regulatory audit defense.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatcher applied this exemption to the dispatch release during the authorization workflow. Captures the operational moment of invocation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the exemption invocation approval within the dispatch release workflow (approved, conditionally_approved, rejected, pending_review). Tracks whether the dispatcher's use of this exemption was validated.

attributes.name: condition_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting how the flight meets all conditions attached to the exemption (e.g., 'Aircraft equipped with required ETOPS equipment per exemption condition 3a; crew ETOPS-qualified per condition 2b').

attributes.name: conditions_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispatcher explicitly acknowledged and accepted all conditions attached to this exemption as applicable to this specific flight. Required for regulatory compliance attestation.

attributes.name: dispatcher_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Textual acknowledgment or attestation statement by the dispatcher confirming understanding of the exemption's conditions and applicability to this flight. May include dispatcher comments on specific condition compliance.

attributes.name: expiry_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispatcher verified that the exemption was still valid (not expired) at the time of dispatch release issuance. Critical for audit trail demonstrating due diligence.

attributes.name: invocation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order in which this exemption was applied within the dispatch release workflow. Useful for understanding dispatcher decision-making sequence during release preparation.

products.name: codeshare_flight_execution
products.description: This association product represents the operational execution of a codeshare agreement on a specific flight leg. It captures the commercial partnership arrangement applied to each operated flight, including the marketing carrier's flight number used, revenue allocation calculations, settlement tracking, and partner notification status. Each record links one flight_leg to one route_partnership agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific codeshare execution instance.. Existence Justification: In airline codeshare operations, a single flight leg can be marketed under multiple partner carrier flight numbers simultaneously (e.g., UA123 operated by United is also sold as LH7500 by Lufthansa and AC9876 by Air Canada under different partnership agreements). Conversely, each route partnership agreement covers hundreds or thousands of flight legs over time. The business actively manages each codeshare execution instance with specific revenue calculations, settlement tracking, passenger counts, and partner notifications that belong to neither the flight leg nor the partnership agreement alone.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: codeshare_flight_execution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this codeshare flight execution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Codeshare Flight Execution - Flight Leg Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific operational flight leg instance on which this codeshare agreement is executed.

attributes.name: partnership_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Codeshare Flight Execution - Route Codeshare Agreement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the route partnership agreement that governs this codeshare execution.

attributes.name: codeshare_flight_number_used
attributes.description: The specific marketing carrier flight number assigned and used for this codeshare execution, including carrier code and numeric identifier. This is the flight number passengers see on their tickets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this codeshare flight execution record was created in the system, typically during flight planning or schedule publication.

attributes.name: execution_status
attributes.description: Operational status of this codeshare execution instance. Tracks whether the codeshare arrangement is active for this specific flight or has been cancelled/suspended due to operational or commercial reasons.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this codeshare flight execution record was last modified, tracking changes to settlement status, passenger counts, or operational status.

attributes.name: partner_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the partner carrier was notified of operational details for this codeshare flight execution (schedule changes, delays, cancellations). Critical for partner carrier customer service operations.

attributes.name: passenger_count
attributes.description: Number of passengers booked on this specific codeshare flight number for this flight leg execution. Used for revenue allocation and capacity management.

attributes.name: prorate_calculation_basis
attributes.description: The method or formula used to calculate revenue allocation for this specific flight execution (e.g., IATA standard prorate, special prorate agreement percentage, block-space fixed amount). Documents how revenue_share_amount was derived.

attributes.name: revenue_share_amount
attributes.description: The calculated revenue amount allocated to the partner carrier for this specific flight leg execution under the partnership agreement terms. Used for settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: seat_allocation_count
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated to the marketing carrier for this specific flight execution under block-space agreements. Null for free-flow codeshare arrangements.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of revenue settlement processing for this codeshare flight execution. Tracks lifecycle from initial calculation through final settlement between carriers.

domains.name: passenger
domains.description: Single source of truth for all passenger identity and profile data — the WHO the airline serves. Owns PNR-linked passenger profiles, identity documents, contact details, travel preferences, accessibility and SSR (Special Service Request) preferences, loyalty tier linkage, and segmentation attributes. Serves as the authoritative customer identity hub referenced by reservation, loyalty, and ancillary domains. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa PSS.
domains.references: IATA PSC, GDPR, DOT Consumer Protection

products.name: profile
products.description: Core master record for every individual passenger served by the airline — the authoritative identity hub (SSOT) for the passenger domain. Stores full legal name, date of birth, gender, nationality, preferred language, passenger type (adult, child, infant, unaccompanied minor), profile creation source (Altéa PSS, web, mobile, GDS), profile status, and data consent flags. Holds a summary primary contact reference (single email, single phone) for display purposes only — the authoritative multi-valued contact store is the contact_detail product. Referenced by reservation, loyalty, and ancillary domains via passenger_id. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa passenger profile entity.
products.reference: Amadeus Altéa PSS Passenger Profile

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Primary key for profile

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership record for this passenger. Links passenger profile to their FFP account for tier status and mileage accrual.

attributes.name: preferred_city_pair_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.city_pair. Business justification: Route development and network planning teams analyze passenger home/preferred city pairs to identify underserved markets and optimize route networks. Marketing uses this for targeted route launch camp

attributes.name: accessibility_requirements
attributes.description: Special assistance or accessibility needs for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility. Free-text field capturing wheelchair requirements, visual/hearing impairments, service animal needs, medical equipment, etc. Detailed SSR codes stored in separate SSR product.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 700 - Passengers with Disabilities, DOT 14 CFR Part 382, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: completeness_score
attributes.description: Calculated percentage score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the completeness of the passenger profile based on presence of key fields (contact details, travel documents, preferences, loyalty linkage). Used for data quality monitoring and personalization readiness.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS Profile Quality Metrics

attributes.name: country_of_residence
attributes.description: Country where the passenger permanently resides, represented as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Used for customs declarations and passenger segmentation analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the passenger profile was first created in the system. Immutable audit field for profile lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: creation_source
attributes.description: System or channel through which the passenger profile was originally created. Tracks profile origin for data quality and channel analytics. GDS=Global Distribution System (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport).
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS, IATA NDC Standards

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Marketing segmentation classification for the passenger based on travel behavior, spend patterns, and loyalty tier. Examples: premium_frequent_flyer, leisure_traveler, business_traveler, occasional_flyer, vip_corporate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium_frequent_flyer|leisure_traveler|business_traveler|occasional_flyer|vip_corporate|group_traveler|family_traveler — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Airline Revenue Management and CRM Strategy

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger has consented to sharing their personal data with airline partners, codeshare airlines, and third-party service providers. True=consented, False=not consented.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the passenger. Required for age verification, infant/child classification, unaccompanied minor processing, and compliance with TSA Secure Flight and API (Advanced Passenger Information) requirements.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight Program, ICAO Annex 9, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the passenger's designated emergency contact person to be notified in case of travel disruptions, medical emergencies, or incidents.
attributes.references: IATA Recommended Practice, Airline Safety Protocols

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the passenger's designated emergency contact person. E.164 international format recommended.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the passenger (e.g., spouse, parent, child, sibling, friend).

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name (given name) of the passenger as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Must match travel documents for international travel.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the passenger as recorded in travel documents. M=Male, F=Female, X=Unspecified/Non-binary, U=Undisclosed. Required for API and TSA Secure Flight compliance.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight Program, ICAO Doc 9303

attributes.name: known_traveler_number
attributes.description: TSA PreCheck Known Traveler Number or equivalent trusted traveler program identifier (e.g., Global Entry, NEXUS, SENTRI). Enables expedited security screening at participating airports.
attributes.references: TSA PreCheck Program, DHS Trusted Traveler Programs

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname/family name) of the passenger as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Must match travel documents for international travel.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger has consented to receive marketing communications, promotional offers, and newsletters from the airline. True=opted in, False=opted out.

attributes.name: meal_preference
attributes.description: Passenger's preferred meal type for in-flight catering. Standard IATA SSR meal codes (e.g., VGML=Vegetarian, KSML=Kosher, DBML=Diabetic, MOML=Muslim, HNML=Hindu). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VGML|KSML|DBML|MOML|HNML|AVML|BBML|BLML|CHML|FPML|GFML|LCML|LFML|LSML|NLML|ORML|PRML|SFML|SPML|VJML|VOML — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the passenger. Optional field that may be required for certain international destinations or to match travel documents.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: Nationality of the passenger represented as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Required for visa validation, customs processing, and API submission to destination countries.

attributes.name: passenger_type
attributes.description: Classification of passenger by age and travel status. ADT=Adult (12+ years), CHD=Child (2-11 years), INF=Infant (under 2 years), UMN=Unaccompanied Minor. Determines fare rules, seating requirements, and service protocols.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Preferred language for passenger communications, notifications, and in-flight services. ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, fr, de, zh).

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for passenger communications, booking confirmations, flight notifications, and digital receipts. Display-only summary field; authoritative multi-valued contact store is the contact_detail product.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for passenger communications, flight alerts, and operational notifications. E.164 international format recommended. Display-only summary field; authoritative multi-valued contact store is the contact_detail product.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the passenger profile. Active=profile in use, Inactive=dormant profile, Suspended=temporarily blocked, Merged=consolidated into another profile, Deceased=passenger deceased per notification.

attributes.name: redress_number
attributes.description: DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP) control number issued to passengers who have been misidentified or delayed during security screening. Prevents future watchlist false positives.
attributes.references: DHS TRIP Program, TSA Secure Flight

attributes.name: seat_preference
attributes.description: Passenger's preferred seat location on the aircraft. Used for automated seat assignment and upgrade processing.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix such as Jr, Sr, III, etc. Used to distinguish passengers with identical names.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Courtesy title or honorific for the passenger used in communications and boarding documents.

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor_guardian_name
attributes.description: Full name of the parent or legal guardian responsible for an unaccompanied minor passenger. Required for UMN bookings to coordinate drop-off and pick-up procedures.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 - Unaccompanied Minors, Airline UMN Policies

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor_guardian_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the parent or legal guardian of an unaccompanied minor passenger. Used for coordination during travel and emergency contact.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 - Unaccompanied Minors, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the passenger profile was last modified. Updated on any change to profile attributes, contact details, or preferences.

attributes.name: vip_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the passenger is designated as a VIP requiring special handling, premium services, or executive attention. True=VIP status, False=standard passenger.

products.name: travel_identity_document
products.description: Stores all identity and travel documents associated with a passenger — passports, national ID cards, visas, residence permits, and known traveller numbers (e.g., TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, NEXUS). Captures document number, issuing country (ICAO alpha-2), document type, issue date, expiry date, machine-readable zone (MRZ) data, and document verification status. Supports APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) regulatory reporting and border control compliance. A passenger may hold multiple documents across multiple nationalities.
products.reference: IATA APIS / ICAO Doc 9303 Machine Readable Travel Documents

attributes.name: travel_identity_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the travel identity document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger who holds this travel document. Links to the passenger master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Travel documents must comply with APIS, Secure Flight, and border authority regulations (19 CFR 122.49b, EU PNR Directive). Airlines verify document validity against regulatory mandates for passenger

attributes.name: apis_response_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) Response Code
attributes.description: Response code received from border control authority after APIS transmission. OK=cleared to board; INHIBITED=passenger denied boarding; CONDITIONAL=manual review required. Codes vary by country.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 792 (APIS), Country-Specific APIS Implementation Guides

attributes.name: apis_transmission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) Transmission Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document data was transmitted to border control authorities. Used to prove compliance with advance notification requirements (typically 72 hours before departure for USA).

attributes.name: apis_transmitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) Transmitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this documents data has been successfully transmitted to destination country border control authorities via APIS. Required for flights to USA, Canada, UK, EU, and many other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the document holder as printed on the travel document. Required for APIS reporting, secure flight screening (TSA), and age-based service eligibility (unaccompanied minor, senior fares).
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303, TSA Secure Flight, IATA Resolution 792 (APIS)

attributes.name: document_image_url
attributes.description: Secure storage location (URI) of the scanned or photographed document image. Used for manual verification, fraud investigation, and regulatory compliance. Access restricted to authorized personnel only.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing), Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier printed on the travel document. This is the primary identifier used for APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) reporting and border control verification.

attributes.name: document_source
attributes.description: Method by which the document data was captured. Manual_entry=agent typed data; OCR_scan=automated optical character recognition from image; Mobile_app=passenger self-service via mobile; GDS=received from Global Distribution System; API_integration=received from partner system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of travel identity document. Passport is the most common for international travel; national ID cards are accepted within certain regions (e.g., EU, Schengen); visas grant entry permission; residence permits prove legal residency; refugee travel documents and stateless person documents are issued under international conventions.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303 Machine Readable Travel Documents

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the travel document expires. Most countries require passport validity of 6 months beyond the intended stay. System must alert if document expires before return travel date.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303, IATA Timatic (Travel Information Manual Automatic)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender marker as printed on the travel document. M=Male, F=Female, X=Unspecified/Non-binary (per ICAO 2018 guidelines). Required for APIS and secure flight reporting.

attributes.name: given_names
attributes.description: First and middle names as printed on the travel document. Must match PNR for secure flight and APIS compliance.

attributes.name: is_primary_document
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the passengers primary travel document for the current booking. A passenger may hold multiple documents (e.g., passport + national ID), but only one is designated primary for APIS reporting.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the travel document was issued by the authority. Used to calculate document age and assess fraud risk (newly issued documents before travel may trigger additional screening).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or authority that issued the document (e.g., 'U.S. Department of State', 'UK Home Office'). Used for document verification and fraud detection.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country or authority that issued the document. Critical for APIS reporting and visa waiver program eligibility determination.

attributes.name: known_traveller_number
attributes.description: Trusted traveller program membership number (e.g., TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, NEXUS, SENTRI, APEC Business Travel Card). Enables expedited security screening and border clearance. Stored for automatic inclusion in secure flight data.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight, CBP Trusted Traveler Programs

attributes.name: known_traveller_program
attributes.description: Name of the trusted traveller program associated with the known traveller number. Determines which expedited lanes and services the passenger is eligible for.

attributes.name: last_used_flight_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent flight on which this document was used for travel. Helps identify stale or outdated document records and supports passenger profile analytics.

attributes.name: mrz_line1
attributes.description: First line of the machine-readable zone at the bottom of the document. Contains document type, issuing country, and surname/given names in standardized format. Used for automated document scanning and APIS transmission.

attributes.name: mrz_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the machine-readable zone. Contains document number, nationality, date of birth, gender, expiry date, and check digits. Enables rapid data capture via optical character recognition (OCR) at check-in kiosks and border control.

attributes.name: mrz_line3
attributes.description: Third line of the machine-readable zone (present on some document types such as ID cards). Contains additional personal data and check digits.

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code representing the nationality of the document holder. May differ from issuing country for dual nationals or residents. Required for APIS and visa requirement checks.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agent or system notes regarding the document. May include verification issues, special handling instructions, or discrepancies requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: place_of_birth
attributes.description: City and country of birth as printed on the travel document. Required for certain APIS destinations (e.g., USA, Canada) and visa applications.

attributes.name: redress_number
attributes.description: DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP) control number issued to passengers who have been misidentified as a security threat. Prevents false positive watchlist matches during secure flight screening.

attributes.name: secure_flight_status
attributes.description: TSA Secure Flight screening result for USA-bound flights. Not_submitted=data not yet sent; Cleared=passenger approved for boarding; Inhibited=passenger denied boarding (no-fly list match); Conditional=requires additional screening or documentation.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight Program, 49 CFR Part 1560

attributes.name: surname
attributes.description: Family name or surname as printed on the travel document. Must match exactly with booking PNR (Passenger Name Record) for boarding pass issuance and border clearance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document record was last modified. Tracks changes to document data, verification status, or APIS transmission results.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification state of the document. Not_verified=newly entered, pending check; Verified=passed authenticity and expiry checks; Failed=document rejected (invalid format, fraudulent); Expired=document past expiry date; Flagged=requires manual review by security or compliance team.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document verification status was last updated. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the agent or automated process that performed the verification. Supports audit trail and accountability for document acceptance decisions.

attributes.name: visa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a visa is required for the passengers itinerary based on nationality, destination, and transit countries. Calculated using IATA Timatic rules. If true, a separate visa document record must exist.

products.name: contact_detail
products.description: All contact channels for a passenger — email addresses, phone numbers (mobile, home, work), postal addresses, and emergency contacts. Captures contact type, channel, preferred contact flag, opt-in/opt-out status for marketing and operational communications, verification status, and effective date range. Supports IROP proactive notification and DOT consumer communication requirements. A passenger may have multiple active contact records across channels. Distinct from pax_profile (which holds a summary contact reference) — this is the detailed, multi-valued contact store.
products.reference: Amadeus Altéa PSS Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact detail record. Primary key.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger who owns this contact detail. Links to the passenger profile in the passenger domain.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The primary street address line (street number, street name, building). Part of the postal address for the passenger.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Universal Postal Union S42 Standard

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, or building details. Optional component of postal address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Universal Postal Union S42 Standard

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city or municipality name for the postal address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Universal Postal Union S42 Standard

attributes.name: contact_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel or medium through which this contact method operates (voice, SMS, email, postal, WhatsApp, app notification). Distinct from contact_type which defines the category.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this contact detail: active (in use), inactive (not in use), bounced (delivery failed), invalid (format error), pending_verification (awaiting confirmation).

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: The category of contact channel: email, mobile phone, home phone, work phone, postal address, or emergency contact.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO country code for the contact address or phone number (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Aligns with IATA and ICAO standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact detail record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601, IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this contact detail becomes active and valid for use. Supports temporal contact management.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this contact detail remains active and valid. Null indicates no expiration. Supports temporal contact management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: The email address for this contact record. Used for e-ticket delivery, booking confirmations, IROP notifications, and marketing communications per DOT consumer communication requirements.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the emergency contact person. Populated only when contact_type is emergency. Used for incident response and passenger welfare.

attributes.description: Unique code identifying the segment type (e.g., HVT for high-value traveller, CFF for corporate frequent flyer, LSR for leisure traveller, PSN for price-sensitive, PRM for premium loyalist, LPS for lapsed traveller).

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the segment characteristics, targeting criteria, and business rationale. Used for segment documentation and stakeholder communication.

attributes.name: segment_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the segmentation model or rule set used to assign this segment. Enables tracking of model evolution and reprocessing.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the passenger segment (e.g., High-Value Traveller, Corporate Frequent Flyer, Leisure Traveller, Price-Sensitive, Premium Loyalist, Lapsed Traveller).

attributes.name: segment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about this segment assignment. Used for manual overrides, special cases, or analyst annotations.

attributes.name: segment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking (1=highest) used when a passenger belongs to multiple segments simultaneously. Determines which segment takes precedence for targeting and personalization.

attributes.name: segment_source
attributes.description: Origin of the segment assignment: rules engine (business rule-based), ML model (machine learning algorithm), manual (analyst-assigned), third-party (external data provider), or hybrid (combination of methods).

attributes.name: segment_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system or model that generated the segment assignment (e.g., Sabre AirVision Revenue Management, internal propensity model, CRM segmentation engine).

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment assignment: active (in use), inactive (not currently applied), expired (past effective date), suspended (temporarily disabled), or pending (awaiting activation).

attributes.name: targeting_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment assignment makes the passenger eligible for targeted marketing campaigns and personalized offers (true) or should be excluded (false) due to opt-out or regulatory restrictions.

attributes.name: travel_frequency_band
attributes.description: Classification of passenger travel frequency based on flight count over a defined period: very high (frequent business traveller), high, medium, low, very low, or inactive (lapsed).

products.name: consent
products.description: Manages passenger data privacy and consent records in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, and other applicable data protection regulations. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, data sharing with partners, profiling, personalisation), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent channel (web, mobile app, call centre, airport kiosk), consent timestamp, consent version (policy version at time of grant), and jurisdiction. Provides the legal basis for data processing activities and supports right-to-erasure and data portability requests. Mandatory for DOT and EASA consumer protection compliance.
products.reference: GDPR Art. 7 / CCPA / IATA Data Privacy Framework

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Primary key for consent

attributes.name: data_subject_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to a data subject access request (DSAR), right-to-erasure request, or data portability request that triggered this consent record update. Null if the consent was not updated as part of a formal data subject request.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger profile to whom this consent record belongs. Links to the authoritative passenger identity in the passenger domain.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Consent management must comply with GDPR Article 7, CCPA Section 1798.120, and other privacy regulations. Airlines link each consent record to the governing regulatory requirement to demonstrate lawfu

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: A structured log or reference to detailed audit records capturing all consent lifecycle events (granted, modified, withdrawn, expired). Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the passenger provided or updated their consent. Critical for audit trail and consent validity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1), EASA Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent. Indicates whether the passenger has granted, withdrawn, or is pending decision on the consent request. Expired indicates consent has passed its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category of consent granted or withheld by the passenger. Defines the specific data processing activity for which consent is required under GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, or other applicable data protection regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the system. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Distinct from consent_granted_timestamp, which reflects the passenger's action.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the passenger to provide consent. Supports user experience analysis and consent validity verification.

attributes.name: dpo_review_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this consent record has been reviewed or flagged for review by the airline's Data Protection Officer (DPO). Used for high-risk or disputed consent cases.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be re-requested from the passenger. Null for consents with no expiration. Recorded in ISO 8601 date format (yyyy-MM-dd). Required for jurisdictions with time-bound consent validity.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the passenger granted consent. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the passenger submitted their consent. Used for fraud detection, audit trail, and jurisdiction determination. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the legal jurisdiction under which this consent was collected. Determines applicable data protection regulation (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California, PDPA for Singapore, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, GDPR Territorial Scope Article 3

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code in which the consent request was presented to the passenger. Required for demonstrating informed consent in the passenger's preferred language.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing the passenger's personal data. While this product focuses on consent, other legal bases may apply for specific processing activities.

attributes.name: minor_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this consent record pertains to a minor (passenger under the age of consent in the applicable jurisdiction). Triggers additional parental consent and verification requirements under GDPR Article 8 and COPPA.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The identifier of the system user or automated process that last modified this consent record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, exceptions, or special handling instructions related to this consent record. Used by customer service and compliance teams.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the consent was obtained via opt-in (true) or opt-out (false) mechanism. GDPR requires opt-in for most marketing and profiling activities.

attributes.name: parental_consent_verified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether parental or guardian consent has been verified for a minor passenger. Null if minor_consent_flag is false. Required for GDPR Article 8 and COPPA compliance.

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: The specific purpose for which the passenger's data will be processed under this consent. Examples include marketing communications, service personalization, loyalty program analytics, or partner offers. Required for GDPR Article 13 transparency.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the airline should proactively request consent renewal from the passenger. Used for consent lifecycle management and regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring periodic re-consent.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system or application that captured the consent record. Examples include Amadeus Altéa PSS, airline mobile app, loyalty portal, or third-party booking platform.

attributes.name: text_snapshot
attributes.description: A snapshot or reference to the exact consent text presented to the passenger at the time of consent. Supports audit and dispute resolution by preserving the wording the passenger agreed to.

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_scope
attributes.description: Description of the third-party entities or categories of entities with whom passenger data may be shared under this consent. Required for transparency under GDPR Article 13 and CCPA Section 1798.100(b).

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The user agent string of the browser or application used by the passenger to provide consent. Supports technical audit and fraud detection.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy policy or consent terms that were in effect at the time the passenger granted consent. Enables tracking of consent under different policy versions and supports re-consent workflows when policies change.

attributes.name: withdrawn_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the passenger withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for right-to-erasure compliance.

products.name: profile_history
products.description: Immutable audit history of changes to the pax_profile master record — capturing every field-level change with before/after values, change timestamp, change source system (Altéa PSS, web self-service, mobile app, call centre, GDS), agent ID or automated process identifier, and change reason code. Supports GDPR data subject access requests, regulatory audit trails, fraud investigation, and data quality root-cause analysis. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of a passenger's profile state for any historical date.
products.reference: GDPR Art. 30 Records of Processing / Amadeus Altéa Audit Trail

attributes.name: profile_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for profile_history

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the airline agent, call center representative, or customer service employee who performed the profile change. Null for passenger self-service or automated system changes. Supports accountability and training quality analysis.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the master pax_profile record that this history entry tracks. Links each audit event to the subject passenger profile.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS - Passenger Profile Master

attributes.name: reversed_history_profile_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the pax_profile_history_id of the original change record that this entry reverses. Null for non-reversal changes. Creates an audit chain linking corrections to their original errors.

attributes.name: agent_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or city code representing the geographic location where the agent performed the change. Null for automated or self-service changes. Supports regional compliance and operational analysis.

attributes.name: audit_retention_category
attributes.description: Classification determining the retention period for this audit record. STANDARD follows default policy, EXTENDED for high-value passengers or complex cases, LEGAL_HOLD for litigation or investigation, PERMANENT for regulatory or historical preservation.
attributes.references: Internal records management policy, IATA audit standards

attributes.name: automated_process_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the automated system process, batch job, or integration workflow that triggered the profile change. Null for human-initiated changes. Examples: NIGHTLY_DATA_QUALITY_JOB, GDS_SYNC_PROCESS, LOYALTY_TIER_RECALC.

attributes.name: change_batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier linking this change to a batch processing run or bulk update operation. Null for individual real-time changes. Enables rollback of entire batch operations and supports bulk change audit reporting.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the profile change. Examples: PASSENGER_REQUEST, DATA_QUALITY_FIX, REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE, FRAUD_PREVENTION, SYSTEM_MIGRATION, DUPLICATE_MERGE. Supports root-cause analysis and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if more than 6 distinct codes emerge]

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the profile change. Captures agent notes, passenger comments, or automated process descriptions that supplement the reason code.

attributes.name: change_source_system
attributes.description: The system or channel that originated the profile change. Identifies whether the mutation came from the core PSS, passenger self-service channels, agent-assisted channels, or external GDS platforms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ALTEA_PSS|WEB_SELF_SERVICE|MOBILE_APP|CALL_CENTRE|GDS_AMADEUS|GDS_SABRE|GDS_TRAVELPORT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS - System Integration Architecture

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the profile change was committed to the system. Represents the business event time of the mutation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The nature of the data mutation: INSERT for new profile creation, UPDATE for field modifications, DELETE for logical deletion, MERGE for profile consolidation, GDPR_ERASURE for right-to-be-forgotten requests, CORRECTION for data quality remediation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure), ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: change_validation_status
attributes.description: The outcome of automated or manual validation checks applied to the profile change. VALIDATED indicates the change passed all business rules, PENDING_REVIEW requires human review, REJECTED indicates the change was blocked, AUTO_APPROVED for low-risk changes, MANUAL_OVERRIDE for supervisor-approved exceptions.
attributes.references: Internal data quality and fraud prevention framework

attributes.name: changed_field_name
attributes.description: The specific attribute name in the pax_profile master record that was modified. Enables field-level audit granularity for compliance and data quality investigations.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this change was made to satisfy a regulatory compliance requirement (e.g., GDPR data correction request, DOT consumer protection mandate). True for compliance-driven changes, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR, DOT 14 CFR Part 259, IATA Resolution 830

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric quality score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the profile record after this change. Calculated by automated data quality rules. Supports data stewardship and remediation prioritization.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality, internal data governance framework

attributes.name: data_subject_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the passenger provided explicit consent for this specific data processing activity at the time of the change. True if consent was obtained, False otherwise. Supports GDPR consent management and audit requirements.

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned by the fraud detection system at the time of the profile change. Higher scores indicate greater likelihood of fraudulent activity. Supports security investigations and pattern analysis.

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 that justifies the processing and retention of this profile change record. Required for EU passenger data. Supports data subject access requests and regulatory audits.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the client device or system from which the profile change was initiated. Captured for security, fraud detection, and forensic analysis. Null for backend batch processes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 (Personal Data definition), ISO 27001 security logging

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field after the mutation. Stored as string representation to accommodate all data types. Null for DELETE operations. Enables forward reconstruction of profile state evolution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 15 (Right of Access), audit trail best practices

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric PNR record locator associated with the transaction that triggered the profile change. Null if the change was not initiated within the context of a specific reservation. Supports cross-domain audit trail linking.
attributes.references: IATA PNR standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field immediately before the mutation. Stored as string representation to accommodate all data types. Null for INSERT operations. Supports point-in-time reconstruction and rollback scenarios.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 15 (Right of Access), audit trail best practices

attributes.name: record_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (SHA-256) of the complete change record payload. Ensures immutability and tamper detection for audit integrity. Supports forensic verification and regulatory compliance with audit trail non-repudiation requirements.

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this audit record is eligible for deletion or archival per the airlines data retention policy and applicable regulatory requirements. Null for records with indefinite retention. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation), internal data retention policy

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this history record represents a reversal or rollback of a previous change. True if this is a corrective reversal, False for normal forward changes. Supports error correction audit trails.

attributes.name: session_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user session or API session during which the profile change occurred. Enables correlation of multiple changes within a single interaction and supports session replay for troubleshooting.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this profile change to the broader business transaction or session that triggered it. Enables correlation of profile mutations with reservation bookings, check-in events, or loyalty transactions.

attributes.name: user_agent_string
attributes.description: The HTTP user agent string identifying the browser, mobile app version, or API client that submitted the profile change. Supports device analytics, compatibility troubleshooting, and fraud pattern detection.

products.name: minor_guardian
products.description: Manages the relationship between unaccompanied minor (UMNR) passengers and their authorised guardians or escorts. Captures guardian full name, relationship to minor (parent, legal guardian, authorised adult), contact phone numbers, government-issued ID reference, authorisation document reference, pickup authorisation at destination, and the effective date range of the guardianship record. Required for UMNR service fulfilment, ground handling handover procedures, and liability compliance. Distinct from contact_detail — this entity carries legal authorisation and handover workflow data specific to minors.
products.reference: IATA UMNR Handling Guidelines / Amadeus Altéa UMNR SSR

attributes.name: minor_guardian_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the minor-guardian relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accepting_crew_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.crew_member. Business justification: Unaccompanied minor programs require airlines to document which cabin crew member accepted custody of the child at departure and handover. Legal liability and duty-of-care mandate. Crew member signs h

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent identifier of the staff member who verified the guardian authorization. Required for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the unaccompanied minor (UMNR) passenger. Links to the passenger master record.

attributes.name: authorization_document_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the authorization document, if applicable. Ensures authorization is valid for the travel date.

attributes.name: authorization_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the authorization document. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: authorization_document_type
attributes.description: Type of legal authorization document provided to permit the minor to travel unaccompanied. Required for regulatory compliance and liability protection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guardian record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: dropoff_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guardian is authorized to drop off the minor at the origin airport. True if authorized, False otherwise. Used for origin handover verification.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this guardian authorization is valid. Supports time-bound guardianship arrangements.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: End date until which this guardian authorization is valid. Null indicates open-ended authorization. Supports time-bound guardianship arrangements.

attributes.name: guardian_address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the guardian. Required for emergency contact and legal documentation.

attributes.name: guardian_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the guardian (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional address component.

attributes.name: guardian_alternate_phone_number
attributes.description: Secondary contact phone number for the guardian. Used as backup contact channel during UMNR service delivery.

attributes.name: guardian_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the guardian residence. Part of the complete contact address.

attributes.name: guardian_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the guardian residence country (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Required for international UMNR services.

attributes.name: guardian_email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the guardian. Used for pre-flight notifications, service confirmations, and post-flight communication.

attributes.name: guardian_first_name
attributes.description: First name or given name of the guardian. Used for identity verification during minor handover.

attributes.name: guardian_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the authorized guardian or escort responsible for the unaccompanied minor. Required for handover procedures at origin and destination.

attributes.name: guardian_government_id_number
attributes.description: Identification number from the guardian government-issued document. Recorded for liability and handover audit trail.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303 - Machine Readable Travel Documents

attributes.name: guardian_government_id_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document presented by the guardian for identity verification during minor handover.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303 - Machine Readable Travel Documents

attributes.name: guardian_id_issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the country that issued the guardian identification document (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: guardian_last_name
attributes.description: Last name or family name of the guardian. Used for identity verification during minor handover.

attributes.name: guardian_phone_country_code
attributes.description: International dialing code for the guardian phone number (e.g., +1, +44, +971). Ensures correct routing for international UMNR services.

attributes.name: guardian_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the guardian. Used for operational communication during UMNR service delivery and irregular operations (IROP).

attributes.name: guardian_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the guardian residence. Used for address validation and emergency contact.

attributes.name: guardian_role
attributes.description: Operational role of the guardian in the UMNR service workflow. Determines which airport handover procedures apply.

attributes.name: guardian_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the guardian residence. Required for certain jurisdictions.

attributes.name: guardianship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guardian authorization record. Determines whether the guardian can be used for active UMNR bookings.

attributes.name: pickup_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guardian is authorized to pick up the minor at the destination airport. True if authorized, False otherwise. Critical for ground handling handover procedures.

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric PNR locator code associated with the unaccompanied minor booking. Used for operational handover and service fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: relationship_to_minor
attributes.description: Nature of the relationship between the guardian and the unaccompanied minor. Determines authorization level and liability scope.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or last updated this guardian record (e.g., Amadeus Altéa, SITA Airport Management). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling instructions related to the guardian handover (e.g., custody arrangements, security concerns, language preferences). Used by ground handling staff.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guardian record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the guardian identity and authorization documents were verified by airline staff. Part of the compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity and authorization document verification for the guardian. Critical for compliance and liability management.

products.name: watchlist_check
products.description: Records the results of security watchlist screening checks performed against a passenger profile — covering TSA Secure Flight, OFAC sanctions screening, Interpol notices, and national no-fly list checks. Captures check timestamp, screening programme (Secure Flight, OFAC, EU PNR Directive, etc.), match status (clear, potential match, confirmed match, resolved), resolution action, resolving officer ID, and regulatory submission reference. Mandatory for TSA Secure Flight compliance on US-bound flights and EU PNR Directive compliance on EU-bound flights. Distinct from redress_record — this captures the screening event, not the resolution credential.
products.reference: TSA Secure Flight / EU PNR Directive 2016/681 / OFAC

attributes.name: watchlist_check_id
attributes.description: Primary key for watchlist_check

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent identifier of the security officer who resolved the watchlist match.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger profile being screened.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Watchlist screening is mandated by TSA Secure Flight (49 CFR 1560), EU-PNR Directive, and national security regulations. Airlines link each screening event to the governing requirement to demonstrate

attributes.name: regulatory_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_violation. Airlines track which watchlist check fai

attributes.name: api_pnr_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information (API) / Passenger Name Record (PNR) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the screening was performed using API data, PNR data, or both.

attributes.name: boarding_pass_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a boarding pass was issued following the watchlist check clearance.

attributes.name: check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the watchlist check record in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: check_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the watchlist screening check was performed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this watchlist check record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_date
attributes.description: Date when this watchlist check record must be purged per regulatory data retention requirements.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the flight destination.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the watchlist check result expires and a new check must be performed.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number for which the watchlist check was performed, following IATA flight number format.

attributes.name: known_traveler_number
attributes.description: TSA PreCheck or other trusted traveler program number that may expedite screening clearance.

attributes.name: match_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the match, including which passenger attributes triggered the screening alert.

attributes.name: match_score

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Result of the watchlist screening check indicating whether the passenger matched any watchlist entries.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight Program, DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP)

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the flight origin.

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric PNR locator code associated with the booking being screened.

attributes.name: redress_number
attributes.description: DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP) redress number provided by the passenger to prevent false matches.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory submission of screening results to TSA, EU authorities, or other governing bodies.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve a potential or confirmed match, including clearance, escalation, or denial.

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the flight for which the passenger was screened.

attributes.name: screening_jurisdiction

attributes.name: screening_program

attributes.name: screening_system

attributes.name: screening_version

attributes.name: selectee_indicator

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when screening results were submitted to the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this watchlist check record was last modified.

attributes.name: watchlist_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific watchlist that triggered a match (e.g., No Fly List, Selectee List, OFAC SDN List).

products.name: corporate_traveller
products.description: Links a passenger profile to a corporate travel account or negotiated corporate agreement — capturing the corporate account code, company name, corporate travel policy reference, cost centre, employee ID within the corporate structure, corporate tier (SME, preferred, strategic), and the effective date range of the corporate affiliation. Supports B2B commercial relationships where the airline has negotiated fares or service agreements with corporate clients. Enables corporate travel reporting, duty-of-care tracking, and corporate billing reconciliation. Distinct from pax_segment (which is marketing segmentation) — this is a formal commercial affiliation.

products.name: apis_submission
products.description: Transactional records of Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) data submissions to border control authorities — capturing the submission timestamp, destination country authority (CBP, UK Border Force, EU Entry/Exit System, etc.), submission status (pending, accepted, rejected, error), passenger travel document data snapshot at time of submission, flight reference, and authority response code. Required for regulatory compliance on international routes under ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS, and EU Entry/Exit System mandates. Distinct from travel_document (the master record) — this captures the regulatory submission event.
products.reference: ICAO Annex 9 / US CBP APIS / EU Entry-Exit System

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Customs authorities require passenger manifests linked to exact operating flights. Mandatory com

attributes.name: original_submission_apis_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original APIS submission record if this is a resubmission or correction. Null for original submissions.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger whose travel document data was submitted to border control authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id

Airlines link each submission to the governing regulatory requirement to demonst

Airlines track which APIS failures triggered

attributes.name: arrival_airport_code
