attributes.name: authority_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by the border control authority indicating acceptance, rejection reason, or error condition. Codes vary by authority (e.g., CBP response codes, UKBF codes).
attributes.references: US CBP APIS, EU Entry/Exit System

attributes.name: authority_response_message
attributes.description: Human-readable message returned by the border control authority providing additional detail on the submission outcome or rejection reason.
attributes.references: US CBP APIS, EU Entry/Exit System

attributes.name: authority_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the border control authority returned a response to the APIS submission.

attributes.name: border_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific border control authority that received the submission (e.g., CBP for US Customs and Border Protection, UKBF for UK Border Force, EES for EU Entry/Exit System).

attributes.name: compliance_mandate
attributes.description: The specific regulatory mandate or legal requirement under which this APIS submission was made (e.g., US CBP APIS Final Rule, EU Entry/Exit System Regulation 2017/2226, ICAO Annex 9 Standard 3.47).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS, EU Entry/Exit System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this APIS submission record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: departure_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code of the departure airport for the flight leg associated with this APIS submission.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the destination country whose border control authority received the APIS submission.

attributes.name: document_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the travel document as submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: document_issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country that issued the travel document submitted in the APIS data.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number of the travel document (passport number, national ID number, etc.) as submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of travel document submitted in the APIS data (passport, national ID card, visa, travel permit, refugee travel document, or other recognized travel document).

attributes.name: message_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned to the APIS transmission message by the sending system or border control authority for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: passenger_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the passenger as submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: passenger_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the passenger as recorded on the travel document submitted to border control authorities (M=Male, F=Female, X=Unspecified/Other). Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: passenger_given_name
attributes.description: Given name(s) (first and middle names) of the passenger as they appear on the travel document submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: passenger_nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code representing the nationality of the passenger as submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: passenger_surname
attributes.description: Surname (family name) of the passenger as it appears on the travel document submitted to border control authorities. Snapshot at time of submission.

attributes.name: pnr
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record locator associated with the booking for which APIS data was submitted.

attributes.name: resubmission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a resubmission of previously rejected or corrected APIS data (True) or an original submission (False).

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled arrival date and time of the flight leg for which APIS data was submitted.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date and time of the flight leg for which APIS data was submitted.

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: Technical channel or interface used to transmit the APIS data (e.g., SITA Type B message, XML web service, EDI, proprietary API).

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the APIS data was submitted to border control authorities: automated (system-triggered), manual (agent-initiated), batch (scheduled bulk transmission), real_time (interactive submission).

attributes.name: submission_source_system
attributes.description: Name or code of the operational system that generated and transmitted the APIS submission (e.g., Amadeus Altéa DCS, Sabre AirCentre, SITA Horizon).

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the APIS submission: pending (awaiting authority response), accepted (approved by border control), rejected (denied by border control), error (technical transmission failure), cancelled (submission withdrawn).
attributes.references: US CBP APIS, EU Entry/Exit System

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the APIS data was transmitted to the destination country border control authority. This is the principal business event timestamp for the submission.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this APIS submission record was last modified in the data platform.

products.name: accessibility_profile
products.description: Dedicated master record for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility (PRM — Passengers with Reduced Mobility) — capturing mobility aid type (manual wheelchair, electric wheelchair, mobility scooter), dimensions and weight of mobility aid, battery type (lithium-ion, dry cell) for cargo hold compliance, ambulatory status, visual impairment level, hearing impairment level, cognitive assistance requirements, medical equipment carried (CPAP, oxygen concentrator), and preferred assistance workflow at each journey touchpoint (check-in, security, gate, boarding, deplaning). Aligns with IATA PRM Handling Guidelines and EU Regulation 1107/2006. Distinct from ssr_record — this is the persistent profile, not the per-flight SSR instance.
products.reference: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines / EU Regulation 1107/2006 / ADA

Business justification: Accessibility service failures (denied boarding, damaged wheelchairs, inadequate assistance) trigger consumer protection cases under DOT Part 382 and EC 1107/2006. Airlines link accessibility profiles

attributes.name: revenue_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.emd. Business justification: Accessibility services (wheelchairs, oxygen, medical equipment, stretchers) are often chargeable ancillaries documented via EMDs. Links PRM service profiles to revenue records for billing, EMD reconci

attributes.name: ambulatory_status
attributes.description: Passengers ability to walk and move independently. Determines boarding method, seating restrictions, and emergency evacuation capability.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, FAA 14 CFR Part 382

attributes.name: assistance_at_arrival_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires ground handling assistance at arrival airport (deplaning, baggage claim, customs, onward connection). Triggers PRM service request to ground handler.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: assistance_at_departure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires ground handling assistance at departure airport (check-in, security, gate, boarding). Triggers PRM service request to ground handler.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: assistance_at_transit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires ground handling assistance during transit or connection. Ensures continuity of care between flights.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: boarding_method_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method for boarding the aircraft. Pre-board allows extra time; ambulift is a hydraulic lift vehicle; aisle chair is a narrow wheelchair for aircraft aisle; carry-onboard means passenger is carried by assistance personnel.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: cognitive_assistance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires cognitive or developmental disability assistance. May require simplified instructions, extra time, or companion support.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: companion_traveler_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is required to travel with a companion or safety assistant due to the severity of their disability. May be mandated by airline medical policy.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 2, FAA 14 CFR Part 382

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accessibility profile record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: hearing_impairment_level
attributes.description: Degree of hearing impairment. Determines need for visual safety briefings, written communication, and assistive listening devices.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006, ADA Title II

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the accessibility profile information was last verified or updated by the passenger or airline staff. Used for data quality and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date until which the medical clearance (MEDIF) is valid. Passenger cannot travel after this date without renewed clearance.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires medical clearance (MEDIF form) from airline medical services before travel. Triggered by certain medical conditions or equipment.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 2, IATA Resolution 700

attributes.name: medical_equipment_carried
attributes.description: Description of medical equipment the passenger carries onboard (CPAP, portable oxygen concentrator, nebulizer, insulin pump). Free-text field for crew awareness and stowage planning.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual, FAA 14 CFR Part 382.133

attributes.name: mobility_aid_battery_type
attributes.description: Type of battery powering the mobility aid device. Critical for dangerous goods compliance and cargo hold safety. Lithium-ion batteries have specific IATA DGR restrictions.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Section 2.3, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: mobility_aid_battery_watt_hours
attributes.description: Energy capacity of the mobility aid battery in watt-hours. Required for lithium battery compliance checks per IATA DGR (batteries over 300Wh require special handling).

attributes.name: mobility_aid_foldable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mobility aid device can be folded or disassembled for stowage. Affects cargo hold space allocation and handling procedures.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_type
attributes.description: Type of mobility aid device used by the passenger. Determines handling and stowage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manual_wheelchair|electric_wheelchair|mobility_scooter|walker|cane|crutches|prosthetic|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: mobility_aid_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the mobility aid device in kilograms. Required for cargo hold planning and aircraft weight and balance calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, ICAO Annex 18

attributes.name: mobility_aid_width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: oxygen_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Prescribed oxygen flow rate in liters per minute. Required for aircraft oxygen system configuration and medical clearance.

attributes.name: oxygen_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires supplemental oxygen during flight. Requires advance coordination with medical services and aircraft equipment availability.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 8, FAA 14 CFR Part 121.574

attributes.name: preferred_seating_location
attributes.description: Passengers preferred seating location based on accessibility needs. Bulkhead seats provide extra space for mobility aids; aisle seats facilitate lavatory access.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: prm_category
attributes.description: IATA standard PRM category code. WCHR=wheelchair for ramp, WCHS=wheelchair for stairs, WCHC=wheelchair for cabin seat, customerD=dry cell battery wheelchair, customerW=wet cell battery wheelchair, WCMP=manual wheelchair, BLND=blind, DEAF=deaf, DPNA=disabled passenger needing assistance, MAAS=meet and assist. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WCHR|WCHS|WCHC|customerD|customerW|WCMP|BLND|DEAF|DPNA|MAAS — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profile_effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this accessibility profile becomes effective and can be used for booking and SSR generation.

attributes.name: profile_effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this accessibility profile remains valid. Nullable for indefinite profiles; populated for time-limited medical clearances.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accessibility profile. Active profiles are used for SSR generation; expired profiles require renewal of medical documentation.

attributes.name: seating_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes on seating restrictions or requirements (e.g., cannot sit in exit row, requires adjacent seat for companion, needs armrest removal). Used by inventory and departure control systems.

attributes.name: service_animal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger travels with a trained service animal (guide dog, hearing dog, psychiatric service animal). Requires cabin accommodation and documentation.
attributes.references: FAA 14 CFR Part 382, DOT Service Animal Rule, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: service_animal_type
attributes.description: Type of trained service animal accompanying the passenger. Determines seating location and cabin crew briefing requirements.
attributes.references: FAA 14 CFR Part 382, DOT Service Animal Rule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or last updated this accessibility profile record (e.g., Amadeus Altéa PSS, airport kiosk, mobile app, call center CRM).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional accessibility instructions, preferences, or notes that do not fit structured fields. Visible to ground handlers and cabin crew.

attributes.name: stretcher_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires stretcher accommodation. Requires removal of multiple seat rows and advance aircraft configuration.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, IATA Medical Manual

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accessibility profile record was last modified. Updated on every change for audit trail and data freshness tracking.

attributes.name: visual_impairment_level
attributes.description: Degree of visual impairment. Determines need for sighted guide, Braille materials, audio announcements, and service animal accommodation.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006, ADA Title II

products.name: pnr_link
products.description: Association entity linking a passenger profile to one or more PNR (Passenger Name Record) bookings managed in the reservation domain. Captures the PNR locator, passenger name as it appears on the PNR (which may differ from legal name on profile), name association type (primary, infant-on-lap, group member), booking role (lead passenger, accompanying passenger), and the source GDS or PSS that created the association. This is the authoritative cross-domain join key between the passenger identity domain and the reservation domain, enabling profile enrichment of PNR data without duplicating reservation master data.
products.reference: IATA PNR Standard / Amadeus Altéa PSS PNR-Profile Link

attributes.name: api_data_submitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information (API) Data Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Advance Passenger Information (passport, visa, destination address) has been submitted to authorities for this passenger on this PNR. True if submitted; false if not yet submitted. Required for international travel compliance.

attributes.name: apis_submission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Submission Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when API data was transmitted to border control authorities for this passenger. Null if not yet submitted. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: boarding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger boarded the aircraft for the flight(s) on this PNR. Null if not yet boarded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: booking_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger was first linked to the PNR in the reservation system. Represents the initial association event. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: booking_role
attributes.description: Defines the passenger's role within the PNR booking. Lead passenger is the primary contact and decision-maker; accompanying passenger travels with the lead; infant is a child under 2; group leader manages a group booking; group member is part of a group.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for cancellation of this passenger-PNR link. Passenger_request indicates voluntary cancellation; schedule_change indicates airline-initiated change; involuntary indicates denied boarding or operational reasons; no_show indicates passenger did not appear; duplicate indicates duplicate booking; fraud indicates suspected fraudulent booking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: passenger_request|schedule_change|involuntary|no_show|duplicate|fraud|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger-PNR link was cancelled. Null if link is still active or completed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger checked in for the flight(s) on this PNR. Null if not yet checked in. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address provided for this passenger on this PNR for booking-specific communications. May differ from the email stored in the passenger profile if the passenger provided a different contact for this booking.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number provided for this passenger on this PNR for booking-specific communications. May differ from the phone stored in the passenger profile if the passenger provided a different contact for this booking.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the emergency contact person for this passenger on this PNR. Used in case of travel disruption or incident.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person for this passenger on this PNR. Used in case of travel disruption or incident.

attributes.name: group_booking_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this passenger-PNR link is part of a group booking (typically 10 or more passengers traveling together). True if group booking; false if individual or small party.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the group if this is a group booking. Examples: corporate event name, tour group name, sports team name. Null for non-group bookings.

attributes.name: infant_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this passenger is an infant (under 2 years old) traveling on this PNR. True if infant; false otherwise. Affects pricing, seating, and service requirements.

attributes.name: infant_on_lap_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the infant is traveling on an adult's lap without a separate seat. True if on lap; false if infant has own seat. Impacts seat assignment and safety procedures.

attributes.name: known_traveler_number
attributes.description: TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, or other trusted traveler program number. Enables expedited security screening. Applicable primarily for US travel.

products.name: passenger_booking_passenger
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between passenger profiles and PNRs in airline reservation operations. It captures the many-to-many reality that one passenger can have multiple bookings over time (frequent flyers, business travelers) and one PNR can contain multiple passengers (family bookings, group travel). Each record links one passenger profile to one PNR with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific booking participation: passenger sequence number, booking role, check-in timestamp, boarding timestamp, and booking-specific preferences.. Existence Justification: Airlines operations exhibit true bidirectional many-to-many cardinality: individual passengers create multiple PNRs over their travel lifetime (frequent flyers, business travelers, leisure trips), and individual PNRs contain multiple passengers (family bookings, group travel, corporate delegations). The relationship itself carries operational data that belongs to neither entity alone: passenger sequence within the booking, booking role (primary/companion/infant), check-in and boarding timestamps, and booking-specific preferences that may override profile defaults.

products.name: passenger_booking
products.description: This association product represents the booking event between a passenger profile and a specific flight inventory. It captures the core reservation relationship in airline operations. Each record links one passenger to one flight-date combination with attributes that exist only in the context of this booking: seat assignment, check-in status, boarding timestamps, ticket details, and fare class. This is the authoritative record of passenger-flight associations managed by Amadeus Altéa PSS and consumed by departure control, revenue management, and customer service systems.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, passengers book multiple flights throughout their travel history (multi-leg journeys, round-trips, frequent travelers), and each flight carries multiple passengers. The booking is the core operational entity managed by reservation systems (Amadeus Altéa PSS), departure control, and customer service. Each booking has its own lifecycle with seat assignment, check-in status, boarding timestamps, ticket number, and fare class that belong to neither the passenger profile nor the flight inventory alone.

products.name: travel_history
products.description: This association product represents the historical record of passenger travel on specific routes. It captures the travel behavior, preferences, and commercial relationship between a passenger and a route over time. Each record links one passenger profile to one route with attributes that track frequency, recency, fare history, and route-specific preferences used for personalization, revenue optimization, and customer lifetime value analysis.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, passengers travel on multiple routes throughout their customer lifetime, and each route serves thousands of different passengers. The business actively manages and analyzes the passenger-route relationship to drive personalization, revenue optimization, targeted offers, and customer lifetime value analysis. This relationship carries meaningful operational and analytical data (frequency, recency, fare history, preferences) that belongs to neither the passenger profile nor the route master alone.

It captures the opt-in decision, tracks progress toward qualification targets, and records bonus miles earned per member-promotion pair. Each record links one passenger to one promotion with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline loyalty operations, passengers routinely enroll in multiple concurrent promotions (e.g., double miles on transatlantic routes, bonus for credit card spend, tier challenge), and each promotion targets thousands of members. The business actively manages these enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment status, progress toward qualification targets, and bonus miles earned per member-promotion pair. This is a genuine M:N relationship with rich relationship semantics that loyalty operations staff query and manage daily.

attributes.description: Three-letter IATA city code for the final arrival point in the itinerary. Used for origin-destination (O&D) analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Location Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Specific distribution channel or sub-channel identifier. For GDS bookings, includes the GDS name (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). For direct bookings, includes the specific platform or partner.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_summary
attributes.description: Summary description of the payment method(s) used for this PNR. May include credit card type, cash, voucher, or multiple forms of payment. Detailed payment data stored separately for PCI compliance.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, PCI DSS

attributes.name: interline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the PNR includes segments operated by multiple airlines under interline agreements. True if interline, false if single-carrier.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, IATA Interline Agreements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the PNR. Updated whenever any element of the PNR is changed (segments, passengers, services, remarks). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: last_modifying_agent_sign
attributes.description: Agent sign or user ID of the individual who last modified the PNR. Updated with each change for audit trail.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: origin_city_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA city code for the first departure point in the itinerary. Used for origin-destination (O&D) analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Location Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: passenger_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers included in this PNR. Supports group bookings and family travel.

attributes.name: point_of_sale_city
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA city code representing the city where the booking was made. Used for market analysis and revenue management.
attributes.references: IATA Location Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: point_of_sale_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the booking was made. Critical for revenue accounting, tax calculation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: purge_date
attributes.description: Date when the PNR is scheduled to be purged or archived from the active reservation system. Typically set based on last travel date plus retention period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: queue_number
attributes.description: PSS queue number where the PNR is currently placed for agent action. Used for workflow management and ticketing time limit monitoring.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: record_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the PNR across systems. The externally-known business identifier used by agents, passengers, and partner systems. Also known as booking reference or confirmation code.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date of the return flight segment departure for round-trip itineraries. Null for one-way or multi-city trips. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: segment_count
attributes.description: Total number of flight segments (legs) included in this PNR itinerary. Each flight leg is counted separately.

attributes.name: special_service_request_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of four-letter SSR codes applicable to the entire PNR (e.g., WCHR for wheelchair, PETC for pet in cabin). Individual passenger SSRs stored separately.
attributes.references: IATA SSR Code List, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount for the PNR, including government taxes, airport taxes, and other mandatory levies. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, IATA BSP Standards

attributes.name: ticketed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the PNR was ticketed (e-ticket issued). Null if not yet ticketed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ticketing_time_limit
attributes.description: Deadline by which the PNR must be ticketed or the reservation will be automatically cancelled. Critical for revenue management and inventory control. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: total_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total fare amount for all passengers and segments in the PNR, including base fare, taxes, fees, and surcharges. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, IATA BSP Standards

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour operator or bulk fare contract code associated with the PNR. Used for special fare validation and commission calculation.

attributes.name: trip_type
attributes.description: Type of itinerary structure. One-way (single segment), round-trip (outbound and return), multi-city (multiple destinations), or open-jaw (different origin/destination for outbound and return).

products.name: itinerary_segment
products.description: Individual flight segment within a PNR itinerary. Represents a single booked flight leg including operating carrier code, flight number, departure airport IATA code, arrival airport IATA code, scheduled departure date and time, scheduled arrival date and time, booking class (RBD), cabin class, fare basis code, segment status code (HK/KL/UN/NO), number of seats, codeshare indicator, operating carrier flight number, marketing carrier code, equipment type, and segment sequence number. Core operational unit of the itinerary.
products.reference: IATA SSR / Amadeus Altéa Segment

attributes.name: itinerary_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the itinerary segment. Primary key for this entity representing a single booked flight leg within a PNR.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Flight planning, schedule optimization, passenger notifications, and operational assignment all require knowing which aircraft type operates each segment. Equipment_type_code is denormalized ICAO/IATA

attributes.name: award_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.award_inventory. Business justification: Award bookings consume specific award inventory allocations per segment. Business process: award seat allocation tracking, inventory management, waitlist clearance, dynamic award pricing.

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Segments book into specific cabin classes (First, Business, Premium Economy, Economy). This link is essential for cabin-level load factor reporting, service delivery (meal type, baggage allowance, lou

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: Revenue management, seat inventory control, ancillary pricing (preferred seats, extra legroom), and passenger service delivery depend on knowing exact cabin layout for each segment. Cabin configuratio

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Revenue management analyzes which campaigns drive bookings on specific routes and flights for pricing strategy optimization. Segment-level campaign attribution enables route-specific promotional effec

attributes.name: cdm_message_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.cdm_message. Business justification: Flight segments generate CDM milestone messages (TOBT, EOBT, TSAT). Airport coordination, slot management, and turnaround optimization require this link for collaborative decision-making processes.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Flight segments are attributed to cost centers (route, hub, region) for management accounting, CASK/RASK analysis, and route profitability reporting. Essential for operational finance and network plan

attributes.name: departure_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Every flight segment departs from a station. Flight planning, crew scheduling, slot coordination, ground handling, and operational reporting all require this link. Core operational relationship in air

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Segment-level FFP tracking required for mileage accrual calculation, tier qualifying segment counting, partner airline crediting. Business process: post-flight accrual posting per segment flown.

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Every booked segment must reference the inventory control record for the specific flight being sold. This is the foundational link enabling revenue management to track bookings against authorized capa

attributes.name: flight_number_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.flight_number. Business justification: Segments are booked on specific flight numbers. Critical for inventory control, codeshare management, schedule change processing, and GDS distribution. Core airline reservation system requirement link

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Flight segment-specific safety occurrences (in-flight turbulence injuries, cabin incidents, medical emergencies, passenger disturbances) require linkage to the itinerary segment for passenger manifest

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent PNR containing this segment. Links this flight leg to the overall booking record.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Every booked segment operates on a defined route in the network. Essential for schedule planning, revenue management, network analysis, and operational reporting. Aviation standard practice to link bo

attributes.name: slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.slot. Business justification: Flight segments at slot-coordinated airports consume allocated slots. Slot compliance monitoring, historic rights protection, and regulatory reporting (IATA slot coordination) require this link for sc

attributes.name: turnaround_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.turnaround. Business justification: Flight segments are served by turnarounds. Operational planning (minimum ground time), delay attribution, and ground handling cost allocation require this link for operational efficiency and cost mana

attributes.name: action_code
attributes.description: Transaction action code representing the booking action taken. NN=Need, HN=Have need, HK=Holding confirmed, KK=Confirmed, UC=Unable to confirm, UN=Unable need, NO=No action, HL=Have waitlist, KL=Confirmed from waitlist, TK=Schedule change confirmed, TL=Schedule change waitlist, HX=Have cancel, XX=Cancel confirmed, WK=Waitlist, RQ=On request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NN|HN|HK|KK|UC|UN|NO|HL|KL|TK|TL|HX|XX|WK|RQ — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: arrival_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination airport of this segment.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance
attributes.description: Baggage allowance for this segment expressed in piece concept (e.g., 2PC) or weight concept (e.g., 23KG). Determined by fare class and route.

attributes.name: booking_channel_code
attributes.description: Channel through which this segment was booked. GDS=Global Distribution System, WEB=Website, MOB=Mobile App, CTO=City Ticket Office, RES=Reservations Call Center, API=Direct API.

attributes.name: booking_class_code
attributes.description: Single-letter Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) representing the fare class booked. Determines inventory bucket and fare rules.

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this segment is a codeshare flight where marketing and operating carriers differ.

attributes.name: endorsement_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing fare rule endorsements and restrictions applicable to this segment (e.g., NON-REF, CHG FEE APPLIES).

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount allocated to this segment for fare construction and revenue accounting purposes. Excludes taxes and fees.

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific fare product and associated rules. Encodes booking class, seasonality, restrictions, and fare type.

attributes.name: fare_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fare amount.

attributes.name: flown_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the passenger has completed travel on this segment. Set to true after departure or boarding confirmation.

attributes.name: gds_pcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Distribution System (GDS) Pseudo City Code (PCC)
attributes.description: GDS Pseudo City Code identifying the travel agency or corporate booking location that created this segment reservation.

attributes.name: interline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this segment involves interline ticketing with a different carrier than adjacent segments in the itinerary.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier marketing and selling this segment. May differ from operating carrier in codeshare scenarios.

attributes.name: marketing_flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number as marketed to the passenger. Includes numeric identifier and optional suffix letter.

attributes.name: marriage_group_indicator
attributes.description: Single-letter code grouping segments that must be priced together as a married segment. Segments with the same indicator are married for fare construction.

attributes.name: meal_service_code
attributes.description: IATA meal service code indicating the type of meal service provided. B=Breakfast, K=Continental Breakfast, L=Lunch, D=Dinner, S=Snack, V=Refreshment, M=Meal, R=Refreshment for purchase, G=Food for purchase, H=Hot meal, C=Alcoholic beverages for purchase, F=Food and beverages for purchase, P=Alcoholic beverages complimentary, O=Cold meal, N=No meal service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: B|K|L|D|S|V|M|R|G|H|C|F|P|O|N — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: number_of_seats
attributes.description: Quantity of seats booked on this segment for the associated passengers in the PNR.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier physically operating this flight. Populated when segment is a codeshare.

attributes.name: operating_flight_number
attributes.description: Actual flight number operated by the operating carrier. Populated when segment is a codeshare and differs from marketing flight number.

attributes.name: schedule_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this segment has experienced a schedule change since original booking, requiring passenger notification and acceptance.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled arrival date and time in local airport time zone. Represents the planned gate arrival time at booking.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date and time in local airport time zone. Represents the planned gate departure time at booking.

attributes.name: segment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment was first added to the PNR in the reservation system.

attributes.name: segment_mileage
attributes.description: Great circle distance in miles between departure and arrival airports. Used for fare construction and frequent flyer accrual.

attributes.name: segment_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment was last modified (status change, schedule change, or other update).

attributes.name: segment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this segment within the PNR itinerary. Determines the travel flow from origin to final destination.

attributes.name: segment_status_code
attributes.description: Current reservation status of the segment. HK=Confirmed, KK=Confirmed by carrier, KL=Confirmed waitlist cleared, HL=Have requested waitlist, UN=Unable to confirm, UC=Unable to accept, NO=No action taken, WK=Waitlisted, RQ=Requested, TK=Schedule change confirmed, TL=Schedule change waitlist. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HK|KK|KL|HL|UN|UC|NO|WK|RQ|TK|TL — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stopover_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this segment represents a stopover (stay exceeding MCT) versus a connection in the passenger journey.

attributes.name: ticketing_time_limit
attributes.description: Deadline by which this segment must be ticketed or the reservation will be automatically cancelled. Set by fare rules or airline policy.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying a tour package or bulk fare contract associated with this segment. Used for negotiated or inclusive tour fares.

products.name: e_ticket
products.description: Electronic ticket (e-ticket) record representing the contractual document of carriage issued to a passenger. Stores ticket number (13-digit IATA format), conjunction ticket numbers, issuing airline code, issuing office IATA number, ticket issue date and time, ticket status (OPEN/USED/VOID/REFUNDED/EXCHANGED), fare amount, tax breakdown, total amount, form of payment, fare calculation string, endorsement/restriction text, tour code, commission amount, and original ticket number for exchanges. SSOT for ticketing lifecycle. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa ticketing module.
products.reference: IATA e-ticket / BSP / ARC

attributes.name: e_ticket_id
attributes.description: Primary key for e_ticket

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Tickets generate accounts receivable entries in BSP/ARC settlement cycles. Airlines track AR aging, credit control, and cash collection by ticket. Natural link for revenue accounting and cash flow man

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Revenue accounting attributes ticket revenue to marketing campaigns for final ROI calculation after ticketing. Finance reconciles marketing spend against attributed ticket revenue to measure campaign

attributes.name: fare_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.fare_quote. Business justification: E-ticket is issued based on a stored fare quote within the PNR. Linking to fare_quote provides the authoritative pricing record and fare calculation details. Columns fare_basis_code and fare_calculati

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: IATA 9-character office identifier (Office ID) of the location or agency that issued the ticket. Used for settlement and commission tracking.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger for whom this electronic ticket was issued. Links ticket to passenger master data.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Passenger Name Record (PNR) associated with this electronic ticket. Links the ticket to the booking record.

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount for the ticket before taxes and fees. Represents the airline's revenue portion of the ticket price.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount paid to the issuing agent or travel agency for selling the ticket. Used for BSP/ARC settlement.

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applied to calculate the commission amount. Null if flat commission was used.

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ticket is part of a conjunction ticket set (multiple tickets issued together for a single journey exceeding 4 flight coupons).

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related conjunction ticket numbers if this ticket is part of a multi-ticket set. Empty if not a conjunction ticket.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this e-ticket record was first created in the reservation system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this ticket (base fare, tax, total).

attributes.name: endorsement_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing fare restrictions, endorsements, and special conditions applicable to the ticket (e.g., NON-REFUNDABLE, VALID ON XX ONLY).

attributes.name: equivalent_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for the equivalent fare amount. Null if no currency conversion was applied.

attributes.name: equivalent_fare_amount
attributes.description: Fare amount converted to the currency of the country of commencement of travel, if different from ticket currency. Used for settlement purposes.

attributes.name: exchange_date
attributes.description: Date when the ticket was exchanged for a new ticket. Null if ticket has not been exchanged.

attributes.name: exchange_ticket_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ticket was issued as an exchange for a previous ticket. True if this is a reissued ticket.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_details
attributes.description: Detailed payment information including masked card number, approval code, or account reference. Sensitive financial data stored according to PCI-DSS requirements.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_type
attributes.description: Primary payment method used to purchase the ticket. Identifies how the passenger paid for the ticket. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CASH|CREDIT_CARD|DEBIT_CARD|VOUCHER|MILES|CORPORATE_ACCOUNT|INVOICE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gds_pcc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Distribution System (GDS) Pseudo City Code (PCC)
attributes.description: GDS Pseudo City Code (PCC) of the agency or office that created the booking. Used for GDS reporting and commission tracking.

attributes.name: gds_record_locator
attributes.description: GDS-specific booking reference number (record locator) linking the ticket to the GDS reservation. May differ from airline PNR.

attributes.name: in_connection_with_ticket
attributes.description: Ticket number of a related ticket when this ticket is issued in connection with another (e.g., companion ticket, family booking). Null if standalone.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the electronic ticket was issued to the passenger. Represents the contractual agreement date.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the electronic ticket was issued, including timezone. Used for audit and settlement purposes.

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA 2-letter or 3-digit airline code of the carrier that issued the electronic ticket. Identifies the validating carrier responsible for the ticket.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this e-ticket record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: original_ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit ticket number of the original ticket if this is an exchange or reissue. Null for original issuances. Used to track ticket exchange history.

attributes.name: refund_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a refund has been processed for this ticket. True if ticket has been refunded (fully or partially).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount collected on the ticket. Sum of all applicable government taxes, airport fees, and surcharges.

attributes.name: ticket_designator
attributes.description: Special fare qualifier or corporate discount code applied to the ticket. Used for negotiated corporate rates or promotional fares.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA standard ticket number uniquely identifying the electronic ticket document. Format: 3-digit airline code + 10-digit serial number. This is the contractual document of carriage identifier.

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the electronic ticket. OPEN=valid for travel, USED=travel completed, VOID=cancelled before use, REFUNDED=refund processed, EXCHANGED=replaced by new ticket, SUSPENDED=temporarily invalid.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid for the ticket including base fare, taxes, and all fees. This is the final price paid by the passenger.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour operator or bulk fare identifier if the ticket was issued under a tour or group contract. Null for regular published fares.

attributes.name: validating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the carrier responsible for fare rules, refunds, and exchanges. May differ from issuing airline in interline scenarios.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date when the ticket was voided. Null if ticket has not been voided. Voiding typically occurs within 24 hours of issuance.

products.name: reservation_booking_passenger
products.description: Passenger name element (PNE) within a PNR — the reservation-context association of a traveller to a booking. Stores passenger title, first name, last name, suffix, passenger type code (ADT/CHD/INF/INS/YTH/UNN), date of birth, gender, nationality, associated infant indicator, frequent flyer number and tier (for display/SSR purposes), known traveller number (KTN), redress number, APIS data completeness flag, seat preference (window/aisle/none), meal preference code, SSR count, and passenger sequence number within the PNR. This is the booking-scoped passenger reference; the canonical passenger identity master is owned by the passenger domain.
products.reference: IATA PNR Name Element / Amadeus Altéa PNE

attributes.name: reservation_booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the passenger name element (PNE) within the PNR. This is the booking-scoped passenger reference; the canonical passenger identity master is owned by the passenger domain.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the canonical passenger master record in the passenger domain. Enables cross-booking passenger recognition and loyalty program linkage.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent PNR booking record. Links this passenger name element to the reservation container.

attributes.name: apis_data_complete_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Passenger Information System (APIS) Data Complete Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required APIS data elements (name, DOB, gender, nationality, passport) have been collected for this passenger. Required for international travel compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS Requirements

attributes.name: associated_infant_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adult passenger has an associated infant (lap child) traveling with them. Used for seat assignment and boarding validation.

attributes.name: boarding_pass_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a boarding pass has been issued to this passenger for at least one segment in the itinerary.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current reservation status of this passenger within the PNR. Reflects confirmation, waitlist, cancellation, or no-show state.

attributes.name: check_in_status
attributes.description: Current check-in and boarding status of the passenger. Tracks progression from reservation through boarding.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the passenger completed check-in for the first flight segment in the itinerary. Used for boarding priority and operational reporting.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for this passenger. Used for e-ticket delivery, flight notifications, and IROP communication.

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for this passenger. Used for flight notifications, IROP rebooking, and operational communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger name element was first added to the PNR. Audit trail for booking creation.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the passenger. Required for infant and child passengers, and for APIS (Advanced Passenger Information System) compliance on international flights.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the passenger's emergency contact person. Collected for safety and incident response purposes.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the passenger's emergency contact person. Used in case of flight incidents or medical emergencies.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the passenger as it appears on travel documents. Must match government-issued ID for international travel.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: frequent_flyer_number
attributes.description: Passenger's frequent flyer membership number for the operating carrier or alliance partner. Used for mileage accrual, tier recognition, and SSR processing.

attributes.name: frequent_flyer_tier_code
attributes.description: Current tier or status level of the passenger in the frequent flyer program. Used for priority boarding, lounge access, and upgrade eligibility.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the passenger as recorded in the booking. M=Male, F=Female, U=Unspecified, X=Non-binary. Required for APIS compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions

attributes.name: known_traveller_number
attributes.description: TSA PreCheck or other trusted traveler program number. Enables expedited security screening for eligible passengers on US domestic and international flights.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the passenger as it appears on travel documents. Must match government-issued ID for international travel.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: meal_preference_code
attributes.description: IATA standard meal code representing the passenger's dietary preference or restriction. VGML=Vegetarian, HNML=Hindu, KSML=Kosher, MOML=Muslim, AVML=Asian Vegetarian, DBML=Diabetic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGULAR|VGML|HNML|KSML|MOML|AVML|DBML — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the passenger. Optional field used when provided on travel documents.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger name element was last modified. Tracks name corrections, SSR updates, and status changes.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the passenger's nationality. Required for APIS and visa validation.

attributes.name: passenger_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this passenger within the PNR. Used for display, SSR association, and segment assignment. Typically starts at 1.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA passenger type code indicating age category and fare eligibility. ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, INF=Infant (lap), INS=Infant (seat), YTH=Youth, UNN=Unaccompanied Minor.

attributes.name: redress_number
attributes.description: DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP) number issued to passengers who have been misidentified during security screening. Prevents false matches on watchlists.
attributes.references: DHS TRIP Program, TSA Secure Flight Program

attributes.name: seat_preference_code
attributes.description: Passenger's preferred seat location type. Used by seat assignment algorithms and displayed to agents during check-in.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the PSS or GDS system through which this passenger name element was created. ALTEA=Amadeus Altéa, DIRECT=airline.com or mobile app.

attributes.name: special_service_request_count
attributes.description: Total number of SSR records associated with this passenger in the PNR. Includes wheelchair assistance, unaccompanied minor service, pet in cabin, extra baggage, etc.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the passenger name (e.g., Jr., Sr., III). Used for name disambiguation.

attributes.name: ticket_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the e-ticket was issued to this passenger. Used for fare rule validation and refund calculations.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA e-ticket number issued to this passenger. Format: 3-digit airline code + 10-digit serial number. Links to the ticket coupon records.

attributes.name: title

attributes.description: Indicates whether this remark should appear on customer-facing itinerary documents. True for itinerary remarks; false for internal operational remarks.

attributes.name: is_transmitted_to_carrier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this remark is transmitted to the operating carrier(s) via PNR distribution. True for OSI elements and operational remarks requiring carrier visibility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this remark element was last updated. Null if never modified after creation. Recorded in UTC.

attributes.name: modifying_agent_sign
attributes.description: Agent sign-in code or initials of the individual who last modified this remark element. Null if never modified.

attributes.name: modifying_office_iata_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modifying Office International Air Transport Association (IATA) Number
attributes.description: Nine-character IATA office identifier of the agency or airline office that last modified this remark. Null if never modified.

attributes.name: osi_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter or ICAO three-letter airline code identifying the carrier to which this OSI element is directed. Populated only when remark_type is 'osi'.

attributes.name: remark_category
attributes.description: Business category or subject area of the remark (e.g., special service request, operational note, customer preference, billing instruction, ground handling instruction).

attributes.name: remark_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this remark within the PNR. Used to maintain display order and support remark modification or deletion operations.

attributes.name: remark_source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the system or channel that originated this remark (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, direct entry, web booking, mobile app, GDS interface).

attributes.name: remark_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the remark element. Active remarks are visible and operational; deleted remarks are soft-deleted for audit purposes; archived remarks are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: remark_text
attributes.description: Free-text content of the remark element. May contain operational instructions, customer notes, special handling requirements, or inter-carrier communication. Confidential due to potential inclusion of customer preferences or operational details.

attributes.name: remark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the remark element. General remarks are visible to all agents; confidential remarks are restricted; invoice remarks support billing; itinerary remarks appear on customer documents; OSI (Other Service Information) elements are directed to carriers; accounting remarks support financial reconciliation.

products.name: fare_quote
products.description: Stored fare quote (pricing record) within a PNR capturing the fare calculation at time of booking or repricing. Stores fare quote number, pricing date, fare basis code per segment, published fare amount, applicable discount, total fare, tax itemisation, surcharges (YQ/YR fuel surcharge), pricing command used, validating carrier, ticketing time limit, fare type (published/negotiated/private/award), tour code, endorsement text, and pricing source (GDS/NDC/direct). Supports ticketing, repricing, and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: fare_quote_id

Revenue management requires this link to validate bucket availability at quote time, track which buckets a

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Branded fare product selection: fare quotes are built from specific fare families (Basic Economy, Main Cabin, etc.). Revenue management and reporting require tracking which branded product was quoted.

attributes.name: original_fare_quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original fare quote ID if this is a repricing. Null for original quotes.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent PNR (Passenger Name Record) containing this fare quote.

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total base fare amount before taxes, fees, and surcharges. Sum of all segment fare basis amounts.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Calculated commission amount payable to the booking agent or distribution partner based on the fare and commission rate.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage commission rate applicable to this fare quote for travel agency or distribution partner compensation.

attributes.name: corporate_account_code
attributes.description: Corporate discount or account code applied to this fare quote for negotiated corporate pricing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare quote record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the fare quote is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the base fare, including promotional codes, corporate discounts, or negotiated reductions.

attributes.name: endorsement_text
attributes.description: Free-text endorsement or restriction box content printed on the ticket, specifying fare rules, non-refundable conditions, or carrier restrictions.

attributes.name: fare_basis_summary
attributes.description: Concatenated or summarized list of fare basis codes applied across all segments in this quote (e.g., YLOW/YLOW/MLOW). Detailed segment-level fare basis stored in related segment records.

attributes.name: fare_calculation_line
attributes.description: Encoded fare construction string showing city pairs, fare basis codes, and amounts per IATA fare calculation standards. Used for ticket validation and interline proration.

attributes.name: fare_quote_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fare quote, typically assigned by the PSS (Passenger Service System) or GDS (Global Distribution System) at time of pricing.

attributes.name: fare_quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fare quote: active (valid for ticketing), ticketed (converted to ticket), expired (past TTL), repriced (superseded by new quote), cancelled, or voided.

attributes.name: fare_type

attributes.name: gds_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare quote record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: number_of_passengers
attributes.description: Count of passengers covered by this fare quote. Typically 1 for individual pricing, or multiple for group or family fares.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA passenger type code for which this fare quote applies: ADT (adult), CHD (child), INF (infant), SRC (senior), STU (student), MIL (military), YTH (youth). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ADT|CHD|INF|SRC|STU|MIL|YTH — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA code of the airline whose ticket stock (plate) will be used to issue the ticket. May differ from validating carrier in interline scenarios.

attributes.name: pricing_command
attributes.description: The cryptic command or API call used to generate this fare quote (e.g., FXP, WPNC, pricing modifiers). Used for audit and repricing.

attributes.name: pricing_date
attributes.description: Date when the fare quote was calculated and stored. Critical for fare validity and repricing scenarios.

attributes.name: pricing_source
attributes.description: Channel or system from which the fare quote was retrieved: GDS (Global Distribution System), NDC (New Distribution Capability), direct airline system, metasearch engine, OTA (Online Travel Agency), or consolidator.

attributes.name: pricing_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the fare quote was generated, including time zone. Used for ticketing time limit enforcement and audit trails.

attributes.name: private_fare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this fare quote uses a private or negotiated fare (true) versus a published public fare (false).

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: Promotional or discount code applied at time of pricing to obtain special fare rates.

attributes.name: repricing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this fare quote is a repricing of a previous quote (true) or an original pricing (false).

attributes.name: ticketing_time_limit
attributes.description: Deadline by which the ticket must be issued to honor this fare quote. After this time, the PNR may be cancelled or repriced.

attributes.name: total_fare_amount
attributes.description: Grand total fare amount payable by passenger: base fare + taxes + surcharges - discounts. The ticketing amount.

attributes.name: total_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all carrier-imposed surcharges including YQ (fuel surcharge) and YR (carrier surcharge) codes.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all government taxes, airport fees, and regulatory charges applicable to this fare quote.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Bulk or inclusive tour code applied to the fare, indicating special tour operator or package pricing.

attributes.name: validating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier responsible for fare validation, ticketing, and revenue settlement.

products.name: pnr_history
products.description: Audit history log of all changes made to a PNR throughout its lifecycle. Provides full PNR audit trail for dispute resolution, revenue integrity, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: pnr_history_id

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: fare_basis_code

attributes.name: field_name

attributes.name: gds_code

attributes.name: is_automated_change
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this change was performed by an automated system process rather than manual agent action. True=automated, False=manual.

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: New value of the field after the modification. Captures the after-state for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: office_iata_number

attributes.description: IATA-assigned office identification number where the change was made. 9-character alphanumeric code identifying the travel agency or airline office.

attributes.description: Previous value of the field before the modification. Captures the before-state for audit comparison and rollback capability.

attributes.name: ticket_number

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source system that processed this change. Enables correlation with external system logs.

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any fare rule waiver or exception applied during this modification. Used for revenue integrity and policy compliance tracking.

Fina

attributes.name: original_arrival_airport_code

attributes.name: original_arrival_datetime

attributes.name: original_departure_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the original scheduled departure airport.

attributes.description: The originally scheduled departure date and time in local airport time, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: segment_mileage_accrual
products.description: This association product represents the transactional linkage between a booked flight segment and the mileage credit event(s) it generates. Each record captures the specific miles earned from a particular segment, including base miles calculated from segment distance and fare class, elite bonuses, and promotional bonuses. A single segment can generate multiple accrual records when multiple passengers on the same PNR earn miles to different FFP accounts, when companions earn miles, or when retroactive claims are processed. Journey-based bonuses may reference multiple segments in a single accrual transaction.. Existence Justification: In airline loyalty operations, a single itinerary segment can generate multiple mileage accrual records when multiple passengers on the same PNR earn miles to different FFP accounts, when companions earn miles, when split crediting occurs (crediting to multiple programs), or when retroactive claims are processed months after travel. Conversely, a single mileage accrual transaction can reference multiple segments when journey-based bonuses are awarded (e.g., 'fly 3 segments in a month, earn 5000 bonus miles') or when promotional accruals span a multi-segment itinerary. The relationship itself carries critical business data: the specific miles breakdown attributable to each segment, posting status per segment, and qualification indicators.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment-to-accrual linkage record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the flight segment that generated this mileage credit. References the specific booked leg including carrier, flight number, origin, destination, booking class, and cabin class used to calculate miles earned.

attributes.name: mileage_accrual_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Mileage Accrual - Mileage Accrual Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the mileage accrual transaction record. References the specific credit event including member, accrual date, posting date, miles breakdown, and status.

attributes.description: System timestamp when this segment-accrual linkage record was created. Audit trail for when the segment was associated with the accrual transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: qualifying_indicator

attributes.name: segment_base_miles
attributes.description: Base miles earned specifically from this segment, calculated from segment distance and fare class. When a journey-based accrual spans multiple segments, this attribute allocates the portion of base miles attributable to this specific segment.

attributes.name: segment_contribution_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment's contribution to the accrual was calculated. Typically the segment departure date for standard accruals, or the claim date for retroactive accruals.

attributes.name: segment_elite_bonus_miles

attributes.name: segment_posting_status

Reversed indicates miles clawed back. Excluded indicates segment did not qualify for miles (award ticket, non-qualifying fare class).

attributes.name: segment_promotional_bonus_miles
attributes.description: Promotional bonus miles earned specifically from this segment. Captures route-specific promotions, cabin-specific bonuses, or segment-level campaign credits.

products.name: segment_ancillary_purchase
products.description: This association product represents the purchase transaction between an itinerary segment and an ancillary product from the catalog. It captures the segment-level merchandising event where a passenger purchases an ancillary service (baggage, seat upgrade, meal, Wi-Fi, etc.) for a specific flight leg. Each record links one itinerary segment to one ancillary product with transaction-specific attributes including purchase date, quantity, price paid, and service delivery status.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, passengers purchase ancillary products (baggage, meals, seat upgrades, Wi-Fi, lounge access) for specific flight segments within their itinerary. A single segment can have multiple ancillary purchases (e.g., checked bag + meal + priority boarding), and each ancillary product is purchased across thousands of segments daily. This is operational segment-level merchandising where the airline actively manages purchase transactions with attributes like purchase date, quantity, price paid, service delivery status, and EMD documentation.

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Revenue management and pricing SSOT — HOW the airline prices and captures revenue. Owns fare structures, pricing rules, yield management parameters, fare classes, dynamic pricing, RASK/CASK/RPK/ASK performance metrics, revenue accounting records, BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) settlements, ARC reporting, and ancillary revenue aggregation. Aligns with Sabre AirVision Revenue Management.

products.name: fare
products.description: Master fare definition record representing a published or private fare basis — the atomic pricing unit in the airline revenue management system. Owns fare basis code, fare amount, currency, cabin class, booking class (RBD), fare type (published/negotiated/private/web), one-way or round-trip indicator, directionality, origin-destination city pair, carrier designator, ticketing carrier, global indicator, routing number, fare tariff number, IATA fare filing reference, effective date, discontinue date, and fare ownership (ATPCO/SITA/carrier-filed). Aligns with Sabre AirVision fare filing and ATPCO Fare Filing standards.

attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport or city code representing the departure point of the fare's origin-destination city pair (e.g., JFK, LHR, SIN). Defines the directional applicability of the fare.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fare origin point. Used for regulatory compliance, DOT reporting, and country-of-sale restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: ownership
