attributes.description: Date on which the ticket was originally issued, refunded, exchanged, or voided by the travel agency. Represents the business event date as recorded in the ARC report, distinct from the settlement processing date.
attributes.references: ARC Industry Agents Handbook (IAH); IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ARC settlement transaction: SALE (new ticket issuance), REFUND (ticket refund to passenger), EXCHANGE (ticket reissue/exchange), VOID (same-week void of issued ticket), ADM (Agency Debit Memo — amount collected from agency), ACM (Agency Credit Memo — amount credited to agency).
attributes.references: ARC Industry Agents Handbook (IAH); IATA Resolution 850 (ADM/ACM)

attributes.name: travel_date
attributes.description: Date of the first flight segment on the ticketed itinerary. Used for revenue recognition timing, yield analysis, and period allocation in revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this ARC settlement record in the silver layer, reflecting status changes, dispute updates, or correction reprocessing. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

products.name: adm
products.description: Agency Debit Memo (ADM) record issued by the airline to a travel agent to recover funds for ticketing errors, fare differences, commission clawbacks, or policy violations. Captures ADM number, issuing airline, agent IATA/ARC code, agent name, related ticket number, ADM reason code (IATA standard), ADM reason description, debit amount, currency, issue date, dispute deadline, dispute status (undisputed/disputed/waived/upheld/reversed), BSP/ARC channel, and resolution notes. SSOT for agent billing dispute and revenue recovery management.
products.reference: IATA ADM/ACM Resolution 850m / BSP ADM Standard

attributes.name: adm_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Agency Debit Memo record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: ADMs issued to agents create AP entries when credits are due (e.g., disputed ADMs resolved in agent favor). Links revenue adjustments to payables.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: ADMs are issued to travel agencies. The agent_iata_code and agent_name attributes in adm should reference the authoritative agency master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict. agent_i

attributes.name: arc_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.arc_settlement. Business justification: ADMs can also be processed through ARC settlement cycles (US market). The arc_reporting_period attribute in adm indicates it's part of an ARC settlement. This should be a FK to the authoritative arc_s

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: ADMs (Agency Debit Memos) are processed through BSP settlement cycles. The bsp_billing_period attribute in adm indicates it's part of a BSP settlement. This should be a FK to the authoritative bsp_set

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Agency debit memos impact specific legal entity financials (revenue adjustments, AR). Required for accurate financial reporting by legal entity.

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: ADM (Agency Debit Memo) is issued to recover funds for ticketing errors or policy violations. Each ADM references one ticket. The adm table has ticket_number (STRING) as a business key. Adding ticket_

attributes.name: adm_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable ADM document number assigned by the issuing airline. Used as the primary reference in BSP/ARC settlement communications and agent correspondence. Typically follows IATA document numbering conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: authorised_commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate (decimal fraction) that the airline had authorised for the agent on this transaction. Compared against commission_rate to determine if a commission clawback ADM is warranted.

attributes.name: collected_fare_amount
attributes.description: The actual fare amount collected by the travel agent on the ticket transaction. The difference between original_fare_amount and collected_fare_amount typically constitutes the fare-difference ADM debit.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.0100 for 1%) that was applied or claimed by the agent on the underlying ticket. Used to calculate commission clawback ADMs where the agent applied an unauthorised or incorrect commission.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the travel agent's location. Determines the applicable BSP market rules, dispute timelines, and regulatory jurisdiction for the ADM.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ADM record was first captured in the revenue management system or lakehouse. Provides the audit trail creation marker per data governance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the ADM debit amount is denominated and settled (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the BSP or ARC settlement currency for the agent's market.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Resolution 850m; BSP Operations Manual

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount being debited from the travel agent by this ADM, expressed in the settlement currency. Represents the principal financial claim before any adjustments or waivers.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; BSP Operations Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code for the destination point of the ticket or itinerary associated with this ADM. Used alongside origin for market-level revenue recovery analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 850m

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the travel agent formally submitted a dispute against this ADM. Null if the ADM has not been disputed. Used to verify dispute was raised within the allowable dispute window.

attributes.name: dispute_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date by which the travel agent may formally dispute this ADM under IATA Resolution 850m or ARC rules. Calculated from the issue date per applicable BSP/ARC market rules. After this date, an undisputed ADM is deemed accepted.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ADM dispute workflow: undisputed (agent has not contested), disputed (agent has raised a formal dispute), waived (airline has waived the debit), upheld (dispute rejected, debit stands), reversed (ADM cancelled and debit reversed).

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code of the fare that should have been applied to the ticket, as determined by the airline's revenue management and pricing system. Used to substantiate fare-difference ADMs.
attributes.references: IATA Fare Basis Code Standard; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: gds_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Global Distribution System through which the original ticket was booked (e.g., 1A=Amadeus, 1S=Sabre, 1G=Galileo, 1V=Worldspan, FD=direct). Relevant for identifying the booking channel and routing disputes.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the ADM was formally issued by the airline to the travel agent. Serves as the principal business event date for settlement cycle inclusion and dispute deadline calculation.

attributes.name: issuing_office_code
attributes.description: Airline office or station code of the revenue accounting unit that issued this ADM. Used for internal routing, accountability tracking, and regional revenue recovery reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: net_debit_amount
attributes.description: Net amount recoverable from the agent after applying any approved waivers, partial reversals, or adjustments to the gross debit amount. Used for final BSP/ARC settlement processing.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code for the origin point of the ticket or itinerary associated with this ADM. Used for market analysis and routing of revenue recovery claims.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 850m

attributes.name: original_fare_amount
attributes.description: The fare amount that should have been applied to the ticket per the airline's published or filed fare rules, as determined by the revenue management system. Used to calculate the fare difference that forms the basis of the ADM debit.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: passenger_name
attributes.description: Name of the passenger on the ticket associated with this ADM, as recorded in the PNR. Captured for audit and dispute evidence purposes. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: IATA PNRGOV Standard; GDPR Article 4; DOT Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric GDS booking reference (PNR locator) associated with the ticket or transaction underlying this ADM. Enables traceability back to the original reservation in Amadeus Altéa or the GDS.
attributes.references: IATA PNRGOV Standard; Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: IATA-standard reason code classifying the cause of the ADM (e.g., fare difference, commission clawback, ticketing error, refund discrepancy, tax error, waiver misuse). Drives downstream reporting and dispute categorisation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FARE|COMM|TAX|RFND|WAIV|TKTERR|POLICY|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; IATA ADM Reason Code Registry

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the specific reason for issuing the ADM, supplementing the structured reason code. Provides the agent with a human-readable explanation of the debit claim.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the ADM dispute was formally resolved (upheld, waived, or reversed). Null if the ADM is still open or undisputed. Used for SLA tracking and revenue recovery reporting.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome of the ADM dispute resolution process, including rationale for upholding, waiving, or reversing the debit. Captured by the revenue accounting team for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: settlement_channel
attributes.description: Billing and settlement channel through which this ADM is processed: BSP (IATA Billing and Settlement Plan for international markets), ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation for US market), or DIRECT (bilateral direct settlement outside BSP/ARC).
attributes.references: IATA BSP Operations Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component included within or associated with the ADM debit, such as VAT or applicable government taxes on the fare difference or commission recovery. May be zero if no tax applies.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; IATA Tax Code Registry; DOT Revenue Accounting Standards

attributes.name: ticket_issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the original ticket associated with this ADM was issued by the travel agent. Used to determine applicable fare rules, commission agreements, and statute of limitations for recovery.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ADM record, including status changes, dispute updates, resolution entries, or amount adjustments. Supports change data capture and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Airline-issued waiver or exception code authorising the reduction or cancellation of the ADM debit. Populated when the airline agrees to waive the claim, typically referencing a commercial agreement, goodwill gesture, or documented error by the airline.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850m; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

products.name: recognition
products.description: Revenue accounting transaction record representing the recognized revenue entry for a flown or used ticket coupon or EMD. Captures the accounting period, ticket/coupon reference, flight date, origin-destination, cabin, booking class, fare amount recognized, prorate share (for interline), tax amounts, surcharges, form of payment, passenger type, revenue recognition method (flown/accrual), interline prorate agreement reference, and accounting status (pending/recognized/adjusted/reversed). SSOT for passenger revenue recognition aligned with IATA revenue accounting standards and airline financial reporting.
products.reference: IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM) / IATA Resolution 743

attributes.name: recognition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for recognition

attributes.name: arc_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.arc_settlement. Business justification: Revenue recognition records for ARC-settled tickets should reference the ARC settlement batch. The bsp_arc_report_period attribute indicates settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritati

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Revenue recognition records track when revenue is recognized from flown/used tickets. The bsp_arc_report_period attribute indicates BSP settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative bs

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Revenue is attributed to cost centers (routes, hubs, regions) for profitability analysis, management reporting, and route P&L. Standard airline financial management practice.

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Revenue accounting must tie recognized revenue to the specific flight inventory instance flown for accurate proration, interline settlement, and GL posting. Required for IFRS 15 compliance, matching r

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Revenue accounting records post to GL for IFRS 15 compliance and financial statement preparation. Core integration between revenue and finance systems.

attributes.name: interline_prorate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.interline_prorate. Business justification: Revenue recognition records for interline journeys should reference the prorate agreement that governs revenue sharing. The prorate_agreement_reference and interline_partner_code attributes in recogni

attributes.name: origin_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Revenue accounting requires origin station FK for cost center allocation, station-level P&L reporting, interline settlement, and GL posting by station. Origin_airport_code is denormalized station refe

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Revenue accounting records feed regulatory financial filings (DOT Form 41, IATA financial reports, bilateral agreement traffic reports). Airlines must file periodic revenue reports to authorities; thi

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Revenue accounting requires route-level attribution for prorate agreement application, bilateral settlement calculations, and P&L reporting by route. Route determines prorate factors, interline partne

attributes.name: ticket_coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket_coupon. Business justification: revenue_recognition records represent recognized revenue entries for flown or used travel. Each accounting record corresponds to one ticket coupon (flight segment). The table has ticket_number and cou

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Financial accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which this revenue is recognized, aligned with the airline's fiscal calendar. Drives period-close reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and DOT financial filings.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: accounting_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this revenue recognition record: PENDING (awaiting period-close processing), RECOGNIZED (revenue posted to GL), ADJUSTED (corrected after initial recognition), REVERSED (voided/cancelled entry), DISPUTED (under interline billing dispute).
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for a revenue adjustment or reversal (e.g., IROP reprotection, involuntary downgrade, fare recalculation, interline dispute resolution). Populated only when accounting_status is ADJUSTED or REVERSED.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) representing the fare class/inventory bucket in which the ticket was booked (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V). Drives yield management analysis and links to Sabre AirVision fare class buckets.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: IATA cabin class code indicating the physical cabin in which the passenger traveled: F (First), C (Business), W (Premium Economy), Y (Economy). Used for cabin-level revenue disaggregation and yield analysis.

attributes.name: codeshare_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coupon was flown on a codeshare flight where the issuing carrier's flight number was marketed but operated by a partner airline. Affects revenue recognition treatment and interline settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 (Codeshare); DOT Codeshare Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue accounting record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and period-close reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival station of the coupon segment. Combined with origin forms the O&D pair for revenue accounting and yield management analysis.

attributes.name: emd_number
attributes.description: IATA Electronic Miscellaneous Document number when this revenue recognition record relates to an ancillary service (e.g., excess baggage, seat upgrade, lounge access) rather than a flight coupon. Null for standard flight coupons.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: IATA Rate of Exchange (IROE) applied to convert the fare from the ticketing currency to the settlement/reporting currency at the time of ticketing. Used for multi-currency revenue normalization in financial reporting.

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount recognized for this coupon in the settlement currency, excluding taxes and surcharges. For interline itineraries this is the prorated share allocated to this carrier. Core revenue figure for RASK and yield calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric fare basis code (e.g., YLOWUS, QXAP21) identifying the specific fare rule set applied to this ticket coupon. Encodes cabin, booking class, restrictions, and seasonality. Key reference for revenue accounting and prorate calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Fare Basis Code Standard; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the flight on which the coupon was flown or the service was consumed. This is the primary business event date for revenue recognition under the flown basis.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA airline designator and numeric flight number (e.g., AA1234) identifying the operating flight on which the coupon was consumed. Used to link revenue to flight operations data.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_type
attributes.description: Category of payment instrument used to purchase the ticket: CASH, CC (Credit Card), CHECK, VOUCHER, MILES (frequent flyer redemption), AGENCY (agency credit), OTHER. Drives revenue disaggregation between cash and non-cash revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CASH|CC|CHECK|VOUCHER|MILES|AGENCY|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Carrier-imposed fuel surcharge (IATA codes YQ for fuel surcharge, YR for carrier-imposed miscellaneous surcharge) collected on this coupon. Tracked separately for revenue accounting transparency and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT Surcharge Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: interline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coupon is part of an interline itinerary involving two or more carriers under an interline ticketing agreement. When true, prorate_amount and prorate_agreement_reference are applicable.

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA designator of the airline that issued the ticket document. May differ from the operating carrier on codeshare or interline itineraries. Used to determine revenue accounting ownership.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: operating_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA designator of the airline that physically operated the flight. Differs from issuing_airline_code on codeshare flights. Required for IATA SSIM reporting and DOT on-time performance attribution.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; DOT 14 CFR Part 234

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA Passenger Type Code indicating the category of traveler: ADT (Adult), CHD (Child), INF (Infant), MIL (Military), GOV (Government), STU (Student). Affects fare applicability and revenue disaggregation.

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record locator from the Amadeus Altéa PSS linking this revenue record to the originating reservation. Used for traceability between revenue accounting and reservation systems.
attributes.references: IATA PNRGOV Standard; Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: prorate_amount
attributes.description: The carrier's prorated share of the total through-fare for interline itineraries, calculated per the applicable IATA prorate agreement or bilateral prorate factor. Equals fare_amount for online (single-carrier) itineraries.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850 (Interline Revenue Accounting); IATA MITA

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: Method by which revenue is recognized for this record: FLOWN (recognized upon flight completion), ACCRUAL (deferred/accrual basis), PRORATE (interline prorate allocation), REDEMPTION (FFP miles redemption), REVERSAL (corrective reversal entry). Aligns with IFRS 15 performance obligation satisfaction.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; IATA Revenue Accounting Standards

attributes.name: recognition_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition entry was processed and posted in the revenue accounting system. Represents the business event time of recognition, distinct from the flight date and the record audit timestamp.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; IATA Revenue Accounting Standards

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: Fare amount converted to the airline's functional reporting currency (e.g., USD) using the IROE exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and DOT/IATA statistical submissions.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; IATA Revenue Accounting Standards

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the fare and surcharge amounts are denominated for BSP/ARC settlement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the settlement currency for interline billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA BSP Settlement Rules; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating revenue accounting system (Sabre AirVision Revenue Management or SAP S/4HANA) for traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all government-mandated taxes collected on this coupon (e.g., departure tax, VAT, PFC, segment tax). Reported separately from fare revenue per IATA revenue accounting standards and DOT reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399; IATA Revenue Accounting Standards

attributes.name: ticket_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the original ticket was issued. Used to determine the advance purchase window, applicable fare rules, and the deferred revenue liability period between ticketing and flight date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this revenue accounting record (e.g., adjustment, status change, prorate recalculation). Used for incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI

products.name: interline_prorate
products.description: Interline prorate agreement and proration record defining how revenue from a multi-carrier itinerary is split between participating airlines. Captures prorate agreement type (IATA pro-rate factor/mileage/specific prorate agreement), partner carrier code, applicable route/market, prorate factor or amount, currency, effective and expiry dates, agreement reference number, and proration calculation method. Also stores actual proration transaction records for settled interline billing. Aligns with IATA interline billing and settlement standards.
products.reference: IATA Interline Prorate Agreement / IATA Resolution 743

attributes.name: interline_prorate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each interline prorate agreement or proration transaction record in the silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: arc_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.arc_settlement. Business justification: Interline prorate settlements can also be processed through ARC channels. The settlement_period attribute indicates settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative arc_settlement record.

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Interline prorate settlements are processed through BSP channels. The settlement_period attribute indicates settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative bsp_settlement record. Standar

attributes.name: interline_billing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.interline_billing. Business justification: Prorate agreements drive interline billing transactions for settlement with partner airlines. Direct operational dependency for interline revenue accounting.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Prorate agreements are route-specific; route determines applicable bilateral ASA, traffic rights category, and revenue split methodology between operating and marketing carriers. Essential for interli

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: interline_prorate records define how revenue from multi-carrier itineraries is split between airlines. Each proration transaction references one ticket. The table has ticket_number (STRING) as a busin

attributes.name: agreement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number assigned to the interline prorate agreement, used for identification in IATA billing and settlement communications. Corresponds to the Specific Prorate Agreement (SPA) or IATA pro-rate factor agreement identifier. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interline prorate agreement: ACTIVE (in force), SUSPENDED (temporarily halted), EXPIRED (past effective period), TERMINATED (cancelled before expiry), PENDING (awaiting activation). LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interline prorate agreement method: SPA (Specific Prorate Agreement), IATA_PRF (IATA Pro-Rate Factor), MILEAGE (mileage-based proration), FIXED_AMOUNT (fixed monetary split), or PERCENTAGE (percentage-based split). CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Cabin class to which this prorate agreement applies, restricting the agreement to a specific service level (e.g., FIRST, BUSINESS, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, ECONOMY). Null if the agreement applies to all cabin classes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the revenue proration between interline carriers: PROPORTIONAL (based on segment distance), EQUAL_SPLIT (equal share per carrier), MILEAGE_RATIO (IATA mileage-based), AGREED_FACTOR (bilaterally negotiated factor), FIXED (fixed amount per agreement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PROPORTIONAL|EQUAL_SPLIT|MILEAGE_RATIO|AGREED_FACTOR|FIXED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: collected_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total fare amount collected from the passenger for the interline itinerary, in the settlement currency. This is the gross base amount from which the prorate split is calculated. MONETARY_TRIPLET — gross base amount.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline prorate record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the prorate amount or settlement value is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Applies to FIXED_AMOUNT and PERCENTAGE agreement types.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 850; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination point of the interline route or market to which this prorate agreement applies.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes (IATA Resolution 763); ICAO Doc 7910

attributes.name: directionality
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prorate agreement applies to one-way (OW), round-trip (RT), or circle-trip (CT) itineraries. Aligns with IATA fare directionality conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proration transaction or agreement is subject to an interline billing dispute: NONE (no dispute), DISPUTED (partner carrier has raised a dispute), UNDER_REVIEW (dispute under investigation), RESOLVED (dispute settled).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Billing Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the interline prorate agreement becomes binding and applicable to interline revenue splits. EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interline prorate agreement ceases to be binding. Null indicates an open-ended agreement with no defined termination date. EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Fare basis code restricting the applicability of this prorate agreement to a specific fare product or fare family. Null if the agreement applies across all fare basis codes in the market.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: global_indicator
attributes.description: Two-letter IATA global indicator code defining the geographic routing area applicable to this prorate agreement (e.g., AT for Atlantic, PA for Pacific, AP for Asia-Pacific, EH for Eastern Hemisphere). Constrains the routing scope of the agreement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference — Global Indicators

attributes.name: iata_conference_area
attributes.description: IATA Traffic Conference area applicable to this prorate agreement: TC1 (Americas), TC2 (Europe, Middle East, Africa), TC3 (Asia-Pacific). Determines the IATA tariff conference jurisdiction governing the agreement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference — Traffic Conference Areas

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline prorate record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

attributes.name: maximum_prorate_amount
attributes.description: Ceiling value for the prorate allocation in the agreement currency. Caps the carrier's revenue share to prevent over-recovery on high-yield itineraries under fixed-factor agreements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: minimum_prorate_amount
attributes.description: Floor value for the prorate allocation in the agreement currency. Ensures the carrier receives at least this amount regardless of the calculated prorate factor or percentage. Protects against under-recovery on low-yield itineraries.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, special conditions, or negotiation notes associated with the interline prorate agreement or transaction. Used by revenue management analysts for context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Interline Module

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin point of the interline route or market to which this prorate agreement applies.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes (IATA Resolution 763); ICAO Doc 7910

attributes.name: own_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code of the operating airline (the airline owning this record) that is party to the prorate agreement.

attributes.name: partner_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code of the interline partner carrier participating in the prorate agreement. Identifies the counterparty airline for revenue split purposes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Airline Designator Codes; IATA Interline Traffic Agreement (ITA)

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA Passenger Type Code (PTC) indicating the passenger category (e.g., ADT for adult, CHD for child, INF for infant) to which this prorate agreement applies. Null if applicable to all passenger types.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Passenger Type Codes

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record (PNR) locator from the Amadeus Altéa PSS or GDS, linking the proration transaction to the passenger booking record.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa PSS — PNR Standards

attributes.name: prorate_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount allocated to this carrier under the prorate agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Used for FIXED_AMOUNT agreement types where a specific dollar/currency value is agreed rather than a factor or percentage.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP)

attributes.name: prorate_basis
attributes.description: The underlying basis on which proration is computed: FARE (based on published fare components), MILEAGE (based on IATA TPM/MPM mileage), WEIGHT (cargo weight-based, for cargo interline), or REVENUE (based on actual collected revenue).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

attributes.name: prorate_factor
attributes.description: Numeric prorate factor (ratio) applied to the total fare to determine the revenue share allocated to this carrier's segment of the interline journey. Used for IATA_PRF and MILEAGE agreement types. Value between 0 and 1 representing the carrier's proportional share.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Pro-Rate Factor Methodology

attributes.name: prorate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total interline fare revenue allocated to this carrier under the prorate agreement. Used for PERCENTAGE agreement types. Value between 0.0000 and 100.0000.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

attributes.name: prorated_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue amount allocated to the own carrier after applying the prorate factor, percentage, or fixed amount to the collected fare. This is the carrier's actual revenue share from the interline itinerary. MONETARY_TRIPLET — net total.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA BSP Settlement Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents a prorate AGREEMENT (the standing agreement defining split rules) or a TRANSACTION (an actual proration event applied to a settled interline billing).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Interline Module

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total taxes, fees, and surcharges (e.g., PFC, government taxes, fuel surcharges) associated with the interline proration transaction. Excluded from the prorate base fare calculation per IATA standards. MONETARY_TRIPLET — adjustment amount.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; DOT 14 CFR Part 399; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: ticketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code of the carrier that issued the ticket for the interline itinerary. The ticketing carrier may differ from the operating carrier and determines BSP/ARC settlement responsibility.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA BSP Settlement Standards; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the actual proration transaction was applied to a settled interline billing. Populated only for TRANSACTION record types; null for AGREEMENT records. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: via_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for an intermediate connecting point that further qualifies the applicable market for this prorate agreement. Null if the agreement applies to all routings between origin and destination.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850; IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference

products.name: fare_family
products.description: Fare family (branded fare) master record defining a named bundle of fare conditions and ancillary inclusions marketed under a commercial brand name (e.g., Basic Economy, Standard, Flex, Business Lite, Business Plus). Captures fare family code, commercial brand name, cabin applicability, included services (carry-on baggage, checked baggage, seat selection, lounge access, miles accrual rate, change/refund conditions), fare class mapping, display priority, and marketing description. Enables branded fare merchandising across GDS, NDC, and direct channels.
products.reference: IATA Branded Fares / ATPCO Fare Families

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fare family (branded fare) record in the revenue management system. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a ticket must be purchased under this fare family. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement. Aligns with ATPCO Category 5 advance purchase rules.

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the ancillary services bundle configuration associated with this fare family in the ancillary revenue management system. Links to the specific set of included and excluded ancillary services (EMD-eligible items) for merchandising.
attributes.references: IATA EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial marketing name of the fare family as displayed to passengers across all sales channels (e.g., 'Basic Economy', 'Standard', 'Flex', 'Business Lite', 'Business Plus'). This is the customer-facing label used in GDS displays, NDC offers, and airline.com.

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Physical cabin of the aircraft to which this fare family applies. Determines the seating product and service level associated with the branded fare. Aligns with IATA cabin class designations.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-letter IATA airline designator code of the carrier that owns and markets this fare family. Used to scope the branded fare to a specific operating or marketing carrier in multi-carrier environments.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Codes; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: carry_on_bags_included
attributes.description: Number of carry-on bags included in the fare family at no additional charge. Zero indicates no carry-on is included (e.g., Basic Economy). Used for ancillary merchandising and EMD issuance logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 (Baggage); DOT Baggage Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: change_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee in the fare family's base currency charged to the passenger for changing an itinerary when change_permitted is true. Zero indicates a fee-free change. Null indicates changes are not permitted.

attributes.name: change_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is permitted to change the itinerary (date, routing, or flight) on a ticket issued under this fare family. When true, change_fee_amount may apply.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259 (Consumer Protections)

attributes.name: checked_bags_included
attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included in the fare family at no additional charge. Drives ancillary upsell logic and EMD issuance in Amadeus Altéa. Reported per DOT baggage disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 (Baggage); DOT 14 CFR Part 399 Baggage Disclosure

attributes.name: combinability_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether fares within this fare family may be combined with fares from other fare families or carriers to construct a round-trip or multi-sector itinerary. Aligns with ATPCO Category 10 combinability rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this fare family record was first created in the revenue management system. Provides audit trail for fare family lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which change_fee_amount and refund_fee_amount are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with IATA BSP settlement currency conventions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this fare family is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates the fare family is open-ended with no planned end date. Aligns with ATPCO discontinue date conventions.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Integer ranking that controls the display order of fare families in shopping results across GDS, NDC, and direct channels. Lower values indicate higher display priority (e.g., 1 = displayed first). Used by Sabre AirVision and Amadeus Altéa for branded fare shelf ordering.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA NDC Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this fare family becomes commercially active and available for sale across all applicable channels. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing effective date conventions.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: family_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fare family in the revenue management and merchandising system. ACTIVE = currently sold; DRAFT = under configuration; RETIRED = no longer sold; SUSPENDED = temporarily withdrawn from sale.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: fare_class_mapping
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of one-letter IATA booking class codes (RBDs) that are associated with this fare family (e.g., 'Y,B,M,H'). Defines which inventory buckets in Amadeus Altéa and Sabre AirVision are merchandised under this branded fare.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: fare_family_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fare family across GDS, NDC, and direct channels (e.g., BASICECO, FLEX, BIZPLUS). Used as the business key in Sabre AirVision and distributed to Amadeus Altéa for branded fare merchandising.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 (Branded Fares); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: gds_display_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare family is visible and bookable through Global Distribution System (GDS) channels (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). When false, the fare family is restricted to direct or NDC channels only.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: interline_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this fare family may be used on interline partner carrier segments. When false, the fare family is restricted to the issuing carrier's own-metal flights only.
attributes.references: IATA Interline Traffic Agreements; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this fare family record was most recently modified in the revenue management system. Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental lakehouse ingestion.

attributes.name: lounge_access_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary airport lounge access is included as part of this fare family's service bundle. Typically applicable to premium cabin fare families (Business Plus, First).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Short customer-facing marketing description of the fare family's value proposition, displayed in booking flows and GDS/NDC shopping responses (e.g., 'Our most flexible fare with full refund and free seat selection'). Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: maximum_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare family's conditions. Null indicates no maximum stay restriction. Aligns with ATPCO Category 7.

attributes.name: meal_service_type
attributes.description: Type of complimentary meal or catering service included with this fare family. NONE = no complimentary meal; SNACK = light snack; MEAL = standard meal; PREMIUM_MEAL = enhanced meal selection; MULTI_COURSE = full multi-course dining (typically First/Business).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: miles_accrual_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Miles Accrual Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of base miles earned per Revenue Passenger Kilometer (RPK) flown under this fare family, expressed as a decimal multiplier (e.g., 0.50 = 50%, 1.00 = 100%, 1.50 = 150%). Feeds Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP mileage posting logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Oracle Loyalty Cloud (FFP Management)

attributes.name: minimum_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare family's conditions. Zero or null indicates no minimum stay requirement. Aligns with ATPCO Category 6.

attributes.name: ndc_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare family is available for distribution via IATA New Distribution Capability (NDC) API channels, enabling rich offer and order management with full ancillary bundling.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA Passenger Type Code (PTC) indicating the passenger category eligible for this fare family (e.g., ADT = Adult, CHD = Child, INF = Infant, MIL = Military). Null indicates the fare family applies to all passenger types.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Type Codes; ATPCO Passenger Type Codes

attributes.name: priority_boarding_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether priority boarding is included as part of this fare family's service bundle, allowing passengers to board before general boarding groups.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: refund_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee in the fare family's base currency charged to the passenger when processing a refund where refund_permitted is true. Zero indicates a fee-free refund. Null indicates refunds are not permitted.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: refund_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a refund to the original form of payment is permitted for tickets issued under this fare family. Drives refund eligibility logic in Amadeus Altéa and BSP/ARC settlement processing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: route_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic scope of routes to which this fare family applies. DOMESTIC = within a single country; INTERNATIONAL = cross-border; TRANSOCEANIC = long-haul intercontinental; ALL = no geographic restriction.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: sabre_brand_code
attributes.description: Native brand identifier assigned to this fare family within the Sabre AirVision Revenue Management system. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational Sabre environment.

attributes.name: seat_selection_included
attributes.description: Level of complimentary seat selection included with this fare family. NONE = no free seat selection; STANDARD = standard seats only; PREFERRED = preferred/extra-legroom seats; ANY = unrestricted seat selection including premium seats.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric tier ranking of this fare family within its cabin class, used for upsell and cross-sell logic (e.g., 1 = entry-level Basic Economy, 2 = Standard, 3 = Flex within Economy cabin). Enables structured upsell path configuration in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this fare family are eligible for complimentary or paid cabin upgrades (e.g., using miles, cash, or status). Feeds upgrade inventory logic in Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory; Oracle Loyalty Cloud (FFP Management)

attributes.name: wifi_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary in-flight Wi-Fi connectivity is included as part of this fare family's ancillary service bundle.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

products.name: corporate_contract
products.description: Corporate travel contract record defining negotiated fare agreements between the airline and corporate accounts or travel management companies (TMCs). Captures contract reference number, corporate account name and ID, contract type (net fare/discount/commission override/soft dollar), applicable markets and routes, discount percentage or net fare amounts, minimum volume commitment (revenue or segment targets), contract period, blackout dates, reporting requirements, account manager, and contract status (draft/active/expired/suspended). SSOT for corporate pricing and B2B revenue agreements.
products.reference: IATA Corporate Travel Agreement Standards

attributes.name: corporate_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the corporate travel contract record in the revenue management system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account or Travel Management Company (TMC) that is party to this contract. Links to the corporate account master record.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the airline's account manager responsible for managing and maintaining this corporate contract relationship. Links to the workforce/HR employee master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module — Employee Master

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Corporate contracts frequently specify aircraft type restrictions (widebody-only for long-haul, specific cabin configurations). Contract compliance validation, pricing accuracy, and inventory allocati

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.bundle. Business justification: Corporate contracts negotiate specific ancillary bundle inclusions (e.g., free checked bags, lounge access for all travelers). Contract management and corporate booking tools require this link to enfo

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Corporate contracts often specify which fare families (branded fares) are eligible under the contract. The applicable_cabin_classes and applicable_booking_classes attributes suggest fare family applic

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Corporate contracts often specify individual traveler FFP accounts for mileage accrual despite company payment. Tracks personal loyalty benefits within corporate travel programs. New attribute; no exi

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Corporate travel contracts often specify preferred ground handlers, catering suppliers, or FBO services as part of negotiated packages. Airlines track these vendor preferences to ensure contract compl

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Corporate discount contracts often require regulatory filing under bilateral air service agreements and government contract disclosure rules. DOT requires filing of certain corporate agreements; inter

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a booking must be made to qualify for the negotiated corporate fare. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 5; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: applicable_booking_classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) booking class codes to which this contract's fares apply (e.g., 'Y|B|M|K'). Governs inventory access in the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — RBD Standards; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: applicable_cabin_classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of cabin classes to which the negotiated fares or discounts under this contract apply (e.g., 'Y|C|F' for Economy, Business, First). Aligns with IATA cabin class designators.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Designators; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corporate contract is set to automatically renew upon reaching the expiry date without requiring a new signed agreement. True = auto-renews; False = requires manual renewal.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of specific dates or date ranges (in yyyy-MM-dd format) during which the corporate contract fares are not applicable (e.g., peak holiday periods, major events). Stored as a structured string for downstream parsing.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter designator of the operating or marketing carrier to which this corporate contract applies. Relevant for codeshare and interline agreements where the contracting carrier may differ from the operating carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; ICAO Doc 8585

attributes.name: changeable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this corporate contract permit voluntary changes (rebooking). True = changes permitted; False = no changes allowed. Governs change fee waiver rules.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 31; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: commission_override_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate (as a percentage) paid to the TMC or travel agent above the standard base commission, applicable when contract_type is 'commission_override'. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 = 5%).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 824; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the corporate contract, typically including the corporate account name and contract year (e.g., 'Acme Corp Global Agreement 2024'). Used for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the corporate contract, used in correspondence with the corporate account and TMC. Serves as the business identifier across systems including Sabre AirVision and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the corporate contract. Draft: under negotiation. Active: in force and bookable. Expired: past end date. Suspended: temporarily halted. Terminated: cancelled before end date.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing mechanism governing this corporate agreement. Net fare: fixed negotiated fare net of commission. Discount: percentage reduction off published fare. Commission override: elevated agency commission. Soft dollar: non-cash incentive credits. Zone fare: flat fare within a geographic zone.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 824 — Interline and Corporate Fare Agreements; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: corporate_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the corporate account or TMC for contract-related communications, reporting delivery, and renewal notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: corporate_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the corporate account or TMC who is the counterpart for this contract. Used for contract correspondence and account management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corporate contract record was first created in the revenue management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values (net fare amounts, volume commitments, soft dollar credits) under this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 024a — Currency Standards

attributes.name: destination_airport_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of IATA three-letter airport codes representing the destination points covered by this corporate contract. Null or wildcard indicates all destinations are applicable.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated percentage discount applied to the applicable published or base fare for this corporate contract. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Applicable when contract_type is 'discount'. Null for net_fare or commission_override contracts.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Pricing; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the corporate contract terms become binding and fares are bookable. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing effective dates where applicable.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corporate contract ceases to be binding. After this date, fares under this contract are no longer bookable unless the contract is renewed. Nullable for open-ended agreements.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: gds_corporate_code
attributes.description: Unique corporate code loaded into the Global Distribution System (GDS) — such as Amadeus, Sabre, or Travelport — that travel agents and TMCs use to access the negotiated corporate fares when booking on behalf of the corporate account.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory — Corporate Fare Access; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this corporate contract record in the revenue management system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: min_revenue_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum annual or contract-period revenue (in contract currency) that the corporate account commits to generate under this agreement. Used for volume-based tier qualification and rebate calculations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: min_segment_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of flight segments the corporate account commits to book with the airline during the contract period. Used alongside or as an alternative to min_revenue_commitment for volume qualification.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: net_fare_amount
attributes.description: Fixed negotiated net fare amount agreed under this corporate contract, net of all commissions and agency fees. Applicable when contract_type is 'net_fare'. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Pricing; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: origin_airport_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of IATA three-letter airport codes representing the origin points covered by this corporate contract. Null or wildcard indicates all origins are applicable.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: pnr_corporate_code
attributes.description: Corporate identifier embedded in the PNR (Passenger Name Record) to associate bookings with this corporate contract for tracking, reporting, and volume measurement purposes within the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory — PNR Corporate Field; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rebate paid back to the corporate account when volume commitments are met or exceeded. Expressed as a percentage of qualifying revenue (e.g., 3.00 = 3%).
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: rebate_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Revenue threshold (in contract currency) that the corporate account must exceed to qualify for a volume rebate payment. When actual revenue exceeds this threshold, the rebate_rate applies to the qualifying spend.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: refundable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this corporate contract are refundable. True = refundable; False = non-refundable. Governs refund processing in the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 33; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for contract renewal review or automatic renewal. Used by account managers to trigger renegotiation workflows ahead of expiry.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: reporting_requirement
attributes.description: Frequency at which the airline is contractually obligated to provide travel and spend reports to the corporate account or TMC. Drives automated report scheduling in the revenue management system.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; DOT Consumer Protection

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corporate contract was formally executed and signed by both the airline and the corporate account or TMC. Used for audit and legal compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: soft_dollar_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total non-cash incentive credit amount committed under this contract for soft dollar arrangements (e.g., upgrades, lounge access, marketing co-op funds). Applicable when contract_type is 'soft_dollar'. Expressed in contract currency.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; DOT Consumer Protection

attributes.name: volume_measurement_period
attributes.description: The time period over which minimum volume commitments (revenue or segment) are measured and evaluated for compliance and rebate qualification.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

products.name: revenue_refund
products.description: Refund transaction record capturing the processing of a ticket or EMD refund to a passenger or agent. Stores refund reference number, original ticket/EMD number, refund type (voluntary/involuntary/IROP/schedule change), refund amount, penalty amount deducted, tax refund breakdown, refund method (original form of payment/voucher/miles), refund request date, processing date, refund status (requested/approved/processed/rejected/pending), approving agent or system, and BSP/ARC refund indicator. SSOT for refund liability management and revenue reversal accounting.
products.reference: IATA Refund Standards / BSP Refund Processing

attributes.name: revenue_refund_id
attributes.description: Primary key for refund

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Refunds create AP obligations to passengers or agents. Required for cash disbursement processing and AP aging.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: Refunds processed through travel agencies should reference the agency master. The travel_agent_iata_code attribute in revenue_refund should reference the authoritative agency record. Standard N:1 rela

attributes.name: arc_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.arc_settlement. Business justification: Refunds processed through ARC channels are included in ARC settlement batches. The bsp_arc_settlement_date attribute suggests settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative arc_settleme

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Refunds processed through BSP channels are included in BSP settlement batches. The bsp_arc_settlement_date attribute suggests settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative bsp_settleme

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the airline agent, travel agent IATA code, or automated system (e.g., 'AUTO-IROP-ENGINE') that approved the refund. Used for audit, fraud detection, and agent performance tracking. Populated with a system identifier when approval is automated.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Internal Audit and Compliance Standard

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Refunds resulting from maintenance-induced cancellations/delays must link to causative work orders for cost recovery from maintenance providers, dispute resolution, and operational impact tracking. Cr

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger (traveller) record who is the beneficiary of this refund. Links to the passenger master data entity in the Passenger domain.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: revenue_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.emd. Business justification: revenue_refund can also process refunds for EMDs (ancillary services). Each refund may reference one EMD. The table has original_emd_number (STRING) as a business key. Adding emd_id FK to emd.emd_id e

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: revenue_refund captures refund transactions for tickets. Each refund references one original ticket. The table has original_ticket_number (STRING) as a business key. Adding ticket_id FK to ticket.reve

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when the refund was approved by an authorised agent or automated revenue management rule engine. Distinct from the processed timestamp; captures the approval decision event in the refund workflow lifecycle.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management Workflow

attributes.name: bsp_arc_settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the refund amount was settled through the IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) or Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) settlement cycle. Null for direct refunds or miles refunds not routed through BSP/ARC.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Operations Manual; ARC Industry Agent Handbook

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: The cabin class of the original ticket being refunded. F — First Class; C — Business Class; W — Premium Economy; Y — Economy. Used for revenue reversal reporting segmented by cabin.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Cabin Class Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this refund transaction record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this refund transaction are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the currency of the original ticket sale.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 024 — Currency Regulations

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code of the final destination on the original ticket or EMD being refunded. Used for revenue reversal reporting by route and for regulatory reporting to DOT.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; DOT Form 41 Reporting

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: The net base fare amount approved for refund after deducting any applicable cancellation penalty from the gross fare amount. This is the fare component of the total refund disbursement. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: The ATPCO fare basis code of the original fare being refunded (e.g., 'YLOWUS', 'QSAVER'). Determines the applicable refund and penalty rules per ATPCO Category 16. Sourced from the original ticket coupon data in Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: ffp_miles_refunded
attributes.description: Number of Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles credited back to the passenger's loyalty account as the refund method, or miles reinstated when an award ticket is cancelled. Populated only when refund_method is 'miles'. Interfaces with Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management; IATA Resolution 735; Internal FFP Policy

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger (GL) account code to which the revenue reversal entry for this refund is posted (e.g., revenue reversal account, refund liability account). Enables reconciliation between the refund transaction system and the financial accounting system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — General Ledger Accounting; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM); IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: gross_fare_amount
attributes.description: The total base fare amount on the original ticket or EMD before any taxes, fees, or surcharges. Represents the revenue component subject to refund calculation and penalty deduction. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM)

attributes.name: involuntary_reason
attributes.description: For involuntary refunds, the specific airline-caused reason triggering the mandatory refund obligation. 'flight_cancellation' — flight cancelled by airline; 'significant_delay' — delay exceeding regulatory threshold; 'denied_boarding' — involuntary denied boarding (IDB); 'downgrade' — passenger downgraded to lower cabin; 'schedule_change' — schedule change beyond passenger tolerance. Null for voluntary refunds.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding; EU Regulation 261/2004 — Passenger Rights; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
