attributes.name: service_product_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_product

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Marketing campaigns promote specific cargo products (express, perishables, temperature-controlled, dangerous goods services). Linking products to campaigns enables product-level campaign effectiveness

attributes.name: acceptance_cutoff_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure by which cargo must be physically accepted at the origin station. Critical for operational planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: applicable_surcharges
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of surcharge codes that apply to this product (e.g., fuel surcharge, security surcharge, peak season surcharge). Used for rate calculation and billing.

attributes.name: booking_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Minimum advance booking time required before scheduled departure, measured in hours. Used to enforce operational cutoff times and capacity planning windows.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cargo service product record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_accepted
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product accepts dangerous goods shipments. Determines whether DG declarations and certifications are required for bookings.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: destination_region_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA region codes or airport codes where this product is available for destination bookings. Empty indicates global availability. Used for regional product offerings.

attributes.name: dimensional_weight_factor
attributes.description: Volumetric conversion factor used to calculate chargeable weight from shipment dimensions (typically 6000 for air cargo, representing cubic centimeters per kilogram). Used when volumetric weight exceeds actual weight.

attributes.name: discontinued_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cargo service product was discontinued and removed from active offerings. Null for active products. Used for product lifecycle analytics and historical reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this cargo service product is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates indefinite availability. Used for product lifecycle management and seasonal offerings.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cargo service product becomes available for booking and operational use. Used for product lifecycle management and seasonal offerings.

attributes.name: eligible_commodity_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA commodity codes eligible for this product. Defines which types of cargo can be booked under this service offering. Empty indicates all commodities accepted.

attributes.name: eligible_uld_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ULD type codes compatible with this product (e.g., AKE, LD3, PMC). Null if product does not support ULD containerization.

attributes.name: freighter_only_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product is restricted to dedicated freighter aircraft and cannot be carried in passenger aircraft belly cargo. Typically true for dangerous goods and oversized cargo.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: insurance_available
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether cargo insurance is available as an add-on for this product. Determines whether declared value for carriage can be specified at booking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cargo service product record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: live_animal_accepted
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product accepts live animal shipments. Determines applicability of IATA Live Animals Regulations (LAR) and special handling requirements.

attributes.name: maximum_piece_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight per individual piece accepted under this product, measured in kilograms. Null indicates no piece weight restriction. Used for operational feasibility and equipment capacity checks.

attributes.name: maximum_shipment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum total weight per shipment accepted under this product, measured in kilograms. Null indicates no shipment weight restriction. Used for capacity allocation and aircraft weight and balance.

attributes.name: minimum_chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: Minimum weight threshold in kilograms for rate calculation. Shipments below this weight are charged at this minimum. Null indicates no minimum.

attributes.name: origin_region_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA region codes or airport codes where this product is available for origin bookings. Empty indicates global availability. Used for regional product offerings.

attributes.name: priority_loading_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product receives priority loading on aircraft. True for express and premium products; affects weight and balance planning and turnaround sequencing.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the cargo service product in operational systems. Used for booking, rating, and billing. Aligns with Mercator product catalog codes.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cargo service product, including key features, benefits, and differentiators. Used for customer communication and sales enablement.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Marketing and operational name of the cargo service product (e.g., Express Freight, Cool Chain, Live Animals, Pharma Secure, Courier, General Cargo, Dangerous Goods Express).

attributes.name: product_owner
attributes.description: Business unit or department responsible for this cargo service product definition, pricing, and lifecycle management. Used for governance and accountability.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cargo service product. Controls availability for new bookings and operational visibility.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cargo service product by operational category. Determines handling requirements, equipment needs, and regulatory compliance obligations.

attributes.name: restricted_commodity_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA commodity codes explicitly excluded from this product. Used to enforce product-specific restrictions (e.g., no dangerous goods on standard service).

attributes.name: sales_channel_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels through which this product can be booked (e.g., direct, GDS, agent, web, mobile). Used for channel management and distribution strategy.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Service tier indicating speed, priority, and handling commitment. Determines transit time commitments, loading priority, and pricing tier.

attributes.name: special_handling_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA special handling codes (SHC) that apply by default to this product (e.g., PER for perishables, AVI for live animals, DGR for dangerous goods). Drives operational handling procedures.

attributes.name: temperature_control_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product requires active temperature control (cool chain, pharma). Determines equipment requirements and handling procedures.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference (CSC) Standards, IATA Temperature Control Regulations (TCR)

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature threshold in Celsius for temperature-controlled products. Null for non-temperature-controlled products. Used for cool chain and pharmaceutical cargo.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature threshold in Celsius for temperature-controlled products. Null for non-temperature-controlled products. Used for cool chain and pharmaceutical cargo.

attributes.name: tracking_capability_level
attributes.description: Level of shipment tracking and visibility provided for this product. Determines frequency of status updates and customer access to tracking data.

attributes.name: transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Committed maximum transit time from origin acceptance to destination delivery, measured in hours. Forms the basis of service level agreements (SLA) and On-Time Performance (OTP) measurement.

attributes.name: uld_compatible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this product supports Unit Load Device (ULD) containerization. Affects capacity planning, loading procedures, and pricing.

products.name: customs_entry
products.description: Customs declaration and clearance record for cargo crossing international borders. Captures customs entry number, AWB reference, entry type (import, export, transit, transshipment), commodity HS code, declared value, country of origin, country of destination, customs broker details, duty and tax amounts, customs status (filed, under examination, released, held, seized), examination type, release timestamp, and regulatory authority reference. Supports import/export compliance and customs clearance workflows.
products.reference: Customs Entry — WCO (World Customs Organization) / IATA e-freight

attributes.name: customs_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs declaration record. Primary key for the customs entry entity.

attributes.name: awb_id
attributes.description: Reference to the air waybill associated with this customs entry. Links the customs declaration to the shipment document.

attributes.name: customs_broker_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Customs brokerage services are procured from licensed vendors. Essential for broker performance tracking, clearance time SLAs, and reconciliation of customs clearance fees against vendor invoices.

attributes.name: customs_officer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Customs entries are processed by specific customs clearance officers. Regulatory requirement - must track who filed the entry for compliance audits and liability. Essential for customs broker accounta

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Customs duties and taxes paid or collected post to GL as expenses or liabilities. Critical for customs cost recovery, tax compliance, and cross-border trade accounting.

attributes.name: port_of_entry_station_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port Of Entry Station Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Customs entries specify port_of_entry_code for clearance. Station link validates customs facility availability, regulatory authority, broker assignment, operating hours, and examination capability for

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Each customs entry must comply with specific import/export regulations of the jurisdiction (e.g., CBP 19 CFR Part 122). Essential for customs clearance processes and compliance verification.

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of origin document supporting the declared country of origin. Required for preferential duty claims.

attributes.name: charges_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all customs charges and fees. Typically the currency of the importing or exporting country.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods being declared for customs purposes. Must accurately describe the nature, composition, and intended use of the cargo.

attributes.name: country_of_destination
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the final destination country for the goods. Used for export control and trade statistics.

attributes.name: country_of_export
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country from which the goods were exported. May differ from country of origin for re-exports.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the goods were manufactured or produced. Determines eligibility for preferential trade agreements and origin-based duties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this customs entry record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: customs_broker_license_number
attributes.description: Official license or registration number of the customs broker authorized to conduct customs business in the jurisdiction.

attributes.name: customs_duty_amount
attributes.description: Total customs duty assessed on the imported or exported goods. Calculated based on tariff classification, value, and applicable trade agreements.

attributes.name: declared_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the goods declared for customs purposes. Used as the basis for calculating duties and taxes.

attributes.name: declared_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the declared value amount. Must align with customs authority requirements for valuation.

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Official customs entry number assigned by the customs authority. Unique identifier for tracking the declaration through customs clearance process.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customs entry in the clearance workflow. Tracks progression from initial filing through final release or other disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|under_examination|released|held|seized|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Type of customs declaration indicating the nature of the cargo movement across borders. Determines applicable customs procedures and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: examination_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the customs examination or inspection. Indicates whether the cargo passed inspection or if issues were identified.

attributes.name: examination_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when customs examination or inspection was conducted. Null if no examination was performed.

attributes.name: examination_type
attributes.description: Type of customs examination or inspection conducted on the cargo. Ranges from documentary review to full physical inspection.

attributes.name: exporter_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the party exporting the goods. Required for export declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: exporter_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number or business registration number of the exporter. Required for export documentation and compliance.

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customs declaration was officially filed with the customs authority. Critical for compliance with advance filing requirements.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the cargo is being held by customs. May include documentation issues, valuation disputes, or regulatory concerns.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International commodity classification code used to determine applicable duties, taxes, and regulatory requirements. Six to ten digit code from the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System.

attributes.name: importer_of_record
attributes.description: Legal name of the party responsible for ensuring imported goods comply with local laws and for paying duties and taxes. Legally liable entity for the import.

attributes.name: importer_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number or business registration number of the importer of record. Required for customs clearance and duty payment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this customs entry record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes to the declaration.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which customs duties and taxes are paid. May include immediate payment or deferred payment arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|check|wire_transfer|ach|periodic_monthly_statement|bond|deferred — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Transaction reference number for the payment of customs duties and taxes. Links the customs entry to financial settlement records.

attributes.name: preferential_trade_agreement
attributes.description: Name or code of the preferential trade agreement under which reduced duties are claimed. Examples include USMCA, EU-FTA, ASEAN agreements.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs or regulatory authority responsible for processing this entry. May be port-specific or national authority code.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cargo was officially released by customs for delivery or onward movement. Marks completion of customs clearance process.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or notes related to the customs entry. May include handling instructions or clarifications.

attributes.name: special_program_indicator
attributes.description: Code or flag indicating participation in special customs programs such as AEO (Authorized Economic Operator), C-TPAT, or bonded warehouse programs.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount assessed on the goods, including VAT, GST, excise, or other applicable taxes. Separate from customs duty.

attributes.name: total_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total of all customs duties, taxes, and fees assessed on this entry. Sum of all financial obligations to clear the cargo.

products.name: interline_cargo
products.description: Interline cargo agreement and proration record governing cargo carried on partner airline segments under a single AWB. Captures interline agreement reference, partner airline code, route segments, proration method (IATA prorate factor, bilateral rate, mileage proration), interline revenue share per segment, settlement currency, CASS settlement reference, interline AWB prefix, and agreement validity. Supports multi-carrier cargo revenue settlement. Aligns with Mercator interline module.
products.reference: Interline Cargo — IATA Interline Traffic Agreements / CASS

attributes.name: interline_cargo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interline cargo agreement record.

attributes.name: awb_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master air waybill under which this interline cargo is carried.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Interline revenue and cost shares post to GL for consolidated financial reporting and interline settlement accounting. Links interline operations to financial statements.

attributes.name: interline_billing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.interline_billing. Business justification: Interline cargo segments generate proration billing entries for settlement with partner airlines. Essential for IATA interline billing, CASS settlement, and partner revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: operating_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.operating_certificate. Business justification: Interline cargo operations require valid operating certificates for each carrier segment. Essential for verifying partner airline authorization and route authority compliance in interline agreements.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Interline cargo segments are prorated and settled by route. Partner settlement, proration calculation, and interline revenue management require route context for each segment. Critical for interline a

attributes.name: segment_origin_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Interline segments track segment_origin_station_code for transfer. Station link provides transfer infrastructure, ground handler, minimum connect time, and customs capability for proration and settlem

attributes.name: agreement_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the interline cargo agreement becomes valid and applicable to shipments.

attributes.name: agreement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interline cargo agreement expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null indicates an open-ended agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interline cargo agreement governing this shipment.

attributes.name: cass_settlement_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cargo Accounts Settlement Systems (CASS) Settlement Reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this interline cargo record to the IATA CASS settlement transaction for inter-carrier billing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline cargo record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this interline cargo segment contains dangerous goods requiring special handling and documentation.

attributes.name: handling_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA code of the airline responsible for physical handling and acceptance of cargo at the interline transfer point.

attributes.name: interline_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the bilateral or multilateral interline cargo agreement governing this shipment.

attributes.name: interline_awb_prefix
attributes.description: Three-digit AWB prefix assigned to the partner airline for interline cargo documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline cargo record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: partner_airline_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter IATA airline code of the partner carrier operating the interline segment.

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Numeric factor applied to calculate the partner airline's revenue share when using IATA prorate factor method. Typically a decimal value between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate revenue between carriers for this interline segment. IATA prorate factor applies standard industry formulas, bilateral rate uses negotiated carrier-to-carrier rates, mileage proration allocates by distance, special prorate agreement applies custom terms, and fixed amount uses predetermined values.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this interline cargo agreement or segment.

attributes.name: route_segment_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of this segment within the multi-carrier routing (1 for first segment, 2 for second, etc.).

attributes.name: segment_chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: Chargeable weight in kilograms used for revenue calculation on this interline segment, which may differ from actual weight based on volumetric calculations.

attributes.name: segment_destination_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination of this interline segment.

attributes.name: segment_flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the partner airline flight carrying this interline cargo segment.

attributes.name: segment_flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number operated by the partner airline for this interline cargo segment.

attributes.name: segment_pieces
attributes.description: Number of individual pieces or packages carried on this interline segment.

attributes.name: segment_revenue_share_amount
attributes.description: Calculated revenue amount allocated to the partner airline for operating this interline segment, based on the proration method.

attributes.name: segment_revenue_share_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the segment revenue share amount.

attributes.name: segment_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Volume in cubic meters of cargo carried on this interline segment.

attributes.name: segment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual or allocated weight in kilograms of cargo carried on this interline segment.

attributes.name: settlement_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the interline revenue settlement for this cargo segment was finalized and funds transferred between carriers.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for final interline settlement between carriers.

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: IATA CASS billing period identifier (typically YYYYMM format) during which this interline cargo settlement is processed.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the interline revenue settlement process for this cargo segment.

attributes.name: settlement_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the interline revenue settlement for this cargo segment was submitted to IATA CASS for processing.

attributes.name: special_handling_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA special handling codes applicable to this interline cargo segment (e.g., PER for perishable, AVI for live animals, DGR for dangerous goods).

attributes.name: transfer_manifest_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the cargo manifest documenting the transfer of cargo between carriers at the interline point.

attributes.name: uld_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the ULD container or pallet used to transport cargo on this interline segment, if applicable.

products.name: cargo_surcharge
products.description: Cargo surcharge rate master record defining all applicable surcharges applied on top of base freight rates. Captures surcharge code, surcharge name (fuel surcharge FSC, security surcharge SSC, handling surcharge, DG surcharge, oversize surcharge, remote area surcharge, currency adjustment factor CAF), calculation basis (per kg, per shipment, per AWB, percentage of freight), rate amount, currency, origin/destination applicability, validity period, and surcharge status. Reference entity used in rating and invoicing.
products.reference: Cargo Surcharge — IATA TACT / Cargo Services Conference

attributes.name: cargo_surcharge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cargo surcharge rate record. Primary key.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Surcharges are revenue line items that post to specific GL accounts for revenue recognition and surcharge revenue reporting. Essential for fuel surcharge and security fee accounting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for the surcharge rate. Ensures proper authorization before surcharge becomes active.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the revenue management or pricing authority who approved this surcharge rate.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surcharge rate was approved for use.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the surcharge amount (per kilogram, per shipment, per Air Waybill (AWB), percentage of base freight, flat rate per transaction, or per piece).

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) or airline-specific commodity code to which the surcharge applies. Null indicates surcharge applies to all commodities.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the surcharge rate record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surcharge rate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for destination applicability. Used when surcharge applies to entire country rather than specific station.

attributes.name: destination_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for destination applicability (e.g., EMEA, APAC, AMER). Used for regional surcharge rules.

attributes.name: destination_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or station code where the surcharge applies at destination. Null indicates surcharge applies to all destinations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the surcharge rate becomes valid and applicable to new bookings and shipments.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surcharge rate ceases to be valid. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the surcharge rate record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surcharge rate record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Maximum surcharge amount cap. Limits the surcharge to prevent excessive charges on high-value or high-weight shipments.

attributes.name: minimum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Minimum surcharge amount to be applied regardless of calculated value. Ensures a floor charge for the surcharge.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for origin applicability. Used when surcharge applies to entire country rather than specific station.

attributes.name: origin_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for origin applicability (e.g., EMEA, APAC, AMER). Used for regional surcharge rules.

attributes.name: origin_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or station code where the surcharge applies at origin. Null indicates surcharge applies to all origins.

attributes.name: pass_through_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surcharge is a pass-through charge collected on behalf of a third party (e.g., government, airport authority) versus airline revenue. True if pass-through, False if airline revenue.

attributes.name: published_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surcharge rate has been published to external systems (GDS, cargo portals, agent systems). True if published, False if internal only.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surcharge rate was published to external distribution channels.

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: Numeric value of the surcharge rate. Interpretation depends on calculation_basis (e.g., dollar amount per kg, percentage value, flat fee amount).

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the surcharge rate is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Legal or regulatory justification for the surcharge (e.g., government-mandated security fee, environmental levy, customs processing fee). Used for compliance and transparency.
attributes.references: ICAO Policies on Charges for Airports and Air Navigation Services

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or explanatory information about the surcharge rate.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of route to which the surcharge applies (domestic within country, international cross-border, regional within continent, intercontinental long-haul).

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Cargo service level to which the surcharge applies. Null indicates surcharge applies to all service levels.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA Special Handling Code (SHC) to which the surcharge applies (e.g., DGR for Dangerous Goods, PER for Perishables, VAL for Valuables, AVI for Live Animals). Null indicates surcharge applies regardless of handling requirements.

attributes.name: surcharge_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the surcharge type for grouping and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: surcharge_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the surcharge type (e.g., FSC for Fuel Surcharge, SSC for Security Surcharge, DGS for Dangerous Goods Surcharge, OVS for Oversize Surcharge, RAS for Remote Area Surcharge, CAF for Currency Adjustment Factor, HAN for Handling Surcharge).

attributes.name: surcharge_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the surcharge (e.g., Fuel Surcharge, Security Surcharge, Dangerous Goods Handling Surcharge, Oversize Cargo Surcharge, Remote Area Delivery Surcharge, Currency Adjustment Factor, Peak Season Surcharge).

attributes.name: surcharge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surcharge rate record. Controls whether the surcharge is applied in rating and invoicing processes.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating how the surcharge is treated for tax purposes (e.g., taxable, exempt, zero-rated). Used for accurate tax calculation and reporting.

attributes.name: uld_type_code
attributes.description: IATA ULD type code to which the surcharge applies (e.g., AKE, PMC, PAG). Used for ULD-specific surcharges. Null indicates surcharge applies regardless of ULD type.

attributes.name: weight_break_maximum_kg
attributes.description: Maximum chargeable weight in kilograms for this surcharge rate to apply. Used for weight-tiered surcharge structures.

attributes.name: weight_break_minimum_kg
attributes.description: Minimum chargeable weight in kilograms for this surcharge rate to apply. Used for weight-tiered surcharge structures.

Mandatory for EU ACC3, TSA CCSP, and ICAO Annex 17 compliance. SSOT for cargo security chain-of-custody evidence.

attributes.name: security_screening_id

attributes.name: operational_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.operational_approval. products.name: forwarder_route_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the commercial contract between a freight forwarder and a specific airline route. It captures route-specific commercial terms, volume commitments, preferential rates, and performance metrics that exist only in the context of this forwarder-route partnership. Each record links one freight forwarder to one route with contractual and operational attributes that govern the commercial relationship on that specific route.. Existence Justification: In airline cargo operations, freight forwarders establish route-specific commercial agreements with airlines that include negotiated rates, volume commitments, and preferential access terms that vary by route. A single freight forwarder operates across multiple routes with different commercial terms on each, and each route has multiple freight forwarder partners with individualized agreements. The airline actively manages these forwarder-route partnerships as distinct commercial contracts with route-specific performance tracking.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.description: Commercial status of the forwarder on this specific route: preferred (priority access and preferential rates), standard (normal commercial terms), restricted (limited capacity allocation). This status is route-specific and may vary across the forwarder's route portfolio.

products.name: product_route_availability
products.description: This association product represents the operational availability configuration between cargo service products and routes. It captures which cargo products are offered on which routes with route-specific service parameters, operational constraints, and availability windows. Each record links one cargo service product to one route with attributes that govern product availability, service commitments, and operational parameters specific to that product-route combination.. Existence Justification: In airline cargo operations, service products (Express Freight, Cool Chain, Pharma, etc.) are selectively offered on routes based on operational capabilities, market demand, and aircraft configuration. A cargo product like 'Pharma' may be available on 50+ routes with different temperature control capabilities, while a single route may offer 8-12 different cargo products with varying service levels. Airlines actively manage product-route availability matrices, configuring route-specific parameters like weight limits, cutoff times, priority levels, and capacity allocations that vary by route characteristics (distance, aircraft type, competitive dynamics).
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: waitlist_status
attributes.description: Status of waitlist request for award space. Not waitlisted means booking was immediately confirmed; waitlisted indicates awaiting availability; confirmed from waitlist means space opened and booking confirmed; waitlist expired means request timed out without confirmation.

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the FFP member who holds this benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: tier_status_id
attributes.description: Reference to the FFP tier status to which this benefit is attached.

attributes.name: activation_trigger
attributes.description: Event or condition that triggered the activation of this benefit entitlement (e.g., tier qualification, manual grant by admin, promotional campaign, lifetime status achievement, status challenge match).

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit automatically renews upon tier re-qualification or expiration (True) or requires manual re-issuance (False).

attributes.name: benefit_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the benefit type (e.g., LOUNGE_ACCESS, PRIORITY_CHECKIN, EXTRA_BAG).

attributes.name: benefit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the benefit entitlement, including terms, conditions, and usage instructions.

attributes.name: benefit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit (e.g., Priority Lounge Access, Extra Baggage Allowance).

attributes.name: benefit_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity or limit of the benefit entitlement (e.g., 2 lounge passes, 20kg extra baggage). Null indicates unlimited.

attributes.name: benefit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit entitlement: active (usable), suspended (temporarily unavailable), expired (validity period ended), revoked (administratively removed), or pending activation.

attributes.name: benefit_terms
attributes.description: Full text of terms and conditions governing the use of this benefit, including restrictions, blackout dates, and eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: benefit_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit entitlement: lounge access, priority check-in, priority boarding, extra baggage allowance, seat upgrade priority, companion ticket, bonus mile multiplier, or dedicated phone support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lounge_access|priority_checkin|priority_boarding|extra_baggage|seat_upgrade|companion_ticket|bonus_miles|dedicated_support — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: benefit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the benefit quantity (e.g., passes, kg for baggage, segments, upgrade certificates, multiplier for bonus miles). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: passes|kg|segments|upgrades|multiplier|tickets|hours — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: benefit_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit entitlement expires. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: benefit_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the benefit entitlement becomes active and usable by the member.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges or specific dates when the benefit cannot be used (e.g., peak holiday periods). Null if no blackout dates apply.

attributes.name: cabin_class_restriction
attributes.description: Cabin class restriction for benefit usage (e.g., benefit applies only to business class bookings). Value 'any' indicates no restriction.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_to_airline amount.

attributes.name: cost_to_airline
attributes.description: Estimated cost to the airline for providing this benefit entitlement, used for financial planning and benefit valuation analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit entitlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the benefit is delivered or redeemed (e.g., airport counter, online portal, mobile app, call center, partner location, automatic application).

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic scope or restriction for benefit usage (e.g., domestic only, international only, specific regions or airport codes). Null if no restriction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit entitlement record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_usage_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit was most recently used or redeemed by the member.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for internal use, capturing special circumstances, manual adjustments, or member service interactions related to this benefit.

attributes.name: partner_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter or ICAO three-letter airline code of the partner airline where this benefit is valid. Null if benefit applies only to the issuing airline.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority level of this benefit when multiple members compete for limited resources (e.g., upgrade waitlist priority). Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Remaining quantity of the benefit available for use (benefit_quantity minus usage_count). Null if unlimited.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for benefit revocation if status is 'revoked' (e.g., tier downgrade, policy violation, account closure). Null if benefit has not been revoked.

attributes.name: tier_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tier codes to which this benefit applies (e.g., GOLD,PLATINUM,DIAMOND).

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit can be transferred to another FFP member or companion (True) or is non-transferable (False).

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this benefit has been used or redeemed by the member during the current validity period.

attributes.name: usage_history_summary
attributes.description: Summary text of benefit usage history, including dates, locations, and transaction references for audit and member inquiry purposes.

products.name: upgrade_request
products.description: Tracks member requests for complimentary or miles-based cabin upgrades. Captures request type (complimentary elite upgrade, miles upgrade, co-pay upgrade), member FFP number, PNR reference, flight number, travel date, origin, destination, requested cabin, current cabin, upgrade priority score, waitlist position, upgrade status (requested, waitlisted, confirmed, cleared, denied, expired), upgrade clearing timestamp, miles deducted if applicable, and upgrade source channel.
products.reference: Upgrade Request — Oracle Loyalty Cloud / Amadeus Altéa

attributes.name: upgrade_request_id

attributes.name: award_booking_id

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Upgrade promotions (discounted co-pay, bonus priority, complimentary upgrades) are marketing campaigns. Attribution measures promotional upgrade take-up rates, revenue impact, and operational costs of

Links request to cas

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the airline agent or system user who processed or approved the upgrade request. Null for automated system processing.

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FFP member who submitted the upgrade request.

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Upgrade requests target specific flight inventory for clearance processing. Critical for upgrade waitlist management, elite benefit fulfillment, and revenue management decisions on premium cabin inven

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: Upgrade requests target specific operated flight legs for real-time inventory management, waitlist clearance processing, and operational upgrade execution at departure. Required for departure control

attributes.name: loyalty_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_promotion. Business justification: upgrade_request has promotion_code (STRING) attribute. Upgrade requests can be part of promotional campaigns offering discounted or complimentary upgrades. Adding loyalty_promotion_id FK enables joini

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Flight disruptions from safety occurrences affect upgrade clearance, waitlist processing, and request expiry. Airlines track which occurrences impacted which upgrade requests to manage operational rec

attributes.name: origin_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Requests track origin_airport_code; FK enables station-level upgrade inventory management, hub capacity planning, and operational reporting on upgrade demand by station. Role prefix for clarity.

attributes.name: ticket_coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket_coupon. Business justification: Upgrades apply to specific flight coupons. Link required for inventory control, revenue recognition (upgrade fees), and operational execution. New attribute; no existing candidate.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or standardized reason for why the upgrade request was cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade request was cancelled by the member or system.

attributes.name: co_pay_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount paid by the member in addition to miles for a co-pay upgrade. Null for complimentary or pure miles-based upgrades.

attributes.name: co_pay_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the co-pay amount.

attributes.name: companion_upgrade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this upgrade request includes a companion passenger traveling on the same PNR and eligible for upgrade under the member's benefits.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason an upgrade request was denied: no availability in requested cabin, insufficient miles balance, ineligible fare class, cabin at capacity, operational restrictions, or request expired.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code representing the arrival airport for the flight segment.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade request will automatically expire if not cleared, typically set relative to departure time or check-in deadline.

attributes.name: fare_class_code
attributes.description: Single-letter fare class booking code of the original ticket, which influences upgrade eligibility and priority.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number for which the upgrade is requested, consisting of two-letter airline code followed by numeric flight identifier.

attributes.name: miles_deducted
attributes.description: Number of frequent flyer miles deducted from the member's account for a miles-based or co-pay upgrade. Null for complimentary elite upgrades.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the upgrade request, typically entered by agents or system for special handling instructions.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code representing the departure airport for the flight segment.

attributes.name: pnr
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record reference associated with the booking for which the upgrade is requested.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this upgrade request record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this upgrade request record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the upgrade request was submitted: web portal, mobile application, call center agent, airport self-service kiosk, gate agent, or partner airline portal.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade request was initially submitted by the member or system.

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Type of upgrade request indicating the method or entitlement basis: complimentary elite upgrade based on tier status, miles-based redemption, co-pay upgrade combining miles and cash, operational upgrade at airline discretion, or revenue upgrade purchased at gate.

attributes.name: requested_cabin_class
attributes.description: The target cabin class to which the passenger is requesting an upgrade.

attributes.name: seat_number_assigned
attributes.description: Specific seat number assigned to the passenger in the upgraded cabin once the upgrade is cleared. Format: row number followed by seat letter.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system that originated this upgrade request record, such as Oracle Loyalty Cloud or Amadeus Altéa PSS.

attributes.name: travel_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of travel for the flight segment being upgraded.

attributes.name: upgrade_cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade was confirmed and cleared, allowing the passenger to board in the upgraded cabin.

attributes.name: upgrade_priority_score
attributes.description: Calculated priority score determining the member's position in the upgrade queue, based on factors such as tier status, fare class, lifetime miles, and request timing.

attributes.name: upgrade_status
attributes.description: Current status of the upgrade request in its lifecycle: requested (initial submission), waitlisted (pending availability), confirmed (upgrade space allocated), cleared (passenger checked in with upgrade), denied (request rejected), expired (request lapsed), or cancelled (passenger withdrew request). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|waitlisted|confirmed|cleared|denied|expired|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Current position of the member in the upgrade waitlist queue for the flight, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

products.name: miles_transfer
products.description: Records peer-to-peer miles transfer transactions between FFP members (gifting, pooling, family sharing). Captures sender FFP number, recipient FFP number, miles transferred, transfer fee charged, transfer date, transfer type (gift, family pool contribution, purchase), transfer status, and applicable transfer limits consumed. Distinct from partner_transaction as it represents member-to-member movement of loyalty currency.
products.reference: Miles Gift/Transfer — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: miles_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the peer-to-peer miles transfer transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the FFP operations agent who approved the transfer. Null if auto-approved or still pending approval.

attributes.name: primary_miles_sender_ffp_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sender Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Member ID
attributes.description: FFP member identifier of the member sending/gifting miles. References the member initiating the transfer.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer requires manual approval by FFP operations team (e.g., high-value transfers, fraud risk, first-time transfer). True if approval required, False if auto-approved.
attributes.references: FFP risk management and approval workflows

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer was approved. Null if auto-approved (approval timestamp equals transfer timestamp) or still pending.

attributes.name: bonus_miles_awarded
attributes.description: Additional bonus miles awarded to sender or recipient as part of a transfer promotion. Zero if no bonus awarded.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the transfer was cancelled by sender or system before completion. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the miles were successfully posted to recipient account and deducted from sender account. Null if transfer not yet completed.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the transferred miles will expire in the recipient account, if different from standard expiry rules. Null if standard expiry applies.

attributes.name: fee_discount_applied
attributes.description: Monetary discount amount applied to the standard transfer fee due to promotion, tier status, or relationship type. Zero if no discount applied.

attributes.name: fraud_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer was flagged for manual fraud review. True if flagged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Automated fraud detection risk score assigned to this transfer at time of initiation (0.00 = no risk, 100.00 = high risk). Used to flag suspicious transfers for review.

attributes.name: miles_transferred
attributes.description: Quantity of loyalty miles transferred from sender to recipient in this transaction. Must be positive integer value.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used by sender to pay the transfer fee: credit_card, debit_card, miles_deduction (fee paid in miles), bank_transfer, paypal, wallet (digital wallet).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment gateway or processor transaction reference number for the transfer fee payment. Null if no fee charged.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Marketing promotion or campaign code applied to this transfer, potentially offering reduced fees or bonus miles. Null if no promotion applied.

attributes.name: recipient_annual_receipt_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative miles the recipient has received in the current calendar year after this transaction completes. Used to enforce annual receipt limits.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: recipient_annual_receipt_limit
attributes.description: Maximum miles the recipient is allowed to receive per calendar year according to FFP program rules. Captured at time of transfer for audit purposes.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was first created in the source system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified in the source system. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the transfer was rejected (e.g., insufficient miles, limit exceeded, fraud detected, policy violation). Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Declared relationship between sender and recipient. Some FFP programs offer preferential transfer terms for family members. Self-declared by sender at time of transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: family|friend|spouse|partner|child|parent|sibling|unrelated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FFP family pooling and relationship policies

attributes.name: relationship_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the declared relationship between sender and recipient has been verified by the airline (e.g., through documentation submission). True if verified, False if unverified or not required.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a completed transfer was reversed (e.g., fraud investigation, payment chargeback, system error). Null if not reversed.
attributes.references: FFP operational procedures and fraud management

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer was reversed and miles returned to sender. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: sender_annual_transfer_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative miles the sender has transferred in the current calendar year after this transaction completes. Used to enforce annual transfer limits.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: sender_annual_transfer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum miles the sender is allowed to transfer per calendar year according to FFP program rules and sender tier status. Captured at time of transfer for audit purposes.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this transfer record (e.g., Oracle Loyalty Cloud, legacy FFP system). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transfer_channel
attributes.description: Digital or physical channel through which the transfer was initiated: web (airline website), mobile_app, call_center (agent-assisted), partner_portal (coalition partner interface), kiosk (airport self-service).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fee charged to the sender for executing the miles transfer. Zero for fee-waived transfers (e.g., family pool contributions).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transfer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the transfer, entered by sender (e.g., gift message) or operations agent (e.g., special handling instructions). Null if no notes.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the miles transfer: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet posted), completed (miles successfully transferred), rejected (transfer denied), cancelled (sender cancelled before completion), reversed (transfer reversed after completion due to fraud or error).

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the miles transfer was initiated by the sender. Represents the business event time of the transfer request.

attributes.name: transfer_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique transaction reference number for the miles transfer, used for customer service inquiries and audit trails.

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the miles transfer transaction: gift (one-time transfer to another member), family_pool (contribution to family pooling account), purchase (bought miles transferred to recipient), share (reciprocal sharing arrangement), donation (charitable contribution of miles).
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

products.name: coalition_program
products.description: Master record for coalition loyalty programs in which the airline participates (e.g., multi-brand earn/burn coalitions). Captures coalition program name, coalition operator, program currency name, conversion rate to airline miles, earn rules, burn rules, member linkage mechanism, settlement terms, data sharing agreement reference, program effective date, and program status. Distinct from bilateral partner_program as coalitions involve multi-party governance.
products.reference: Coalition Loyalty Program — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: coalition_program_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that last modified this coalition program record.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_authority. attributes.name: api_authentication_method

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_reference

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: marketing_visibility_level

attributes.name: member_enrollment_url
attributes.description: Web URL where airline FFP members can enroll in or link their accounts to the coalition program.

attributes.name: member_linkage_mechanism

attributes.name: notice_period_days

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the coalition program, used in external communications and partner integrations.

attributes.name: program_currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the loyalty currency used within the coalition program (e.g., 'Alliance Miles', 'Coalition Points').

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official marketing name of the coalition loyalty program (e.g., 'Star Alliance Rewards', 'SkyTeam Elite Plus').

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the airline's participation in the coalition program.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coalition program by industry vertical or partnership model.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code

attributes.name: settlement_frequency

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url

attributes.name: ffp_member_id

products.name: award_inventory
products.description: Manages the availability of award seats allocated for FFP redemption across flights and cabin classes. Captures flight number, travel date, origin, destination, cabin class, award bucket code (saver/standard/premium), total award seats allocated, seats available, seats held, seats redeemed, blackout date flag, partner award availability flag, and last updated timestamp. Distinct from the revenue inventory domain — this is the loyalty-specific award seat pool managed by the FFP program.
products.reference: Award Seat Availability — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: award_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award inventory record. Primary key for the award seat allocation entity.

attributes.description: The date from which this award seat allocation becomes effective and available for member booking.

attributes.name: allocation_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this award seat allocation expires and is no longer available for booking. Null for open-ended allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special conditions, restrictions, or context for this award inventory allocation. Used by revenue management and FFP operations teams.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: The source or method by which award seats were allocated to this inventory bucket. Revenue management indicates standard RM allocation; partner agreement indicates contractual allocation; promotional indicates campaign-driven allocation; dynamic indicates real-time algorithmic allocation.

attributes.name: award_bucket_code
attributes.description: The award inventory bucket code indicating the redemption tier (e.g., saver, standard, premium). Determines mileage cost and availability rules.

attributes.name: award_bucket_type
attributes.description: The award redemption tier type. Saver awards require fewer miles but have limited availability; standard and premium awards offer greater availability at higher mileage cost.

attributes.name: blackout_date_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this travel date is designated as a blackout date for award redemptions. True means no award seats are available regardless of inventory.

attributes.description: The minimum number of days before departure that award bookings close. Typically 1-14 days depending on route and cabin.

attributes.name: booking_window_open_days

attributes.name: cancellation_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard award cancellation fee is waived for bookings in this inventory bucket. Often applies to elite members or promotional awards.

attributes.name: change_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard award change fee is waived for bookings in this inventory bucket. Often applies to elite members or promotional awards.
attributes.references: FFP Award Change and Cancellation Policy

attributes.name: co_pay_amount
attributes.description: The mandatory cash co-payment amount required in addition to miles for award redemption. Zero if no co-pay is required.

attributes.name: co_pay_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the co-payment amount. Null if no co-pay is required.

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic award pricing is enabled for this inventory, allowing mileage cost to vary based on demand and availability rather than fixed award chart rates.

attributes.name: elite_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether award seat availability is restricted to elite tier members only. Used for premium cabin inventory management.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: The airline flight number for which award seats are allocated. Follows IATA flight number format with carrier code and numeric identifier.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the award inventory. Open means available for booking; closed means no longer accepting reservations; suspended means temporarily unavailable; restricted means limited access.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award inventory record was last modified. Critical for real-time availability synchronization across distribution channels.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier marketing the award seats. Relevant for codeshare and partner award bookings.

attributes.name: miles_required
attributes.description: The number of FFP miles required to redeem one award seat in this bucket and cabin class. Varies by route, cabin, and bucket type.

attributes.name: minimum_tier_required
attributes.description: The minimum FFP tier status code required to access this award inventory bucket. Null if available to all members.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier operating the flight. May differ from marketing carrier in codeshare scenarios.

attributes.name: partner_award_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether these award seats are available for redemption by partner FFP members under reciprocal agreements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award inventory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: The current number of award seats available for immediate booking. Decremented upon award reservation confirmation.

attributes.name: seats_held
attributes.description: The number of award seats currently held in pending or unconfirmed reservations. These seats are temporarily unavailable but not yet redeemed.

attributes.name: seats_redeemed
attributes.description: The cumulative number of award seats that have been successfully redeemed and ticketed for this flight, cabin, and bucket.

attributes.name: seats_waitlisted
attributes.description: The number of members currently on the waitlist for award seats on this flight and cabin when availability is zero.

attributes.name: total_award_seats_allocated
attributes.description: The total number of seats allocated to the FFP award inventory pool for this flight, cabin, and bucket combination. Set by revenue management.

attributes.name: travel_date
attributes.description: The scheduled departure date of the flight for which award inventory is allocated. Key dimension for award seat availability queries.

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether these award seats are eligible for mileage upgrade from a lower cabin class. Relevant for upgrade award inventory management.

products.name: partner_settlement
products.description: Records financial settlement transactions between the airline and FFP earn/burn partners for miles sold, redeemed, and reconciled. Captures partner program ID, settlement period, miles sold to partner (earn), miles redeemed via partner (burn), net miles position, settlement amount, settlement currency, exchange rate, invoice reference, payment status, and settlement date. attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id

Real billing and collection process for mile sales revenue, essential for cash flow management and rev

products.name: member_audit_sample
products.description: This association product represents the sampling and examination of individual FFP member accounts during compliance audit events. It captures the selection, interview, documentation review, and findings for each member-audit pair. Each record links one ffp_member to one audit_event with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit sampling relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline loyalty program compliance audits, auditors sample multiple member accounts to test controls around revenue recognition, fraud prevention, tier qualification accuracy, and consumer protection compliance. Each member may be sampled across multiple audit events over time (annual audits, regulatory inspections, fraud investigations). The relationship represents the operational audit sampling methodology where each member-audit pair has distinct examination data (selection criteria, interview notes, documentation reviewed, findings specific to that member in that audit).

attributes.name: finding_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings, discrepancies, or non-conformances identified specifically related to this member account during this audit event. Zero indicates clean examination.

attributes.name: sample_selection_flag

domains.name: airport
