attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Special Service Request code indicating special handling requirements for this gate assignment (e.g., WCHR for wheelchair, DEPA for deportee, MEDA for medical). Drives ground service and security coordination.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: stand_compatibility_code
attributes.description: ICAO aerodrome reference code indicating maximum aircraft size the gate can accommodate (A through F). Ensures aircraft-gate physical compatibility for safe operations.

attributes.name: turnaround_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes for aircraft turnaround at the gate, from gate-in to gate-out. Varies by aircraft type, service level, and operational requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - Turnaround Standards

products.name: turnaround
products.description: Master operational record for an aircraft turnaround event at a gate, representing the full ground servicing cycle between inbound and outbound flight legs. Captures inbound and outbound flight references, tail number, gate assignment, scheduled and actual block-in/block-out times, turnaround type (standard/quick/overnight/transit), target turnaround time (TTT), actual turnaround time, overall status, responsible ground handler, ramp service order details (ordered services, service window, handler instructions, completion status, deviation notes), and OTP contribution metrics. Central entity for ground operations coordination, handler SLA measurement, and OTP root-cause analysis.
products.reference: IATA AHM 730 — Aircraft Turnaround Management

attributes.name: turnaround_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft turnaround event. Primary key for the turnaround record.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Turnaround performance analysis by aircraft, maintenance event correlation, and technical delay attribution require aircraft linkage. Ground operations planning and aircraft-specific service requireme

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Turnaround operations are cost-tracked activities for CASK (cost per available seat kilometer) calculation, station profitability analysis, and ground handling cost allocation. Essential for financial

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate_assignment. Business justification: turnaround occurs at a specific gate assignment (time-bound gate allocation). Currently stores gate_assignment as STRING. FK to gate_assignment provides access to gate details, assignment times, and a

attributes.name: ground_handler_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.ground_handler. Business justification: turnaround services are performed by a specific ground handler. Currently stores ground_handler_code (STRING). FK to ground_handler provides access to handler name, capabilities, performance tier, SLA

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Aircraft turnaround events occur at specific airport stations. The turnaround table currently has airport_code as a STRING denormalized attribute, but no FK to station. Adding station_id normalizes th

attributes.name: turnaround_inbound_flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the arriving flight leg that initiates this turnaround event.

attributes.name: turnaround_outbound_flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the departing flight leg that concludes this turnaround event.

attributes.name: actual_block_in_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the inbound aircraft arrived at the gate and parking brake was set (OOOI - On event).

attributes.name: actual_block_out_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the outbound aircraft pushed back from the gate and began taxi (OOOI - Off event).

attributes.name: actual_turnaround_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration in minutes from block-in to block-out. Calculated as the difference between actual_block_out_time and actual_block_in_time.

attributes.name: all_services_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all ordered ground services have been completed and signed off. True when turnaround is ready for departure.

attributes.name: baggage_pieces_loaded
attributes.description: Total number of baggage pieces loaded onto the outbound flight during turnaround.

attributes.name: baggage_pieces_offloaded
attributes.description: Total number of baggage pieces offloaded from the inbound flight during turnaround.

attributes.name: cargo_weight_loaded_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of cargo and mail loaded onto the outbound flight.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual (CSCRM)

attributes.name: cargo_weight_offloaded_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of cargo and mail offloaded from the inbound flight.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual (CSCRM)

attributes.name: cdm_milestone_status
attributes.description: JSON or delimited string capturing CDM milestone timestamps (TOBT, TSAT, TTOT, AOBT, ASAT, ATOT) for Airport CDM integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delay_code
attributes.description: Two-digit IATA delay code indicating the primary cause of any turnaround delay (e.g., 31=aircraft defect, 32=lack of crew, 81=weather, 82=ATC).

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Total delay in minutes attributed to turnaround operations. Calculated as actual_turnaround_time_minutes minus target_turnaround_time_minutes when positive.

attributes.name: deviation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any deviations from standard turnaround procedures, service failures, or operational irregularities encountered.

attributes.name: fuel_uplift_kg
attributes.description: Quantity of fuel in kilograms added to the aircraft during this turnaround.

attributes.name: ground_support_equipment_assigned
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GSE unit identifiers assigned to this turnaround (e.g., GPU-123, belt loader-456, tug-789).

attributes.name: handler_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions or notes for the ground handler regarding this specific turnaround (e.g., VIP passenger, special cargo, MEL items, security requirements).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: otp_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this turnaround contributed to an on-time performance failure (departure delay >15 minutes). Used for OTP root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: passenger_count_boarded
attributes.description: Number of passengers who boarded the outbound flight during this turnaround.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: passenger_count_deplaned
attributes.description: Number of passengers who deplaned from the inbound flight during this turnaround.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: ramp_service_order_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ramp service order that defines all ground services to be performed during this turnaround.

attributes.name: scheduled_block_in_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the inbound aircraft is scheduled to arrive at the gate (OOOI - On event).

attributes.name: scheduled_block_out_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the outbound aircraft is scheduled to push back from the gate (OOOI - Off event).

attributes.name: service_window_end_time
attributes.description: Latest timestamp by which all ground service operations must be completed to meet scheduled block-out time.

attributes.name: service_window_start_time
attributes.description: Earliest timestamp when ground service operations can commence, typically shortly after block-in.

attributes.name: services_completion_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when all ground services were completed and aircraft was declared ready for departure.

attributes.name: services_ordered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ground services ordered for this turnaround (e.g., fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, GPU, air start, deicing, baggage handling, cargo loading).

attributes.name: target_turnaround_time_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes for the complete turnaround cycle from block-in to block-out, based on aircraft type and turnaround type.

attributes.name: turnaround_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the turnaround event. Tracks lifecycle from scheduled through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: turnaround_type
attributes.description: Classification of turnaround based on duration and service scope. Standard (60-90 min), quick (<45 min), overnight (>8 hours), transit (international connection), maintenance (scheduled service), extended (unplanned delay).

products.name: turnaround_task
products.description: Individual ground servicing task within a turnaround event, including GSE deployment details. Captures task type (fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, de-icing, cargo loading, PAX boarding, pushback), planned and actual start/end times, responsible service provider, task status (pending/in-progress/complete/skipped), delay reason code, sequence order, assigned GSE asset(s), GSE operator, GSE deployment start/end times, fuel consumed by GSE, and any equipment defect noted. Enables milestone tracking, SLA compliance measurement, and GSE utilization optimization for each turnaround service element.
products.reference: IATA AHM 730 — Turnaround Milestone Tracking

attributes.name: turnaround_task_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual ground servicing task within a turnaround event. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual ground service operator or technician assigned to execute this task. Used for accountability and certification tracking.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight leg associated with this turnaround task. Connects the ground service task to the specific flight operation.

attributes.name: gse_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary ground support equipment asset deployed for this task (e.g., fuel truck, catering truck, GPU, tug, belt loader).

attributes.name: gse_deployment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gse_deployment. Business justification: turnaround_task may involve a specific gse_deployment. While turnaround_task already has gse_asset_id, the gse_deployment record captures the transactional deployment details (planned/actual times, op

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ground crew or team assigned to perform this turnaround task.

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Individual tasks (fueling, catering, pushback) are the specific activity during which safety occurrences happen. Task-level occurrence linking supports detailed root cause analysis and task-specific s

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Individual turnaround tasks (fueling, catering, cleaning, etc.) occur at specific airport stations. The turnaround_task table currently has airport_code as a STRING denormalized attribute, but no FK t

attributes.name: turnaround_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent turnaround event that this task belongs to. Links this task to the overall aircraft turnaround operation.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground servicing task was completed. Used for SLA compliance measurement and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground servicing task commenced. Used for performance measurement and delay analysis.

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the service provider upon task completion, including any exceptions, observations, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Direct cost incurred for this ground servicing task, including labor, equipment, and materials. Used for turnaround cost analysis and vendor billing.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround task record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of task delay in minutes, calculated as the difference between planned and actual completion times. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized IATA delay code indicating the reason for any task delay or late completion. Used for root cause analysis and performance improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full IATA delay code taxonomy]

attributes.name: gate_stand_position
attributes.description: Specific gate or stand position identifier where the aircraft is parked and this task is being performed.

attributes.name: gse_defect_description
attributes.description: Textual description of any GSE defect, malfunction, or maintenance issue observed during task execution. Populated when defect flag is true.

attributes.name: gse_defect_noted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Defect Noted Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether any equipment defect or malfunction was noted during this task. Triggers maintenance follow-up.

attributes.name: gse_deployment_end_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Deployment End Time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GSE asset was released from this task and became available for other operations. Used for GSE utilization optimization.

attributes.name: gse_deployment_start_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Deployment Start Time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GSE asset was deployed and positioned for this task. Used for GSE utilization tracking and availability management.

attributes.name: gse_fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Volume of fuel consumed by the GSE asset during this task deployment, measured in liters. Used for environmental reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround task record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the ground servicing task is planned to be completed, based on standard service times and turnaround requirements.

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the ground servicing task is planned to begin, based on the turnaround schedule and task dependencies.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the task indicating urgency and importance for turnaround completion. Critical tasks are mandatory for flight departure.

attributes.name: quality_check_performed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether a quality inspection or verification check was performed for this task. Used for quality assurance and safety compliance.

attributes.name: quality_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection or verification check, if performed. Used for quality assurance tracking and corrective action triggering.

attributes.name: quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of service delivered or resource provided during this task (e.g., liters of fuel, kilograms of cargo, number of meals, gallons of water). Unit depends on task type.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether any safety incident, near-miss, or hazard was reported during this task execution. Triggers safety investigation and SMS reporting.

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric order indicating the planned sequence of this task within the turnaround event. Used to coordinate dependencies and parallel operations during aircraft servicing.

attributes.name: service_provider_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ground handling service provider or vendor responsible for executing this task. May be airline self-handling or third-party handler.

attributes.name: service_provider_name
attributes.description: Full name of the ground handling service provider or vendor responsible for this task.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the task was completed within the SLA target duration. Used for service provider performance measurement.

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Contractual service level agreement target duration for this task type, measured in minutes. Used for performance benchmarking and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: task_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the specific ground servicing task, including any special instructions, requirements, or notes for the service provider.

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the turnaround task. Tracks progression from pending assignment through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|ASSIGNED|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETE|SKIPPED|CANCELLED|FAILED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: task_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of ground servicing task being performed. Examples include fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, de-icing, cargo loading/unloading, passenger boarding/deplaning, pushback, ground power unit (GPU), air start unit (ASU), potable water, waste removal, cabin preparation, security check, or pre-flight inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FUEL|CATER|CLEAN|WATER|LAV|DEICE|CARGO_LOAD|CARGO_UNLOAD|PAX_BOARD|PAX_DEPLANE|PUSHBACK|GPU|ASU|POTABLE|WASTE|CABIN_PREP|SECURITY|INSPECTION — 18 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Ground Operations Manual (IGOM), AHM 810 (Airport Handling Manual)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity delivered field. Varies by task type (e.g., liters for fuel, kilograms for cargo, units for catering). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LITERS|KILOGRAMS|GALLONS|UNITS|MEALS|PASSENGERS|BAGS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: slot
products.description: Airport slot record representing an allocated takeoff or landing time at a capacity-constrained airport, including utilization tracking. Captures IATA season, slot type (arrival/departure), allocated time, slot coordinator reference, airport ICAO code, airline designator, aircraft type, slot series (regular/ad-hoc), slot status (allocated/confirmed/returned/swapped), historic slot precedence flag, and per-operating-date utilization data including actual flight reference, compliance status (used/missed/cancelled/swapped), variance in minutes, reason for non-compliance, and regulatory reporting flag. Aligns with IATA Worldwide Slot Guidelines (WSG) and supports slot compliance monitoring and slot pool management.
products.reference: IATA Worldwide Slot Guidelines (WSG) — Slot Allocation

attributes.name: slot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the airport slot record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Slot compliance monitoring (noise chapter restrictions, wake turbulence separation), coordinator reporting, and slot utilization analysis by aircraft type require aircraft_type linkage. Regulatory com

attributes.name: coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Slot allocation and coordination decisions require workforce employee accountability for regulatory compliance, airline negotiations, and slot pool management. Critical for slot-coordinated airports.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Slot coordination costs (fees, administrative overhead) are allocated to network planning cost centers for route profitability analysis and slot portfolio valuation. Required for network planning ROI

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: slot is allocated at a specific airport/station. Currently stores airport_icao_code (STRING). FK to station provides access to station name, time zone, slot coordinator, CDM capability, and operationa

attributes.name: actual_flight_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the actual flight that operated using this slot, typically the flight leg identifier or operational flight number. Used for post-operation reconciliation and compliance tracking. Null if slot was not used.

attributes.name: actual_operation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which this slot was actually used for a flight operation. Populated post-operation for utilization tracking. Null if not yet operated or if slot was not used.

attributes.name: actual_operation_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the flight operation occurred (actual takeoff time for departure slots, actual landing time for arrival slots). Used to calculate variance from allocated time. Null if not yet operated.

attributes.name: airline_designator
attributes.description: Two or three-character IATA airline code of the carrier to whom this slot is allocated (e.g., BA, AA, LH).

attributes.name: allocated_time
attributes.description: The specific date and time allocated for this slot operation (takeoff or landing). This is the coordinated time assigned by the slot coordinator.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: Date when this slot was initially allocated to the airline by the slot coordinator.

attributes.name: cdm_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for Airport Collaborative Decision Making (A-CDM) messages related to this slot, used for real-time coordination between airline, airport, ATC, and ground handlers. Aligns with SITA Airport Management Platform.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot was used in compliance with allocation: used (operated within tolerance), missed (not operated without valid reason), cancelled (airline cancelled in advance), swapped (exchanged with another slot), not_yet_operated (future slot).

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the airline confirmed intention to use this slot. Null if not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: coordinator_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by the airport slot coordinator (e.g., Airport Coordination Limited, Flughafen-Koordinierung Deutschland) for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Planned flight number for this slot operation, combining airline designator and numeric identifier (e.g., BA123, LH456). May be null for slots not yet assigned to specific flights.

attributes.name: historic_precedence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot carries historic precedence (grandfather rights) under IATA 80/20 rule, meaning the airline used the slot at least 80% of the time in the previous equivalent season and has priority for renewal.

attributes.name: iata_season
attributes.description: IATA scheduling season for which this slot is allocated, in format S## (summer) or W## (winter), e.g., S23, W23. IATA seasons run summer (last Sunday March to last Saturday October) and winter (last Sunday October to last Saturday March).

attributes.name: justification_category
attributes.description: Categorized reason for non-compliance or slot misuse. Weather: meteorological conditions; ATC delay: air traffic control restrictions; Technical: aircraft maintenance or defect; Operational: crew, ground handling, or airport issues; Commercial: passenger or cargo demand changes; Other: miscellaneous.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a slot was missed or operated outside tolerance. May reference weather, Air Traffic Control (ATC) delays, technical issues, or other justifiable causes. Used for regulatory reporting and historic precedence calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or operational notes related to this slot allocation. May include coordinator instructions, special handling requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: pool_category
attributes.description: Classification of the slot pool from which this slot was allocated. New entrant: reserved for new carriers; Domestic: domestic operations; International: international operations; General: unrestricted pool. Used for regulatory compliance and fair competition monitoring.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot record must be included in regulatory compliance reports to aviation authorities (e.g., for 80/20 rule enforcement, slot pool management, or competition monitoring). True if reporting required.
attributes.references: IATA WSG, EU Regulation 95/93, FAA slot rules

attributes.name: series
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a regular series slot (recurring throughout the season) or an ad-hoc slot (one-time or irregular operation).

attributes.name: series_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this slot to a series of recurring slots. Populated for regular series slots; null for ad-hoc slots.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of flight service this slot is allocated for: passenger (revenue passenger service), cargo (freight service), ferry (non-revenue aircraft repositioning with no payload), positioning (deadhead crew or aircraft movement).

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the slot allocation. Allocated: initially assigned; Confirmed: airline confirmed usage; Returned: handed back to coordinator; Swapped: exchanged with another carrier; Cancelled: withdrawn; Suspended: temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is for an arrival or departure operation at the airport.

attributes.name: swap_date
attributes.description: Date when the slot swap transaction was executed and recorded with the slot coordinator. Null if no swap occurred.

attributes.name: swap_partner_airline
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the carrier with whom this slot was swapped, if applicable. Null if no swap occurred.

attributes.name: terminal_identifier
attributes.description: Airport terminal designation where this slot operation is planned (e.g., T1, T5, Terminal A). May be null if not yet assigned.

attributes.name: time_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference in minutes between allocated slot time and actual operation time. Positive values indicate late operation, negative values indicate early operation. Used for compliance monitoring against tolerance thresholds (typically +/- 5 or 15 minutes depending on airport rules).

products.name: slot_utilization
products.description: Transactional record tracking actual use of an allocated slot against its planned parameters. Captures slot reference, associated flight, operated date, planned vs actual departure/arrival time, slot compliance status (used/missed/cancelled/swapped), variance in minutes, reason for non-compliance, and regulatory reporting flag for slot return obligations. Supports IATA slot compliance monitoring and slot pool management.
products.reference: IATA WSG — Slot Utilization Monitoring

attributes.name: slot_utilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the slot utilization transaction record.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight operation that utilized this slot.

attributes.name: slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the allocated airport slot being utilized.

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Slot utilization records track actual use of allocated slots at specific airport stations. The slot_utilization table currently has airport_code as a STRING denormalized attribute, but no FK to statio

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: The actual on-block or landing time recorded for the flight operation.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: The actual off-block or takeoff time recorded for the flight operation.

attributes.name: arrival_variance_minutes
attributes.description: The difference in minutes between planned and actual arrival time, calculated as actual minus planned. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early arrival.

attributes.name: cdm_message_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the Airport CDM message that confirmed the actual slot utilization, typically sourced from SITA Airport Management Platform or equivalent CDM system.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of the slot utilization indicating whether the slot was used as allocated, missed, cancelled, swapped with another carrier, returned to the pool, or forfeited due to non-compliance.

attributes.name: departure_variance_minutes
attributes.description: The difference in minutes between planned and actual departure time, calculated as actual minus planned. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early departure.

attributes.name: historic_rights_protected_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this slot utilization contributes to the airline's historic rights (grandfather rights) for future season slot allocation under the 80/20 use-it-or-lose-it rule.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this slot utilization record, reflecting corrections or status changes.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for slot non-compliance or variance, such as weather delay, technical issue, air traffic control restriction, or operational irregularity.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances that led to slot non-compliance or significant variance from the allocated time.

attributes.name: operated_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the slot was actually utilized by the flight operation.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_time
attributes.description: The scheduled arrival time as allocated in the original slot assignment.

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: The scheduled departure time as allocated in the original slot assignment.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this slot utilization event must be reported to the slot coordinator or aviation authority for compliance monitoring and slot return obligation assessment.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: IATA scheduling season identifier (e.g., S23 for Summer 2023, W23 for Winter 2023/24) during which the slot was allocated and utilized.

attributes.name: slot_coordinator_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code identifying the slot coordination authority responsible for this slot allocation.

attributes.name: slot_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the slot allocation as issued by the slot coordinator.

attributes.name: slot_series_indicator
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether this slot utilization is part of a recurring series allocation or an ad-hoc one-time slot request.

attributes.name: swap_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the slot swap transaction record if this slot utilization resulted from a slot exchange agreement between carriers.

attributes.name: utilization_recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this slot utilization record was first captured in the airport operations system.

products.name: cdm_message
products.description: Collaborative Decision Making (CDM) message record exchanged between the airline, airport, ATC, and ground handlers. Captures message type (TOBT/TSAT/TTOT/AOBT/ATOT/CTOT/DPI/SRM), originating system, target system, flight reference, airport ICAO, message timestamp, target off-block time (TOBT), calculated take-off time (CTOT), sequence number, and processing status. Aligns with EUROCONTROL/ICAO CDM standards and SITA Airport Management Platform integration.
products.reference: EUROCONTROL Airport CDM Implementation Manual — CDM Message Types

attributes.name: cdm_message_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CDM message record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Airport Collaborative Decision Making (A-CDM) requires accurate aircraft tracking for TOBT calculation, turnaround monitoring, and departure sequencing. Critical for slot compliance and on-time perfor

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight associated with this CDM message.

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate_assignment. Business justification: cdm_message references a specific gate/stand position. Currently stores stand_gate_number (STRING). FK to gate_assignment provides precise gate allocation details, timing, and status. The stand_gate_n

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: CDM (Collaborative Decision Making) messages are exchanged between airline, airport, ATC, and ground handlers at specific airport stations. The cdm_message table currently has airport_icao_code as a S

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual time when the aircraft commenced pushback or taxi from the gate. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual time when the aircraft became airborne. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cobt
attributes.description: Coordinated off-block time agreed upon by all CDM stakeholders (airline, airport, ATC, ground handler). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: correlation_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier used to correlate related CDM messages across multiple systems and message types for the same flight operation.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CDM message record was first created in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated take-off time assigned by the central flow management unit (e.g., EUROCONTROL Network Manager) for slot-controlled flights. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delay_code
attributes.description: IATA standard delay code associated with the flight at the time of the CDM message (e.g., 11-Aircraft defect, 81-Weather).

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated time when the aircraft will commence pushback or taxi, as estimated by the airline. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Airline flight number associated with this CDM message (e.g., AA100, BA2036).

attributes.name: is_slot_constrained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flight is subject to slot constraints and requires CTOT coordination.

attributes.name: message_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the CDM message for processing and routing purposes.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: message_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CDM message was created and transmitted. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: message_type
attributes.description: Type of CDM message: TOBT (Target Off-Block Time), TSAT (Target Start-Up Approval Time), TTOT (Target Take-Off Time), AOBT (Actual Off-Block Time), ATOT (Actual Take-Off Time), CTOT (Calculated Take-Off Time), DPI (Departure Planning Information), SRM (Slot Revision Message), EOBT (Estimated Off-Block Time), COBT (Coordinated Off-Block Time). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TOBT|TSAT|TTOT|AOBT|ATOT|CTOT|DPI|SRM|EOBT|COBT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: message_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CDM message format or protocol used (e.g., CDM 1.0, CDM 2.0).

attributes.name: originating_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system that generated the CDM message (e.g., airline operations system, airport management platform, ATC system, ground handler system).
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the CDM message: received (message received by target system), validated (message passed validation checks), processed (message successfully processed and applied), rejected (message rejected due to validation errors), failed (message processing failed due to system error).
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: receiver_organization
attributes.description: Name or code of the organization intended to receive the CDM message.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason why the CDM message was rejected or failed processing, including error codes and descriptions.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the flight operation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: sender_organization
attributes.description: Name or code of the organization that sent the CDM message (airline, airport authority, ATC, ground handler).

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the CDM message within a series of messages for the same flight, used to track message order and detect duplicates.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: target_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system intended to receive and process the CDM message.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target time when the aircraft is expected to commence pushback or taxi from the gate, provided by the airline. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: Target time provided by ATC for the aircraft to start engines and request pushback clearance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target time when the aircraft is expected to become airborne, calculated by the CDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: turnaround_status
attributes.description: Current status of the aircraft turnaround operation at the time of the CDM message.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CDM message record was last updated in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

SSOT for GSE fleet managed at airline-operated stations.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: GSE assets are involved in many ground safety occurrences (equipment failures, collisions, maintenance defects). Asset-level occurrence history tracking supports fleet safety analysis and maintenance

attributes.name: owning_vendor_id

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_currency_code

attributes.name: acquisition_date

attributes.name: availability_flag

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity value, defining whether capacity is expressed in weight, power, volume, or passenger count.

attributes.name: capacity_value
attributes.description: Primary quantitative capacity specification for the equipment, such as towing capacity for tugs, power output for GPUs, or volume for fluid trucks. The principal measurement defining the equipment's operational capability.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current safety certification expires, requiring recertification or inspection before continued operation. Critical for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: certification_number

attributes.name: current_station_code

attributes.name: depreciation_method

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag

attributes.name: equipment_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or serial number assigned to the GSE unit by the manufacturer or regulatory authority. Serves as the external business identifier for the asset.

attributes.name: equipment_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional detail on the equipment variant or model family within the primary equipment type.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel or power source used by the equipment, relevant for refueling logistics, environmental reporting, and operational cost tracking.

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled_flag

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date

attributes.name: maintenance_status

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the ground support equipment unit.

attributes.name: maximum_towing_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum aircraft weight in kilograms that the equipment can safely tow or push, applicable to pushback tractors and tugs. Critical for matching equipment to aircraft type.

attributes.name: model_designation
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or designation for the equipment unit, identifying the specific product line and configuration.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required maintenance inspection or service, based on manufacturer recommendations and operational hours.

attributes.name: operating_hours_total
attributes.description: Cumulative total operating hours logged for the equipment since commissioning, used for maintenance scheduling and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the equipment indicating its availability for ground operations. Tracks whether the asset is active, under maintenance, or decommissioned.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this GSE asset record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this GSE asset record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special handling instructions, or operational comments related to the equipment asset.

attributes.name: telematics_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the telematics or IoT device installed on the equipment for remote monitoring of location, usage, and performance metrics.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the equipment in years, used for depreciation calculations and replacement planning.

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the equipment unit was manufactured, used for age tracking and depreciation calculations.

products.name: gse_deployment
products.description: Transactional record for the deployment of a GSE asset to a specific turnaround task or gate operation. Captures GSE asset reference, turnaround or gate assignment reference, task type, assigned operator, planned and actual deployment start/end times, deployment status, fuel consumed, and any equipment defect noted during deployment. Enables GSE utilization tracking, scheduling optimization, and maintenance trigger events.

attributes.name: gse_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GSE deployment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gate assignment where the GSE is deployed. Links to the gate assignment record.

attributes.name: gse_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific GSE asset deployed (e.g., tug, belt loader, GPU). Links to the GSE asset master record.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GSE deployment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any equipment defect, malfunction, or performance issue observed during the deployment. Populated when defect_noted_flag is true.

attributes.name: defect_noted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any equipment defect or malfunction was noted during this deployment. Triggers maintenance workflow.

attributes.name: defect_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the noted defect (e.g., minor, moderate, major, critical). Determines maintenance priority and equipment availability.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes of any delay in GSE deployment or task completion, measured against planned times. Used for OTP analysis and resource planning.

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any delay in GSE deployment or task completion (e.g., equipment unavailable, operator unavailable, weather, aircraft delay).

attributes.name: deployment_location
attributes.description: The specific physical location where the GSE was deployed (e.g., gate number, ramp position, hangar bay). Supports spatial analysis and resource optimization.

attributes.name: deployment_status

attributes.name: idle_duration_minutes

attributes.name: utilization_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes that the GSE was actively utilized during this deployment, calculated from actual start and end times. Used for utilization rate analysis.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time of GSE deployment (e.g., clear, rain, snow, ice, fog). Impacts task duration, safety, and equipment performance.

products.name: checkin_session

Supports OTP, passenger flow, and ground operations analytics.

attributes.name: ffp_member_id

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger checked in more than 24 hours before scheduled departure (advance/online check-in). True if advance check-in.

attributes.name: bags_checked_count

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Cabin class of the seat assigned at check-in. Reflects the service level for this flight segment.

attributes.name: checkin_channel

attributes.name: checkin_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the check-in session was completed and boarding pass issued. Recorded in UTC.

attributes.name: checkin_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language used during the check-in session (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: checkin_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to the passenger within the flight check-in order. Used for boarding priority and operational sequencing.

attributes.name: checkin_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the passenger initiated the check-in session. Recorded in UTC and converted to local airport time for operational reporting.

attributes.name: checkin_status

attributes.description: Timestamp when this check-in session record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger checked excess baggage beyond the standard allowance. True if excess baggage charges apply.

attributes.name: group_checkin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this check-in is part of a group booking check-in. True if group check-in.

attributes.name: infant_accompanying_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is traveling with an infant (under 2 years) on lap. True if infant accompanying.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this check-in session record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: pnr_reference

attributes.name: priority_boarding_flag

attributes.name: seat_assigned

attributes.name: special_service_requests
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SSR codes processed or confirmed during check-in (e.g., WCHR, VGML, PETC). Reflects special assistance, meal preferences, or service requests.

attributes.name: standby_status

attributes.name: travel_document_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passengers travel documents (passport, visa) were verified during check-in. True if documents verified.

attributes.name: upgrade_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cabin upgrade (e.g., economy to business) was processed during check-in. True if upgrade applied.

attributes.name: excess_baggage_charge_currency

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the baggage item in centimeters. Used for oversized baggage determination and ULD planning.

attributes.name: interline_indicator

attributes.name: last_scan_timestamp

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the baggage item in centimeters. Used for oversized baggage determination and ULD (Unit Load Device) planning.

attributes.name: mishandling_code

attributes.name: mishandling_report_number

attributes.name: pnr
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record identifier linking this baggage item to the booking. Used for reservation system integration and passenger association.

attributes.name: priority_handling_code
attributes.description: Special handling priority assigned to the baggage item. Determines expedited processing for tight connections, premium passengers, or operational requirements.

attributes.name: routing_sequence
attributes.description: Planned routing path for the baggage item through connecting stations. Formatted as a sequence of IATA airport codes representing the complete journey.

attributes.name: security_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of security screening process for this baggage item. Indicates whether the bag has been cleared for loading or requires additional inspection.

attributes.name: special_service_request_codes

attributes.name: uld_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the Unit Load Device (container or pallet) in which this baggage item is loaded for transport. Null if loaded as bulk baggage.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight of the baggage item measured in kilograms at acceptance. Used for load planning, excess baggage charge calculation, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the baggage item in centimeters. Used for oversized baggage determination and ULD planning.

products.name: baggage_scan

attributes.name: actual_connect_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in minutes between the inbound flight arrival scan and the outbound flight departure scan for transfer baggage. Used for connection performance analysis.

attributes.name: bag_tag_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique baggage tag identifier affixed to the checked baggage item. Primary tracking identifier throughout the baggage journey from acceptance to delivery.

attributes.name: baggage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the baggage item based on handling requirements and passenger service level. Determines handling priority and routing logic.

attributes.name: baggage_weight_kg

attributes.name: customs_status

attributes.name: destination_airport_code

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether this scan event represents an irregular or exception condition requiring manual intervention or investigation.

attributes.name: exception_reason_code

attributes.name: flight_date

attributes.name: flight_number

attributes.name: iata_753_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator confirming whether this scan event meets IATA Resolution 753 baggage tracking requirements for mandatory scan point reporting.

attributes.name: makeup_position
attributes.description: Specific location identifier within the baggage makeup area where bags are staged for loading onto the aircraft. Used for ground crew coordination.

attributes.name: minimum_connect_time_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum connection time in minutes required for successful baggage transfer between the inbound and outbound flights. Used to identify at-risk connections.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code

attributes.name: uld_number
