attributes.name: remains_sent_to_lab_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collected wildlife remains were sent to a laboratory for identification or forensic analysis. True if sent, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FAA Wildlife Strike Database Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, context, or details about the wildlife strike that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: FAA Wildlife Strike Database Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: repair_hours
attributes.description: The total number of maintenance labor hours required to repair damage caused by the wildlife strike.

attributes.name: reporter_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual who reported the wildlife strike occurrence, typically the pilot, crew member, or airport operations personnel.

attributes.name: reporter_role
attributes.description: The operational role or position of the individual who reported the wildlife strike. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pilot|first_officer|cabin_crew|maintenance|airport_ops|atc|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sky_condition
attributes.description: The weather and sky conditions at the time of the wildlife strike.

attributes.name: species_identified
attributes.description: The common or scientific name of the wildlife species involved in the strike, if identified. May be unknown if species could not be determined.
attributes.references: FAA Wildlife Strike Database Species Taxonomy

attributes.name: species_quantity
attributes.description: The estimated number of wildlife individuals involved in the strike event.
attributes.references: FAA Wildlife Strike Database Reporting Requirements

products.name: runway_incursion
products.description: Runway incursion and excursion event records capturing incidents where an aircraft, vehicle, or person incorrectly entered a protected runway area. Captures event date, airport ICAO code, runway designator, incursion category (ICAO A/B/C/D severity), aircraft/vehicle/person involved, ATC clearance status, contributing factors (communication/situational awareness/signage/lighting), weather conditions, time of day, and regulatory notification status. Supports ICAO runway safety programme reporting.
products.reference: ICAO Runway Safety Programme / ICAO Doc 9870

attributes.name: runway_incursion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the runway incursion event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Runway incursion investigations require aircraft performance data (braking capability, wingspan for clearance analysis) and equipment status (TCAS, ADS-B). Direct aircraft link enables investigation t

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight leg involved in the runway incursion event, if applicable.

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Runway incursions are a specific type of occurrence. Adding runway_incursion.occurrence_id → occurrence.occurrence_id links runway incursion records to their master occurrence record. Removes redundan

attributes.name: occurrence_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent safety occurrence report under which this runway incursion is documented.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Runway incursions have mandatory reporting requirements to aviation authorities. Links incursion records to regulatory notification obligations, enabling compliance tracking and demonstrating adherenc

attributes.name: atc_clearance_status
attributes.description: Whether the entity involved had proper ATC clearance to enter the runway area at the time of the incursion.

attributes.name: atc_instruction
attributes.description: The specific ATC instruction or clearance that was active at the time of the incursion, if available from voice recordings or transcripts.

attributes.name: collision_avoidance_action
attributes.description: Description of any evasive action taken to avoid collision (e.g., rejected takeoff, go-around, emergency braking, evasive steering).

attributes.name: contributing_factor_communication
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether communication issues (misunderstood clearance, readback error, language barrier, radio congestion) contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_lighting
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inadequate or inoperative runway/taxiway lighting contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_procedures
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inadequate or non-compliance with standard operating procedures contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_signage
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inadequate, missing, or confusing airport signage contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_situational_awareness
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether loss of situational awareness (disorientation, confusion about position, distraction) contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_training
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inadequate training or lack of familiarity with airport layout contributed to the runway incursion.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required to prevent recurrence of similar runway incursion events.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of corrective actions identified to address the runway incursion root causes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this runway incursion record was first created in the safety management system.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: How the runway incursion was detected (e.g., ATC visual observation, pilot report, ASDE-X/surface radar, runway status lights, airport surface detection equipment).

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the runway incursion event, including sequence of events, parties involved, and circumstances.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the runway incursion event, formatted as RI-YYYY-NNNNNN for tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: incursion_category
attributes.description: ICAO severity classification of the runway incursion: A (serious incident with collision narrowly avoided), B (significant potential for collision), C (ample time/distance to avoid collision), D (little or no chance of collision).

attributes.name: incursion_type
attributes.description: Type of entity that entered the protected runway area: aircraft, vehicle, pedestrian, or mixed (multiple types).

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the runway incursion investigation.

attributes.name: investigator_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes and observations recorded by the safety investigator during the runway incursion investigation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this runway incursion record was last updated, supporting audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the runway incursion was formally notified to the relevant civil aviation authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this runway incursion event meets the threshold for mandatory reporting to civil aviation authorities (FAA, EASA, national CAA).

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk assessment score assigned to the runway incursion event based on severity, likelihood, and consequence, per SMS risk matrix.

attributes.name: runway_designator
attributes.description: Runway identifier where the incursion occurred, formatted as magnetic heading with optional L/C/R suffix (e.g., 27L, 09R, 18).

attributes.name: separation_distance_meters
attributes.description: Minimum separation distance in meters between the incurring entity and other aircraft or vehicles on the runway at the closest point of approach.

attributes.name: time_of_day

products.name: alert_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution event between safety alerts and marketing channels. It captures the operational process of disseminating safety-critical information through various communication channels to ensure timely delivery and acknowledgement tracking. Each record links one alert to one marketing channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline safety operations, a single safety alert must be distributed through multiple communication channels simultaneously (email to management, SMS to critical personnel, crew app notifications, intranet posting) to ensure comprehensive reach. Each channel serves different recipient populations with different delivery characteristics, acknowledgement rates, and effectiveness metrics. The business actively manages alert distribution as an operational process, tracking delivery status, acknowledgement compliance, and channel effectiveness for each alert-channel combination.

products.description: Operational tracking record linking a specific regulatory requirement to the airlines internal compliance program, serving as the airlines compliance register and accountability bridge. Captures the assigned compliance owner, due date, compliance method, current status (pending, in-progress, compliant, non-compliant, waived), evidence reference, last review date, next review date, and risk rating. Also tracks training compliance obligations at the program level — whether mandatory regulatory training requirements (dangerous goods, security awareness, human trafficking, fatigue risk, SMS, GDPR) are being met across the organization. This is the bridge between external regulatory requirements and internal accountability — the SSOT for what the airline owes and whether it is meeting those obligations.

products.name: channel_audit_assessment
products.description: This association product represents the audit assessment of individual sales channels within a broader compliance audit event. It captures channel-specific audit scope, findings, compliance ratings, and remediation timelines. Each record links one audit_event to one sales_channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory assessment relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline ancillary revenue compliance audits, a single audit event (IOSA, DOT, internal compliance review) assesses multiple sales channels (GDS, NDC API, mobile app, kiosk, agent) for regulatory compliance with pricing transparency, disclosure requirements, and refund processing rules. Each channel within an audit receives its own scope definition, findings count, compliance rating, and remediation timeline. Conversely, each sales channel undergoes multiple audit events over time as part of ongoing regulatory compliance programs. This is an operational M:N relationship where compliance teams actively manage channel-specific audit assessments.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: audit_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between audit programs and cost centres within the airline. It captures the budgeting and actual cost tracking for compliance audit activities across organizational units. Each record links one audit program to one cost centre with budget allocation amounts, actual costs incurred, allocation percentages, and fiscal tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship. Enables compliance budget management, departmental audit cost reporting, and CASK attribution of regulatory compliance expenses.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, audit programs (IOSA, FAA ATOS, EASA inspections) span multiple organizational units - flight operations, maintenance, cabin crew, ground handling, and corporate functions all participate in regulatory audits. Conversely, each cost centre participates in multiple audit programs simultaneously (e.g., flight operations is audited under IOSA, FAA ATOS, and internal quality programs). The airline actively manages budget allocations and tracks actual costs per cost centre per audit program for compliance budget management and CASK attribution of regulatory expenses.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between regulatory requirements and cost centres. It captures how compliance costs for specific regulatory obligations are distributed across organizational cost centres, enabling accurate CASK attribution, departmental P&L reporting, and regulatory cost tracking. Each record links one regulatory requirement to one cost centre with the allocated cost amount, budget percentage, and validity period for that allocation.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, regulatory compliance costs are systematically allocated across multiple organizational cost centres because compliance activities span departments (e.g., CORSIA environmental compliance involves fuel procurement, operations planning, finance reporting, and sustainability teams). Each cost centre manages budgets for multiple regulatory requirements simultaneously (safety, environmental, consumer protection, operational approvals). Finance controllers and management accountants actively manage these allocations with specific cost amounts, budget percentages, allocation methods, and validity periods.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Ancillary pricing rules must map to GL accounts for automated revenue recognition. Different price types (base fare, premium seat, baggage) post to different GL accounts per airline revenue accounting

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ancillary product being priced (e.g., baggage, seat selection, lounge access, Wi-Fi).

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Ancillary pricing varies by route (distance bands, regional regulations, competitive dynamics). Revenue management systems require route-level price configuration for baggage, seats, meals. Real busin

attributes.name: sales_channel_id

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter booking class (fare class) code for which this price applies. Used in yield-linked pricing strategies. Null if price applies across all booking classes.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage paid to the sales channel or agent for selling this ancillary product at this price. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this price record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fare amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination of the route or market where this price applies. Null if price is not route-specific.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price becomes valid and can be used in offer generation and booking.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) used to record this ancillary charge: EMD-S (standalone) or EMD-A (associated with e-ticket). Null if not EMD-linked.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this price is no longer valid. Null for open-ended prices.

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: The base price amount for the ancillary product in the specified currency. Does not include taxes or fees.

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Fare basis code that this ancillary price is linked to, used in yield-linked pricing strategies. Null for flat-fee or non-fare-linked pricing.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Geographic market or region code where this price applies (e.g., origin-destination pair, country, or region). Used when price is market-specific rather than route-specific.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units that can be purchased at this price. Null if no maximum limit applies.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be purchased for this price to apply. Typically 1 for most ancillary products. Used for volume-based pricing.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin of the route or market where this price applies. Null if price is not route-specific.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: Three-letter passenger type code indicating the passenger category for which this price applies (e.g., ADT for adult, CHD for child, INF for infant, SRC for senior). Null if price applies to all passenger types.

attributes.name: price_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the price record, used in revenue management and offer generation systems.

attributes.name: price_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the price, including any special conditions, restrictions, or promotional messaging. Used for customer-facing display.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price record: active (in use), inactive (not currently offered), pending (scheduled for future activation), expired (past expiration date), or suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy: flat fee (fixed amount), yield-linked (varies with fare class), dynamic (real-time demand-based), bundled (part of fare package), promotional (temporary discount), or seasonal (time-based).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Ranking or priority order for this price when multiple prices are available for the same product and conditions. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in offer generation logic.

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product purchased at this price is refundable. True if refundable, False if non-refundable.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: IATA Reason For Issuance Sub-Code identifying the specific ancillary service type (e.g., 0CC for checked baggage, 0B5 for seat selection). Used in EMD processing and settlement.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the ancillary service being priced: baggage, seat selection, meal, lounge access, Wi-Fi, travel insurance, priority boarding, fast track security, cabin upgrade, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: baggage|seat|meal|lounge|wifi|insurance|priority_boarding|fast_track|upgrade|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the ancillary product price, including VAT, GST, or other jurisdiction-specific taxes.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total price including base fare amount and all applicable taxes and fees.

attributes.name: travel_date_from
attributes.description: The earliest travel date for which this price is applicable. Used for seasonal or date-restricted pricing. Null if no travel date restriction applies.

attributes.name: travel_date_to
attributes.description: The latest travel date for which this price is applicable. Used for seasonal or date-restricted pricing. Null if no travel date restriction applies.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this price record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price record was last modified.

products.name: bundle
products.description: Defines bundled ancillary fare products (e.g., Basic, Standard, Flex, Premium bundles) that package multiple ancillary services into a single purchasable offer. Captures bundle composition rules, included service entitlements, pricing tiers, and unbundling eligibility. Supports the airline's unbundled fare strategy and branded fare merchandising.
products.reference: IATA NDC Offer / Branded Fares

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bundle

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Fare bundles define service levels aligned with cabin classes (Basic Economy, Main Cabin, Premium). Fare family design and merchandising require formal cabin class linkage for bundle eligibility rules

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Ancillary bundles (e.g., Premium Economy packages) are often launched as part of marketing campaigns with promotional pricing and targeted messaging. Real business need to track which campaign introdu

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Fare bundles (Basic Economy, Premium Economy, etc.) require GL mapping for revenue allocation across bundled components. Critical for unbundling revenue recognition and compliance with ASC 606 / IFRS

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Fare bundles are configured per route or route group (transatlantic vs domestic bundles differ in included services). Real business process: route-specific bundle definition for fare family merchandis

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_pieces
attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included in the bundle entitlement. Null if baggage is not included or uses weight-based allowance.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight allowance in kilograms for checked baggage included in the bundle. Null if baggage is not included or uses piece-based allowance.

attributes.name: base_price_amount
attributes.description: The base price of the bundle product before any adjustments, taxes, or dynamic pricing modifiers are applied.

attributes.name: booking_channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies any restrictions on which booking channels can sell this bundle (e.g., direct channels only, GDS excluded, mobile app exclusive). Empty if available on all channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all_channels|direct_only|gds_only|mobile_only|web_only|call_center_only|travel_agent_excluded — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bundle_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the bundle product used in reservation systems and merchandising platforms (e.g., BASIC_ECO, FLEX_PLUS, PREMIUM_BIZ).

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the bundle product including all included services, entitlements, restrictions, and value proposition for customer communication.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the bundle displayed to customers during booking and merchandising (e.g., Basic Economy, Flex Plus, Premium Business).

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bundle product indicating its availability for sale and merchandising.

attributes.name: bundle_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier level of the bundle within the airlines branded fare structure, indicating the level of service and entitlements included.

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle product by its primary business purpose and composition strategy.

attributes.name: cancellation_refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets purchased with this bundle are refundable upon cancellation (True) or non-refundable (False).

attributes.name: change_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ticket change fees are waived for bookings purchased with this bundle (True) or standard change fees apply (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bundle product record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bundle pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this bundle product becomes active and available for sale in reservation systems.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this bundle product expires and is no longer available for sale. Null for bundles with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: included_services_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct ancillary services included in this bundle composition.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bundle product record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lounge_access_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether airport lounge access is included as an entitlement in this bundle (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: maximum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: The maximum number of days before departure that this bundle can be purchased. Null if no maximum advance purchase restriction exists.

attributes.name: meal_service_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary in-flight meal service is included in this bundle (True) or meals must be purchased separately (False).

attributes.name: mileage_accrual_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of flown miles that accrue to the passengers Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) account when traveling on this bundle (e.g., 100.00 for full accrual, 50.00 for half accrual).

attributes.name: minimum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days before departure that this bundle must be purchased. Null if no advance purchase requirement exists.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The pricing methodology applied to this bundle indicating whether pricing is fixed, dynamically adjusted based on demand, or subject to yield management rules.

attributes.name: priority_boarding_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether priority boarding privileges are included in this bundle entitlement (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: route_restriction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle is available on all routes or restricted to specific route types (domestic, international, regional, or specific route list).

attributes.name: seat_selection_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance seat selection is included as an entitlement in this bundle (True) or must be purchased separately (False).

attributes.name: seat_selection_type
attributes.description: The category of seats available for selection under this bundle entitlement (standard, preferred, extra legroom, or any seat).

attributes.name: standby_priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to passengers on this bundle when placed on standby lists for earlier or alternative flights. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: travel_date_restriction_end
attributes.description: The latest travel date for which this bundle is valid and can be applied to bookings. Null if no end date restriction exists.

attributes.name: travel_date_restriction_start
attributes.description: The earliest travel date for which this bundle is valid and can be applied to bookings. Null if no start date restriction exists.

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers purchasing this bundle are eligible for cabin upgrades using miles, vouchers, or operational upgrades (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: wifi_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary in-flight Wi-Fi connectivity is included in this bundle entitlement (True) or not (False).

products.name: ancillary_bundle_component
products.description: Junction entity linking bundles to their constituent ancillary products, defining the specific services included in each bundle with quantity entitlements (e.g., 1x checked bag, 1x seat selection), inclusion type (mandatory/optional/upgradeable), and merchandising display sequence. Resolves the many-to-many relationship between bundles and products. Enables flexible bundle composition, entitlement validation at service delivery, and branded fare comparison displays.
products.reference: IATA NDC Offer Item

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_component_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bundle component junction record linking a bundle to a constituent ancillary product.

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent bundle (branded fare product) that contains this component.

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ancillary product or service included in this bundle component.

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_component_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this bundle component: active (available for sale), inactive (not offered), suspended (temporarily unavailable), pending_approval (awaiting commercial approval), deprecated (being phased out), seasonal_inactive (off-season).

attributes.name: booking_channel_restriction
attributes.description: Booking channel restriction for this component. Defines which distribution channels can sell bundles containing this component. All indicates no restriction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|web|mobile|gds|call_center|airport|travel_agent|corporate_booking_tool — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cabin_class_restriction
attributes.description: Cabin class restriction for this component. Defines which cabin classes this component applies to within the bundle. All indicates no restriction.

attributes.name: charge_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the incremental charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is eligible for travel agent or distribution partner commission. True if commissionable; false if non-commissionable.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable to this component if commission_eligible is true. Null if not commissionable.

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: Merchandising display order for this component within the bundle presentation, used for consistent UI rendering and fare comparison displays.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle component record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this component becomes active within the bundle composition. Used for seasonal or promotional component changes.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) issued for this component: emd_s (standalone, not linked to ticket), emd_a (associated with ticket), not_applicable (no EMD required).

attributes.name: entitlement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity entitlement: piece (baggage items), kilogram (weight allowance), segment (per flight leg), trip (round-trip), hour (lounge time), day (rental period), access (single entry), selection (seat choice), upgrade (cabin class). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: piece|kilogram|segment|trip|hour|day|access|selection|upgrade — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this component is removed from the bundle composition. Null indicates no expiration. Used for time-limited promotional components.

attributes.name: fulfillment_timing
attributes.description: Defines when this component is delivered or activated in the customer journey: at_booking (immediate), pre_departure (before travel date), at_checkin (during check-in), at_gate (boarding area), onboard (during flight), post_flight (after arrival), on_demand (customer-initiated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: at_booking|pre_departure|at_checkin|at_gate|onboard|post_flight|on_demand — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inclusion_type
attributes.description: Defines how this ancillary product is included in the bundle: mandatory (always included), optional (customer may decline), upgradeable (customer may enhance), conditional (subject to availability or route), promotional (limited-time offer), or seasonal (specific travel periods).

attributes.name: incremental_charge_amount
attributes.description: Additional charge amount for this component if is_chargeable is true. Null or zero if component is fully included in bundle base price.

attributes.name: is_chargeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component incurs an additional charge beyond the bundle base price. True if customer must pay extra for this component; false if fully included in bundle price.

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is refundable if the bundle is cancelled or downgraded. True if customer can receive refund for this component; false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component entitlement can be transferred to another passenger or booking. True if transferable; false if restricted to original purchaser.

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Customer-facing marketing description of this component for bundle merchandising displays, fare comparison tools, and booking flow presentation.

attributes.name: maximum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days before departure that the bundle containing this component can be purchased. Null indicates no maximum restriction.

attributes.name: minimum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that the bundle containing this component must be purchased. Null or zero indicates no advance purchase requirement.

attributes.name: passenger_type_restriction
attributes.description: Passenger type restriction for this component. Defines which passenger types are eligible for this component within the bundle. All indicates no restriction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|adult|child|infant|senior|student|military|corporate — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this component within the bundle for operational fulfillment and service delivery sequencing. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: quantity_entitlement
attributes.description: Number of units of this ancillary product included in the bundle entitlement (e.g., 1 for one checked bag, 2 for two lounge passes). Zero indicates unlimited or not-applicable.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: Four-character IATA RFISC code identifying the specific ancillary service type for EMD issuance and settlement (e.g., 0CC1 for checked baggage, 0B5A for seat selection).

attributes.name: route_applicability
attributes.description: Defines the route scope where this component is applicable: all (all routes), domestic (within country), international (cross-border), regional (within geographic region), intercontinental (long-haul), specific_routes (defined route list).

attributes.name: service_fee_code
attributes.description: Internal or IATA service fee code for revenue accounting and settlement of this component within the bundle.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL link to the detailed terms and conditions governing this component within the bundle, for customer disclosure and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle component record was last modified.

products.name: ancillary_order

Captures order date, sales channel (GDS, NDC, direct, airport), total amount, currency, payment reference, order status, and the originating booking context. Acts as the commercial anchor for ancillary revenue recognition and EMD issuance.
products.reference: IATA EMD-A / EMD-S Order

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.sales_channel. Business justification: Ancillary orders are placed through specific sales channels (web, mobile, GDS, airport kiosk, etc.). The order table has sales_channel and gds_code as STRING columns but no FK. Adding this FK normaliz

attributes.name: booking_class

attributes.name: cabin_class

products.name: ancillary_emd
products.description: Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) master record issued for ancillary services sold separately from the base e-ticket. Captures EMD number (13-digit IATA format), EMD type (EMD-S standalone or EMD-A associated), issuing airline, issuing office/GDS, associated ticket number, passenger name, total face value, currency, issuance date, validity period, and current coupon status. SSOT for EMD lifecycle management.

attributes.name: ancillary_emd_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Electronic Miscellaneous Document record. Primary key for the ancillary EMD product.

attributes.name: associated_reservation_reservation_e_ticket_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Office ID or GDS pseudo-city code (PCC) of the issuing location. Identifies the sales channel, agency, or airline office that created the EMD.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.pnr. Business justification: Links EMDs to booking records for IATA BSP/ARC settlement, revenue accounting, and EMD-to-ticket association. Mandatory for EMD lifecycle management and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.booking_passenger. Business justification: Links EMDs to booking passengers for passenger-specific EMD issuance, service entitlement, and refund processing. Essential for EMD passenger association and service delivery.

attributes.name: sales_channel_id

attributes.name: ancillary_service_code
attributes.description: IATA RFIC (Reason for Issuance Code) or RFISC (Reason for Issuance Sub-Code) identifying the specific ancillary service. Examples: 0CC=baggage, 0B5=seat selection, 0G1=lounge access.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount payable to the issuing agent or agency for selling the ancillary service. Used for agent settlement and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Commission rate as a percentage of the face value. Used to calculate agent compensation for ancillary sales.

attributes.name: coupon_number
attributes.description: Sequential coupon number within the EMD. An EMD may have multiple coupons for multi-segment or multi-service purchases. Typically 1 for single-service EMDs.

attributes.name: coupon_status
attributes.description: Current status of the individual EMD coupon. Tracks the lifecycle state of each service component within the EMD. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|used|refunded|exchanged|void|airport_control|checked_in|flown|suspended|irregular — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code in which the EMD was issued. Identifies the monetary unit for all amounts on the document.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA 3-letter airport code of the destination for the service. Identifies where the ancillary service ends or is delivered.

attributes.name: emd_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA-standard EMD number uniquely identifying the document globally. Format follows IATA Resolution 722 structure with airline code prefix and sequential number.

attributes.name: emd_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the EMD coupon. Open indicates unused, used indicates service consumed, refunded indicates money returned, exchanged indicates replaced with new EMD, void indicates cancelled before use, expired indicates validity period lapsed.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD issued. EMD-S (standalone) is issued independently for ancillary services. EMD-A (associated) is linked to a base e-ticket for bundled services.

attributes.name: endorsement_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing endorsement and restriction information. Specifies conditions, limitations, or special handling instructions for the EMD.

attributes.name: exchange_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the EMD is exchangeable. True if the ancillary service can be exchanged for another service or flight, false if non-exchangeable.

attributes.name: face_value_amount
attributes.description: Total face value amount of the EMD in the currency of issuance. Represents the gross charge for the ancillary service before any adjustments or taxes.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number to which the ancillary service applies. Format includes airline code and numeric flight identifier. May be null for non-flight-specific services like lounge memberships.

attributes.name: form_of_payment
attributes.description: Detailed form of payment string including masked card number or payment reference. Format follows IATA FOP standards. Contains partial payment card data.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EMD was issued. Marks the creation of the document and start of validity period.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the EMD was issued in the issuing system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA 2-letter or 3-letter airline code of the carrier that issued the EMD. Identifies the airline responsible for the document and settlement.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA 3-letter airport code of the origin for the service. Identifies where the ancillary service begins or is consumed.

attributes.name: original_issue_date
attributes.description: Original issue date for exchanged or reissued EMDs. Tracks the first issuance date when an EMD has been modified or replaced.

attributes.name: passenger_name
attributes.description: Full name of the passenger for whom the ancillary service EMD was issued. Format typically follows surname/given name convention per IATA standards.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA passenger type code. ADT=adult, CHD=child, INF=infant, SRC=senior citizen, MIL=military, STU=student. Determines eligibility for certain ancillary services and pricing.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method of payment used to purchase the EMD. Identifies the financial instrument used for settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|miles|voucher|corporate_account|bank_transfer — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the EMD is refundable. True if the ancillary service can be refunded per fare rules, false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ancillary service is scheduled to be consumed or delivered. For flight-related services, typically matches the flight departure date.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the ancillary service purchased. Examples: Extra Baggage 23kg, Premium Seat 12A, Priority Boarding, Lounge Access.

attributes.name: service_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the ancillary service purchased. For example, number of baggage pieces, number of meal vouchers, or 1 for single-use services like lounge access.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the EMD. Sum of all applicable taxes such as VAT, GST, or service taxes on the ancillary service.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount payable for the EMD including face value, taxes, and any fees. This is the final charge to the passenger.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour or promotional code associated with the EMD. Used for tracking special offers, packages, or corporate agreements.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the EMD is valid for use. After this date, the EMD expires and cannot be consumed or refunded.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: First date on which the EMD is valid for use. Defines the beginning of the service consumption window.

products.name: emd_coupon

Enables coupon-level reconciliation with BSP/ARC settlement.

attributes.name: conjunctive_ticket_indicator

attributes.name: coupon_amount

attributes.name: coupon_currency_code

attributes.name: coupon_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: destination_airport_code

Drives seat merchandising offers and revenue attribution by seat tier.

attributes.name: advance_selection_window_hours

attributes.description: Standard base price for this seat product in USD. Actual pricing may vary by route, fare class, and dynamic pricing rules. Used as reference price for revenue attribution.

attributes.name: bundle_eligibility

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seat product record was first created in the ancillary catalog system. Used for audit trail and product lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base price (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this seat product is discontinued or removed from sale. Null for products with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this seat product becomes available for sale and merchandising. Supports seasonal product launches and fleet configuration changes.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD issued for this seat product purchase. EMD-S (standalone) for ancillary-only purchases; EMD-A (associated) when linked to an e-ticket.

attributes.name: fare_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fare class codes eligible to purchase or select this seat product (e.g., 'Y,B,M,H,Q,V,W'). Empty indicates available to all fare classes.

attributes.name: ffp_tier_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of FFP elite tier codes eligible for complimentary access to this seat product (e.g., 'GOLD,PLATINUM,DIAMOND'). Empty indicates no elite benefit applies.

attributes.name: in_seat_entertainment

attributes.name: is_advance_selection_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers can select this seat product in advance during booking or check-in. False for seats assigned only at gate or by operational staff.

attributes.name: is_bassinet_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product supports bassinet attachment for infant passengers. Typically applies to bulkhead seats in long-haul configurations.

attributes.name: is_bulkhead

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seat product record was last updated. Tracks pricing changes, configuration updates, and status transitions.

attributes.name: merchandising_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking for display priority in seat selection interfaces and upsell offers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for merchandising presentation.

attributes.name: power_outlet_type

attributes.name: product_status

attributes.name: recline_inches

attributes.name: seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the seat measured in inches. Key comfort specification for merchandising and customer communication.

attributes.name: seat_characteristics
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of seat characteristics or attributes such as window, aisle, extra legroom, power outlet, restricted recline, etc.

attributes.name: seat_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount charged for the seat assignment if it was a paid ancillary product. Zero or null for complimentary assignments.

attributes.name: seat_fee_currency_code

products.name: baggage_allowance
products.description: Defines the baggage entitlement rules associated with a fare product, frequent flyer tier, or ancillary purchase — including number of pieces, weight limits (kg/lbs), size restrictions, and applicable route/cabin/PTC combinations. Supports both piece concept and weight concept allowance models per IATA Resolution 302. Used for entitlement validation at check-in and ancillary upsell logic.
products.reference: IATA Resolution 302 / Baggage Allowance

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_id
attributes.description: Primary key for baggage_allowance

attributes.name: ancillary_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.category. Business justification: Baggage allowances should be classified by ancillary category (e.g., Baggage, Checked Bag, Carry-On). The baggage_allowance table has baggage_category (STRING) but no FK. Adding this FK normalizes the

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Baggage allowances are defined per cabin class in fare construction rules (business 2 pieces, economy 1 piece). Fare rule application and ticketing require formal cabin class linkage. Fare constructio

attributes.name: allowance_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the baggage allowance rule, used for reference in fare products and ancillary catalogs.

attributes.name: allowance_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the baggage allowance rule (e.g., 'Economy Standard 2PC', 'Business Premium 3PC 32KG').

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: The allowance model applied: piece_concept (number of bags), weight_concept (total weight limit), or hybrid (combination of both).

attributes.name: applicable_ptc
attributes.description: Passenger Type Code this allowance applies to (e.g., ADT=adult, CHD=child, INF=infant, MIL=military). Null if applies to all passenger types.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the baggage allowance rule: active (in use), inactive (not in use), pending (scheduled for future), expired (past validity), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baggage allowance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the destination of travel. Null if not country-specific.

attributes.name: destination_region_code
attributes.description: IATA region or sub-region code for the destination (e.g., TC1=North America, TC2=Europe, TC3=Asia). Null if not region-specific.

attributes.name: dimension_limit_cm
attributes.description: Maximum dimensions allowed for each piece in centimeters, expressed as LxWxH (e.g., '158x90x75'). Null if no dimension restriction applies.

attributes.name: dimension_limit_inches
attributes.description: Maximum dimensions allowed for each piece in inches, expressed as LxWxH (e.g., '62x35x30'). Provided for markets using imperial units.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this baggage allowance rule becomes active and applicable to bookings.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD used to document this baggage allowance when purchased as ancillary: EMD-S (standalone) or EMD-A (associated with e-ticket).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this baggage allowance rule ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended rules.

attributes.name: fare_brand_code
attributes.description: Fare brand or product code associated with this allowance (e.g., BASIC, STANDARD, FLEX, PREMIUM). Null if not brand-specific.

attributes.name: ffp_tier_code
attributes.description: Frequent flyer tier code that grants this baggage allowance (e.g., GOLD, PLATINUM, ELITE). Null if not tier-dependent.

attributes.name: interline_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the interline or codeshare agreement under which this allowance applies. Null if not interline-specific.

attributes.name: is_combinable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allowance can be combined with other allowances (e.g., fare allowance + FFP tier allowance). True if combinable, false if exclusive.

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the baggage allowance (if purchased as ancillary) is refundable. True if refundable, false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baggage allowance can be transferred to another passenger or booking. True if transferable, false if non-transferable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baggage allowance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: linear_dimension_limit_cm
attributes.description: Maximum sum of length, width, and height in centimeters (L+W+H). Common standard is 158 cm for international checked baggage.

attributes.name: linear_dimension_limit_inches
attributes.description: Maximum sum of length, width, and height in inches (L+W+H). Common standard is 62 inches for international checked baggage.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline code of the marketing carrier for which this allowance applies. Null if applies to all carriers.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline code of the operating carrier for which this allowance applies. Null if applies to all carriers.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the origin of travel. Null if not country-specific.

attributes.name: origin_region_code
attributes.description: IATA region or sub-region code for the origin (e.g., TC1=North America, TC2=Europe, TC3=Asia). Null if not region-specific.

attributes.name: piece_count
attributes.description: Number of baggage pieces allowed under this rule (applicable for piece concept allowances). Null if weight concept only.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple allowance rules apply to the same booking context. Lower number = higher priority.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: IATA RFISC code identifying the specific ancillary service type for baggage (e.g., 0CC1=first checked bag, 0CC2=second checked bag).

attributes.name: route_group_code
attributes.description: Route group or geographic zone code this allowance applies to (e.g., DOM=domestic, INTL=international, TRANSATLANTIC). Null if applies globally.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field describing any special conditions, restrictions, or notes applicable to this baggage allowance (e.g., 'Applies only to direct flights', 'Excludes codeshare partners').

attributes.name: weight_limit_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight allowed per piece or total weight limit in kilograms. Applicable for weight concept or per-piece weight restrictions.

attributes.name: weight_limit_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum weight allowed per piece or total weight limit in pounds. Provided for markets using imperial units.

Key source for airport ancillary revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: booking_pnr_id
attributes.description: Internal system identifier for the passenger booking associated with this excess baggage charge.

attributes.name: checkin_counter_id

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.product_catalog. Business justification: Excess baggage charges are ancillary products (e.g., Extra Bag, Overweight Bag). No FK currently exists. Adding this FK enables product-level revenue tracking and standardized product definitions.

attributes.name: airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code where the excess baggage charge was assessed.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_kg
attributes.description: Passenger's included baggage allowance in kilograms based on fare class, route, and frequent flyer status. Used to calculate excess weight.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_pieces
attributes.description: Passenger's included baggage allowance in number of pieces based on fare class, route, and frequent flyer status. Used to calculate excess pieces.

attributes.name: base_charge_amount
attributes.description: Base excess baggage charge amount before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Cabin class of travel for the passenger on this segment, influencing baggage allowance and excess baggage pricing.

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the excess baggage charge indicating whether it has been collected, is pending payment, refunded, waived by staff, or under dispute.

attributes.name: charge_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the excess baggage charge was assessed and recorded in the system. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: collection_point
attributes.description: Location or channel where the excess baggage charge was assessed and collected (e.g., airport check-in counter, self-service kiosk, online pre-purchase, gate, baggage service office).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this excess baggage charge record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: excess_piece_count
attributes.description: Number of baggage pieces exceeding the passenger's included allowance. Null if charge is based on weight rather than piece count.

attributes.name: excess_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of baggage exceeding the passenger's included allowance. Null if charge is based on piece count rather than weight.

attributes.name: fare_class
attributes.description: Booking class or fare basis code of the passenger's ticket, which determines the baggage allowance and applicable excess baggage rates.

attributes.name: ffp_tier
attributes.description: Passenger's frequent flyer program tier status at time of charge, which may provide additional baggage allowance or waiver eligibility.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this excess baggage charge record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments recorded by the issuing agent regarding special circumstances, passenger requests, or operational context for this charge.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used by the passenger to settle the excess baggage charge (e.g., credit card, debit card, cash, mobile payment, voucher, frequent flyer miles, corporate account). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|cash|mobile_payment|voucher|miles_redemption|corporate_account — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: External payment transaction reference or authorization code from the payment gateway or processor. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: rate_per_kg

attributes.name: rate_per_piece
attributes.description: Charge rate applied per excess baggage piece. Used when pricing is piece-based. Null if weight-based pricing applies.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Explanation if the excess baggage charge was refunded after collection, including reason code or justification (e.g., measurement error, customer complaint resolution, operational error).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the excess baggage charge, including applicable VAT, GST, or other jurisdiction-specific taxes.

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total excess baggage charge amount including base charge and all applicable taxes and fees. Net amount collected from passenger.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation if the excess baggage charge was waived by staff, including reason code or justification (e.g., operational disruption, customer service recovery, elite status courtesy).

products.name: upgrade_offer
products.description: Defines commercial upgrade offers presented to passengers for cabin upgrades (e.g., Economy to Business) via bid, fixed-price, or miles-based mechanisms. Captures offer type (bid upgrade, instant upgrade, miles upgrade, operational upgrade), eligible fare classes, minimum and maximum bid amounts, offer window (hours before departure), target cabin, and channel availability. Supports revenue-optimized upgrade merchandising programs.
products.reference: IATA NDC Upgrade Offer / Bid Upgrade Program

attributes.name: upgrade_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the upgrade offer record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Upgrade offers (bid upgrades, mileage upgrades, paid upgrades) are frequently campaign-driven with specific promotional terms and targeted customer segments. Real business need to track campaign attri

attributes.name: source_cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Upgrade offers specify source cabin class for eligibility (economy to business, business to first). Upgrade program design and offer targeting require formal cabin class linkage for source eligibility

attributes.name: aircraft_type_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of aircraft type codes (ICAO designators) where this upgrade offer is valid. Null or empty indicates no aircraft restrictions. Used to target wide-body long-haul vs narrow-body short-haul configurations.

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of distribution channels where this upgrade offer is available (e.g., web, mobile app, airport kiosk, call center, Global Distribution System (GDS)). Defines merchandising channel strategy.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this upgrade offer record. Audit field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this upgrade offer record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this offer (minimum bid, maximum bid, fixed price).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this upgrade offer expires and is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended offer with no expiration. Defines the end of the offers lifecycle.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this upgrade offer becomes valid and available for presentation to passengers. Defines the beginning of the offers lifecycle.

attributes.name: eligible_fare_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fare class codes (booking classes) that qualify for this upgrade offer. Fare classes determine revenue management eligibility and upgrade priority.

attributes.name: emd_type_code
attributes.description: IATA Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) type code associated with this upgrade offer when issued as an ancillary charge. Typically 'A' for EMD-A (standalone) or 'S' for EMD-S (associated with e-ticket).

attributes.name: ffp_tier_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) elite tier status required for eligibility. None indicates no tier restriction; higher tiers may receive preferential upgrade offers.

attributes.name: fixed_price_amount
attributes.description: The fixed monetary price for instant upgrade offers. Null for bid-based or miles-based offers. Represents the non-negotiable purchase price.

attributes.name: inventory_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this upgrade offer is subject to real-time inventory availability checks in the target cabin. True means offer availability depends on seat inventory; false means offer is always available regardless of inventory.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this upgrade offer record. Audit field for change accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this upgrade offer record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: maximum_bid_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary bid amount allowed for bid-based upgrade offers. Null for non-bid offer types. Represents the ceiling price for competitive bidding.

attributes.name: miles_required
attributes.description: Number of Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles required to redeem this upgrade offer. Null for non-miles-based offers.

attributes.name: minimum_bid_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monetary bid amount required for bid-based upgrade offers. Null for non-bid offer types. Represents the floor price for competitive bidding.

attributes.name: offer_close_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure when this upgrade offer closes and is no longer available for purchase or bidding. Defines the closing of the offer window.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code identifying this upgrade offer in merchandising and revenue management systems.

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the upgrade offer including benefits, terms, and conditions presented to passengers during the offer flow.
attributes.references: DOT Consumer Protection Regulations 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Marketing name or title of the upgrade offer displayed to passengers in booking channels and merchandising platforms.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the upgrade offer. Active offers are available for purchase or bidding; inactive offers are not currently presented; expired offers have passed their validity window; suspended offers are temporarily paused; withdrawn offers have been permanently removed.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the upgrade offer mechanism. Bid upgrade allows passengers to submit competitive bids; instant upgrade is fixed-price immediate purchase; miles upgrade uses Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles; operational upgrade is airline-initiated for operational reasons; points upgrade uses loyalty points; voucher upgrade redeems a voucher or certificate.

attributes.name: offer_window_hours

products.name: channel_vendor_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the commercial agreement between a sales channel and a vendor for distributing the vendor's ancillary products through that channel. It captures channel-specific commission rates, settlement terms, integration methods, and service level agreements that exist only in the context of this channel-vendor partnership. Each record links one sales channel to one vendor with the commercial and technical terms governing their distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline ancillary distribution, vendors (catering providers, lounge operators, ground service providers) distribute their ancillary products through multiple sales channels (GDS, NDC APIs, airline.com, mobile app, airport kiosks), and each channel sells products from multiple vendors. The airline actively manages channel-vendor agreements that specify channel-specific commission rates, settlement terms, integration methods, and SLAs for each vendor-channel partnership. This is an operational business process involving contract negotiation, commission reconciliation, and multi-channel merchandising strategy.

attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: equipment_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the aircraft type assigned to this flight-date has been changed from the originally scheduled equipment. Equipment changes may alter cabin configuration, total capacity, and fare class bucket allocations requiring inventory rebalancing.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_config
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the active fare class bucket (booking class) configuration for this flight-date, listing each IATA booking class code and its authorized seat allocation (e.g., 'Y:20,B:15,M:10,Q:5'). Managed by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management and consumed by Amadeus Altéa for availability control.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: first_class_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the First Class cabin on this flight-date. Reflects the aircraft configuration and any cabin reconfiguration applied for this specific flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA-format airline designator and numeric flight number (e.g., AA101) identifying the marketed flight for which inventory is being managed. Used by GDS and direct channels to query availability.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; IATA Airline Designator Standard

attributes.name: gds_availability_code
attributes.description: Single-letter availability status code broadcast to Global Distribution Systems (GDS) representing the highest open booking class on this flight-date (e.g., 'Y' for full availability, 'L' for restricted availability). Conforms to IATA availability message standards.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; IATA PADIS (Passenger and Airport Data Interchange Standards); GDS Availability Standards

attributes.name: group_seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats currently held under group booking reservations (typically 10+ passengers under a single PNR group) on this flight-date. Group holds reduce available inventory for individual bookings and are subject to group ticketing deadlines.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: interline_seats_allocated
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated for interline ticketing partner bookings on this flight-date under IATA interline agreements. Distinct from codeshare allocations and tracked for ARC/BSP proration and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 780 (Interline); IATA ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation); Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: inventory_control_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory management for this flight-date is operating under MANUAL (revenue analyst override), AUTOMATED (Sabre AirVision algorithmic control), or HYBRID (automated with manual overrides) mode. Affects how fare class bucket changes are applied.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flight inventory record in Amadeus Altéa. OPEN indicates seats are available for sale; CLOSED indicates no further sales permitted; WAITLIST indicates demand exceeds supply and waitlist is active; SUSPENDED indicates temporary hold on sales; CANCELLED indicates the flight has been cancelled and inventory is frozen.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: last_seat_availability_date
attributes.description: Date on which the last available seat on this flight-date was sold or the inventory was closed. Used for post-departure revenue analysis and booking curve benchmarking.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this flight inventory record, including any changes to seat counts, fare class buckets, overbooking parameters, or inventory status. Critical for real-time availability synchronization with GDS.

attributes.name: load_factor_pct
attributes.description: Current load factor expressed as a percentage, calculated as seats_sold divided by authorized_capacity multiplied by 100. A key revenue management KPI representing the proportion of available seat capacity that has been sold. Used by Sabre AirVision for yield optimization decisions.
attributes.references: IATA WATS (World Air Transport Statistics); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: operational_seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats withheld from sale for operational purposes including deadhead crew positioning, airline staff travel, and aircraft ferry requirements. These seats are excluded from the sellable inventory pool.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; AIMS Crew Management System

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure station of this flight leg (e.g., JFK, LHR). Used to identify the inventory leg origin in route network and GDS availability queries.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: Revenue management-approved overbooking multiplier expressed as a percentage above physical capacity (e.g., 105.00 means 5% overbooking allowed). Set by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management based on historical no-show and cancellation rates to maximize load factor while managing denied boarding risk.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 (Oversales); IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: Absolute maximum number of bookings permitted on this flight-date including the overbooking allowance. Computed from authorized_capacity multiplied by overbooking_factor and used as the hard ceiling in the Amadeus Altéa booking engine.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: premium_economy_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the Premium Economy cabin on this flight-date. Nullable for aircraft configurations that do not include a Premium Economy cabin.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: revenue_management_class
attributes.description: Revenue management classification assigned by Sabre AirVision to this flight-date based on demand forecast, booking curve position, and competitive pricing environment. Drives automated fare class bucket opening and closing decisions for yield optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA RASK/CASK Framework

attributes.name: schedule_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this flight-date has undergone a schedule change (time, equipment, or routing modification) since the original inventory record was created. Schedule changes may trigger IROP (Irregular Operations) rebooking workflows and inventory reallocation.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; DOT 14 CFR Part 259 (IROP); IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: Current number of seats available for sale across all cabins on this flight-date, calculated as authorized_capacity minus seats_sold minus overbooking_buffer. This is the real-time availability figure broadcast to GDS and direct booking channels.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: seats_sold
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed seat bookings (Pax) across all cabins and fare classes on this flight-date. Updated in real-time as reservations are created, modified, or cancelled in the Amadeus Altéa Reservation system.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: total_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of physical seats available on the aircraft for this flight-date combination across all cabins. Derived from the aircraft configuration assigned to the flight and represents the maximum sellable inventory ceiling.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: Current number of passengers on the waitlist for this flight-date when inventory_status is WAITLIST or when specific fare classes are closed. Waitlisted passengers are cleared in priority order as cancellations occur.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

products.name: cabin_class
