attributes.description: Terminal identifier at the origin airport from which this leg departs (e.g., 'T1', 'T5', 'B'). Used for passenger wayfinding, ground handling coordination, and SITA airport management integration.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM; SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport of this inventory leg (e.g., 'LAX', 'CDG', 'SIN'). Defines the physical destination point of the leg for inventory, pricing, and slot management.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard (IATA SSIM); ICAO Doc 7910

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: The operating carrier's flight number for this leg, combining the IATA carrier code and numeric designator (e.g., 'AA101', 'LH400'). Used as the primary commercial identifier for the flight leg in GDS, OTA, and direct channels.

attributes.name: group_blocked_count
attributes.description: Number of seats currently blocked and held for group bookings on this leg. Reduces the net availability exposed to individual GDS and direct channel requests.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Inventory Control; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: interline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leg is eligible for interline ticketing, allowing passengers to be ticketed on a single document across multiple carriers. True = interline agreements apply to this leg.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 780 — Interline Traffic Agreements; IATA BSP

attributes.name: inventory_close_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when inventory for this leg was closed to new bookings. Typically triggered at departure or by revenue management closure rules. Null if inventory is still open.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Control; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: inventory_open_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when inventory for this leg was first opened for sale across GDS and direct channels. Marks the start of the revenue management availability window.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Control; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: irop_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leg is currently subject to an Irregular Operations (IROP) event such as a delay, cancellation, diversion, or equipment swap. True = IROP condition active. Triggers passenger re-accommodation workflows in Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory (PSS) — IROP Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 259

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent modification to this inventory leg record, including availability updates, status changes, capacity adjustments, or schedule revisions. Essential for incremental ETL processing and Silver Layer change detection.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability; ISO 9001:2015 — Records Control; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: leg_status
attributes.description: Current operational and inventory lifecycle status of this leg. 'active' — open for sale; 'cancelled' — flight cancelled, inventory closed; 'diverted' — flight diverted to alternate airport; 'suspended' — temporarily removed from sale; 'closed' — inventory closed post-departure.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Leg Status Codes; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: load_factor
attributes.description: Current load factor for this leg expressed as a percentage: (booked_count / total_seat_capacity) × 100. Key revenue management KPI representing the percentage of available seats filled. Updated in real time as bookings change.
attributes.references: IATA World Air Transport Statistics — Load Factor Definition; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code of the carrier physically operating this flight leg (e.g., 'AA', 'LH', 'EK'). Distinguishes the operating carrier from any marketing/codeshare carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; ICAO Doc 8585

attributes.name: operating_day_of_week
attributes.description: IATA day-of-week code on which this leg operates, where 1=Monday through 7=Sunday per IATA SSIM convention. Used for schedule frequency analysis and inventory pattern matching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 2 — Day of Week Coding

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport of this inventory leg (e.g., 'JFK', 'LHR', 'DXB'). Defines the physical origin point of the leg for inventory, pricing, and slot management.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard (IATA SSIM); ICAO Doc 7910

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: The overbooking multiplier applied to physical seat capacity for this leg, expressed as a percentage above 100 (e.g., 105.50 means 5.5% overbooking). Derived from Sabre AirVision Revenue Management no-show and cancellation forecasting models.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Model; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 (Denied Boarding Compensation)

attributes.name: schedule_period_code
attributes.description: IATA seasonal schedule period code under which this leg is published (e.g., 'W24' for Winter 2024, 'S25' for Summer 2025). Aligns with IATA SSIM scheduling seasons for slot coordination and network planning.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 1 — Scheduling Seasons; IATA Slot Guidelines

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled gate arrival date and time for this leg in UTC (ISO 8601 format). Represents the planned OOOI 'In' time used for connection logic, MCT calculations, and inventory closure triggers.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 2 — Schedule Data; ICAO Annex 2

attributes.name: scheduled_block_hours
attributes.description: Planned block time for this leg in decimal hours, measured from scheduled gate departure (Out) to scheduled gate arrival (In). Block hours are the primary unit for aircraft utilization, crew duty time, and cost accounting (CASK calculations).
attributes.references: IATA SSIM; FAA 14 CFR Part 117 — Flight and Duty Limitations; EASA ORO.FTL

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled gate departure date and time for this leg in UTC (ISO 8601 format). Represents the planned OOOI 'Out' time used for inventory availability windows, GDS display, and OTP measurement.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 2 — Schedule Data; ICAO Annex 2

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_distance_km
attributes.description: Great-circle distance of this leg in kilometres between origin and destination airports. Used in RPK (Revenue Passenger Kilometre) and ASK (Available Seat Kilometre) calculations, yield analysis, and CORSIA carbon emissions reporting.
attributes.references: IATA World Air Transport Statistics — RPK/ASK Definitions; CORSIA (ICAO Doc 9501)

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this physical leg within the parent flight inventory record (e.g., 1 for the first leg, 2 for the second leg of a multi-leg service). Used to reconstruct itinerary order and support through-availability logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787 — Leg/Segment Distinction; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: IATA single-character service type code indicating the nature of the flight service (e.g., 'J' for scheduled passenger, 'F' for scheduled freight, 'C' for charter). Drives inventory partitioning between passenger and cargo domains.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Appendix A — Service Type Codes

attributes.name: through_availability_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leg participates in through-availability calculations, allowing connecting itinerary availability to be computed across multiple legs without individual leg-level availability checks. True = through-availability enabled.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Through Availability; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: total_seat_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of sellable passenger seats on this leg across all cabins, as configured in the inventory system for the assigned aircraft type. This is the gross capacity before overbooking authorization is applied.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Capacity Management; IATA RP 1724

attributes.name: waitlisted_count
attributes.description: Number of passengers currently on the waitlist for this leg, pending availability opening due to cancellations or capacity adjustments. Managed within Amadeus Altéa Inventory waitlist queues.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Management; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: wet_lease_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leg is operated under a wet lease (ACMI) arrangement, where the aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance are provided by a lessor airline. Affects operating carrier attribution and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9626 — Wet Lease; EASA Air Operations Regulation (EU) 965/2012

products.name: segment
products.description: Master entity representing a commercial O&D (origin-destination) segment as sold to passengers, which may span one or more physical inventory legs. Captures the marketed flight number, O&D city pair, cabin, fare basis, and the through-availability nesting rules that govern how segment availability is derived from underlying leg buckets. Critical for connecting-itinerary inventory control and MCT (Minimum Connecting Time) enforcement.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Segment / IATA O&D Availability

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commercial Origin-Destination (O&D) inventory segment record in the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Segment-level inventory control and nesting logic depend on aircraft type's seat capacity and cabin class distribution. GDS availability calculations and codeshare seat allocation require aircraft typ

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: inventory_segment represents a commercial O&D segment sold in a specific cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links segment records to the cabin master. cabi

attributes.name: inventory_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying physical inventory leg (flight leg) from which this commercial segment derives its availability. A segment may span one or more legs in a connecting itinerary.

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled flight record associated with this inventory segment, linking to the flight operations domain for operational context.

attributes.name: authorized_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats authorized for sale on this segment in the specified cabin and booking class, including any overbooking allowance approved by revenue management. This is the gross sellable inventory before netting sold seats.

attributes.name: availability_control_method
attributes.description: Method used to control seat availability for this segment: 'leg_based' = availability derived from individual leg bucket counts; 'od_based' = availability controlled at the O&D segment level using virtual nesting; 'hybrid' = combination of leg and O&D controls.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_time
attributes.description: Timestamp (UTC) at which the current availability figures (seats_sold, seats_available, load_factor) were last refreshed from the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system. Critical for GDS cache synchronization and real-time availability accuracy.

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) representing the fare class bucket for this segment (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V, W). Directly controls availability nesting and revenue management yield optimization in Sabre AirVision and Amadeus Altéa.

attributes.name: codeshare_seat_allocation
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated to the marketing carrier under a block-space codeshare agreement for this segment. Applicable only when codeshare_type = 'block_space'. Null for free-flow or non-codeshare segments.

attributes.name: codeshare_type
attributes.description: Type of codeshare arrangement governing inventory allocation for this segment: 'free_flow' = marketing carrier draws from operating carrier's open inventory; 'block_space' = a fixed seat block is allocated to the marketing carrier; 'none' = not a codeshare segment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this inventory segment record was first created in the system, typically when the flight schedule was loaded into Amadeus Altéa Inventory for the season.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the segment at the origin airport in local time (yyyy-MM-dd). Used as the primary date dimension for inventory availability queries and revenue management yield optimization.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination station of this commercial O&D segment as sold to the passenger. Defines the arrival point of the sellable unit.

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code identifying the specific fare product associated with this inventory segment (e.g., YLOWUS, BAPOW). Governs fare rules, restrictions, and the booking class bucket to which availability is mapped.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: gds_availability_code
attributes.description: Availability status code published to Global Distribution Systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport for this segment and booking class. Standard codes include numeric seat counts (0-9) or alpha codes (A=available, C=closed, L=waitlist) per IATA AIRIMP standards.
attributes.references: IATA AIRIMP; IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: group_seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats currently held under group booking reservations for this segment. Group holds reduce available inventory and are subject to release deadlines managed by the group desk.

attributes.name: interline_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory segment is eligible for interline ticketing agreements, allowing passengers to book connecting itineraries across multiple carriers on a single ticket. Governed by bilateral interline agreements and IATA BSP/ARC settlement rules.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 780; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: load_factor
attributes.description: Current load factor for this inventory segment expressed as a percentage of physical cabin capacity that is sold or confirmed (seats_sold / physical_capacity * 100). Key performance indicator for revenue management and capacity planning. Note: this is a point-in-time snapshot value, not a computed aggregate.
attributes.references: IATA Economics; DOT Form 41; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: marketed_flight_number
attributes.description: The IATA-format flight number as sold to passengers and published in GDS channels (e.g., AA1234). For codeshare segments, this is the marketing carrier's flight number, which may differ from the operating carrier's flight number.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; IATA Airline Coding Directory

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier that markets and sells this segment to passengers. For codeshare flights, this is the airline whose flight number appears on the ticket.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 788

attributes.name: min_connecting_time_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum Connecting Time (MCT) in minutes required at the connecting airport for this segment to be valid in a connecting itinerary. Enforced during availability display and booking to prevent infeasible connections. Sourced from IATA SSIM MCT tables.

attributes.name: nesting_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical nesting level of this booking class within the cabin's availability nesting structure (e.g., 1=highest yield class, 10=lowest yield class). Governs through-availability rules: higher-level classes inherit availability from lower-level buckets per revenue management nesting policy.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier that physically operates the aircraft for this segment. Differs from marketing_carrier_code on codeshare flights.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin station of this commercial O&D segment as sold to the passenger. Defines the departure point of the sellable unit.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of seats that may be sold beyond the physical cabin capacity for this segment, as authorized by revenue management overbooking controls. Expressed as an absolute seat count above physical capacity.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: overbooking_rate
attributes.description: Overbooking authorization expressed as a percentage above physical cabin capacity (e.g., 5.00 = 5% overbooking). Used by revenue management to calibrate no-show risk models and optimize load factor.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: sale_close_date
attributes.description: Date after which this inventory segment is no longer available for new bookings. Typically set to the departure date or earlier based on advance purchase restrictions and revenue management close-out rules.

attributes.name: sale_open_date
attributes.description: Date from which this inventory segment is open for sale in GDS and direct booking channels. Defines the advance purchase window start for revenue management and distribution control.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time
attributes.description: Scheduled arrival date and time of the segment at the destination airport in UTC (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for MCT enforcement and connecting itinerary feasibility validation.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date and time of the segment at the origin airport in UTC (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for precise GDS availability display and MCT (Minimum Connecting Time) enforcement calculations.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: IATA scheduling season code for this inventory segment (e.g., S25 = Summer 2025, W24 = Winter 2024). Aligns inventory records with the IATA Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM) scheduling seasons used for slot management and route planning.

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: Current count of seats available for sale on this segment, computed as authorized_capacity minus seats_sold minus seats_blocked. This is the real-time availability figure published to GDS and direct channels.

attributes.name: seats_blocked
attributes.description: Number of seats held back from general sale for operational purposes such as crew positioning, group holds, codeshare allocations, or special service requests (SSR). Reduces net available inventory without being sold.

attributes.name: seats_sold
attributes.description: Number of seats currently confirmed as sold (booked and ticketed) on this inventory segment. Updated in real-time from the Passenger Service System (PSS) as bookings are made or cancelled.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of this inventory segment as published to GDS and direct booking channels. 'open' = seats available for sale; 'closed' = no availability; 'waitlisted' = demand exceeds supply, waitlist active; 'cancelled' = flight/segment cancelled; 'suspended' = temporarily removed from sale.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial segment by its operational and commercial structure: 'direct' = single leg O&D; 'connecting' = multi-leg through-availability segment; 'codeshare' = marketed by partner airline; 'interline' = cross-carrier ticketing agreement; 'virtual' = constructed availability for display purposes.

attributes.name: through_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment participates in through-availability nesting, meaning its availability is derived from the aggregated availability of underlying leg buckets rather than being independently controlled. True = through-availability applies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (UTC) of the most recent update to this inventory segment record, including availability changes, overbooking adjustments, or status transitions. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: Number of passengers currently on the waitlist for this inventory segment and booking class. Used by revenue management to assess latent demand and inform overbooking and upgrade decisions.

products.name: availability_snapshot
products.description: Transactional point-in-time capture of the full availability state across all fare class buckets for a flight inventory record, taken at scheduled intervals or triggered by significant booking events. Used for historical availability analysis, revenue management model training, and audit of GDS availability broadcasts. Stores the complete bucket-level seat count array, load factor at snapshot time, and the trigger reason (scheduled, booking threshold, manual override).
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Availability History / Sabre AirVision Availability Archive

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each point-in-time availability snapshot record captured for a flight inventory record.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — internal record key

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: availability_snapshot captures point-in-time availability state for a specific cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links snapshot records to the cabin maste

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: availability_snapshot captures availability state for a specific fare class bucket (RBD). fare_class_bucket is the master entity for RBD buckets. This FK links snapshot records to the bucket master. b

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight inventory record (flight-date-leg combination) for which this availability snapshot was captured. Links to the parent inventory entity in Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — flight inventory object

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled flight (operating flight number and departure date) associated with this snapshot, enabling direct join to flight operations data.
attributes.references: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — flight schedule object

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days before departure that a booking must be made to qualify for this fare class bucket at snapshot time. A fare restriction parameter that governs bucket eligibility.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — fare restriction conditions; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: authorized_capacity
attributes.description: The total number of seats authorized for sale in this cabin at snapshot time, incorporating the overbooking factor applied to physical cabin capacity. Represents the effective sellable ceiling for the cabin.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — authorized capacity; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: availability_code
attributes.description: The availability indicator code broadcast to GDS channels at snapshot time (e.g., A = available, L = limited, C = closed, R = request). Follows IATA/GDS standard availability display codes used in Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787 — GDS availability display codes

attributes.name: bucket_status
attributes.description: The availability status of this fare class bucket as broadcast to GDS and direct channels at snapshot time. Open = seats available for sale; Closed = bucket closed by RM; Waitlist = no seats but waitlist accepted; Request_only = availability subject to manual approval.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — bucket status codes; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: channel_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare class bucket has channel-specific distribution restrictions applied at snapshot time (e.g., web-only, GDS-excluded, direct-only). True = one or more channel restrictions are active.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787 — distribution channel controls; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: codeshare_seats_allocated
attributes.description: The number of seats in this fare class bucket allocated to codeshare partner airlines at snapshot time. Represents inventory blocked for partner distribution and reduces the seats available to the operating carrier's own channels.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — codeshare inventory allocation; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when this snapshot record was first written to the Silver layer data store. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and ETL traceability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and time format; internal data governance audit standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the rm_bid_price is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Necessary for multi-currency RM analysis across international routes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IATA BSP settlement currency standards

attributes.name: days_before_departure
attributes.description: The number of days between the snapshot timestamp and the scheduled departure date at the time of capture. A critical dimension for revenue management booking curve analysis and demand forecasting model training.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — booking curve analysis; IATA RP 1724

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The scheduled local departure date of the flight for which availability is being snapshotted. Used as a primary partitioning and filtering dimension for historical availability analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; DOT Schedule B-43 reporting

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival station of the flight leg being snapshotted (e.g., LAX, CDG). Denormalized for direct availability analysis by destination market.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: The IATA-format operating flight number (e.g., AA101, BA0293) at the time of the snapshot. Denormalized here for direct query access without joining to the flight schedule table.

attributes.name: gds_broadcast_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp at which this availability state was broadcast to Global Distribution Systems (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). Used for GDS audit trails and latency analysis between snapshot capture and distribution. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787 — GDS availability broadcast; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: group_seats_blocked
attributes.description: The number of seats in this cabin blocked for confirmed or tentative group bookings at snapshot time. Group blocks reduce the net availability for individual (PNR-level) bookings.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — group block management

attributes.name: is_active_snapshot
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the most current (latest) availability snapshot for the given flight inventory record and fare class bucket combination. True = this is the current state; False = superseded by a later snapshot. Supports efficient current-state queries without full history scans.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — current availability state management

attributes.name: load_factor
attributes.description: The cabin-level load factor at snapshot time, expressed as a ratio of seats sold to physical cabin capacity (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). A key revenue management KPI used to assess fill rate and trigger yield optimization actions. Calculated as seats_sold / physical_capacity.
attributes.references: IATA — Load Factor definition (RPK/ASK basis); DOT Form 41 Schedule T-100

attributes.name: minimum_stay_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a minimum stay condition (e.g., Saturday night stay) is required for bookings in this fare class bucket at snapshot time. True = minimum stay restriction is active on this bucket.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure station of the flight leg being snapshotted (e.g., JFK, LHR). Denormalized for direct availability analysis by origin market.

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: The overbooking multiplier applied to this cabin at snapshot time, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1.0500 = 5% overbooking above physical capacity). Set by revenue management to account for expected no-shows and cancellations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — overbooking controls; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 (denied boarding compensation)

attributes.name: physical_capacity
attributes.description: The actual number of physical seats installed in this cabin on the aircraft assigned to this flight at snapshot time. Reflects the aircraft configuration at the time of capture, which may differ from the scheduled configuration.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM — aircraft configuration; FAA 14 CFR Part 121 (aircraft certification)

attributes.name: rm_bid_price
attributes.description: The revenue management bid price (opportunity cost threshold) for this cabin at snapshot time, expressed in the operating currency. A booking is accepted only if its revenue exceeds the bid price. Core RM optimization output from Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — bid price optimization; IATA RP 1724

attributes.name: rm_forecast_demand
attributes.description: The revenue management system's demand forecast (unconstrained) for this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot, expressed as number of expected bookings. Sourced from Sabre AirVision RM forecasting module. Used for model training and forecast accuracy measurement.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — demand forecast output

attributes.name: seats_authorized
attributes.description: The maximum number of seats authorized by revenue management for sale in this fare class bucket (the bucket cap set by the RM system). Distinct from physical capacity; reflects yield optimization controls from Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — bucket authorization level

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: The number of seats available for sale in this fare class bucket at the moment of the snapshot. A value of zero indicates the bucket is closed. This is the primary sellable inventory count broadcast to GDS and direct channels.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — bucket availability count; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats in this bucket currently held under option or waitlist status (not yet confirmed) at snapshot time. Represents tentative demand that may convert to confirmed bookings.

attributes.name: seats_sold
attributes.description: The cumulative number of confirmed bookings (paid and held) in this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot. Includes codeshare and interline bookings allocated to this bucket.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — confirmed booking count

attributes.name: snapshot_sequence_number
attributes.description: An ordinal sequence number for snapshots taken for the same flight inventory record and fare class bucket, ordered by snapshot_timestamp ascending. Enables reconstruction of the full availability history and booking curve for a given flight-bucket combination.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — availability history sequencing

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise UTC date and time at which this availability state was captured. Serves as the primary temporal anchor for point-in-time analysis and GDS broadcast audit. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system that generated or triggered this availability snapshot. ALTEA = Amadeus Altéa Inventory (primary PSS); SABRE_AV = Sabre AirVision RM override; NETLINE = Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops operational change; MANUAL = manually entered override.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: The business event or condition that caused this snapshot to be taken. Distinguishes between routine scheduled captures, threshold-driven captures (booking or cancellation crossing a bucket boundary), manual revenue management overrides, reaccommodation events (IROPs), and overbooking adjustments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|booking_threshold|cancellation_threshold|manual_override|reaccommodation|overbooking_adjustment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — availability event types; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when this snapshot record was last modified in the Silver layer (e.g., due to late-arriving corrections or reprocessing). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and time format; internal data governance audit standard

attributes.name: upgrade_seats_used
attributes.description: The number of seats in this cabin occupied by passengers who have been upgraded from a lower cabin class (operational, complimentary, or mileage-based upgrades) at snapshot time. Affects net revenue yield for the cabin.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — upgrade tracking; Oracle Loyalty Cloud (FFP upgrade processing)

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: The number of passengers currently on the waitlist for this fare class bucket at snapshot time. A non-zero value when bucket_status is 'waitlist' or 'closed', indicating latent demand that may be cleared if cancellations occur.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — waitlist queue count

products.name: bucket_adjustment
products.description: Transactional audit record of every manual or automated change to inventory state, including fare class bucket capacity/limit changes, bucket open/close actions, cabin closures, flight-level stop-sale events, and reopen actions. Captures before and after values, adjustment type (bucket limit change, status change, flight closure, cabin closure, stop-sale), reason code (RM optimization, IROP reprotection, group block, codeshare reallocation, load factor threshold, schedule change), the initiating system or analyst (Sabre AirVision, Altéa Inventory, manual override), affected scope (flight, cabin, bucket), and effective timestamp. Provides the single authoritative audit trail of all inventory control decisions for post-departure revenue analysis and regulatory compliance.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Bucket Change Log / Sabre AirVision AU/BL Adjustment

attributes.name: bucket_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inventory bucket adjustment audit record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional audit entity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Audit Log Entity

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: bucket_adjustment records changes to inventory state affecting a specific cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links adjustment records to the cabin master.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or system account identifier of the analyst or automated process that initiated this inventory adjustment. Populated for manual overrides and analyst-driven actions; may be a system service account for automated RM adjustments. Confidential as it identifies internal workforce activity.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 — Operational Records; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fare class bucket (booking class) whose capacity or status was adjusted. Links to the fare class bucket master defining the booking class code and cabin association.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Class Bucket

attributes.name: rm_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the revenue management demand forecast record in Sabre AirVision that triggered or informed this automated inventory adjustment. Links the audit record to the RM optimization decision for post-departure forecast accuracy analysis.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Forecast-to-Action Linkage

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight leg whose inventory was adjusted. Identifies the flight-date-origin-destination combination affected by this adjustment.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Object

attributes.name: adjustment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this inventory adjustment event, used for cross-system traceability between Altéa Inventory, Sabre AirVision Revenue Management, and GDS channels.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Adjustment Reference; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: adjustment_scope
attributes.description: Defines the granularity level at which this inventory adjustment was applied: 'flight' (entire flight stop-sale or reopen), 'cabin' (all buckets within a cabin class), or 'bucket' (a specific fare class booking designator). Determines which of the cabin_code and booking_class_code fields are applicable.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Adjustment Scope; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this adjustment record. 'applied' indicates the change is live in inventory; 'reversed' indicates a subsequent correction nullified this action; 'superseded' indicates a later adjustment replaced this one.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the nature of the inventory control action applied. Drives downstream revenue analysis and audit classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bucket_limit_change|status_change|cabin_closure|flight_stop_sale|flight_reopen|codeshare_reallocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Adjustment Type Codes; Sabre AirVision RM Action Types

attributes.name: after_authorization_level
attributes.description: The bucket authorization level (seat limit / cap) set by this adjustment. Represents the maximum number of seats authorized for sale in this booking class after the change is applied. Delta from before_authorization_level quantifies the inventory impact.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Authorization Level; Sabre AirVision RM Bucket Controls

attributes.name: after_bucket_status
attributes.description: The availability status of the fare class bucket set by this adjustment. Captures whether the bucket is now open for sale, closed, on waitlist, or request-only after the change is applied.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Status; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: before_authorization_level
attributes.description: The bucket authorization level (seat limit / cap) in effect immediately before this adjustment was applied. Represents the maximum number of seats authorized for sale in this booking class prior to the change. Used for before/after delta analysis in revenue management.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Authorization Level; Sabre AirVision RM Bucket Controls

attributes.name: before_bucket_status
attributes.description: The availability status of the fare class bucket immediately before this adjustment. Captures whether the bucket was open for sale, closed, on waitlist, or request-only prior to the change.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Status; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: booking_class_code
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) identifying the fare class bucket affected by this adjustment (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V, G). Null for flight-level or cabin-level adjustments that span all buckets.

attributes.name: channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies whether this inventory adjustment applies to all distribution channels or is restricted to a specific channel subset: GDS (Global Distribution System), direct (airline.com and mobile), or NDC (New Distribution Capability) channels only. 'none' indicates no channel restriction is applied.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard (Resolution 787d); Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Channel Controls

attributes.name: codeshare_partner_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the codeshare marketing partner whose inventory allocation is affected by this adjustment. Populated only when is_codeshare_affected is True. Used to reconcile codeshare inventory reallocation events with partner settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; IATA Airline Designator Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this bucket adjustment record was first captured in the silver layer data product. Distinct from effective_timestamp which reflects the business event time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standard

attributes.name: days_to_departure
attributes.description: Number of days between the effective_timestamp of this adjustment and the scheduled flight departure date. Critical revenue management context metric used to analyze booking curve behavior and evaluate the appropriateness of inventory control decisions at each booking horizon.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Booking Curve Analysis; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival station of the flight leg affected by this inventory adjustment (e.g., LAX, CDG). Together with origin_airport_code defines the O&D pair for revenue analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard — IATA Resolution 763

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp at which the inventory adjustment became effective in the live inventory system. This is the business event time, distinct from the audit record creation timestamp. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Effective Date/Time; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the flight leg whose inventory was adjusted. Combined with flight_number provides the flight-date key used in GDS availability queries. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Date Key

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA-format airline designator and numeric flight number (e.g., AA1234) identifying the operating flight affected by this inventory adjustment. Denormalized for direct audit readability without joining to the flight entity.

attributes.name: initiating_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system or channel that triggered this inventory adjustment. Distinguishes automated revenue management actions (Sabre AirVision) from inventory system actions (Altéa Inventory), operations control actions (NetLine/Ops for IROPs), and manual analyst overrides.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Source System Identifier; Sabre AirVision RM Integration

attributes.name: irop_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this inventory adjustment to a specific Irregular Operations (IROP) event such as a cancellation, diversion, or significant delay that necessitated inventory reprotection or stop-sale actions. Null for non-IROP-driven adjustments.
attributes.references: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — IROP Event Management; ICAO Annex 6

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment was triggered automatically by a revenue management system rule or algorithm (True) versus initiated manually by a revenue management analyst (False). Enables segregation of automated vs. manual control decisions in audit and performance analysis.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Automation Rules; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: is_codeshare_affected
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment affects codeshare inventory allocations (True) in addition to or instead of the operating carrier's own inventory. When True, the codeshare_partner_code field identifies the affected marketing carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Inventory Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: load_factor_at_adjustment
attributes.description: The cabin or flight load factor (percentage of seats filled) at the time this adjustment was triggered. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.85 = 85%). Key context metric for revenue management yield optimization analysis and threshold-triggered automation.
attributes.references: IATA — Load Factor Definition; Sabre AirVision RM — Load Factor Threshold Triggers

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Supplementary free-text notes attached to this inventory adjustment record by the revenue management analyst or operations control team. May include escalation context, regulatory compliance notes, or cross-team coordination details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure station of the flight leg affected by this inventory adjustment (e.g., JFK, LHR). Used to scope the adjustment to the correct flight-leg inventory.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard — IATA Resolution 763

attributes.name: overbooking_factor_after
attributes.description: The overbooking authorization factor (as a percentage above physical capacity) set by this adjustment for this cabin/bucket. Compared against overbooking_factor_before to quantify the overbooking control change applied.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Controls; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: overbooking_factor_before
attributes.description: The overbooking authorization factor (as a percentage above physical capacity) in effect for this cabin/bucket immediately before this adjustment. For example, 1.10 represents 110% of physical seat capacity authorized. Used to audit overbooking control decisions.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Controls; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code classifying the business driver behind this inventory adjustment. Enables post-departure revenue analysis by adjustment cause. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rm_optimization|irop_reprotection|group_block|codeshare_reallocation|load_factor_threshold|schedule_change — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Reason Codes; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Action Reason

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the inventory adjustment beyond the standardized reason_code. Entered by the revenue management analyst or populated by the automated system (e.g., 'Load factor exceeded 85% threshold — closing Q class').

attributes.name: reversal_reference_number
attributes.description: The adjustment_reference_number of the subsequent adjustment record that reversed or superseded this action. Populated only when adjustment_status is 'reversed' or 'superseded'. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for compliance and revenue analysis.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Adjustment Reversal Chain; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: seats_available_after
attributes.description: The count of seats available for sale in this fare class bucket immediately after this adjustment was applied. Compared against seats_available_before to measure the net availability impact on GDS and direct channel inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Snapshot; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: seats_available_before
attributes.description: The count of seats available for sale in this fare class bucket immediately before this adjustment was applied. Snapshot of the real-time availability figure consumed by GDS channels prior to the change.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Snapshot; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction or message identifier assigned by the originating operational system (Altéa Inventory, Sabre AirVision, or NetLine/Ops) for this adjustment event. Enables traceability back to the system-of-record for reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Message ID; Sabre AirVision — Transaction Reference

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the last modification to this bucket adjustment record in the silver layer, for example when a reversal or status correction is applied. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standard

products.name: group_block
products.description: Master entity representing a reserved seat block allocated to a group booking request on a specific flight-date and cabin. Captures the group name, number of seats blocked, option date (deadline for confirmation), ticketing deadline, applicable fare class, deposit status, and the linked PNR reference. Group blocks reduce available inventory for individual sale and must be tracked separately from regular fare class bucket availability.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Group Block / IATA Group Booking Standard

attributes.name: group_block_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the group block record in the inventory system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Master

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: group_block allocates seats in a specific cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links group block records to the cabin master. cabin_code is redundant and ava

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Group bookings are often generated through marketing campaigns targeting tour operators, corporate travel programs, and event organizers. Airlines attribute group sales to campaigns for ROI measuremen

attributes.name: catering_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.catering_order. Business justification: Group bookings trigger special catering orders with bulk meal requirements and custom menus. Group coordinators link blocks to catering orders for accurate provisioning and cost allocation. Essential

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Group sales agents create and manage group blocks. Essential for sales commission calculation, performance metrics, accountability, and customer relationship management. Replaces agent_code with prope

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fare class bucket (booking class) under which the group block seats are held. Determines the yield and revenue management bucket impacted by this block.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Fare Class Bucket; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: group_block reserves a seat block for a group booking on a specific flight-date. flight_inventory is the master inventory record for that flight-date. This FK establishes the natural parent-child rela

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight-date instance on which this group block is reserved. Links to the flight schedule/operations entity.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master Passenger Name Record (PNR) associated with this group block. A group block is linked to a single group PNR in the Passenger Service System (PSS).
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — PNR; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the group block. 'tentative' = seats held pending confirmation; 'confirmed' = group has committed; 'ticketed' = tickets issued; 'cancelled' = block released back to inventory; 'expired' = option date passed without confirmation; 'waitlisted' = requested but not yet allocated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tentative|confirmed|ticketed|cancelled|expired|waitlisted — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Status; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: booking_class_code
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA booking class (fare class bucket) code under which the group seats are held (e.g., 'G' for group fare class). Directly controls which revenue management bucket is debited when seats are allocated.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Booking Class Codes; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group block is associated with a codeshare flight operation, where the operating carrier differs from the marketing carrier. True = codeshare flight; False = own-metal operation. Affects inventory allocation and interline settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group block record was first created in the inventory system. Supports audit trail, SLA tracking, and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 9001

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary deposit amount required or received for this group block, expressed in fare_currency_code. Null if deposit_required is False.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Deposit; IATA Resolution 722; BSP Settlement

attributes.name: deposit_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required deposit has been received from the group organizer. True = deposit received; False = deposit outstanding. Drives follow-up and cancellation workflows.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Deposit Status; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: deposit_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deposit payment was received from the group organizer. Null if deposit has not been paid.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Deposit; BSP Settlement

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a deposit payment is required from the group organizer to hold or confirm this group block. True = deposit required; False = no deposit required.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Deposit; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: fare_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the group_fare_amount is denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').

attributes.name: final_payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the full fare payment for all ticketed seats in the group block must be settled. Distinct from the deposit due date and ticketing deadline.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Payment; BSP Settlement; ARC Reporting

attributes.name: free_seat_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of complimentary (free) seats granted to the group organizer relative to the total seats purchased, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 1 free seat per 10 paid). Drives revenue accounting and yield calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — Group Complimentary Seats; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: free_seats_allocated
attributes.description: The actual number of complimentary (free) seats allocated to the group organizer based on the free_seat_ratio and confirmed group size. Impacts revenue accounting and load factor reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — Group Complimentary Seats; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: group_fare_amount
attributes.description: Negotiated per-seat fare amount agreed for this group block, expressed in the currency specified by fare_currency_code. Represents the contracted price per passenger for revenue accounting and settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — Group Fares; BSP Settlement; DOT Reporting

attributes.name: group_fare_basis
attributes.description: The fare basis code applicable to the group block, defining the fare rules, restrictions, and pricing conditions under which the group seats are sold (e.g., 'GEXCAP', 'YGROUP'). Aligns with IATA fare construction rules.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — Fare Basis; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The commercial or organizational name of the group for whom the seat block is reserved (e.g., 'Smith Wedding Party', 'ACME Corp Sales Conference'). Used for identification and communication with the group organizer.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Master; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group by purpose or segment. Used for revenue management analysis, pricing strategy, and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: leisure|corporate|incentive|military|religious|sports|charter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Segment Classification; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group block record was most recently updated in the inventory system. Used for change detection, ETL delta processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 9001

attributes.name: minimum_group_size
attributes.description: The minimum number of passengers required to qualify for group fare pricing on this block, as defined by the applicable fare rules. Typically 10 passengers per IATA group fare conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — Group Fare Minimum; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: names_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the group organizer must submit individual passenger names (Pax names) for all seats in the confirmed block. Required for check-in, security compliance, and advance passenger information (API) submission.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Group Names Due; IATA Resolution 722; TSA Secure Flight; ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier actually operating the flight (relevant for codeshare blocks where the operating carrier may differ from the marketing carrier). Required for interline settlement and ACARS reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Airline Designators; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: option_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the group organizer must confirm the number of seats and provide passenger names. If not confirmed by this date, the block may be automatically released back to inventory. Critical for inventory management and revenue optimization.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Option Date; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: overbooking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group block is subject to overbooking controls. True = the block counts against overbooking limits; False = the block is protected from overbooking displacement (e.g., guaranteed allocation). Feeds revenue management overbooking models.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Controls; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this group block by the Passenger Service System (PSS) or reservations team. Used by travel agents and group coordinators to identify and manage the block.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Reference; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or special instructions associated with this group block, entered by the reservations agent or group coordinator. May include special service requests (SSR), handling notes, or commercial conditions.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — PNR Remarks; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the group block was requested and booked. 'direct' = airline reservations team; 'gds' = Global Distribution System (GDS) such as Amadeus or Sabre; 'online_travel_agency' = OTA; 'corporate' = corporate travel desk; 'charter' = charter operator.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Distribution Channel; IATA Resolution 722; GDS Standards

attributes.name: seats_blocked
attributes.description: Current number of seats held (blocked) in inventory for this group. Reduces available seat count for individual sale. May differ from seats_requested if the airline partially approved the block.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Allocation; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: seats_confirmed
attributes.description: Number of seats within the block that have been formally confirmed by the group organizer. May be less than seats_blocked during the tentative phase. Drives revenue recognition and ticketing obligations.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Confirmation; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: seats_released
attributes.description: Number of seats that have been released back to general inventory from this group block, either due to partial cancellation, reduction, or expiry of the option. Supports inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block Release; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: seats_requested
attributes.description: Total number of seats originally requested by the group organizer at the time of the initial group block request. Baseline for tracking changes to the block size.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Block; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: seats_ticketed
attributes.description: Number of seats within the confirmed block for which electronic tickets (e-tickets) have been issued. Used to track ticketing progress against the ticketing deadline.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — e-Ticket; IATA Resolution 722; BSP Settlement

attributes.name: ticketing_deadline
attributes.description: The final date by which all confirmed seats in the group block must be ticketed (e-tickets issued). Failure to ticket by this date may result in automatic cancellation of unticketed seats and release to general inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Ticketing Deadline; IATA Resolution 722; BSP Settlement

products.name: waitlist_entry
products.description: Transactional record of a passenger or booking placed on the waitlist for a specific fare class bucket when availability is closed. Captures the PNR reference, requested cabin and fare class, waitlist priority rank, waitlist reason (sold-out, upgrade request, group overflow), creation timestamp, and clearance status. Managed by Altéa Inventory's waitlist processing engine and cleared automatically when bucket availability opens.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Waitlist / IATA Waitlist Processing

attributes.name: waitlist_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each waitlist entry record in the Altéa Inventory waitlist processing engine. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: campaign_response_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_response. Business justification: Passengers may waitlist after responding to a campaign offer when inventory is sold out. Airlines track campaign-driven demand including waitlisted requests for demand forecasting. Essential for measu

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fare class booking class bucket (e.g., Y, B, M, Q) for which availability was closed and the waitlist entry was created. Drives revenue management yield optimization.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Class Bucket; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: Waitlist entries specify the requested fare class (RBD) for clearance processing. Waitlist clearance algorithms prioritize by fare class yield, eligibility rules, and bucket authorization. Essential f

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight inventory record (flight-date-cabin combination) for which this waitlist entry is held. Identifies the sellable inventory unit in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Object

attributes.name: group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group booking record when the waitlist entry originates from a group overflow scenario (waitlist_reason = GROUP_OVERFLOW). Links the individual waitlist entry back to the parent group contract for group management reporting.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Group Booking; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual passenger profile associated with this waitlist entry. A single PNR may contain multiple passengers, each generating a separate waitlist entry.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Passenger Profile; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Passenger Name Record (PNR) booking that is placed on the waitlist. Links the waitlist entry to the originating reservation in the Passenger Service System (PSS).
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — PNR Object; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: altea_waitlist_sequence
attributes.description: Native waitlist sequence number assigned by the Amadeus Altéa Inventory waitlist processing engine. Serves as the business identifier for this waitlist entry within the Altéa system, used for reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the source PSS.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Sequence; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA booking class (fare class) code within the requested cabin for which the waitlist entry was created (e.g., Y, B, M, H, Q, K, L, V, W, S, N, G). Directly maps to a revenue management fare class bucket in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Class

attributes.name: cabin_code
attributes.description: IATA single-character cabin designator for the cabin class requested by the waitlisted passenger. F: First Class; C: Business Class; W: Premium Economy; Y: Economy. Determines the inventory pool from which clearance will be attempted.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Cabin Configuration

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the waitlist entry was created. GDS: Global Distribution System (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport); NDC: IATA New Distribution Capability channel; DIRECT_WEB: airline direct website; MOBILE: airline mobile application; AIRPORT: airport check-in or gate agent; CALL_CENTER: reservations call center; INTERLINE: interline partner booking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GDS|NDC|DIRECT_WEB|MOBILE|AIRPORT|CALL_CENTER|INTERLINE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clearance_booking_class
attributes.description: The actual booking class in which the waitlist entry was cleared and confirmed, which may differ from the originally requested booking class if the revenue management system cleared the passenger into a higher-availability bucket. Null until clearance occurs.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Clearance; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: clearance_method
attributes.description: Method by which the waitlist entry was cleared. AUTOMATIC: Altéa Inventory engine cleared automatically when bucket availability opened; MANUAL: airport or reservations agent manually cleared the entry; UPGRADE_PROCESSING: cleared as part of an upgrade processing run; IROP_REACCOMMODATION: cleared during Irregular Operations (IROP) reaccommodation workflow.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Clearance Method; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the waitlist entry was successfully cleared and the seat confirmed. Null if the entry has not yet been cleared. Used to measure waitlist clearance latency and revenue recovery timing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Clearance Event; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the waitlist entry was first created in the Altéa Inventory system. Serves as the business event timestamp for queue ordering and audit purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Creation Event; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport of the waitlisted flight segment (e.g., LAX, CDG, SIN). Used for route-level waitlist analysis and GDS availability messaging.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) at which the waitlist entry will automatically expire if not cleared, typically aligned with the flight departure time or a configurable pre-departure deadline set by revenue management policy. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Expiry Rules; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code associated with the waitlisted booking (e.g., YLOWUS, BAPUS21). Encodes the fare family, booking class, and applicable restrictions. Used by revenue management to validate clearance eligibility and by pricing to re-price upon confirmation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Basis

attributes.name: ffp_member_number
attributes.description: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) membership number of the waitlisted passenger. Used to apply loyalty-based priority rules and to credit miles upon clearance and travel. Classified as confidential PII as it is a unique personal identifier.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — Member Number; IATA Resolution 728; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: ffp_tier
attributes.description: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) membership tier of the waitlisted passenger at the time of waitlist entry creation (e.g., NONE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, ELITE). Higher tiers receive elevated priority rank in the waitlist queue per revenue management policy.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — FFP Tier; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 253

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled local departure date of the flight for which the waitlist entry is held. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Used for inventory snapshot reporting and waitlist aging analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Date

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA flight number (carrier designator + numeric suffix, e.g., AA101) for the flight on which the waitlist entry is held. Denormalized from the flight inventory record for operational reporting and GDS availability messaging.

attributes.name: gds_queue_number
attributes.description: Queue number assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) for this waitlist entry, used to route clearance notifications back to the originating travel agent or booking system. Null for direct-channel bookings.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — GDS Queue Management; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: is_codeshare
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waitlist entry is associated with a codeshare flight operation where the marketing carrier differs from the operating carrier. True: codeshare booking; False: own-metal operation. Affects inventory allotment rules and clearance authority.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 (Codeshare); Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Codeshare Inventory

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier under whose flight number the ticket was sold (marketing carrier). For codeshare flights, this may differ from the operating carrier. Determines which inventory pool and allotment rules apply.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a clearance or status-change notification has been dispatched to the passenger or booking agent following a waitlist status transition. True: notification sent; False: notification pending or not applicable. Supports DOT consumer notification compliance.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259 — Passenger Notification; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the clearance or status-change notification was dispatched to the passenger or booking agent. Null if no notification has been sent. Used for DOT consumer protection compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259 — Passenger Notification; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier actually operating the flight (e.g., AA, BA, EK). Relevant for codeshare flights where the marketing carrier differs from the operating carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; ICAO Doc 8585

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport of the waitlisted flight segment (e.g., JFK, LHR, DXB). Used for route-level waitlist analysis and GDS availability messaging.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank of this waitlist entry within the queue for the same flight, cabin, and fare class bucket. Lower values indicate higher priority for clearance. Determined by Altéa Inventory based on booking time, fare paid, and frequent flyer tier.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Queue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: revenue_management_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether a revenue management analyst manually overrode the standard Altéa Inventory waitlist clearance rules for this entry (e.g., to prioritise a high-value passenger or honour a corporate contract). True: manual override applied; False: standard automated rules applied.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Override Controls; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: seat_count_requested
attributes.description: Number of seats requested on the waitlist for this entry. For individual bookings this is typically 1; for group bookings this may be greater than 1. Determines the inventory units required for clearance.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Seat Request; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this waitlist entry. Primarily ALTEA_INV (Amadeus Altéa Inventory) but may include GDS source codes for externally originated waitlist requests. Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — System Integration; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: ssr_codes
