attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA Special Service Request (SSR) codes associated with the waitlisted passenger (e.g., WCHR, VGML, UMNR). These SSRs must be honoured upon clearance and seat assignment. Stored as a denormalized string for operational reference.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — SSR Codes; Amadeus Altéa Reservation — SSR

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA electronic ticket (e-ticket) number associated with the waitlisted booking segment. Follows the IATA 13-digit format (3-digit airline code + 10-digit serial). May be null if the ticket has not yet been issued at the time of waitlist creation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the waitlist entry record was last modified in the source system, including status transitions, priority re-ranking, or clearance processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Record Audit; ISO 8601

attributes.name: upgrade_from_cabin_code
attributes.description: For upgrade-request waitlist entries, the cabin code of the originally booked cabin from which the passenger is requesting an upgrade (e.g., Y for Economy). Null for sold-out or group overflow waitlist reasons. Used by upgrade processing logic in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Processing; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: waitlist_reason
attributes.description: Business reason why the passenger or booking was placed on the waitlist rather than confirmed. SOLD_OUT: requested fare class bucket was closed; UPGRADE_REQUEST: passenger requested cabin upgrade pending availability; GROUP_OVERFLOW: group booking exceeded available allotment; OVERBOOKING_CONTROL: revenue management overbooking limit reached; CODESHARE_ALLOTMENT: codeshare partner inventory allocation exhausted.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Reason Codes; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: waitlist_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the waitlist entry as managed by the Altéa Inventory waitlist processing engine. OPEN: actively queued awaiting availability; CLEARED: bucket opened and seat confirmed; CANCELLED: passenger or agent cancelled the waitlist request; EXPIRED: flight departed or deadline passed without clearance; REJECTED: system or revenue management rule prevented clearance.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Waitlist Status Codes; IATA Resolution 728

products.name: upgrade_inventory
products.description: Master entity managing the pool of seats designated for complimentary and paid upgrade processing within a cabin on a specific flight-date. Captures the number of seats held for elite FFP upgrades, bid-upgrade auction seats, operational upgrade pool, upgrade priority rules, and the clearance window (hours before departure). Interfaces with the loyalty domain for elite tier upgrade prioritization and the ancillary domain for paid upgrade products.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Upgrade Pool / FFP Elite Upgrade Management

attributes.name: upgrade_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the upgrade inventory record. Primary key for the upgrade_inventory data product within the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Inventory Entity

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Elite upgrade clearance algorithms determine upgrade seat pool size from aircraft type's cabin configuration (business class seat count, lie-flat availability). Automated upgrade processing at departu

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: upgrade_inventory manages upgrades TO a target cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links upgrade inventory to the target cabin master. cabin_class_code is r

attributes.name: catering_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.catering_order. Business justification: Upgrade clearances change cabin meal requirements post-catering cutoff. Catering must adjust premium meal counts when upgrades clear. Operational link ensures service delivery to upgraded passengers a

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: upgrade_inventory manages the pool of seats designated for upgrades on a specific flight-date. flight_inventory is the master inventory record for that flight-date. This FK establishes the natural par

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight instance (flight-date combination) for which this upgrade inventory pool is managed. Links to the flight operations domain.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Object

attributes.name: auto_upgrade_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system is configured to automatically process and clear eligible upgrade requests for this flight-cabin pool without manual agent intervention.

attributes.name: bid_upgrade_max_price
attributes.description: Maximum monetary bid amount cap for a paid bid-upgrade auction seat in this cabin on this flight. Prevents outlier bids and anchors the auction ceiling for revenue management.
attributes.references: IATA EMD Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: bid_upgrade_min_price
attributes.description: Minimum monetary bid amount accepted for a paid bid-upgrade auction seat in this cabin on this flight. Expressed in the operating currency. Feeds ancillary revenue management.
attributes.references: IATA EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: bid_upgrade_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated to the paid bid-upgrade auction channel (e.g., Plusgrade or equivalent ancillary upgrade product). Feeds the ancillary services domain for revenue capture.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Ancillary Upgrade Allocation; IATA EMD Standards

attributes.name: clearance_cutoff_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure at which upgrade clearance processing closes. After this threshold, no further upgrades are processed and remaining pool seats revert to general inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Clearance Configuration

attributes.name: clearance_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure at which the upgrade clearance processing window opens. Defines when the system begins auto-clearing eligible waitlisted upgrade requests.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Clearance Configuration

attributes.name: codeshare_upgrade_seats
attributes.description: Number of upgrade seats within the pool allocated to codeshare partner airline passengers. Governs interline and codeshare upgrade entitlements per bilateral agreements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Codeshare Inventory Allocation

attributes.name: confirmed_upgrades
attributes.description: Current count of upgrade seats that have been confirmed and assigned to passengers across all upgrade types. Used to compute remaining availability in real time.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Real-Time Availability Snapshot

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this upgrade inventory record was first created in the system, typically at schedule publication or inventory initialization for the flight-date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which bid upgrade prices are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with BSP settlement currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan)

attributes.name: elite_upgrade_processing_order
attributes.description: Primary sort criterion used when sequencing elite FFP upgrade candidates from the waitlist. TIER_FIRST=highest loyalty tier processed first; FARE_FIRST=highest paid fare class first; CHECKIN_FIRST=earliest check-in time first; MILES_FIRST=highest accrued miles balance first.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — Upgrade Priority Configuration; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: elite_upgrade_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats within the upgrade pool reserved exclusively for complimentary upgrades to elite-tier Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) members. Interfaces with Oracle Loyalty Cloud for tier eligibility.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — Elite Tier Upgrade Allocation; IATA FFP Standards

attributes.name: fare_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of booking class (fare class bucket) codes whose holders are eligible for upgrade processing from this pool (e.g., Y|B|M|H). Aligns with Amadeus Altéa fare class bucket configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full fare class list]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Fare Class Bucket Configuration; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent real-time availability snapshot for this upgrade inventory pool, as published to GDS and direct booking channels. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa real-time availability feeds.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Real-Time Availability Snapshot; IATA NDC (New Distribution Capability)

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the upgrade inventory pool for this flight-cabin combination. OPEN=upgrades available for processing; CLOSED=no further upgrades accepted; WAITLIST=pool exhausted but waitlist active; SUSPENDED=temporarily halted by revenue management; EXPIRED=clearance window has passed.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Status Codes

attributes.name: last_clearance_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent automated upgrade clearance processing run for this flight-cabin pool. Used for operational monitoring and audit of clearance execution.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Clearance Audit Log

attributes.name: load_factor_at_snapshot
attributes.description: Cabin load factor (percentage of seats filled) in the target upgrade cabin at the time of the most recent inventory snapshot. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used by revenue management to calibrate upgrade pool sizing.
attributes.references: IATA — Load Factor (ASK/RPK Metrics); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: min_elite_tier_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Elite Tier Required for Complimentary Upgrade
attributes.description: Minimum Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) elite tier level a member must hold to be eligible for a complimentary upgrade from this pool. Tiers below this threshold are excluded from elite upgrade processing.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — Elite Tier Upgrade Eligibility; IATA FFP Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by revenue management or inventory control staff regarding special handling instructions, exceptions, or context for this upgrade inventory pool.

attributes.name: operational_upgrade_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats held for operational upgrades issued by the airline at check-in or gate (e.g., IROP recovery, oversell resolution, VIP handling). Managed by ground operations and airport staff.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Irregular Operations (IROP) Handling; SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: overbooking_buffer_seats
attributes.description: Number of additional upgrade seats held as an overbooking buffer above physical cabin capacity to account for expected no-shows and cancellations. Managed by revenue management yield optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Controls; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why a revenue management override was applied to this upgrade inventory pool. Applicable only when revenue_management_override is TRUE. IROP=Irregular Operations; VIP=VIP passenger handling; COMMERCIAL=commercial agreement; CAPACITY_CHANGE=aircraft swap or gauge change.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Override Audit; IATA IROP Standards

attributes.name: pool_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the upgrade inventory pool was closed, either by reaching the clearance cutoff or by manual revenue management action. Null if pool is still open.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Pool Lifecycle

attributes.name: pool_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the upgrade inventory pool was opened and made available for upgrade request intake. Marks the start of the upgrade acceptance window.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Pool Lifecycle

attributes.name: priority_rule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the upgrade priority rule set applied to this inventory pool. Governs the sequencing logic for elite FFP tier, fare class paid, check-in time, and other tiebreaker criteria.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Priority Rules Engine; Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: revenue_management_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether a revenue management analyst has manually overridden the system-calculated upgrade seat allocation for this flight-cabin pool, superseding automated yield optimization rules.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Manual Override Controls

attributes.name: source_cabin_class_code
attributes.description: IATA cabin class code of the originating cabin from which passengers are being upgraded. Defines the upgrade direction (e.g., Y→C means Economy to Business). Complements cabin_class_code which is the target cabin.

attributes.name: total_upgrade_seats
attributes.description: Total number of seats in the target cabin designated as available for upgrade processing across all upgrade types (elite FFP, bid, operational). This is the gross pool before allocation by upgrade type.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Seat Capacity Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this upgrade inventory record, including seat count adjustments, status changes, or override actions.

attributes.name: waitlisted_upgrades
attributes.description: Number of upgrade requests currently on the waitlist for this flight-cabin pool, pending seat availability or clearance processing.

products.name: irop_reprotection
products.description: Transactional record of inventory reprotection actions taken during IROP (Irregular Operations) events such as flight cancellations, diversions, or significant delays. Captures the disrupted flight reference, the reprotection flight(s) offered, number of seats ring-fenced for displaced passengers, priority class (elite, connecting, medical), reprotection status, and the operations control center authorization. Directly impacts available inventory on recovery flights.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory IROP Reprotection / IATA Irregular Operations Standard

attributes.name: irop_reprotection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each IROP reprotection action record in the inventory system. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: authorized_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Operations Control Center staff authorize IROP passenger reprotections and inventory ring-fencing. Required for operational accountability, regulatory compliance audit trails (EU261, DOT), and cost ce

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: irop_reprotection records inventory reprotection actions targeting a specific cabin class during irregular operations. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links reprotec

attributes.name: catering_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.catering_order. Business justification: IROP events trigger catering order cancellations for disrupted flights and adjustments for recovery flights. Operations Control Center uses this link to manage catering changes during irregular operat

attributes.name: consumer_protection_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consumer_protection_case. Business justification: IROP reprotection events that trigger passenger rights obligations (EU261 delay/cancellation compensation, DOT tarmac delay) must link to consumer protection cases for compensation tracking, regulator

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: IROP recovery costs (passenger compensation, rebooking, hotel vouchers) are tracked by cost center for financial impact analysis and operational performance reporting. Airlines monitor IROP cost expos

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: irop_reprotection records target a specific fare class bucket for reprotection. fare_class_bucket is the master entity for RBD buckets. This FK links reprotection records to the bucket master. fare_cl

attributes.name: flight_irop_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IROP event (e.g., cancellation, diversion, significant delay) that triggered this reprotection action. Links to the IROP event master record.
attributes.references: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — IROP Event; IATA Irregular Operations Handbook

attributes.name: primary_irop_scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original flight segment that was disrupted (cancelled, diverted, or significantly delayed), causing the need for passenger reprotection. Directly impacts inventory on the disrupted flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops

attributes.name: authorized_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the Operations Control Center (OCC) formally authorized this reprotection action. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.
attributes.references: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — OCC Authorization; ICAO Annex 6 — Flight Operations

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recovery flight operates under a codeshare agreement. When true, inventory ring-fencing must be coordinated with the operating carrier's inventory system, adding complexity to the reprotection process.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Codeshare Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this reprotection record was first created in the inventory system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; ISO 9001 — Records Management

attributes.name: destination_airport_iata_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport of the disrupted flight (e.g., LAX, CDG). Denormalized for IROP reporting and route-level disruption analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 762

attributes.name: disrupted_flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date (local airport time) of the disrupted flight. Used for day-of-operations reporting and IROP timeline analysis.

attributes.name: disrupted_flight_number
attributes.description: IATA flight number of the disrupted flight (e.g., AA1234). Denormalized for operational reporting and IROP dashboards without requiring a join to the flight segment table.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Flight Numbering; Amadeus Altéa

attributes.name: downgrade_compensation_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers in this reprotection block are entitled to downgrade compensation (e.g., fare difference refund or EMD issuance) because they are being accommodated in a lower cabin class than originally booked.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 261/2004 — Air Passenger Rights; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: gds_availability_updated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Distribution System (GDS) Availability Updated Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the real-time availability snapshot on the recovery flight has been updated and broadcast to GDS channels (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) to reflect the ring-fenced seats. Critical for preventing oversell on the recovery flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — GDS Availability; IATA Resolution 788; SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: interline_reprotection_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reprotection action involves rebooking passengers onto a flight operated by a different carrier under an interline agreement. Triggers BSP/ARC settlement and interline billing processes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Interline Reprotection; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: inventory_impact_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Revenue Management system has acknowledged and processed the inventory reduction on the recovery flight caused by this reprotection action. Ensures yield optimization models reflect the ring-fenced seats.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Snapshot

attributes.name: irop_cause_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of the IROP event that triggered reprotection. Drives downstream analytics on disruption patterns and recovery cost attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CANCELLATION|DIVERSION|SIGNIFICANT_DELAY|EQUIPMENT_SWAP|ATC_GROUND_STOP|WEATHER|CREW_SHORTAGE|SECURITY|MEDICAL|MECHANICAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Irregular Operations Handbook; DOT 14 CFR Part 234; FAA Advisory Circular

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this reprotection record was last modified. Tracks status changes, seat count adjustments, and authorization updates for audit purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; ISO 9001 — Records Management

attributes.name: occ_authorization_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Operations Control Center authorization record that approved this reprotection action. Ensures accountability and traceability of inventory ring-fencing decisions.
attributes.references: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — OCC Authorization; ICAO Annex 6

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-letter IATA airline designator code of the carrier actually operating the recovery flight. May differ from the marketing carrier in codeshare scenarios. Required for interline reprotection coordination.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Airline Designator Codes; IATA Interline Traffic Agreements

attributes.name: origin_airport_iata_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport of the disrupted flight (e.g., JFK, LHR). Denormalized for IROP reporting and passenger communication workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 762

attributes.name: overbooking_override_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OCC applied an overbooking override to accommodate reprotected passengers beyond the recovery flight's standard authorized overbooking limit. Requires elevated authorization and triggers denied boarding risk monitoring.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Overbooking Controls; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: pax_displaced_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers displaced by the IROP event who are eligible for reprotection under this action. May exceed seats_ring_fenced if partial reprotection is applied.
attributes.references: IATA Irregular Operations Handbook; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding Compensation

attributes.name: pnr_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct Passenger Name Records (PNRs) included in this reprotection action. Used to track the scope of the reprotection and reconcile against seats_ring_fenced.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722 — PNR Standard; Amadeus Altéa Reservation

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Priority tier assigned to this reprotection block, determining the order in which displaced passengers are accommodated on the recovery flight. ELITE: frequent flyer elite members; CONNECTING: passengers with onward connections at risk; MEDICAL: passengers with medical needs or SSR codes; UNACCOMPANIED_MINOR: UM passengers; STANDARD: general passengers.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Priority Handling; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: recovery_flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date (local airport time) of the recovery flight. Used to determine inventory impact window and reprotection timeline.

attributes.name: recovery_flight_number
attributes.description: IATA flight number of the recovery (reprotection) flight on which seats are ring-fenced (e.g., AA1456). Denormalized for operational dashboards and GDS availability messaging.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when unused ring-fenced seats were released back to general inventory. Populated when reprotection_status transitions to RELEASED or EXPIRED. Null if all seats were utilized or reprotection is still active.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Management; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: reprotection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the OCC agent describing special circumstances, exceptions, or instructions related to this reprotection action (e.g., VIP handling, diplomatic passengers, group reprotection conditions).
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops — OCC Remarks

attributes.name: reprotection_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned by the Passenger Service System (PSS) to uniquely identify this reprotection action across operational systems and GDS channels. Used for cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: reprotection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reprotection action. PENDING: awaiting OCC authorization; ACTIVE: seats ring-fenced and available for displaced passengers; CONFIRMED: passengers booked onto recovery flight; RELEASED: unused seats returned to general inventory; EXPIRED: reprotection window passed without use; CANCELLED: reprotection voided.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Management; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: reprotection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reprotection strategy applied. SAME_DAY: recovery on same calendar day; NEXT_DAY: recovery on following day; MULTI_LEG: recovery requires multiple connecting flights; INTERLINE: recovery on partner carrier; UPGRADE: passenger accommodated in higher cabin; DOWNGRADE: passenger accommodated in lower cabin with compensation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: reprotection_window_close_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the reprotection inventory block expires. After this time, unused ring-fenced seats are released back to general inventory. Nullable if the window is open-ended until flight departure.

attributes.name: reprotection_window_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the reprotection inventory block was activated and seats became available for displaced passenger booking. Marks the start of the reprotection window.

attributes.name: seats_released
attributes.description: Number of ring-fenced seats that were released back to general inventory after the reprotection window closed or the action was cancelled. Equals seats_ring_fenced minus seats_utilized when fully resolved.

attributes.name: seats_ring_fenced
attributes.description: Number of seats on the recovery flight that have been ring-fenced (blocked from general sale) for displaced passengers under this reprotection action. Directly reduces available inventory on the recovery flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Seat Availability Management; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: seats_utilized
attributes.description: Number of ring-fenced seats that were actually used by displaced passengers. Compared against seats_ring_fenced to measure reprotection efficiency and inventory recovery.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; IATA Irregular Operations Handbook

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this reprotection record. ALTEA: Amadeus Altéa Inventory PSS; NETLINE: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops; SABRE: Sabre AirVision; MANUAL: manually entered by OCC agent. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 — Data Provenance; Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops

attributes.name: ssr_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA four-letter Special Service Request (SSR) codes applicable to passengers in this reprotection block (e.g., WCHR, UMNR, MEDA). Ensures special handling requirements are preserved during reprotection.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 831 — Special Service Requests (SSR); Amadeus Altéa Reservation

products.name: season_inventory_plan
products.description: Master entity representing the pre-departure seasonal inventory plan for a flight or route, defining the planned capacity deployment, cabin mix, initial bucket authorization levels, and overbooking strategy for an IATA season (summer/winter schedule period). Created during schedule planning and used as the baseline against which actual inventory performance is measured. Aligns with IATA SSIM season definitions.
products.reference: IATA SSIM Season / Altéa Inventory Season Plan

attributes.name: season_inventory_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the seasonal inventory plan record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Strategic network planning allocates aircraft types to seasonal routes based on fleet composition, range capability, and seat capacity. Season inventory plans drive schedule filings and slot coordinat

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget_plan. Business justification: Seasonal capacity plans (ASK, frequencies, aircraft deployment) are budgeted in financial planning cycles. Links planned inventory to revenue/cost budgets for variance analysis and board reporting. Co

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Seasonal marketing campaigns are planned against seasonal inventory plans (summer schedules, winter routes). Integrated commercial planning requires alignment between capacity deployment and marketing

attributes.name: fuel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.fuel_contract. Business justification: Seasonal flight programs determine fuel contract volumes and airport coverage requirements. Fuel procurement uses seasonal plans for contract negotiations, minimum offtake commitments, and supplier se

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the route master record for the origin-destination pair covered by this inventory plan. Enables route-level aggregation and network planning analysis.

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight schedule record from which this seasonal inventory plan was derived. Links the inventory plan to the underlying schedule planning entity (route, frequency, and timing) as defined in the schedule planning system.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Seasonal capacity plans drive long-term catering and ground service contracts. Procurement negotiates seasonal supply contracts based on planned flight programs. Essential for contract volume commitme

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Revenue Management or Inventory Control authority who formally approved this seasonal inventory plan for activation. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.
attributes.references: ICAO SMS (Safety Management System) Doc 9859; Internal Governance

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this seasonal inventory plan was formally approved by the authorized Revenue Management or Inventory Control authority. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the approval milestone.

attributes.name: authorized_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of bookings authorized for acceptance on this flight for the season, incorporating the overbooking strategy applied to total_planned_capacity. This is the effective sellable inventory ceiling used by the Passenger Service System.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Authorization Level; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: business_class_capacity
attributes.description: Number of seats planned in the Business Class cabin (including premium business variants such as Clipper Class, Club World) for this seasonal inventory plan. Zero if no Business Class cabin exists.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Definitions; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: codeshare_allocation_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats within the total authorized capacity allocated to codeshare marketing partners for sale under their own flight numbers. Null or zero if codeshare_indicator is False.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this inventory plan includes codeshare seat allocations (True) or is a purely operating-carrier plan (False). When True, codeshare partner allocations are governed by this plan.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seasonal inventory plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which yield targets and revenue metrics for this inventory plan are denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan)

attributes.name: days_of_operation
attributes.description: IATA SSIM-standard days-of-week string indicating which days this flight operates within the season (e.g., '1234567' = daily, '135' = Mon/Wed/Fri). Uses IATA day numbering: 1=Monday through 7=Sunday.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 3 — Days of Operation

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival station of the flight covered by this inventory plan (e.g., 'JFK', 'CDG'). Used to identify the route destination.

attributes.name: economy_class_capacity
attributes.description: Number of seats planned in the Economy Class cabin for this seasonal inventory plan. Typically the largest cabin and primary driver of load factor and yield management decisions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Definitions; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: first_class_capacity
attributes.description: Number of seats planned in the First Class cabin for this seasonal inventory plan. Zero if the aircraft configuration does not include a First Class cabin.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Definitions; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA-format operating flight number (carrier designator + numeric suffix, e.g., 'AA101') for which this seasonal inventory plan is defined. Identifies the specific flight or flight series covered by this plan.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Flight Designators; ICAO Doc 8585

attributes.name: gds_availability_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this flight's inventory is made available for sale through Global Distribution Systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport (True) or is restricted to direct channels only (False).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 854 — GDS Distribution; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: iata_season_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: IATA (International Air Transport Association) Season Code
attributes.description: IATA-standard season designator indicating the schedule period this plan covers. Format: S=Summer, W=Winter followed by 2-digit year (e.g., 'S24' for Summer 2024, 'W24' for Winter 2024). Aligns with IATA SSIM season definitions.

attributes.name: initial_bucket_authorization
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Fare Class Bucket Authorization Levels
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the initial booking class (fare bucket) authorization levels at season open, as configured in Amadeus Altéa Inventory (e.g., 'Y:180,B:120,M:90,Q:60,V:30'). Defines the starting inventory allocation across RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) buckets before dynamic RM optimization. Confidential as it encodes pricing strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote bucket detail to a child product season_inventory_bucket_plan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Authorization; IATA Resolution 728 — RBD

attributes.name: interline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this flight and its inventory plan participates in interline ticketing agreements with other carriers (True) or is restricted to own-carrier ticketing only (False).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 780 — Interline Traffic Agreements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this seasonal inventory plan record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for change tracking and data lineage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: load_factor_target
attributes.description: The target load factor (percentage of seats filled) set by Revenue Management for this flight during the season, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Used as the baseline KPI against which actual load factor performance is measured. Confidential as it reflects commercial strategy.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier marketing and selling seats on this flight. May differ from operating_carrier_code in codeshare arrangements. Null if same as operating carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; IATA Resolution 762

attributes.name: minimum_connecting_time_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum Connecting Time (MCT) in minutes applicable at the origin airport for this flight, as published for the season. Used by GDS and booking systems to validate connection feasibility for itinerary construction.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 6 — Minimum Connecting Times; IATA Resolution 743

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier actually operating the flight (e.g., 'AA', 'BA', 'LH'). Distinguishes the operating carrier from marketing carriers in codeshare arrangements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Airline Designators; ICAO Doc 8585

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure station of the flight covered by this inventory plan (e.g., 'LHR', 'JFK'). Used to identify the route origin.

attributes.name: overbooking_rate
attributes.description: The planned overbooking percentage applied to total capacity for this seasonal inventory plan, expressed as a percentage above 100% (e.g., 5.00 means 5% overbooking above physical capacity). Set by Revenue Management based on historical no-show and cancellation rates. Confidential as it reflects pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Oversales; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this seasonal inventory plan, used in Amadeus Altéa Inventory and cross-system references (e.g., 'SIP-W24-LHR-JFK-Y'). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this master resource.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the seasonal inventory plan (e.g., 'Winter 2024 LHR-JFK Economy Inventory Plan'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this master resource.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the seasonal inventory plan. 'draft' = under construction; 'approved' = authorized for use; 'active' = currently governing live inventory; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'closed' = season ended; 'superseded' = replaced by a revised plan. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Plan Lifecycle; IATA SSIM

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory plan by its operational purpose. 'baseline' = initial seasonal plan; 'revised' = updated mid-season plan; 'codeshare' = plan governing codeshare inventory allocation; 'charter' = charter flight inventory; 'adhoc' = ad-hoc or supplemental plan. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare

attributes.name: planned_arrival_time
attributes.description: Planned scheduled arrival time in local time at the destination airport, in HHMM format (e.g., '1145' for 11:45). Represents the published schedule time for the season as filed in IATA SSIM.

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Planned scheduled departure time in local time at the origin airport, in HHMM format (e.g., '0830' for 08:30). Represents the published schedule time for the season as filed in IATA SSIM.

attributes.name: premium_economy_capacity
attributes.description: Number of seats planned in the Premium Economy cabin for this seasonal inventory plan. Zero if no Premium Economy cabin exists on the planned aircraft type.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Definitions; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: revenue_management_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to this inventory plan within the Sabre AirVision Revenue Management system. Used for cross-system traceability between the inventory plan in Altéa and the corresponding RM optimization model in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: season_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the IATA schedule season for which this inventory plan is effective. Corresponds to the IATA SSIM-defined season end date. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL.

attributes.name: season_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the IATA schedule season for which this inventory plan is effective. Corresponds to the IATA SSIM-defined season start date (typically last Sunday of March for Summer, last Sunday of October for Winter). Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM.

attributes.name: total_planned_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of sellable seats planned for this flight for the season, across all cabins. Represents the principal quantitative capacity fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this inventory plan. Derived from aircraft configuration but stored here as the authoritative planned figure.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Capacity Management

attributes.name: yield_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Yield Target (Revenue per Revenue Passenger Kilometer)
attributes.description: The target yield (revenue per Revenue Passenger Kilometer — RPK) set by Revenue Management for this flight for the season, expressed in the operating currency per RPK. Used as the baseline revenue efficiency target. Confidential as it encodes pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines; DOT Form 41

products.name: lease_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of aircraft lease contract costs to specific flight inventory records for IFRS 16 compliance, route profitability analysis, and unit cost accounting. Each record links one lease contract to one flight-date inventory record, capturing the proportion of lease expense, flight hours attributed, allocation methodology, and effective period. This enables accurate P&L attribution at the flight level and supports revenue management yield optimization decisions.. Existence Justification: Airlines operate under IFRS 16 lease accounting requirements that mandate allocation of aircraft lease costs to individual flight operations for accurate unit cost accounting and route profitability analysis. A single lease contract (covering an aircraft, engine, or APU) generates costs that must be allocated across hundreds or thousands of flight inventory records over the lease term, while a single flight may consume resources from multiple leased assets (primary aircraft lease, spare engine lease, APU lease). The allocation relationship is actively managed by finance teams who calculate, approve, and post allocation entries monthly, with specific allocation percentages, flight hours, cost amounts, and methodology tracked for each lease-flight pairing.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: lease_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lease cost allocation record

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Cost Allocation - Flight Inventory Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the flight inventory record receiving the allocated lease cost

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA general ledger journal entry document generated from this allocation record. Supports audit trail and reconciliation between cost allocation system and financial ledger.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Cost Allocation - Lease Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease contract from which costs are being allocated

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to allocate lease costs to this flight. FLIGHT_HOURS: proportional to block hours; CYCLE_COUNT: proportional to takeoff/landing cycles; REVENUE_SHARE: proportional to revenue generated; SEAT_MILES: proportional to available seat miles; MANUAL: finance-approved override allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the lease contract's periodic cost allocated to this specific flight inventory record, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0125 = 1.25%). Sum of allocation percentages across all flights for a given lease-period should equal 1.0.

attributes.name: allocation_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM format) for which this lease cost allocation applies. Supports monthly close processes and period-over-period cost variance analysis.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the allocation record. DRAFT: preliminary calculation; APPROVED: finance-reviewed and approved; POSTED: GL journal entries generated; REVERSED: allocation reversed due to correction or schedule change.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of lease expense allocated to this flight inventory record for the effective period, denominated in the lease contract currency. Calculated as periodic_lease_payment × allocation_percentage, adjusted for any variable payment components.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the finance analyst or manager who approved this allocation for posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was approved for GL posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this allocation record was initially created by the lease cost allocation batch process or manual entry.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this lease cost allocation is effective. Typically aligns with the flight departure date or the beginning of the accounting period for which costs are being allocated.

attributes.name: flight_hours_attributed
attributes.description: Block hours (departure gate to arrival gate) attributed to this flight for the purpose of lease cost allocation. Used in utilization-based allocation methods where lease cost is distributed proportionally to flight hours operated.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Corporate financial management SSOT covering general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, cost centre accounting, budget planning, financial consolidation, CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) reporting, fuel cost accounting, lease liability (IFRS 16), interline billing settlements, treasury operations, and regulatory financial reporting. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules.
domains.references: IFRS, GAAP, DOT Form 41, IATA Financial Accounting Guidelines

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SSOT for all accounting entries across the airlines chart of accounts. Each record represents a journal entry document (posting) with header attributes (document number, posting date, fiscal period, document type, company code, reference, reversal indicator, posting user) and line items (debit/credit amounts, GL account, cost centre, profit centre, functional area, cost element, currency, exchange rate). Supports IFRS and local GAAP dual reporting, period-end close, intercompany postings, accruals, provisions, and financial consolidation across all legal entities. Serves as the immutable audit trail for regulatory financial reporting and the single authoritative source for all financial postings.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (General Ledger)

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each general ledger journal entry line item record in the SAP S/4HANA FI-GL module. Serves as the immutable primary key for the silver layer lakehouse table.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each GL entry belongs to ONE company code. The general_ledger table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. This is a mandatory dimension in SAP FI-GL.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each GL entry can be assigned to ONE cost center for CO allocation. The general_ledger table has cost_centre (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master.

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this posting is recorded. Supports dual-reporting requirements for airlines operating across multiple jurisdictions. IFRS16 specifically tracks right-of-use asset and lease liability postings for aircraft operating leases.
attributes.references: IFRS 1; IFRS 16; Local GAAP; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: amount_company_currency
attributes.description: The posting amount converted to the company code's local currency (BSEG-DMBTR). Used for statutory financial reporting, local GAAP compliance, and period-end balance sheet preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 21; Local GAAP

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: The posting amount translated to the group reporting currency (BSEG-KURSF-based calculation, stored as parallel ledger amount). Supports consolidated financial statements and group-level CASK/RASK reporting across all airline entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Parallel Ledger; IFRS 10; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: The gross posting amount in the original transaction currency (BSEG-WRBTR). Represents the raw financial value before currency conversion. Used for interline billing settlements, BSP reconciliation, and multi-currency financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 21; IATA BSP

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field used for sorting and grouping line items in account statements (BSEG-ZUONR). Typically populated with flight number, route code, or cost object reference to facilitate operational cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency (T001-WAERS). The currency in which statutory accounts are prepared for the legal entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI T001; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element corresponding to the GL account for cost and revenue postings (BSEG-KOSTL-linked KSTAR). Bridges FI and CO modules, enabling detailed cost analysis for fuel uplift, crew costs, MRO expenses, and lease payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CEL; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accounting document was first created in SAP (BKPF-CPUDT + BKPF-CPUTM combined). Provides the immutable audit creation timestamp for the journal entry, distinct from the business posting_date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: SAP indicator specifying whether the line item is a debit (S = Soll) or credit (H = Haben) posting (BSEG-SHKZG). Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and ensures the document balances to zero.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 1; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract) that triggered the accounting entry (BKPF-BLDAT). May differ from posting_date for accruals, prepayments, or late-received invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number uniquely identifying the journal entry header within a company code and fiscal year. Corresponds to BKPF-BELNR in SAP. All line items sharing the same document number belong to the same posting event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the accounting entry (BKPF-BLART). Controls number ranges and account types. Common airline values include SA (GL account document), KR (vendor invoice), DR (customer invoice), ZP (payment), AA (asset posting), AB (accounting document). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|ZP|AA|AB|RV|WA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL T003; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the company code currency at the time of posting (BKPF-KURSF). Critical for IFRS IAS 21 compliance and interline settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 21; IATA BSP

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (1–16) within the fiscal year to which the posting belongs (BKPF-MONAT in SAP). Periods 13–16 are special closing periods used for year-end adjustments, accruals, and audit corrections.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the accounting document belongs (BKPF-GJAHR in SAP). Used for period-end close, annual financial reporting, and year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classifying the business function of the posting for cost-of-sales accounting (BSEG-FKBER). Enables income statement presentation by function (e.g., Flight Operations, Sales & Distribution, Administration) per IFRS IAS 1.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account number from the chart of accounts to which this line item is posted (BSEG-HKONT / SKA1-SAKNR). Represents the financial classification of the transaction (e.g., fuel expense, lease liability, revenue, accrued liabilities). Core to CASK reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: gl_account_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the GL account (SKA1-TXT50). Denormalised from the chart of accounts for reporting convenience and audit trail completeness. Examples: 'Jet Fuel Expense', 'Aircraft Lease Liability (IFRS 16)', 'Interline Receivable'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the accounting document header level (BKPF-BKTXT). Provides overall context for the journal entry, shared across all line items of the same document. Used for audit trail and period-end close documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this posting is an intercompany transaction between two legal entities within the airline group (BKPF-BVTYP populated). True = intercompany posting requiring elimination in group consolidation. Critical for IFRS 10 consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; IATA Interline Accounting

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order number used to collect costs for specific projects, campaigns, or temporary cost objects (BSEG-AUFNR). Used in aviation for aircraft modification projects, route launch campaigns, and MRO work orders.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accounting document was last modified in SAP. Tracks changes to parked documents, header text updates, or clearing events. Supports change audit trail requirements under SOX and IFRS.

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: SAP parallel ledger identifier (BKPF-RLDNR) supporting dual IFRS and local GAAP reporting. Common values: '0L' = leading ledger (IFRS), 'N1' = local GAAP ledger. Enables simultaneous reporting under multiple accounting standards required for multinational airline operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Parallel Ledger; IFRS 1; Local GAAP

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the accounting document (BSEG-BUZEI in SAP). Identifies the specific debit or credit posting line within the journal entry. Combined with document_number and company_code forms the natural key of a GL line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accounting document is posted to the general ledger (BKPF-BUDAT). Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date used for financial reporting and period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1; ICAO Doc 9562

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accounting document. 'posted' = active GL entry; 'reversed' = entry has been reversed by a reversal document; 'parked' = document saved but not yet posted; 'held' = incomplete document; 'cleared' = open item has been cleared against a payment or offsetting entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of the individual line item posting (BSEG-SGTXT). Provides narrative context for the accounting entry, e.g., 'Jet fuel uplift JFK-LHR 15-Jan', 'IFRS 16 lease liability accrual Q1', 'Interline settlement IATA BSP Jan'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created the accounting document (BKPF-USNAM). Essential for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties controls, and financial fraud detection. May be a batch job ID for automated postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: profit_centre
attributes.description: SAP Controlling profit centre representing a business unit responsible for its own profitability (BSEG-PRCTR / CEPC-PRCTR). Used for route-level, hub-level, or business-segment P&L reporting. Supports RASK and yield analysis by profit centre.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (BKPF-XBLNR), such as a vendor invoice number, AWB (Air Waybill) number, PNR, interline billing statement number, or BSP settlement reference. Enables traceability from the GL back to the originating business transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IATA BSP; IATA AWB

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the corresponding reversal or reversed document (BKPF-STBLG). Populated when reversal_indicator is true, enabling bidirectional traceability between original and reversal entries for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this document is a reversal of a previously posted document (BKPF-STBLG is populated). True = this is a reversal document. Supports audit trail integrity and period-end close accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (VAT/GST/PFC) associated with this line item in the transaction currency (BSEG-WMWST). Supports tax reconciliation, VAT return preparation, and Passenger Facility Charge (PFC) reporting to airport authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IATA Tax Guide; DOT PFC Regulations; EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code determining the applicable tax rate and tax account for the posting (BSEG-MWSKZ). Relevant for VAT/GST on airline ancillary services, ground handling charges, and MRO procurement. Supports tax reporting to national revenue authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IATA Tax Guide; EU VAT Directive; DOT

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany postings (BSEG-VBUND). Populated when intercompany_indicator is true. Used for automated intercompany elimination during group financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; IATA Interline Accounting

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original transaction (BSEG-WAERS). Identifies the currency in which the business event was denominated, e.g., USD for US routes, EUR for European operations, GBP for UK operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System WBS element for project-based cost assignment (BSEG-PS_PSP_PNR). Used for capital expenditure projects such as fleet acquisition, terminal construction, and major MRO overhauls. Supports IFRS IAS 16 capitalisation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; IFRS IAS 16; IFRS 16

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Individual accounting posting records in the general ledger representing debits and credits for every financial transaction across the airline. Captures document type, posting date, fiscal period, currency, exchange rate, reference document, reversal indicators, and posting user. Aligns with SAP FI document posting model and supports audit trail for regulatory financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Document / Journal Entry

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Primary key for the journal_entry data product in the finance domain silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Model; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each journal entry belongs to ONE company code (legal entity). The journal_entry table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Company code is a mandat

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each journal entry can be assigned to ONE cost center for CO allocation. The journal_entry table has cost_center (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master. This is a standa

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each journal entry posts to ONE GL account. The journal_entry table has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This is a standard SAP FI relationship

attributes.name: primary_journal_customer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master record for accounts receivable postings (e.g., interline billing receivables, corporate travel account receivables, cargo customer invoices). Populated for document types involving customer transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Account (BSEG-KUNNR); IATA Interline Billing; ARC Settlement

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/supplier master record for accounts payable postings (e.g., fuel suppliers, MRO providers, catering vendors, airport authorities, ACMI lessors). Populated for document types involving vendor transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Account (BSEG-LIFNR); IATA BSP Vendor Settlement

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP FI account type indicating the subledger category for this posting: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor/Accounts Receivable), K=Vendor (Creditor/Accounts Payable), M=Material, S=General Ledger. Determines which subledger is updated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Type (BSEG-KOART); IFRS IAS 1 Balance Sheet Classification

attributes.name: amount_document_currency
attributes.description: The transaction amount in the original document currency (transaction currency). May differ from amount_local_currency when the source document is in a foreign currency, such as interline billing settlements in USD or EUR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Currency Amount (BSEG-WRBTR); IFRS IAS 21; IATA BSP Settlement

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount in the company code's local (functional) currency. This is the primary monetary value for statutory reporting and forms part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Local Currency Amount (BSEG-DMBTR); IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: SAP FI assignment field used for sorting and matching open items during clearing (e.g., flight number, route code, cost object reference). Supports automated payment matching and interline settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Assignment (BSEG-ZUONR); IATA Interline Billing Standards

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area code representing an organizational unit for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be produced (e.g., passenger operations, cargo, MRO, loyalty). Supports segment reporting under IFRS 8.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area (BSEG-GSBER); IFRS 8 Operating Segments; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared (matched against a payment or offsetting entry). Used for accounts receivable aging analysis, days sales outstanding (DSO) calculation, and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Date (BSEG-AUGDT); IFRS IAS 7 Cash Flow Statements; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the clearing transaction that matched and closed this open item (e.g., payment document clearing an invoice, credit memo clearing a debit). Populated when posting_status is 'cleared'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Document (BSEG-AUGBL); IATA BSP Clearing; ARC Settlement

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and ensures the general ledger remains in balance. Aligns with SAP FI posting key logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Debit/Credit Indicator (BSEG-SHKZG); IFRS IAS 1; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original document currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for interline billing, BSP settlements, and multi-currency treasury operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Key (BKPF-WAERS); IATA BSP

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice date, payment date, contract date) that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting_date when documents are processed with a lag.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date (BKPF-BLDAT); IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally visible SAP FI document number uniquely identifying this accounting document within the company code and fiscal year. Used as the primary business reference for audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number (BKPF-BELNR); IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP FI document type code classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, ZP=Payment, AB=Accounting Document). Drives number range assignment and posting rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|ZP|AB|RE|RV|KZ|DZ — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type (BKPF-BLART); IATA ARC/BSP Document Standards

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this journal entry record was created in the SAP S/4HANA system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Entry Time (BKPF-CPUDT/CPUTM); SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the document currency amount to the local currency amount at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP exchange rate tables and aligned with treasury hedging policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate (BKPF-KURSF); IFRS IAS 21; IATA Currency Clearance

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16, including special periods 13–16 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA posting period control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The accounting fiscal year in which this journal entry is recorded, as defined by the airline's fiscal year variant in SAP S/4HANA. May differ from the calendar year for airlines with non-calendar fiscal years.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area classifying the cost by business function (e.g., PROD=Production/Flight Operations, SELL=Sales, ADMN=Administration, MAINT=Maintenance). Supports cost-of-sales accounting and CASK component analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area (BSEG-FKBER); IATA CASK Reporting; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the document header level providing business context for the journal entry (e.g., 'Monthly fuel accrual JFK hub', 'IFRS 16 lease liability Q3', 'Interline BSP settlement October'). Supports audit review and financial analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Header Text (BKPF-BKTXT); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order number used to collect costs for specific projects or events (e.g., aircraft heavy maintenance C-check, airport terminal renovation, fleet acquisition project). Enables project-level cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Orders (BSEG-AUFNR); AMOS MRO Work Order Integration; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last modified in the source system. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Timestamp; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 8 Accounting Policies

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the individual line item level providing specific context for this debit or credit posting (e.g., 'Jet-A fuel uplift LHR 15-Oct', 'ACMI wet lease payment', 'Crew hotel deadhead expense').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Text (BSEG-SGTXT); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency. Defines the base currency for statutory financial reporting for the legal entity.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Currency; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and determines the fiscal period assignment. This is the authoritative accounting date for period-end close and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date (BKPF-BUDAT); IFRS IAS 1; DOT Form 41 Financial Reporting

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP FI two-digit posting key controlling the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field selection for this line item (e.g., 40=GL Debit, 50=GL Credit, 31=Vendor Credit, 01=Customer Debit). Determines the accounting treatment applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key (BSEG-BSCHL); GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Standards

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the general ledger workflow. 'Posted' indicates a completed, immutable entry; 'parked' is a draft pending approval; 'reversed' indicates a correcting entry has been applied; 'cleared' indicates the open item has been matched.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center identifying the business segment (e.g., route, hub, cabin class, cargo) responsible for this posting. Supports profitability analysis by route, fleet type, and business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting (CEPC-PRCTR); IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, PNR, AWB number, interline billing statement number, lease contract reference). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Document Number (BKPF-XBLNR); IATA AWB Standards; IATA BSP

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal document (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries are created to correct erroneous postings and maintain audit integrity in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Indicator (BKPF-STBLG); SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 8 Error Corrections

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component (VAT, GST, PFC, or other applicable taxes) included in or associated with this journal entry posting. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Supports tax reporting and PFC (Passenger Facility Charge) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Amount (BSEG-WMWST); IATA PFC Reporting; DOT Tax Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: tax_code
