Stores lessor details, lease commencement and expiry dates, lease term, right-of-use asset value, lease liability opening balance, discount rate (incremental borrowing rate), variable lease payment terms, renewal/termination options, modification history, and complete period-by-period liability amortisation schedule (opening balance, interest expense, lease payment, principal repayment, closing balance). Supports automated GL journal entry generation, IFRS 16 disclosure notes, lease vs buy analysis, fleet planning integration, and auditor reconciliation.
products.reference: IFRS 16 Leases / SAP RE-FX Lease Accounting

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IFRS 16 lease contract record within the finance data platform. Primary key for the lease_contract data product.

attributes.name: base_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.crew_base. Business justification: Aircraft and facility leases associated with crew bases for base operating cost allocation, hub economics analysis, and IFRS 16 lease accounting. Essential for base profitability and cost attribution.

attributes.name: contract_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lease contracts (aircraft, facilities, equipment) managed by specific employees require relationship manager tracking for accountability, renewal negotiations, and contract administration per airline

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each lease contract is assigned to ONE cost center for cost allocation. The lease_contract table has cost_centre_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Lease contracts must link to vendor master for lessor payment terms, performance tracking, vendor consolidation reporting, and IFRS 16 disclosure requirements. Essential for lease accounting and vendo

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level asset class of the underlying leased asset. Used for IFRS 16 disclosure note groupings (right-of-use asset classes) and fleet planning integration.

attributes.name: asset_registration
attributes.description: ICAO/national civil aviation authority tail number or asset registration identifier for the leased aircraft or engine (e.g., N-number, G-prefix). Null for property leases and spare part pool agreements. Links to fleet planning and MRO systems.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 — Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks; FAA; EASA

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lessor makes the underlying asset available for use by the lessee. This is the IFRS 16 commencement date from which the right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability are initially recognised on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which lease payments are denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro). Aircraft leases are predominantly USD-denominated. Drives FX translation to functional currency for IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; IFRS 16

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the lessor or jointly agreed at execution. Used for correspondence, audit trails, and SAP S/4HANA FI-AA lease object identification.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 — Leases (IASB); SAP S/4HANA RE-FX / FI-AA

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease contract. Drives IFRS 16 accounting treatment and GL journal generation. 'modified' indicates a lease modification event has been processed per IFRS 16 paragraph 44.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease contract record was first created in the finance data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and IFRS 16 initial recognition date verification.

attributes.name: discount_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Discount Rate / Incremental Borrowing Rate (IBR) Percentage
attributes.description: Annual discount rate used to calculate the present value of future lease payments. Represents the rate implicit in the lease if readily determinable; otherwise the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR) as determined by the treasury function. Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: IFRS 16 paragraphs 26–27 — Leases (IASB); IASB IBR guidance

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the non-cancellable lease term as stated in the executed agreement, before consideration of renewal or termination options. Used as the base for lease term calculation and amortisation schedule generation.

attributes.name: functional_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the reporting entity's functional currency. Used for translating the lease liability and ROU asset from contract currency to functional currency per IAS 21.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; IFRS 16

attributes.name: gl_lease_liability_account
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA GL account code for the lease liability balance sheet line. Supports automated posting of opening balance, interest accrual, and principal repayment journal entries.

attributes.name: gl_rou_asset_account
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA GL account code for the right-of-use asset balance sheet line. Used for automated journal entry generation for initial recognition, depreciation, and derecognition of the ROU asset.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the lease contract (e.g., 'English Law', 'New York Law', 'Irish Law'). Relevant for dispute resolution, enforcement, and cross-border lease structuring common in aviation.
attributes.references: IATA Lease Accounting Guidelines; Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment

attributes.name: ifrs16_exemption_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for a recognition exemption under IFRS 16. 'short_term' = lease term of 12 months or less at commencement; 'low_value' = underlying asset value below the entity's low-value threshold (typically USD 5,000); 'none' = full IFRS 16 recognition required.

attributes.name: last_modification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent lease modification event (e.g., extension of lease term, change in lease payments, change in scope). Triggers remeasurement of the lease liability at the revised discount rate.

attributes.name: lease_liability_opening
attributes.description: Present value of the lease payments not yet made at the commencement date, discounted at the incremental borrowing rate (IBR) or the rate implicit in the lease. This is the initial recognition amount of the lease liability on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Total lease term in whole months as determined under IFRS 16, including the non-cancellable period plus any optional renewal periods that the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise, and excluding optional termination periods the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease by asset category and operational arrangement. Dry lease = aircraft without crew; wet lease / ACMI (Aircraft Crew Maintenance Insurance) = aircraft with crew, maintenance, and insurance; engine_lease = standalone engine; spare_part_pool = access agreement for pooled spare parts; property_lease = airport lounges, hangars, office space. Determines IFRS 16 scope and disclosure grouping.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 — Leases (IASB); IATA Lease Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: lessor_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lessor's registered jurisdiction. Relevant for withholding tax treatment, OECD transfer pricing, and cross-border lease disclosure.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OECD BEPS Pillar Two; IFRS 16

attributes.name: maintenance_reserve_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes maintenance reserve payments (common in aircraft dry leases). Maintenance reserves are typically excluded from IFRS 16 lease liability measurement and treated as variable lease payments or prepaid maintenance.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 paragraph 38; IATA MRO Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: modification_count
attributes.description: Running count of the number of lease modifications processed against this contract since commencement. Each modification triggers remeasurement of the lease liability and ROU asset per IFRS 16 paragraphs 44–46. Supports audit trail and modification history tracking.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which fixed lease payments are contractually due. Determines the period length used in the amortisation schedule and GL journal entry generation cadence.

attributes.name: payment_in_advance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether lease payments are due at the beginning (True) or end (False) of each payment period. Affects the timing of interest expense accrual and principal repayment in the IFRS 16 amortisation schedule.

attributes.name: periodic_lease_payment
attributes.description: Fixed lease payment amount due per payment period (monthly, quarterly, or annually as defined by payment_frequency). Excludes variable lease payments not dependent on an index or rate. Used as the primary input to the amortisation schedule.

attributes.name: purchase_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option for the lessee to purchase the underlying asset. If the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the purchase option, the option price is included in the lease liability measurement.

attributes.name: purchase_option_price
attributes.description: Contractual price at which the lessee may purchase the underlying asset if the purchase option is exercised. Included in the lease liability present value calculation when the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise. Null when purchase_option_flag is False.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains one or more renewal options exercisable by the lessee. When True, renewal_option_reasonably_certain_flag must be assessed for IFRS 16 lease term determination.

attributes.name: renewal_option_reasonably_certain
attributes.description: Management's assessment of whether the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the renewal option. When True, the optional renewal period is included in the IFRS 16 lease term and the lease liability is remeasured accordingly.

attributes.name: residual_value_guarantee
attributes.description: Amount of any residual value guarantee provided by the lessee to the lessor, representing the lessee's exposure to the residual value of the leased asset at lease end. Included in the IFRS 16 lease liability measurement as a lease payment.

attributes.name: rou_asset_value
attributes.description: Initial carrying amount of the right-of-use (ROU) asset recognised on the balance sheet at the lease commencement date, comprising the initial lease liability measurement plus any initial direct costs, prepaid lease payments, and estimated dismantling costs, less any lease incentives received. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Cash security deposit paid to the lessor at lease commencement, refundable at lease expiry subject to asset return conditions. Classified as a financial asset (receivable) on the lessee's balance sheet, separate from the lease liability.

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains a termination option exercisable by the lessee before the contractual expiry date. Affects IFRS 16 lease term and liability measurement.

attributes.name: termination_option_reasonably_certain
attributes.description: Management's assessment of whether the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the termination option. When True, the lease term is shortened to the termination date and the liability is remeasured.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lease contract record in the finance data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: variable_payment_terms
attributes.description: Free-text description of any variable lease payment clauses, including index-linked escalation (e.g., CPI, LIBOR/SOFR), utilisation-based payments (e.g., per flight hour for ACMI), or maintenance reserve adjustments. Required for IFRS 16 disclosure notes.

products.name: lease_liability_schedule
products.description: IFRS 16 lease liability amortisation schedule records for each lease contract, detailing period-by-period opening balance, interest expense, lease payment, principal repayment, and closing balance. Supports automated journal entry generation for right-of-use asset depreciation and interest accrual. Enables IFRS 16 disclosure notes and auditor reconciliation for aircraft and property leases.
products.reference: IFRS 16 Lease Liability Amortisation Schedule

attributes.name: lease_liability_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lease liability amortisation schedule record in the IFRS 16 ledger. Primary key for this table.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Asset Accounting) / RE-FX (Flexible Real Estate)

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each lease liability schedule line is assigned to ONE cost center for cost allocation. The lease_liability_schedule table has cost_centre_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_c

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each lease liability schedule line posts to ONE GL account. The lease_liability_schedule table has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This links

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent lease contract master record from which this amortisation schedule is derived. Links each period row back to the originating lease agreement.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Contract Object

attributes.name: asset_registration
attributes.description: ICAO/national civil aviation authority aircraft registration mark (e.g., N-number, G-prefix) or property/equipment asset identifier for the underlying leased asset. Links the financial schedule to the physical asset in the fleet or property register.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7; IATA; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: Carrying amount of the lease liability at the end of the period (opening balance + interest expense − principal repayment). Becomes the next period's opening balance. Key IFRS 16 balance sheet figure.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26(e); IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lessor makes the underlying asset available for use by the lessee. This is the date from which the right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability are initially recognised on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 22; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease liability schedule record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; ISO 8601; IFRS 16 audit trail requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the lease liability amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aircraft leases are frequently denominated in USD regardless of the airline's functional currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 20; IATA BSP

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate used to discount future lease payments to present value, typically the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR) or the implicit rate in the lease if determinable. Expressed as an annual decimal (e.g., 0.045 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraphs 26 and 63; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: extension_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease term used in the liability calculation includes one or more extension option periods that management has assessed as reasonably certain to be exercised.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric accounting period (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year. Drives journal entry posting period in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this amortisation period belongs, as defined in the airline's SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant. Used for annual IFRS 16 disclosure aggregation.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code for the airline's functional currency used for consolidated financial reporting. Enables FX translation of foreign-currency lease liabilities for IFRS disclosure.
attributes.references: IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to translate lease liability amounts from the lease currency to the functional currency at the period end date. Sourced from the treasury system or SAP S/4HANA exchange rate table.
attributes.references: IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate

attributes.name: initial_recognition_amount
attributes.description: Present value of future lease payments at the commencement date, representing the lease liability recognised on the balance sheet at inception. Equals the initial ROU asset cost (before initial direct costs and lease incentives).
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26(a); SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Value

attributes.name: interest_expense
attributes.description: Finance charge accrued during the period calculated by applying the incremental borrowing rate (or implicit rate) to the opening lease liability balance. Posted to the P&L interest expense account.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26(c); IAS 23 Borrowing Costs

attributes.name: journal_entry_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI accounting document number assigned when the IFRS 16 journal entry is posted. Provides a direct audit trail from the amortisation schedule row to the posted ledger document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounting Document; IFRS 16 Leases; ICAO financial audit standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the automated IFRS 16 journal entries (interest accrual and principal repayment) for this period have been successfully posted to the SAP S/4HANA general ledger. Supports period-close control and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Journal Entry; IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the lease term, including any reasonably certain extension options. Used to determine the remaining lease term for present value calculations and maturity analysis disclosures.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraphs 19–21; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: lease_payment
attributes.description: Total cash payment made to the lessor during the period, comprising both the principal repayment and the interest component. Corresponds to the cash outflow in the statement of cash flows.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 50; IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease contract as of the period. Drives whether amortisation rows continue to be generated and whether remeasurement events have occurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraphs 44–46; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Contract Status

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease by asset category and IFRS 16 lease classification (finance vs. operating). Aircraft leases dominate the airline balance sheet; property leases cover airport lounges, offices, and hangars. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aircraft_operating|aircraft_finance|property_operating|property_finance|equipment_operating|equipment_finance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraphs 61–66; IATA Guidance on IFRS 16

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lessor (aircraft leasing company, property owner, or equipment provider) from whom the asset is leased. Common aviation lessors include AerCap, Air Lease Corporation, SMBC Aviation Capital.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master

attributes.name: low_value_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the IFRS 16 low-value asset exemption (underlying asset value when new is approximately USD 5,000 or below). When true, payments are expensed and no liability is recognised.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 5(b); IASB Basis for Conclusions BC100

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: Carrying amount of the lease liability at the beginning of the period before any payments or interest accrual. Equals the prior period's closing balance. Core IFRS 16 disclosure figure.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26(b); SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the amortisation period covered by this schedule row. Typically the last day of the accounting month or quarter.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: period_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential integer identifying the ordinal position of this amortisation period within the full lease term (e.g., 1 = first period, 24 = twenty-fourth period). Enables ordered traversal of the schedule.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the amortisation period covered by this schedule row. Aligns with the accounting period open date in the general ledger.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: principal_repayment
attributes.description: Portion of the lease payment that reduces the lease liability principal (lease payment minus interest expense). Classified as a financing cash outflow under IAS 7.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraph 26(d); IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: profit_centre_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO profit centre associated with the leased asset, enabling segment-level IFRS 16 reporting (e.g., narrow-body fleet, wide-body fleet, cargo operations).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA (Profit Centre Accounting); IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: remeasurement_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment to the lease liability arising from a remeasurement event (e.g., lease modification, change in extension option assessment, change in index/rate). Positive values increase the liability; negative values decrease it.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases paragraphs 44–46; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Adjustment Posting

attributes.name: remeasurement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease liability was remeasured due to a triggering event such as a lease modification, reassessment of extension option, or change in variable lease payments linked to an index. Null if no remeasurement occurred in this period.

attributes.name: remeasurement_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the lease liability was remeasured in this period. Required for IFRS 16 disclosure notes and auditor reconciliation. Null if no remeasurement occurred.

attributes.name: short_term_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the IFRS 16 short-term lease exemption (lease term of 12 months or less at commencement). When true, payments are expensed on a straight-line basis and no liability is recognised.

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a termination option and whether management has assessed it as reasonably certain NOT to be exercised (i.e., the full term is included in the liability measurement).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this lease liability schedule record, in ISO 8601 format. Captures remeasurement postings, corrections, and period-close adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; ISO 8601; IFRS 16 audit trail requirements

attributes.name: variable_lease_payment
attributes.description: Lease payments that depend on an index or rate (e.g., CPI-linked rent escalations) included in the lease liability measurement. Excludes purely variable payments not based on an index or rate, which are expensed as incurred.

products.name: interline_billing
products.description: Interline billing and settlement records for revenue and cost flows between the airline and partner carriers under interline ticketing agreements. Captures IATA billing and settlement plan (BSP) transactions, interline proration amounts, debit memos, credit memos, billing period, partner airline IATA code, and settlement currency. Supports IATA CASS (Cargo Accounts Settlement System) and passenger interline reconciliation.
products.reference: IATA BSP / Interline Billing and Settlement

attributes.name: interline_billing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interline billing record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each interline billing record is assigned to ONE cost center for cost allocation. The interline_billing table has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each interline billing record posts to ONE GL account. The interline_billing table has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This links interline se

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this interline billing transaction is posted in the general ledger. Used for financial reporting and period close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Standards

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Eleven-digit Air Waybill number (format: 3-digit airline code + 8-digit serial number) for cargo interline billing. Links billing to the cargo shipment.

attributes.name: billing_document_number
attributes.description: Unique externally-known billing document number or reference assigned to this interline billing transaction. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this interline billing record. Defines the close of the settlement window.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this interline billing record. Defines the beginning of the settlement window.

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interline billing record. Tracks the billing through submission, acceptance, dispute resolution, and final settlement stages.

attributes.name: billing_type
attributes.description: Type of interline billing transaction. Categorizes the nature of the settlement: passenger ticketing, cargo waybill, ancillary services, or billing adjustment.

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Cabin class of service for the interline segment. Used for proration calculation and revenue allocation between partner airlines.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission or handling fee amount deducted from the gross billing amount. May represent agent commission or interline handling charges.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline billing record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record origination.

attributes.name: destination_airport_iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Airport IATA (International Air Transport Association) Code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination of the interline segment. Identifies the arrival point for billing allocation.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for billing dispute if status is disputed. Used for tracking and resolving interline billing disagreements.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Currency exchange rate applied to convert original transaction currency to settlement currency. Used for multi-currency interline billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Fare basis code associated with the ticket or segment being billed. Defines the fare rules and proration methodology for interline revenue sharing.

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the flight segment associated with this interline billing transaction. Key date for revenue recognition and settlement timing.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number associated with the interline segment being billed. Combines airline code and numeric flight identifier.

attributes.name: gross_billing_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount billed before any adjustments, fees, or commissions. Base amount for the interline transaction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline billing record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes and dispute resolution activity.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount to be settled between airlines after all adjustments, commissions, and taxes. This is the actual payable or receivable amount.

attributes.name: origin_airport_iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Origin Airport IATA (International Air Transport Association) Code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin of the interline segment. Identifies the departure point for billing allocation.

attributes.name: original_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction before currency conversion for settlement. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: partner_airline_iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Partner Airline IATA (International Air Transport Association) Code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code of the partner carrier involved in the interline agreement. Identifies the counterparty airline for billing settlement.

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record locator code associated with this interline billing transaction. Links billing to the original passenger reservation.

attributes.name: proration_amount
attributes.description: Revenue or cost amount allocated to the partner airline based on interline proration rules. Represents the partner's share of the total ticket or waybill value.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or notes associated with this interline billing record. Used for clarifications, special instructions, or dispute documentation.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the interline settlement is denominated. Defines the currency for all monetary amounts in this billing record.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the interline billing was settled and payment was processed. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the interline settlement payment is due. Defines the payment deadline per IATA settlement cycle rules.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method used for interline settlement. BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) for passenger, ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) for US market, CASS (Cargo Accounts Settlement System) for cargo, direct bilateral billing, or ICH (IATA Clearing House).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the interline billing. Covers applicable aviation taxes, fees, and surcharges allocated to the partner carrier.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: Thirteen-digit electronic ticket number (e-ticket) associated with this interline billing record. Unique identifier for the passenger ticket in interline transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Specific transaction type within the billing record. Indicates whether this is a debit memo (amount owed to partner), credit memo (amount owed by partner), proration allocation, or final settlement.

products.name: treasury_position
products.description: Treasury cash and liquidity position records tracking the airlines cash balances, short-term investments (money market funds, commercial paper, time deposits), foreign currency exposures, and bank facility utilisation across all bank accounts, currencies, and legal entities. Stores position date, bank account, currency, balance type (actual/forecast/committed), liquidity category, counterparty bank, and maturity profile. Supports daily cash management, bank account reconciliation, FX exposure reporting, debt covenant monitoring, and IROP (Irregular Operations) contingency liquidity planning.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA TRM (Treasury and Risk Management)

attributes.name: treasury_position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each treasury cash and liquidity position record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR (Treasury and Risk Management) module

attributes.name: cash_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the notional or physical cash pool to which this bank account belongs. Supports zero-balance sweeping, notional pooling, and group-level liquidity optimisation across legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Cash Pooling; IAS 32 Financial Instruments Presentation

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each treasury position belongs to ONE legal entity (company code). The treasury_position table has legal_entity_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Treasury po

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each treasury position can be assigned to ONE cost center for cost allocation. The treasury_position table has cost_centre_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each treasury position is linked to ONE GL account. The treasury_position table has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This links treasury positi

attributes.name: treasury_officer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Treasury positions managed by specific treasury officers require accountability tracking for cash management, investment decisions, and regulatory compliance (SOX, internal controls) per airline treas

attributes.name: balance_amount
attributes.description: The gross cash or investment balance in the transaction currency for this position record. Positive values represent assets/inflows; negative values represent liabilities/outflows or overdraft positions. Core monetary field for daily cash management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IAS 7; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: balance_amount_usd
attributes.description: The balance amount translated to US Dollars (USD) using the applicable FX rate on the position date. Used for consolidated group-level cash reporting, CASK analysis, and DOT financial reporting in USD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR FX Translation; DOT Form 41 Financial Reporting; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: balance_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the balance recorded: 'actual' (confirmed bank balance), 'forecast' (projected inflow/outflow), 'committed' (contractually obligated but not yet settled), 'projected' (model-driven estimate), 'opening' (start-of-day balance), 'closing' (end-of-day balance). Supports daily cash management and IROP contingency liquidity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Cash Management; IAS 7

attributes.name: bank_account_iban
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Account International Bank Account Number (IBAN)
attributes.description: The International Bank Account Number (IBAN) for the bank account associated with this position, where applicable (primarily European and SEPA-zone accounts). Classified as confidential financial data.
attributes.references: ISO 13616 IBAN Standard; SEPA Payment Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-BL

attributes.name: bank_account_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the bank account as registered with the counterparty bank (e.g., 'Airlines Operating Account USD - JPMorgan NYC'). Used for human-readable identification in cash management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-BL Bank Master Data

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number associated with this treasury position. Classified as confidential financial data. Used for bank account reconciliation and cash pooling identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-BL (Bank Accounting); PCI DSS; ISO 13616 IBAN Standard

attributes.name: bank_statement_reference
attributes.description: The bank-assigned statement or transaction reference number from the SWIFT MT940 or ISO 20022 camt.053 bank statement. Used for bank account reconciliation matching in SAP S/4HANA FI-BL.
attributes.references: SWIFT MT940; ISO 20022 camt.053; SAP S/4HANA FI-BL Bank Statement Processing

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) Settlement Period
attributes.description: The IATA BSP or ARC settlement period (YYYY-MM format) to which this interline or agency settlement cash flow belongs. Populated only when interline_settlement_flag is True. Used for BSP reconciliation and interline billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: IATA BSP; ARC Settlement Standards; IATA Resolution 850

attributes.name: counterparty_bank_code
attributes.description: The BIC (Bank Identifier Code) / SWIFT code of the counterparty bank holding this position. Used for FX exposure reporting, counterparty credit risk monitoring, and debt covenant compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9362 BIC/SWIFT Standard; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Counterparty Management

attributes.name: counterparty_bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the counterparty bank or financial institution holding this treasury position (e.g., 'JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A.'). Used in FX exposure and counterparty risk reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IATA BSP Bank Requirements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the bank account is domiciled (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for regulatory reporting, capital controls monitoring, and country-level FX exposure aggregation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICAO Doc 9760; DOT Financial Reporting

attributes.name: covenant_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current balance_amount is below the covenant_threshold_amount, triggering a potential debt covenant breach. True = covenant breach condition; False = compliant. Drives automated treasury alerts.
attributes.references: IFRS 7; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; Debt Covenant Agreements

attributes.name: covenant_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The minimum cash or liquidity balance required under debt covenant agreements with lenders, in the transaction currency. Used for debt covenant monitoring and breach early-warning reporting. Null if no covenant applies to this account.
attributes.references: IFRS 7 Financial Instruments Disclosures; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Covenant Management; Loan Agreement Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treasury position record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the denomination of this treasury position (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Drives FX exposure calculation and multi-currency cash reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 024 Currency Standards

attributes.name: facility_limit_amount
attributes.description: The total approved credit limit of the bank facility (revolving credit line, overdraft facility) in the transaction currency. Used for bank facility utilisation monitoring and debt covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Credit Facility Management; IFRS 16; Debt Covenant Agreements

attributes.name: facility_utilised_amount
attributes.description: The amount currently drawn down against the bank facility limit on the position date. The difference between facility_limit_amount and this field represents available headroom. Used for IROP contingency liquidity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IFRS 16; Debt Covenant Monitoring

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to translate the position currency to USD on the position date. Sourced from the treasury system's daily FX rate feed. Used for FX exposure reporting and IAS 21 translation.
attributes.references: IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR FX Rate Management

attributes.name: fx_rate_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of FX rate used for translation: 'spot' (real-time market rate), 'average' (period average rate), 'closing' (period-end rate), 'budget' (planning rate), 'hedge' (contractual hedge rate). Determines the accounting treatment under IAS 21.
attributes.references: IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Exchange Rate Types

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is designated as a hedging instrument under IFRS 9 hedge accounting: 'fair_value_hedge', 'cash_flow_hedge', 'net_investment_hedge', or 'not_designated'. Drives hedge effectiveness testing and P&L reclassification.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Hedge Management

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treasury position relates to an IFRS 16 lease liability payment obligation (e.g., aircraft dry lease or wet lease financing). True = IFRS 16 lease-related cash flow; False = non-lease treasury position.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX / FI-TR IFRS 16 Module

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: The specific financial instrument type underlying this treasury position. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_deposit|term_deposit|money_market_fund|commercial_paper|treasury_bill|revolving_credit|overdraft|certificate_of_deposit|repo|fx_forward — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Transaction Types

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.045 = 4.5%) applicable to this treasury position for time deposits, money market funds, or revolving credit facilities. Used for interest income/expense accrual and yield analysis.

attributes.name: interline_settlement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treasury position is associated with an interline billing settlement (IATA BSP or ARC settlement cycle). True = interline settlement cash flow; False = standard treasury position. Supports interline prorate reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan); ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation); IATA Resolution 743

attributes.name: irop_reserve_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treasury position is designated as an IROP (Irregular Operations) contingency liquidity reserve. True = reserved for IROP events (e.g., mass rebooking, hotel accommodation, compensation payouts); False = general operating liquidity.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259 (Airline Customer Service); IATA Irregular Operations Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR

attributes.name: liquidity_category
attributes.description: Classifies the type of liquid asset or instrument: 'cash_and_equivalents' (demand deposits), 'money_market_fund', 'commercial_paper', 'time_deposit', 'bank_facility' (revolving credit facility drawdown), 'restricted_cash' (escrowed or pledged funds). Aligns with IAS 7 cash and cash equivalents classification.
attributes.references: IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Liquidity Management

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which a short-term investment (time deposit, commercial paper, money market fund) matures and principal is returned. Null for demand deposits and revolving facilities. Critical for maturity profile and liquidity ladder reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary entered by the treasury analyst regarding this position record (e.g., reason for manual adjustment, covenant waiver details, IROP reserve activation rationale). Supports audit trail and operational transparency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; SOX Section 404 Audit Documentation

attributes.name: position_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this cash or liquidity position is recorded. Used as the primary time dimension for daily cash management, bank reconciliation, and FX exposure reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: position_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the treasury position record, sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-TR or the bank's statement reference. Used for reconciliation and audit trail across systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treasury position record: 'open' (pending confirmation), 'confirmed' (bank-confirmed balance), 'reconciled' (matched to bank statement), 'disputed' (discrepancy under investigation), 'closed' (period-end finalised), 'cancelled' (voided entry).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; IAS 7; DOT Financial Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation state of this position against the bank statement: 'unreconciled' (not yet matched), 'matched' (fully reconciled to bank statement), 'partially_matched' (partial match with outstanding difference), 'exception' (reconciliation exception requiring investigation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-BL Bank Reconciliation; IAS 7; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this treasury position record was sourced: 'SAP_S4HANA' (FI-TR module), 'BANK_DIRECT' (bank portal feed), 'SWIFT_MT940' (bank statement message), 'KYRIBA' (treasury management system), 'MANUAL' (manually entered adjustment).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; SWIFT MT940 Bank Statement Standard; ISO 20022

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treasury position record was last modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks balance revisions, reconciliation updates, and status changes for audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Log; ISO 8601

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which the funds are actually available or settled in the bank account, which may differ from the position date due to clearing cycles or float. Critical for accurate liquidity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; ISO 20022 Payment Standards

products.name: hedge_contract
products.description: Financial hedging instrument master records for the airline's fuel price hedging, foreign currency hedging, and interest rate hedging programmes. Captures instrument type (swap, option, forward, collar), underlying commodity or currency, notional amount, strike price, premium paid, hedge designation (cash flow / fair value), effectiveness test results, and maturity date. Supports IFRS 9 hedge accounting documentation.
products.reference: IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting / SAP TRM Hedge Management

attributes.name: hedge_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hedge contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fuel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.fuel_contract. Business justification: Fuel hedging programs must link hedge instruments to specific fuel supply contracts for hedge effectiveness testing, P&L attribution, and IFRS 9 hedge accounting documentation. Required for fuel risk

attributes.name: collateral_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which collateral is posted. Null if no collateral posted.

attributes.name: collateral_posted_amount
attributes.description: Amount of cash or securities posted as collateral to the counterparty under Credit Support Annex (CSA) terms. Null if no collateral arrangement exists.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the hedge contract, used in treasury operations and external reporting.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hedge contract, indicating whether it is in force, expired, or terminated early.

attributes.name: counterparty_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty, typically LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) or internal counterparty code.

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the financial institution or counterparty with whom the hedge contract is executed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hedge contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_gain_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative realized and unrealized gain or loss on the hedge contract since inception, used for hedge accounting reserve calculations.

attributes.name: currency_pair
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency pair for foreign exchange hedges (e.g., USD/EUR, GBP/USD). Null for non-FX hedges.

attributes.name: documentation_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required IFRS 9 hedge accounting documentation (hedge designation memo, effectiveness testing methodology) has been completed and approved.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the hedge contract becomes active and hedge accounting treatment begins.

attributes.name: effectiveness_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent hedge effectiveness test was performed.

attributes.name: fair_value_amount
attributes.description: Current fair value (mark-to-market) of the hedge instrument as of the last valuation date, used for balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: fair_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the fair value is denominated.

attributes.name: fair_value_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the fair value was calculated, typically month-end or quarter-end for financial reporting.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Formal hedge accounting designation under IFRS 9, determining how gains and losses are recognized in financial statements.

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the most recent prospective or retrospective hedge effectiveness test under IFRS 9, determining continued eligibility for hedge accounting.

attributes.name: hedge_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the hedging instrument quantity to the hedged item quantity, used in hedge effectiveness calculations (e.g., 1.0000 for perfect hedge).

attributes.name: hedged_item_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific forecasted transaction or recognized asset/liability being hedged (e.g., Q3 2024 jet fuel purchases for transatlantic routes).

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of financial derivative instrument used for hedging. Determines the contractual structure and settlement mechanism.

attributes.name: isda_master_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Master Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hedge contract is governed by an ISDA Master Agreement with the counterparty.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hedge contract record was last updated, capturing any changes to contract terms, valuations, or status.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hedge contract expires or settles, marking the end of the hedging relationship.

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount or volume of the underlying exposure being hedged (e.g., barrels of fuel, currency units, interest principal).

attributes.name: notional_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the notional amount (barrels for fuel, currency code for FX, basis points for interest rate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: barrels|gallons|metric_tons|usd|eur|gbp|basis_points — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: premium_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the premium was paid.

attributes.name: premium_paid
attributes.description: Upfront premium paid to acquire the hedge instrument (primarily for options and collars). Zero for forwards and swaps with no upfront cost.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which cash settlement or physical delivery occurred. Null if contract has not yet settled.

attributes.name: strike_price
attributes.description: Agreed price or rate at which the hedge instrument can be exercised (for options) or settled (for forwards/swaps). Null for instruments without a fixed strike.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hedge contract was terminated early, if applicable. Null for contracts that matured naturally or are still active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination of the hedge contract (e.g., hedged item no longer expected, counterparty credit event, portfolio rebalancing). Null if not terminated.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hedge contract was executed and agreed between the airline and counterparty.

attributes.name: underlying_commodity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the specific commodity being hedged (e.g., JET for jet fuel, BRENT for Brent crude). Null for non-commodity hedges.

attributes.name: underlying_type
attributes.description: Category of the underlying asset or rate being hedged (fuel commodity, currency pair, interest rate benchmark, or carbon allowance).

products.name: tax_transaction
products.description: Tax posting and compliance records for all applicable taxes including VAT/GST on ancillary services, passenger facility charges (PFC), airport taxes, withholding tax on vendor payments, and corporate income tax provisions. Captures tax code, tax jurisdiction, taxable base amount, tax amount, tax period, filing reference, and tax authority. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance and DOT/EASA regulatory financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX (Tax Accounting)

attributes.name: tax_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax posting record in the finance domain. Primary key for the tax_transaction data product.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each tax transaction belongs to ONE company code. The tax_transaction table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Tax transactions are company-code s

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each tax transaction can be assigned to ONE cost center for cost allocation. The tax_transaction table has cost_center (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which this tax posting is recorded, aligning with SAP S/4HANA FI chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or passenger party associated with this tax transaction, applicable for output VAT/GST on ancillary services, passenger facility charges, and airport taxes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: tax_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax transactions related to employee benefits, payroll taxes, expatriate tax equalization require employee linkage for compliance reporting, tax certificate generation, and employee tax statement prep

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier party associated with this tax transaction, applicable for withholding tax on vendor payments and input VAT/GST recoveries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; IATA BSP

attributes.name: airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code associated with this tax transaction, applicable for airport taxes, Passenger Facility Charges (PFC), and slot-related levies. Identifies the airport at which the tax obligation arises.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax transaction record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (invoice, receipt, or tax certificate) that triggered this tax posting. May differ from posting_date due to processing lag.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP Billing Cycle

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI at the time of tax posting. Used as the primary business reference for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA ARC Settlement

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency tax amounts to local currency at the posting date. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables aligned with IATA rate publications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; IATA Currency Clearance Service

attributes.name: filing_reference
attributes.description: The reference number assigned by the tax authority or internal tax filing system when this tax transaction is included in a periodic tax return or remittance filing (e.g., VAT return reference, PFC quarterly report number, WHT certificate number).
attributes.references: FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number (1–16 in SAP, including special periods) within the fiscal year to which this tax transaction is assigned. Supports period-end close and tax accrual reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this tax transaction is assigned in the airline's financial calendar. Used for annual tax provision, corporate income tax filing, and IFRS financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Module; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input tax amount is recoverable (reclaimable) from the tax authority as a credit against output tax liability. True for recoverable input VAT/GST; False for irrecoverable taxes such as non-deductible VAT on entertainment or blocked input tax.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code's local (functional) currency (e.g., USD for a US entity, EUR for a German entity). Used for statutory reporting and local tax filings.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: local_currency_tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount translated into the company code's local (functional) currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Required for statutory financial reporting and local tax authority filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount after tax, representing the total transaction value inclusive of tax (taxable_base_amount + tax_amount). Used for financial statement presentation and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; IATA ARC Settlement

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax transaction was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; DOT Financial Reporting

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center associated with this tax transaction, enabling profitability analysis by route, fleet type, or business unit. Supports RASK (Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer) and segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax amount was remitted (paid) to the relevant tax authority. Null until payment is made. Used to confirm compliance with statutory payment deadlines and avoid late payment penalties.
attributes.references: FAA PFC Regulations; DOT; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA BSP

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the reversal posting if this tax transaction has been reversed or cancelled. Null for active postings. Supports audit trail and reconciliation of corrected tax entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 8 Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: SAP FI reversal reason code explaining why this tax posting was reversed (e.g., data entry error, duplicate posting, credit note issued). Null for non-reversed transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, AWB number for cargo customs, PNR for passenger-related taxes, BSP billing reference). Enables traceability from tax posting back to the originating business transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP; IATA AWB Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: Type of the originating business document that generated this tax posting. INVOICE=vendor or customer invoice; CREDIT_NOTE=credit memo; PAYMENT=payment document; JOURNAL=manual journal entry; CUSTOMS_DECL=customs declaration for cargo; PFC_REPORT=Passenger Facility Charge quarterly report; WHT_CERT=withholding tax certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INVOICE|CREDIT_NOTE|PAYMENT|JOURNAL|CUSTOMS_DECL|PFC_REPORT|WHT_CERT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP; FAA PFC Regulations; DOT

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount in the transaction currency. Represents the actual tax liability or recoverable tax for this posting. Core monetary component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; DOT Financial Reporting; IATA BSP

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the government or regulatory body to which this tax is remitted (e.g., 'IRS', 'HMRC', 'Bundeszentralamt für Steuern', 'FAA - PFC'). Required for tax filing and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FAA; EASA; DOT; IATA; ICAO; National Civil Aviation Authorities

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-TX tax code identifying the applicable tax type and rate combination (e.g., V1 for standard VAT, W1 for withholding tax, PF for Passenger Facility Charge). Drives automatic tax calculation and account determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; FAA PFC Regulations

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an input tax (recoverable tax paid on purchases/vendor invoices) or output tax (tax collected from customers on sales of ancillary services and tickets). Drives VAT/GST net settlement calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, or municipality) that levies this tax. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance across the airline's global route network. Aligns with SAP FI-TX jurisdiction configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; ICAO; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'United States Federal', 'Germany VAT', 'New York State', 'London Heathrow Airport'). Supports tax reporting and audit documentation.

attributes.name: tax_period
attributes.description: The fiscal tax reporting period in YYYY-MM format to which this tax transaction belongs. Used for VAT/GST return filing, withholding tax remittance, and corporate income tax provision reporting.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 20.0000 for 20% VAT, 7.5000 for 7.5% WHT). Sourced from the tax code configuration in SAP FI-TX and validated against jurisdiction-specific statutory rates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; FAA; EASA; National Tax Authorities

attributes.name: tax_return_period
attributes.description: The period identifier for the tax return in which this transaction is reported to the tax authority. May be monthly (YYYY-MM) or quarterly (YYYY-Q1 through YYYY-Q4) depending on jurisdiction requirements.
attributes.references: DOT; FAA; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax category applicable to this transaction. VAT=Value Added Tax, GST=Goods and Services Tax, WHT=Withholding Tax, PFC=Passenger Facility Charge, AIRPORT_TAX=Airport-levied tax, CORP_INCOME_TAX=Corporate Income Tax provision, EXCISE=Fuel/aviation excise duty, CUSTOMS=Import/export customs duty on cargo. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VAT|GST|WHT|PFC|AIRPORT_TAX|CORP_INCOME_TAX|EXCISE|CUSTOMS — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA; FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT; EASA; ICAO

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount on which the tax is calculated, expressed in the transaction currency. For VAT/GST this is the net invoice value; for PFC it is the per-passenger charge base; for WHT it is the gross vendor payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; FAA PFC Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the transaction in which the tax amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across the airline's global network.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax posting in SAP FI. POSTED=active tax document posted to GL; REVERSED=document reversed/cancelled; CLEARED=tax settled/remitted to authority; PARKED=saved but not yet posted; BLOCKED=held for review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax transaction record was last modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: SAP FI-AA fixed asset master for the airline's capitalised assets including owned aircraft, engines, simulators, ground support equipment, IT infrastructure, and leasehold improvements. Stores asset class, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, asset location, and disposal date. Supports CAPEX tracking, insurance valuation, and IFRS 16 right-of-use asset management.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Asset Accounting)

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fixed asset record in the SAP FI-AA module. Primary key for the fixed asset master data product.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; IFRS 16; IAS 16

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Aircraft are the largest fixed assets on the balance sheet. This FK links the financial asset record to the operational aircraft master for depreciation tracking, asset valuation, and financial report

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each fixed asset belongs to ONE company code. The fixed_asset table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Fixed assets are company-code specific in S

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each fixed asset can be assigned to ONE cost center for depreciation allocation. The fixed_asset table has cost_center (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master.

attributes.name: custodian_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Assets assigned to employees (laptops, uniforms, tools, crew equipment) require custodian tracking for asset accountability, loss prevention, and disposal authorization per airline asset management po

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each fixed asset is linked to ONE GL account for asset accounting. The fixed_asset table has gl_account (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This links fixed asset

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: Each IFRS 16 right-of-use asset is created from ONE lease contract. The fixed_asset table has lease_contract_number (STRING) and is_ifrs16_rou_asset flag, which should be replaced with a FK to the lea

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation charged against the asset from acquisition date to the current reporting period. Corresponds to SAP ANLC.KNAFA (cumulative ordinary depreciation). Used to compute net book value and for balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost (historical cost) of the asset in the document currency at the time of purchase. For aircraft, includes purchase price, import duties, and directly attributable costs to bring the asset to its intended use. Corresponds to SAP ANLC.KANSW.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was acquired, purchased, or placed in service. Corresponds to SAP ANLA.AKTIV. Used as the start date for depreciation calculation and CAPEX reporting.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP asset class (ANLKL) categorising the asset for depreciation rules, GL account determination, and reporting. Examples: 1000=Aircraft, 1100=Aircraft Engines, 1200=Simulators, 2000=Ground Support Equipment, 3000=IT Infrastructure, 4000=Leasehold Improvements, 5000=Right-of-Use Assets (IFRS 16). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1000|1100|1200|2000|3000|4000|5000|6000 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SAP asset class (e.g., 'Aircraft', 'Aircraft Engines', 'Flight Simulators', 'Ground Support Equipment'). Denormalised for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Primary human-readable description of the fixed asset (e.g., 'Boeing 737-800 MSN 45123', 'Full Flight Simulator B737', 'Ground Power Unit GPU-400'). Corresponds to SAP ANLA.TXT50 field.

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: IATA airport or facility code indicating the primary physical location of the asset (e.g., 'LHR' for Heathrow maintenance base, 'JFK' for ground support equipment). Corresponds to SAP ANLA.STORT. Supports insurance valuation and physical asset verification.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLA.STORT; IATA Airport Codes; IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA main asset number uniquely identifying the asset within the company code. Corresponds to the ANLN1 field in SAP Asset Master (ANLZ/ANLB tables). Used for CAPEX tracking and asset register reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLZ.ANLN1; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. 'active' = in service and depreciating; 'under_construction' = Asset Under Construction (AUC) not yet capitalised; 'disposed' = sold, scrapped, or written off; 'transferred' = transferred to another company code or cost centre; 'impaired' = impairment loss recognised per IAS 36; 'deactivated' = temporarily taken out of service.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLZ.DEAKT; IAS 16; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA sub-number (ANLN2) used to track component-level assets under a main asset number, such as individual aircraft engines under a parent airframe asset. Supports component accounting per IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLZ.ANLN2; IAS 16 Component Accounting

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Categorises the asset by ownership or lease arrangement. 'owned' = outright purchase; 'finance_lease' = IFRS 16 right-of-use finance lease; 'operating_lease_rou' = IFRS 16 right-of-use operating lease; 'dry_lease' = aircraft leased without crew; 'wet_lease' = aircraft leased with crew; 'acmi' = Aircraft Crew Maintenance Insurance lease. Drives IFRS 16 vs IAS 16 accounting treatment.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IATA Lease Accounting Guidance

attributes.name: capitalisation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was formally capitalised and transferred from Asset Under Construction (AUC) to a productive asset class. May differ from acquisition_date for self-constructed assets or aircraft deliveries with pre-delivery payments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset master record was first created in SAP FI-AA. Corresponds to SAP ANLA.ERDAT and ANLA.ERZET. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLA.ERDAT; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the acquisition cost and valuation amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the transaction currency used at time of asset acquisition.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI WAERS

attributes.name: depreciation_area
