attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area code (AFABE) identifying the valuation basis (e.g., 01=Book Depreciation IFRS, 10=Tax Depreciation, 20=Group Reporting). Multiple depreciation areas allow parallel valuation for IFRS, local GAAP, and tax purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLB.AFABE; IAS 16; IFRS 16; Local GAAP

attributes.name: depreciation_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the depreciation method applied to the asset. SL=Straight-Line; DB=Declining Balance; UOP=Units of Production (e.g., flight cycles or block hours for engines); SOYD=Sum of Years Digits; NONE=Non-depreciable (e.g., land). Corresponds to SAP ANLB.AFASL.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLB.AFASL; IAS 16.62; IATA Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Triggers cessation of depreciation and recognition of disposal gain or loss. Corresponds to SAP ANLA.DEAKT.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net proceeds received on disposal or sale of the asset. Used to calculate the gain or loss on disposal (disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal date). Relevant for aircraft sales, part-out transactions, and GSE disposals.

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognised on the asset where the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount. Applicable for aircraft fleets affected by route network changes, AOG events, or market value declines. Corresponds to SAP ANLC extraordinary depreciation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLC; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: insurance_value
attributes.description: Agreed hull insurance value of the asset as declared to the insurer, typically the agreed value or replacement cost for aircraft. Used for insurance premium calculation and claims settlement. May differ from net book value for older aircraft.
attributes.references: IATA Insurance Manual; IAS 16; Aviation Hull Insurance Market Practice

attributes.name: is_ifrs16_rou_asset
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is a right-of-use (ROU) asset recognised under IFRS 16 Leases. True for aircraft, engines, and equipment under finance or operating leases. Drives separate balance sheet presentation and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 16.22; IATA IFRS 16 Implementation Guide; SAP FI-AA IFRS 16 Configuration

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to the fixed asset master record in SAP FI-AA. Corresponds to SAP ANLA.AEDAT and ANLA.AEZET. Supports change audit trail for SOX compliance and data reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLA.AEDAT; SOX Section 404; IAS 16

attributes.name: lease_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease term commences and the right-of-use (ROU) asset is recognised on the balance sheet under IFRS 16. Determines the start of ROU asset amortisation and lease liability unwinding.
attributes.references: IFRS 16.26; SAP RE-FX; IATA IFRS 16 Implementation Guide

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the lease term for right-of-use assets. Used to determine the remaining lease term for IFRS 16 ROU asset amortisation and lease liability discounting. Includes any reasonably certain renewal option periods.
attributes.references: IFRS 16.19-21; SAP RE-FX; IATA IFRS 16 Implementation Guide

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code local currency used for statutory financial reporting. Supports multi-currency consolidation in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI WAERS; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation and any impairment losses. Corresponds to SAP ANLC carrying amount. Key metric for CAPEX tracking, insurance valuation, and balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP Controlling profit centre (PRCTR) associated with the asset for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables allocation of depreciation to route or fleet profit centres for management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA PRCTR; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number (EBELN) associated with the asset acquisition. Links the fixed asset to the procurement process for CAPEX budget control and three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice).
attributes.references: SAP MM EBELN; SAP FI-AA Asset Acquisition from PO

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official civil aviation authority registration number (tail number) assigned to the aircraft asset (e.g., G-BOAC, N12345). Applicable to aircraft and rotorcraft assets. Used for cross-referencing with flight operations, MRO, and insurance records.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks; FAA AC 21-12; EASA Part-21

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual (salvage) value of the asset at the end of its useful life. For aircraft, this is typically the estimated scrap or resale value. Depreciation is calculated on the depreciable amount (acquisition cost minus residual value). Corresponds to SAP ANLB.SCHRW.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLB.SCHRW; IAS 16.53; IATA Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative revaluation surplus or deficit recognised where the airline applies the revaluation model for aircraft or property assets. Recorded in Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) under IAS 16 revaluation model. Corresponds to SAP ANLC.KZINS.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLC; IAS 16.31-42; IAS 1 OCI

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number (MSN) or equipment serial number uniquely identifying the physical asset. For aircraft, this is the Manufacturer Serial Number (MSN); for engines, the Engine Serial Number (ESN). Critical for cross-referencing with AMOS maintenance records and insurance policies.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLA.SERNR; ICAO Aircraft Registration; IATA MSN Standards

attributes.name: useful_life_periods
attributes.description: Remaining useful life expressed in fiscal periods (months) within the current fiscal year. Complements useful_life_years for mid-year acquisitions and partial-period depreciation calculations. Corresponds to SAP ANLB.NDPER.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful economic life of the asset in years as defined in the depreciation key. For aircraft, typically 20-25 years; for engines, 15-20 years; for simulators, 10-15 years; for IT infrastructure, 3-5 years. Corresponds to SAP ANLB.NDJAR.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA ANLB.NDJAR; IAS 16.50-57; IATA Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor account number (LIFNR) of the supplier or lessor from whom the asset was acquired or leased. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and CAPEX purchase order matching.
attributes.references: SAP MM LIFNR; SAP FI-AA Asset Acquisition Posting

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System WBS element (POSID) linked to the asset for CAPEX project tracking. Used during the Asset Under Construction (AUC) phase to accumulate project costs before capitalisation. Common for aircraft delivery projects and MRO facility upgrades.
attributes.references: SAP PS POSID; SAP FI-AA AUC Settlement; IAS 16.22

products.name: company_code
products.description: Legal entity and company code master representing the airline's individual legal entities, subsidiaries, and joint ventures registered in SAP FI. Stores company code, legal entity name, country of incorporation, local currency, chart of accounts, fiscal year variant, and consolidation group. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and statutory reporting per jurisdiction.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the company code record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master

attributes.name: airline_accounting_code
attributes.description: Three-digit IATA numeric airline accounting code (also known as the airline prefix) used in e-ticket stock numbering, interline billing, and BSP/ARC settlement transactions. Uniquely identifies the airline in financial settlement systems.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: arc_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity participates in the Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) settlement system for US domestic ticket sales. Relevant for North American entities and drives ARC settlement accounts receivable processing.
attributes.references: ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) Industry Agents Handbook; DOT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: bsp_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity is a registered participant in the IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) for settlement of ticket sales through travel agents. Drives interline billing and accounts receivable settlement workflows.
attributes.references: IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Manual; IATA Resolution 850

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Four-character SAP code identifying the chart of accounts assigned to this company code. Defines the general ledger account structure, account numbering, and account descriptions applicable to all financial postings. Corresponds to SAP KTOPL field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts (KTOPL); IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: company_code_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric SAP FI company code uniquely identifying the legal entity within the SAP S/4HANA system. Matches the SAP Bukrs field. Used as the primary business key across all FI/CO postings, journal entries, and financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code (BUKRS); IATA Airline Accounting Standards

attributes.name: company_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the company code within SAP FI. Controls whether new financial postings can be made against this entity. 'inactive' blocks new postings; 'in_liquidation' triggers specific closing procedures under IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Status; IFRS 5 Non-current Assets Held for Sale

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial consolidation group to which this company code belongs within the group reporting hierarchy. Used for intercompany elimination, minority interest calculations, and preparation of consolidated financial statements under IFRS 10.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: consolidation_unit
attributes.description: SAP Group Reporting consolidation unit identifier mapped to this company code. Represents the lowest-level reporting unit in the consolidation hierarchy for multi-entity financial roll-up and statutory consolidation.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP CO controlling area code assigned to this company code. Defines the scope of cost accounting, profit center accounting, and internal order management. Enables CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) and RASK reporting by aligning cost objects to revenue data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area; IATA CASK Reporting Standards

attributes.name: corsia_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity is subject to CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation) obligations. Drives carbon offset liability accounting and regulatory reporting to ICAO.
attributes.references: CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); ICAO Doc 9501

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the legal entity is incorporated. Drives statutory reporting requirements, applicable tax law, and national civil aviation authority oversight.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICAO Doc 9626; FAA/EASA Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this company code record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance with data governance policies.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP code identifying the credit control area governing credit limit management and accounts receivable risk assessment for this company code. Relevant for interline billing settlements and BSP/ARC credit exposure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Rules

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this company code became active and eligible for financial postings in SAP FI. Marks the start of the entity's operational financial lifecycle within the group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this company code was deactivated or ceased financial operations. Null for currently active entities. Used to enforce period-end close and prevent postings after entity dissolution or merger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master; IFRS 5; IFRS 3 Business Combinations

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity by its corporate structure. Determines consolidation treatment, intercompany elimination rules, and applicable accounting standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: airline|subsidiary|holding|joint_venture|special_purpose_vehicle|branch — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character SAP code defining the fiscal year structure for this company code, including the number of posting periods, special periods, and whether the fiscal year aligns with the calendar year. Corresponds to SAP PERIV field. Critical for period-end close and CASK reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant (PERIV); IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the parent group's reporting currency used for financial consolidation. Transactions in local currency are translated to group currency for consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IAS 21

attributes.name: iata_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code assigned to this legal entity. Used in BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) settlements, interline billing, ticket issuance, and ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) reporting. Links financial entity to operational airline identity.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 Airline Designator Codes; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: icao_airline_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ICAO airline designator code for this legal entity. Used in flight plan filings, ATC communications, NOTAM references, and regulatory correspondence with national civil aviation authorities.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 8585 Designators for Aircraft Operating Agencies; ICAO Annex 2

attributes.name: ifrs16_lessee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this company code is subject to IFRS 16 Leases accounting, requiring recognition of right-of-use assets and lease liabilities on the balance sheet. Applicable to entities with aircraft dry leases, wet leases, or ACMI arrangements.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; IATA Guidance on IFRS 16 for Airlines

attributes.name: ifrs_reporting_standard
attributes.description: Accounting standard under which this legal entity prepares its statutory financial statements. Determines recognition, measurement, and disclosure requirements including IFRS 16 lease liability treatment and CORSIA carbon offset accounting.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation; FASB US GAAP; IATA Airline Accounting Guide; CORSIA

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity was formally incorporated or registered with the relevant national company registry. Used for entity lifecycle tracking and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: Local Company Registry Requirements; IFRS 3 Business Combinations

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether intercompany transactions posted against this company code are subject to elimination during group financial consolidation. True for entities within the consolidation perimeter; false for associates or joint ventures accounted for under equity method.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this company code record in the Silver Layer. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the entity as recorded with the relevant national company registry or civil aviation authority. Used for statutory reporting, regulatory filings, and intercompany agreements.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9626; IATA Resolution 788; Local Company Registry

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional/local currency of the company code as defined in SAP FI. All financial transactions are translated to this currency for statutory reporting. Corresponds to SAP WAERS field.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI (WAERS)

attributes.name: operating_certificate_number
attributes.description: Air Operator Certificate (AOC) number issued by the national civil aviation authority authorising this legal entity to conduct commercial air transport operations. Links the financial entity to its operational regulatory authorisation.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 Operation of Aircraft; FAA 14 CFR Part 119; EASA Part-OPS

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the immediate parent entity in this legal entity. Determines consolidation method: full consolidation (>50%), equity method (20-50%), or cost method (<20%) under IFRS 10/IAS 28.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IAS 28 Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Four-character SAP code controlling which fiscal periods are open or closed for posting in this company code. Governs period-end close procedures and prevents backdated postings outside approved windows. Corresponds to SAP BDATV field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Variant (BDATV); IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: registered_address
attributes.description: Full registered office address of the legal entity as recorded with the national company registry. Used for statutory correspondence, regulatory filings, and legal notices.
attributes.references: Local Company Registry Requirements; ICAO Doc 9626

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the registered office address of the legal entity. May differ from country of incorporation for branch entities. Required for statutory filings and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Local Company Registry Requirements

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated trading or operating name of the legal entity used in internal reports, SAP correspondence, and financial dashboards. Corresponds to SAP BUTXT field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master (BUTXT)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this company code record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture Standards

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code identifying the applicable tax authority and tax calculation procedure for this company code. Used for VAT/GST determination, withholding tax, and Passenger Facility Charge (PFC) reporting to DOT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; DOT PFC Reporting; IATA Tax Handbook

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Official VAT or GST registration number issued by the national tax authority for this legal entity. Required for VAT invoicing, reclaim submissions, and cross-border tax compliance. Sensitive business identifier.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IATA Tax Handbook; Local Tax Authority Requirements

products.name: cash_pool
products.description: Master reference table for cash_pool. Referenced by cash_pool_id.

attributes.name: cash_pool_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cash_pool

attributes.name: bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial institution providing the cash pooling service and managing the pool accounts.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity that acts as the pool leader or header account holder, responsible for overall pool management and bank relationship.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for treasury management costs and interest income/expense allocation related to this cash pool.

attributes.name: treasury_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for managing and monitoring this cash pool arrangement.

attributes.name: auto_sweep_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic cash sweeping is enabled to transfer excess balances from participant accounts to the master account.

attributes.name: base_interest_rate
attributes.description: Reference interest rate (in decimal form, e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%) used as the foundation for pool interest calculations, typically linked to a benchmark rate such as LIBOR, SOFR, or EURIBOR.

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this cash pool record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cash pool record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the cash pool. Multi-currency pools may require separate pool records per currency.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the cash pool arrangement becomes active and operational for treasury transactions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the cash pool arrangement terminates or requires renewal. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.

attributes.name: ifrs_16_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IFRS 16 lease accounting considerations apply to this cash pool, relevant when pool is linked to lease liability financing arrangements.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Day count convention used for calculating interest on pooled balances and compensating participating accounts.

attributes.name: interest_spread_bps
attributes.description: Spread in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%) added to or subtracted from the base rate for credit or debit positions within the pool.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the cash pool arrangement was last reviewed for performance, compliance, and alignment with treasury policy.

attributes.name: master_account_number
attributes.description: The primary bank account number serving as the header or concentration account for the cash pool structure.

attributes.name: maximum_pool_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate exposure or balance limit for the cash pool arrangement, set by the bank or internal treasury policy.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum aggregate balance required to be maintained in the cash pool to avoid penalties or maintain favorable interest terms.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this cash pool record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cash pool record was last modified.

attributes.name: netting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether intercompany netting is enabled within the cash pool to offset payables and receivables among participating entities.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the cash pool arrangement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or operational notes related to the cash pool arrangement.

attributes.name: overdraft_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cash pool includes an overdraft facility allowing negative aggregate balances up to an approved limit.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: Maximum overdraft amount permitted for the cash pool when overdraft facility is enabled. Nullable if no overdraft facility exists.

attributes.name: pool_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the cash pool arrangement, used in treasury operations and intercompany settlements.

attributes.name: pool_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cash pool arrangement, typically reflecting the participating entities or geographic scope.

attributes.name: pool_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cash pool arrangement indicating operational state and availability for treasury operations.

attributes.name: pool_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cash pooling structure: notional (interest compensation without physical transfer), physical (actual fund transfers), hybrid (combination), zero balancing (daily sweep to zero), target balancing (sweep to target level), or header structure (master account with sub-accounts).

attributes.name: pooling_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which cash concentration or interest calculation occurs within the pool structure.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Reference number for regulatory approval or notification required for cross-border or multi-jurisdictional cash pooling arrangements.

attributes.name: sweep_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum balance threshold that triggers an automatic sweep transaction from a participant account to the master account.

attributes.name: target_balance_amount
attributes.description: Target balance to be maintained in participant accounts after sweep operations in target balancing pool structures.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter country code representing the primary tax jurisdiction governing the cash pool for withholding tax and interest reporting purposes.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Applicable withholding tax rate (in decimal form, e.g., 0.15 for 15%) on interest income generated within the cash pool, based on tax jurisdiction.

attributes.name: parent_cash_pool_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cash_pool (parent_cash_pool_id)

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master reference table for legal_entity. Referenced by lessee_entity_id.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Primary key for legal_entity

attributes.name: parent_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy. Null if this is the ultimate parent.

attributes.name: ultimate_parent_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy. Null if this is the ultimate parent.

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: Primary accounting framework used by the entity for financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, or local GAAP).

attributes.name: air_operator_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the civil aviation authority authorizing the entity to conduct commercial air transport operations.

attributes.name: aoc_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Air Operator Certificate became effective and the entity was authorized to commence operations.

attributes.name: aoc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Air Operator Certificate expires and must be renewed. Null if certificate has no expiry.

attributes.name: aoc_issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the civil aviation authority that issued the Air Operator Certificate (e.g., FAA, EASA, CAAC).

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to consolidate this entity's financial results into group reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this legal entity record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity's business purpose within the corporate structure (e.g., operating company, holding company, SPV).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_day
attributes.description: Day of month (1-31) representing the end of the entity's fiscal year.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) representing the end of the entity's fiscal year for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary currency of the economic environment in which the entity operates.

attributes.name: iata_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator code assigned to the legal entity if it operates as an airline.

attributes.name: icao_airline_code
attributes.description: Three-character ICAO airline designator code assigned to the legal entity if it operates as an airline.

attributes.name: incorporation_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the entity is incorporated.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered with the relevant authority.

attributes.name: incorporation_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State, province, or sub-national jurisdiction within the incorporation country (e.g., Delaware, Ontario).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this legal entity record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the legal entity used in financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the entity as it appears in incorporation documents and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: legal_form
attributes.description: Type of legal structure of the entity (e.g., corporation, LLC, partnership, branch).

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier, a 20-character alphanumeric code for unique identification in financial transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: operating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where the entity conducts business operations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state indicating whether the entity is actively conducting business.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent entity (0.00 to 100.00). Used for consolidation calculations.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the official registered address of the legal entity as filed with the corporate registry.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the official registered address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the registered address.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the corporate registry or companies house in the jurisdiction of incorporation.

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory standing of the legal entity with the corporate registry or governing authority.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trading name of the legal entity used in operational systems and reports.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Primary tax identification number assigned by the tax authority in the entity's jurisdiction of incorporation.

attributes.name: parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on legal_entity (parent_legal_entity_id)

products.name: bank
products.description: Master reference table for bank. Referenced by bank_id.

attributes.name: bank_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bank

attributes.name: account_opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the airline first established a banking relationship with this bank.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the bank's headquarters or main branch office.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building name, floor, or suite number.

attributes.name: bank_code
attributes.description: Unique bank identification code assigned by the national banking authority or central bank. Used for domestic payment routing and interbank settlements.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the bank as registered with the banking authority.

attributes.name: bank_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank in the airline's treasury and payment systems.

attributes.name: bank_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank based on its primary business function and regulatory category.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the bank's headquarters or main branch is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the bank is domiciled and regulated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Current credit rating assigned to the bank by major rating agencies, used for counterparty risk assessment in treasury operations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the primary currency in which the bank operates and settles transactions.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for treasury operations, payment inquiries, and interline settlement communications with the bank.

attributes.name: iban_prefix
attributes.description: Country-specific IBAN prefix used for international account number validation. Consists of 2-letter country code and 2-digit check digits.

attributes.name: is_preferred_vendor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank is designated as a preferred banking partner for the airline's treasury operations, offering negotiated rates and priority service.

attributes.name: is_sanctions_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank has been verified as compliant with international sanctions regulations (OFAC, UN, EU) and is approved for airline treasury operations.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent financial transaction processed through this bank.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or operational notes related to the bank relationship.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the bank's treasury or corporate banking department.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the bank's address.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the primary banking regulatory authority or central bank that supervises and licenses this bank.

attributes.name: relationship_manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the bank's relationship manager for treasury correspondence and payment instructions.

attributes.name: relationship_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the bank's relationship manager or account officer assigned to the airline's corporate banking account.

attributes.name: relationship_manager_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number of the bank's relationship manager for urgent treasury matters and payment escalations.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit routing transit number (RTN) used for domestic electronic funds transfers and automated clearing house (ACH) transactions. Primarily used in United States banking.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank was last screened against international sanctions lists for compliance verification.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the bank is located.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: International bank identifier code (BIC) used for cross-border wire transfers and interline billing settlements. Format: 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the bank for reference and online banking portal access.

attributes.name: correspondent_bank_id

domains.name: workforce

Aligns with SAP S/4HANA HR PA master (Infotype 0001/0002).

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the employee. Used for age verification, retirement planning, and benefits eligibility.

attributes.name: department_code

attributes.name: email_address

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name

attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, SAP S/4HANA HR Infotype 0021

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the employee's designated emergency contact person.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, SAP S/4HANA HR Infotype 0021

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend).

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique employee number assigned by HR system. Business identifier used on badges, payroll, and HR documents.

attributes.name: employment_status
