attributes.references: Local Labor Law, Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the employee receives salary payments. Monthly is standard for salaried staff; biweekly or weekly may apply to hourly or ground staff.

attributes.name: probation_period_months
attributes.description: Duration of the probationary period in months during which the employee's performance is evaluated before permanent status is confirmed. Nullable if no probation applies.
attributes.references: IATA HR Standards, Local Labor Law

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or exceptions related to the employment contract (e.g., secondment details, special allowances, visa sponsorship notes).

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the base salary is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the employment contract becomes effective and the employee begins their employment relationship with the airline.
attributes.references: SAP PA Infotype 0016, IATA HR Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the employment contract was terminated, either by resignation, dismissal, or mutual agreement. Nullable for active contracts.
attributes.references: SAP PA Infotype 0016, DOT (Department of Transportation) Reporting

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for contract termination. Resignation indicates employee-initiated departure; dismissal indicates employer-initiated termination for cause; redundancy indicates position elimination; retirement indicates age or service-based exit; mutual agreement indicates negotiated separation; contract expiry indicates natural end of fixed-term contract.
attributes.references: SAP PA Infotype 0016, Local Labor Law

attributes.name: travel_privileges_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier for employee travel benefits (e.g., standby travel, confirmed seats, companion passes). Higher tiers typically apply to longer-tenured employees and flight crew. Airline-specific tier codes.

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Transactional entity representing a payroll processing cycle executed for a defined pay group and period. Captures payroll area, pay period start/end dates, run type (regular, off-cycle, correction), processing status, total gross pay, total net pay, total employer NI/social charges, currency, number of employees processed, and posting date to SAP FI/CO. Aligns with SAP Payroll (PY) module payroll run control records.
products.reference: SAP PY Payroll Run

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll processing cycle. Primary key for the payroll run entity.
attributes.references: SAP Payroll (PY) Module - Payroll Control Record

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Payroll runs must post to cost centers for labor cost allocation, financial reporting, and budget variance analysis. Essential for airline CASK calculation and operational cost management.

attributes.name: primary_payroll_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the payroll manager or authorized approver who approved this payroll run for payment. Required for segregation of duties and audit compliance.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period in YYYYPPP format where YYYY is fiscal year and PPP is period number (001-012 or 001-013 for special periods). Aligns payroll costs with financial reporting periods.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run received management approval to proceed to payment and posting. Critical control point in payroll workflow.

attributes.name: calculation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when payroll calculation processing completed for this run. Used for performance monitoring and audit trail.

attributes.name: calculation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when payroll calculation processing began for this run. Used for performance monitoring and audit trail.

attributes.name: co_document_number
attributes.description: SAP Controlling document number generated when payroll costs were allocated to cost centers and internal orders. Links payroll run to management accounting for cost analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit representing the legal entity for which this payroll run is executed. Used for financial reporting and statutory compliance at the legal entity level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll run. Typically matches the payroll area's local currency.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees included in this payroll run. Used for reconciliation and validation of payroll completeness.

attributes.name: fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP Financial Accounting document number generated when payroll was posted to General Ledger (GL). Links payroll run to accounting entries for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll administrators to document special circumstances, processing exceptions, or other relevant information about this payroll run.

attributes.name: off_cycle_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for executing an off-cycle payroll run outside the regular payroll schedule. Common reasons include termination settlements, bonus payments, or correction of prior period errors. Populated only when run_type is off_cycle.

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when net pay will be disbursed to employees via bank transfer or other payment method. Typically follows payroll approval and posting.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the end of the earnings and deductions calculation window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the beginning of the earnings and deductions calculation window.

attributes.name: payroll_area
attributes.description: Organizational grouping that defines payroll processing frequency and rules. Typically represents a country, region, or employee group with common payroll characteristics. Maps to SAP HR Payroll Area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll Area Configuration

attributes.name: payroll_period_identifier
attributes.description: Standardized period code in YYYYMM format representing the calendar month and year of the payroll run. Used for period-based reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payroll_schema
attributes.description: SAP Payroll calculation schema that defines the sequence of payroll rules and wage types processed in this run. Different schemas apply to different employee groups (pilots, cabin crew, ground staff).

attributes.name: personnel_area
attributes.description: SAP HR organizational unit representing a geographic or operational division within the company. Typically aligns with airports, hubs, or regional offices for airline workforce segmentation.
attributes.references: SAP HR Organizational Management - Personnel Area

attributes.name: personnel_subarea
attributes.description: SAP HR organizational subdivision within a personnel area. Used for more granular workforce segmentation such as terminal, department, or crew base.
attributes.references: SAP HR Organizational Management - Personnel Subarea

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when payroll financial transactions were posted to SAP FI/CO. Marks the point when payroll costs are recognized in the General Ledger (GL).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when payroll financial transactions were posted to SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules. Establishes the accounting period for General Ledger (GL) entries.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run. Draft indicates initial setup; in_progress indicates active calculation; calculated indicates computation complete pending approval; approved indicates management sign-off; posted indicates financial posting to General Ledger (GL); reversed indicates payroll reversal; cancelled indicates abandoned run. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|calculated|approved|posted|reversed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reversing this payroll run. Populated only when processing_status is reversed. Common reasons include calculation errors, incorrect period selection, or regulatory compliance issues.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run was reversed. Populated only when processing_status is reversed. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll processing cycle. Regular runs are scheduled periodic payroll; off-cycle runs handle unscheduled payments; correction runs fix prior period errors; advance runs provide early payments; bonus runs process incentive compensation; final runs handle termination settlements.

attributes.name: total_employee_tax
attributes.description: Aggregate employee tax withholdings including income tax, National Insurance (NI) employee portion, and other statutory deductions withheld from employee gross pay.
attributes.references: SAP Payroll Tax Calculation - Employee Portion

attributes.name: total_employer_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Employer Tax and Social Charges
attributes.description: Aggregate employer-borne tax obligations including National Insurance (NI), social security contributions, unemployment insurance, and other statutory employer charges for this payroll run.
attributes.references: SAP Payroll Tax Calculation - Employer Portion

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: Aggregate gross earnings for all employees processed in this payroll run before any deductions. Includes base salary, overtime, allowances, bonuses, and other earnings components.
attributes.references: SAP Payroll Results - Gross Pay Accumulation

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: Aggregate net pay disbursed to all employees in this payroll run after all statutory and voluntary deductions. Represents the actual amount paid to employees.
attributes.references: SAP Payroll Results - Net Pay Accumulation

attributes.name: total_voluntary_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate voluntary deductions including pension contributions, health insurance premiums, union dues, savings plans, and other employee-elected deductions.

products.name: payslip
products.description: Transactional entity representing the individual payroll result for a single employee in a specific pay period. Captures gross pay, net pay, all earnings components (base salary, flying pay, per diem, overtime, allowances), all deductions (tax, pension, union dues, benefit premiums), employer contributions, bank account details for payment, and payroll run reference. Aligns with SAP PY payroll results cluster (RT table). SSOT for individual employee pay outcomes.
products.reference: SAP PY Payroll Result (RT Cluster)

attributes.name: payslip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payslip record. Primary key for the payslip entity representing a single employee's payroll result for a specific pay period.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual payslips must attribute to cost centers for detailed labor cost tracking, departmental budget monitoring, and crew cost analysis per flight/route for airline profitability reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who received this payslip. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch that generated this payslip. Links to the payroll execution cycle.

attributes.name: allowances
attributes.description: Sum of miscellaneous allowances including housing, transportation, uniform, meal, and other special allowances applicable to the employee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the payroll manager or system user who approved this payslip for payment. Audit trail for approval authority.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payslip was approved by payroll manager or automated approval workflow. Required before payment disbursement.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Employee's bank account number for direct deposit of net pay. Masked for security except last 4 digits in employee-facing systems.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number for direct deposit. Identifies the financial institution receiving the payment.

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: The fixed base salary component for the pay period. Core compensation before allowances, overtime, or deductions.

attributes.name: block_hours
attributes.description: Total block hours (gate departure to gate arrival time) flown by crew during the pay period. Used to calculate flying pay and per diem.

attributes.name: bonus
attributes.description: Performance-based or discretionary bonus paid during this pay period. Includes annual bonuses, spot awards, and incentive payments.

attributes.name: commission
attributes.description: Sales commission or variable compensation earned during the pay period. Applicable to sales and revenue-generating roles.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payslip record was first created in the payroll system. Audit trail for payroll processing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this payslip. Supports multi-currency payroll for international operations.

attributes.name: employee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee receiving this payslip. Determines applicable pay rules, allowances, and union agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pilot|cabin_crew|ground_staff|maintenance|corporate|contract|temporary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: employer_health_contribution
attributes.description: Employer portion of health insurance premium. Not deducted from employee pay but recorded for total compensation and benefits cost tracking.

attributes.name: employer_payroll_tax
attributes.description: Employer portion of payroll taxes including social security, medicare, unemployment insurance, and other statutory employer taxes.

attributes.name: employer_pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employer matching or non-elective contribution to employee pension plan. Not deducted from employee pay but recorded for total compensation tracking.

attributes.name: flying_pay
attributes.description: Additional compensation for flight crew based on block hours flown during the pay period. Aviation-specific allowance for pilots and cabin crew.

attributes.name: garnishments
attributes.description: Court-ordered wage garnishments for child support, alimony, tax liens, or other legal obligations deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total earnings before any deductions. Sum of base salary, flying pay, overtime, allowances, bonuses, and all other earnings components.

attributes.name: health_insurance_premium
attributes.description: Employee portion of health insurance premium deducted from gross pay. Covers medical, dental, and vision insurance.

attributes.name: income_tax
attributes.description: Federal, state, and local income tax withheld from gross pay. Statutory deduction remitted to tax authorities on behalf of employee.

attributes.name: medicare_tax
attributes.description: Medicare tax withheld from gross pay. Statutory payroll tax for healthcare benefits for retirees.

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: Take-home pay after all deductions. Amount disbursed to employee's bank account. Calculated as gross pay minus total deductions.

attributes.name: other_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of miscellaneous deductions including life insurance, disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, loan repayments, and other voluntary deductions.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period. Used to calculate overtime pay at applicable premium rates.

attributes.name: overtime_pay
attributes.description: Additional compensation for hours worked beyond standard duty hours. Calculated based on overtime rate and hours worked.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the pay period covered by this payslip. Defines the end of the earnings and deductions calculation window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the pay period covered by this payslip. Defines the beginning of the earnings and deductions calculation window.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was or will be disbursed to the employee's bank account. Actual payment execution date.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to disburse net pay to the employee. Direct deposit is standard for most airlines.

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique payslip number assigned to this payroll result. Used for employee reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payslip. Tracks progression from calculation through approval to payment disbursement.

attributes.name: pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employee contribution to pension or retirement plan deducted from gross pay. Voluntary or mandatory retirement savings.

attributes.name: per_diem
attributes.description: Daily allowance paid to crew for meals and incidental expenses during layovers and duty periods away from base. Aviation-specific travel allowance.

attributes.name: shift_differential
attributes.description: Additional compensation for working non-standard shifts such as nights, weekends, or holidays. Premium pay for undesirable work hours.

attributes.name: social_security_tax
attributes.description: Social security or national insurance tax withheld from gross pay. Statutory payroll tax for retirement and disability benefits.

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions from gross pay including taxes, pension, insurance premiums, union dues, garnishments, and other deductions.

attributes.name: union_dues
attributes.description: Union membership dues deducted from gross pay. Mandatory for unionized employees per collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: year_to_date_gross
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period. Used for tax reporting and annual compensation tracking.

attributes.name: year_to_date_tax
attributes.description: Cumulative income tax withheld from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period. Used for tax reporting and reconciliation.

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Reference master defining all employee benefit plans offered by the airline including health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, pension/retirement schemes, travel concession programmes, and employee assistance programmes. Captures plan name, plan type, provider, coverage tiers, employee contribution rates, employer contribution rates, eligibility rules (employment type, tenure, grade), enrolment window dates, and plan status. Aligns with SAP Benefits (BN) module plan definitions.
products.reference: SAP BN Benefit Plan

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan. Primary key for the benefit plan master data.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Benefit plan should reference the union agreement that defines eligibility and terms. The union_agreement_reference is an attribute of union_agreement and should be retrieved via JOIN. This ensures be

attributes.name: coverage_tier_structure
attributes.description: Defines the available coverage tiers for the plan, determining who can be covered (employee only, employee plus dependents, family coverage).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dependent_coverage_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan allows employees to enroll eligible dependents (spouse, domestic partner, children).

attributes.name: eligibility_employment_type
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employment types eligible for this plan (e.g., full_time, part_time, contract, pilot, cabin_crew, ground_staff). Aligns with workforce employment classifications.

attributes.name: eligibility_grade_range
attributes.description: Employee grade or pay band range eligible for this plan (e.g., G1-G5, Executive, Management). Used to differentiate benefit offerings by organizational level.

attributes.name: eligibility_minimum_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months an employee must be employed before becoming eligible for this benefit plan. Zero indicates immediate eligibility.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Percentage or fixed amount that the employee contributes toward the benefit plan premium or cost. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 for 25%).

attributes.name: employer_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Percentage or fixed amount that the employer contributes toward the benefit plan premium or cost. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 for 75%).

attributes.name: enrollment_window_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the annual open enrollment period ends for this benefit plan. Elections must be submitted before this date.

attributes.name: enrollment_window_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the annual open enrollment period begins for this benefit plan. Employees can make elections during this window.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was last updated. Tracks changes to plan configuration, rates, or eligibility rules.

attributes.name: maximum_dependent_age
attributes.description: Maximum age for dependent children to remain eligible under the plan. Typically 26 in the US under ACA, varies by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the HR administrator who last modified this benefit plan record. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: monthly_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total monthly premium cost for the benefit plan per coverage tier. Used for payroll deduction calculations and budget planning.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the benefit plan across HR systems and communications. Used in payroll integration and employee self-service portals.

attributes.name: plan_description_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the benefit plan features, coverage highlights, and key terms. Used in employee communications and benefits guides.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL link to the full plan document, Summary Plan Description (SPD), or benefits handbook stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: plan_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan becomes active and coverage begins for enrolled participants. Aligns with plan year start.

attributes.name: plan_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null for evergreen plans without fixed end dates.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benefit plan as presented to employees and used in official documentation.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit plan. Active plans are available for enrollment; inactive plans are no longer offered but may have legacy participants.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benefit plan by category. Determines eligibility rules, contribution structures, and regulatory compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|retirement|pension|travel_concession|employee_assistance — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which this plan configuration applies. Used for year-over-year plan comparison and historical tracking.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the external insurance carrier or benefits provider administering the plan (e.g., Aetna, Blue Cross, Fidelity).

attributes.name: provider_policy_number
attributes.description: External policy or contract number assigned by the benefit provider for this plan. Used for claims reconciliation and provider communication.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_framework
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory frameworks this plan must comply with (e.g., ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, GDPR, local labor laws). Determines reporting and governance requirements.
attributes.references: ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, GDPR - Benefits Compliance

attributes.name: travel_concession_class_entitlement
attributes.description: Highest cabin class the employee is entitled to under travel concession benefits. Varies by employee grade and plan tier.

attributes.name: travel_concession_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan includes airline employee travel concession benefits (standby travel, discounted tickets for employee and dependents). Aviation industry-specific benefit.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an employee must wait after enrollment before coverage becomes effective. Common for health and insurance plans.

products.name: benefit_enrolment
products.description: Transactional master entity recording an employee's active enrolment in a specific benefit plan. Captures enrolment date, coverage start and end dates, selected coverage tier, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, dependants enrolled, waiver flag (if employee opted out), and enrolment source (open enrolment, life event, new hire). Aligns with SAP BN Participation records. SSOT for which benefits each employee is enrolled in.
products.reference: SAP BN Participation

attributes.name: benefit_enrolment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrolment record. Primary key for the benefit enrolment entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolled. Links to the benefit plan catalog.

attributes.name: primary_benefit_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee enrolled in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: Total annual amount elected by employee for this benefit plan. Applicable for flexible spending accounts (FSA), health savings accounts (HSA), and similar contribution-based benefits.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation
attributes.description: Identifier or reference to the designated beneficiary for this benefit plan (applicable for life insurance, retirement plans). May reference dependent or external party.

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or certificate number assigned by the insurance carrier or benefit provider for this enrolment. Used for claims processing and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Deadline Date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which terminated employee must elect COBRA continuation coverage. Typically 60 days from termination or notice date. Null if not COBRA eligible.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of employment. Applicable for US-based health benefit plans.

attributes.name: contribution_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for employee and employer contribution amounts. Supports multi-currency operations for international airline workforce.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted and paid. Aligns with payroll cycle.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date when benefit coverage terminates for the employee. Null for active ongoing coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date when benefit coverage begins for the employee. May differ from enrolment date due to waiting periods or plan year alignment.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage selected by the employee. Determines who is covered under the benefit plan (employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrolment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: dependents_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents (spouse, children, domestic partner) enrolled under this benefit plan coverage. Zero for employee-only coverage.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount contributed by the employee per pay period for this benefit plan. Represents the employee's share of the benefit cost.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount contributed by the employer per pay period for this benefit plan. Represents the employer's share of the benefit cost.

attributes.name: enrolment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or transaction number generated when the enrolment was processed. Provides audit trail and reference for employee inquiries.

attributes.name: enrolment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee enrolled in the benefit plan. Represents the business event timestamp of enrolment action.

attributes.name: enrolment_method
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the employee completed the benefit enrolment. Tracks whether enrolment was done via self-service portal, paper form, phone, HR representative, or automated system.

attributes.name: enrolment_source
attributes.description: Source or trigger event that initiated this benefit enrolment. Indicates whether enrolment occurred during open enrolment period, new hire onboarding, qualifying life event, annual renewal, or administrative action.

attributes.name: enrolment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrolment. Indicates whether the enrolment is active, terminated, suspended, pending approval, waived by employee, or cancelled.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is required to provide evidence of insurability (medical underwriting) for this benefit enrolment. Typically required for late enrolments or coverage above guaranteed issue limits.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: Status of evidence of insurability review process. Tracks whether medical underwriting has been completed and approved. Not_required if evidence_of_insurability_required_flag is False.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrolment record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: life_event_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualifying life event occurred. Used to validate enrolment change eligibility and timing. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: life_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying life event that triggered mid-year enrolment change. Applicable when enrolment_source is life_event. Null for standard enrolment periods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|birth|adoption|divorce|death|loss_of_coverage|employment_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pre_tax_election_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee contributions are deducted on a pre-tax basis under Section 125 cafeteria plan. True for pre-tax, False for post-tax contributions.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit enrolment was terminated. Distinct from coverage_end_date; represents the administrative termination action date. Null for active enrolments.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for benefit enrolment termination. Indicates whether termination was due to employment end, employee request, plan discontinuation, non-payment, loss of eligibility, retirement, or death. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employment_termination|employee_request|plan_discontinuation|non_payment|ineligibility|retirement|death — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tobacco_user_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee declared tobacco use during enrolment. Affects premium rates for health and life insurance plans. Protected health information.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee explicitly waived (opted out of) this benefit plan. True if waived, False if enrolled.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by employee for waiving the benefit plan. Applicable only when waiver_flag is True.

products.name: type_rating
products.description: Master entity representing an individual pilot's or maintenance engineer's ICAO/EASA/FAA type rating qualification for a specific aircraft type. Captures aircraft type designator (e.g., B737NG, A320neo, B777), rating category (PIC, SIC, TRI, TRE, FE), issuing authority, certificate number, initial issue date, expiry/revalidation date, and current validity status. Critical for crew scheduling legality checks, fleet transition planning, and regulatory compliance. Note: operational crew pairing assignment uses the crew domain; this entity is the HR qualification SSOT.
products.reference: ICAO Annex 1 Type Rating / EASA Part-FCL

attributes.name: type_rating_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the type rating qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Type rating certification requires reference to fleet aircraft type specifications for training syllabus requirements, simulator qualification level, and crew scheduling eligibility determination. Rep

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pilot or maintenance engineer who holds this type rating qualification.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or license number issued by the regulatory authority for this type rating qualification.

attributes.name: checkride_date
attributes.description: The date when the practical test or skill test (checkride) for the type rating was successfully completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this type rating record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crew_scheduling_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this type rating is currently valid and eligible for crew scheduling and pairing assignment (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: current_validity_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the current validity period for this type rating, typically following the most recent revalidation or renewal.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional endorsements or authorizations associated with the type rating (e.g., ETOPS, CAT II/III, RVSM, RNP).

attributes.name: examiner_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated pilot examiner (DPE) or type rating examiner (TRE) who conducted the checkride.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the current type rating validity expires and requires revalidation or renewal. Null if the rating has no expiry (rare).

attributes.name: fleet_transition_source_type
attributes.description: The aircraft type from which the employee transitioned when obtaining this type rating, if applicable (used for fleet transition planning).

attributes.name: initial_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the type rating was first issued to the employee.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The national or regional aviation authority that issued this type rating certificate (e.g., FAA, EASA, CAAC, TCCA, CASA, DGCA).

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the authority that issued the type rating (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN, CAN, AUS, IND).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this type rating record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_revalidation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent revalidation or proficiency check that extended the validity of this type rating.

attributes.name: line_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent line check or line operational evaluation conducted on this aircraft type.

attributes.name: next_revalidation_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next revalidation or proficiency check must be completed to maintain currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this type rating qualification.

attributes.name: pic_hours_on_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pilot in Command (PIC) Hours on Aircraft Type
attributes.description: Total flight hours logged as Pilot in Command on this specific aircraft type.

attributes.name: proficiency_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent operator proficiency check (OPC) or competency check for this type rating.

attributes.name: rating_category
attributes.description: Category of type rating qualification: PIC (Pilot in Command), SIC (Second in Command), TRI (Type Rating Instructor), TRE (Type Rating Examiner), FE (Flight Engineer), AME (Aircraft Maintenance Engineer).

attributes.name: recency_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recency or currency check (e.g., three takeoffs and landings within 90 days) for this type rating.

attributes.name: restrictions
attributes.description: Any operational restrictions or limitations placed on the type rating (e.g., VFR only, co-pilot only, specific equipment limitations).

attributes.name: simulator_qualification_level
attributes.description: The qualification level of the flight simulator used for type rating training and testing (Level A/B/C/D, FTD - Flight Training Device, FFS - Full Flight Simulator).
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9625 - Manual of Criteria for the Qualification of Flight Simulation Training Devices

attributes.name: total_flight_hours_on_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Flight Hours on Aircraft Type
attributes.description: Cumulative total flight hours logged by the employee on this specific aircraft type since initial type rating.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the initial type rating training course was successfully completed.

attributes.name: training_organization_code
attributes.description: Code or identifier of the approved training organization (ATO) where the initial type rating training was completed.

attributes.name: transition_training_hours
attributes.description: Total training hours required or completed for transition to this aircraft type from a previous type rating.

attributes.name: validity_status
attributes.description: Current validity status of the type rating: valid (current and usable), expired (past expiry date), suspended (temporarily invalid), revoked (permanently invalid), pending (awaiting issuance or revalidation).

products.name: training_record
products.description: Transactional entity capturing the completion of a specific training event by an employee. Covers recurrent training (simulator checks, line checks, SEP/HUET, CRM, RVSM, ETOPS, DG awareness), initial type rating training, ground school, and mandatory regulatory training. Captures training course code, training type, delivery method (simulator, classroom, CBT, OJT), training centre, instructor, start date, completion date, result (pass/fail/incomplete), score, and next due date for recurrent items.
products.reference: AIMS Training Records / SAP LSO Learning Solution

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Primary key for training_record

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Training costs must post to cost centers for budget tracking, regulatory compliance reporting (FAA/EASA training requirements), and crew development cost analysis per airline training policies.

attributes.name: primary_training_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who completed this training event. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: training_centre_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Training centers are airport stations. Normalize code to FK for training logistics, travel cost allocation, simulator facility management, and training capacity planning.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.training_course. Business justification: Training record should reference the master training_course for course details, duration, regulatory mandate, and certification type. The training_course_code STRING attribute should be replaced by FK

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the training event commenced. May differ from scheduled start date due to operational changes or employee availability.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_code
attributes.description: ICAO aircraft type designator for the aircraft type covered by this training. Examples: B737, A320, B77W. Applicable for type rating training, differences training, and aircraft-specific recurrent training.

attributes.name: approval_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory authority or internal approval body that approved or certified this training event. Used for compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: EASA Part-ORA, FAA Part 121, National Aviation Authority Standards

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the training certificate or qualification was officially issued by the regulatory authority or training organization.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or qualification number issued upon successful completion of the training. Used for regulatory compliance verification and audit trails.
attributes.references: EASA Part-FCL, FAA Part 121, National Aviation Authority Standards

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the training event was completed. This is the official date of record for training currency and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EASA Part-ORO (Organisation Requirements for Air Operations), FAA Part 121.433 (Training Required)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training was delivered. Includes simulator sessions, classroom instruction, computer-based training (CBT), e-learning, on-the-job training (OJT), line training, and blended approaches. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: simulator|classroom|cbt|elearning|ojt|line_training|blended|virtual_classroom — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Training Standards, ICAO Doc 9868 (Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Training)

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training event in hours. Includes classroom time, simulator time, or e-learning time as applicable. Used for training cost allocation and resource planning.
attributes.references: IATA Training Standards, Internal Training Management Standard

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this training qualification expires and recurrent training is required. Applicable for time-limited certifications such as type ratings, proficiency checks, and recurrent training items. Null for one-time training events.
attributes.references: EASA Part-FCL.740 (Recency Requirements), FAA Part 121.439 (Pilot Qualification: Recent Experience)

attributes.name: external_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training was conducted by an external training provider or approved training organization (ATO) rather than internal airline training resources. True for external providers, false for internal training.

attributes.name: external_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training organization or approved training organization (ATO) that conducted the training. Null for internal training events.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was last updated. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training is mandatory for regulatory compliance or operational qualification. True for required training such as proficiency checks, dangerous goods, security, and type ratings. False for optional or developmental training.
attributes.references: EASA Part-ORO, FAA Part 121, IATA Training Standards

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next recurrent training event is due. Used for proactive scheduling and compliance monitoring. Calculated based on regulatory recurrency intervals (e.g., 12 months for proficiency checks, 24 months for dangerous goods training).
attributes.references: EASA Part-ORO, FAA Part 121.433, IATA DGR (Dangerous Goods Regulations)

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the training event, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Defines the pass/fail boundary for graded assessments.
attributes.references: Internal Training Assessment Standard, EASA Part-FCL

attributes.name: recurrency_interval_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recurrent training events. Common values: 12 months for proficiency checks, 24 months for dangerous goods training, 36 months for security training. Null for non-recurrent training.
attributes.references: EASA Part-ORO, FAA Part 121, IATA DGR

attributes.name: recurrent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training is recurrent (requires periodic renewal) or one-time. True for recurrent training such as annual proficiency checks, biennial dangerous goods training, and periodic emergency procedures training.

attributes.name: recurrent_training_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must complete mandatory recurrent training (e.g., annual safety training, CRM, emergency procedures). Critical for regulatory compliance. [Moved from employee: This attribute represents the next due date for recurrent training, which is specific to each employee-course combination, not to the employee globally. Different courses have different recurrence intervals, so this belongs in the training_record association as next_due_date.]
attributes.references: FAA Part 121, EASA Part-ORO, ICAO Annex 6

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Aviation regulatory authority under whose jurisdiction this training was conducted and certified. Examples: FAA (Federal Aviation Administration), EASA (European Union Aviation Safety Agency), CAAC (Civil Aviation Administration of China). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FAA|EASA|CAAC|TCCA|CASA|DGCA|ANAC|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, National Civil Aviation Authorities

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special circumstances related to the training event. May include instructor comments, performance observations, or administrative notes.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the training event. Used for training scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numerical score or grade achieved in the training event, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Applicable for assessments and examinations. Null for non-graded training such as briefings or awareness sessions.

attributes.name: simulator_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the flight simulator or training device used for the training event. Applicable only for simulator-based training. References the specific Full Flight Simulator (FFS), Flight Training Device (FTD), or other approved training device.
attributes.references: EASA Part-FSTD (Flight Simulation Training Devices), FAA Part 60 (Flight Simulation Training Device Initial and Continuing Qualification)

attributes.name: training_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this training event, including instructor fees, facility costs, simulator rental, and materials. Expressed in the airline's reporting currency. Used for training budget management and cost allocation.

attributes.name: training_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the training cost amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: training_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the training event. Indicates whether the employee successfully passed, failed, did not complete, or withdrew from the training.

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training record. Tracks the training event from scheduling through completion and expiry.

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training event. Distinguishes between initial type rating, recurrent training, line checks, simulator sessions, ground school, and other training categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_type_rating|recurrent|differences|conversion|ground_school|simulator|line_check|proficiency_check|emergency_procedures|dangerous_goods|crm|security|regulatory_compliance|ojtother — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1 (Personnel Licensing), EASA Part-FCL, FAA Part 121.400 Series

products.name: training_course
products.description: Reference master defining all training courses and programmes offered or mandated by the airline. Captures course code, course name, course category (type rating, recurrent, regulatory, leadership, safety, ground ops), delivery method, duration, regulatory mandate flag, applicable ICAO/EASA/FAA regulation reference, required recurrence interval (months), minimum pass score, and approved training organisation (ATO) delivering the course. Used to drive training compliance tracking and scheduling.
products.reference: EASA Part-ORA / FAA AC 120 Training Programme

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_training_organisation
attributes.description: Name of the EASA/FAA/ICAO-approved training organisation or internal training department authorized to deliver this course.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method used to evaluate participant competency and determine pass/fail. Simulator check refers to proficiency evaluation in a flight training device or full flight simulator.

attributes.name: ato_approval_number
attributes.description: Regulatory approval or certification number issued by the civil aviation authority to the training organisation for this course.

attributes.name: certification_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of this course results in a formal certification, license endorsement, or type rating. True if certification is issued, False if course is for awareness or development only.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of certification or credential awarded upon successful completion. Examples: Type Rating A320, Dangerous Goods Certification, CRM Certificate, Safety Management System Certification. Null if no certification is issued.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, EASA Part-FCL, IATA Training Standards

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Standard cost to deliver the training course per participant, including instructor fees, materials, simulator time, and facility costs. Used for training budget planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: Classification of the training course by functional area. Type rating refers to aircraft-specific pilot certification, recurrent refers to periodic refresher training, regulatory refers to mandated compliance training. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: type_rating|recurrent|regulatory|leadership|safety|ground_ops|cabin_crew|technical|customer_service|security — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, EASA Part-FCL, FAA Part 121

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the training course in the airline's training management system. Used for scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the course content, learning objectives, and outcomes. Used for course catalogue and employee self-service portals.

attributes.name: course_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the training course or programme.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course. Active courses are available for scheduling. Retired courses are no longer offered but retained for historical compliance records.

attributes.name: course_version
attributes.description: Version number of the course curriculum. Incremented when course content, duration, or regulatory requirements change. Format: major.minor (e.g., 2.1).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per participant. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Mode of instruction for the training course. Simulator refers to flight training device or full flight simulator sessions.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total instructional time required to complete the course, measured in hours. Includes classroom, simulator, and practical training time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this course version became active and available for scheduling. Used to track curriculum changes and regulatory updates.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this course version is retired or superseded. Null if the course is currently active with no planned retirement.

attributes.name: language_of_instruction
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the primary language in which the course is delivered. Examples: EN (English), FR (French), DE (German).

attributes.name: maximum_participants
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants allowed per training session. Driven by classroom capacity, simulator availability, or instructor-to-student ratio requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_pass_score
attributes.description: Minimum score or percentage required to successfully complete the course. Typically expressed as a percentage (e.g., 80.00 for 80%).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the training administrator who last modified this course record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: prerequisite_courses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of course codes that must be completed before enrolling in this course. Null if no prerequisites exist.

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recurrent training sessions. Null if the course is not recurrent. Common values: 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), 6 (semi-annual).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, EASA Part-FCL, FAA Part 121

attributes.name: regulation_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific ICAO, EASA, FAA, or national civil aviation authority regulation that mandates this training course. Examples: ICAO Annex 6, EASA Part-ORO, FAA 14 CFR Part 121.427.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is mandated by aviation regulatory authorities (ICAO, EASA, FAA, national CAA). True if required by regulation, False if voluntary or internal development.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, EASA Part-FCL, FAA Part 121

attributes.name: sms_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is part of the airline's Safety Management System (SMS) training programme as required by ICAO Annex 19. True if SMS-related, False otherwise.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Primary employee group or role for which this training course is designed. Pilots include flight deck crew, cabin crew include flight attendants, ground staff include airport and customer service personnel.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the training administrator who created this course record in the system.

products.name: union_agreement
products.description: Master entity representing a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) between the airline and a recognised labour union or staff association. Captures union name, IATA union code, bargaining unit scope (pilots/ALPA, cabin crew/AFA, IAM ground staff, AMFA engineers), effective and expiry dates, negotiation status, key provisions (pay scales, duty hour limits, rest rules, seniority bidding, furlough/recall), applicable jurisdictions, and amendment history. SSOT for labour relations — referenced by employment contracts, payroll rules, and scheduling constraints.
products.reference: IATA Labour Relations / National Labour Law CBA

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Full legal name or title of the collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement, typically formatted as CBA- followed by alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agreement lifecycle stage (initial, renewal, amendment, extension, successor, interim).

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments made to this collective bargaining agreement since its effective date.

attributes.name: arbitration_clause
attributes.description: Terms and conditions for binding arbitration of unresolved disputes under this collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit
attributes.description: Category of employees covered by this agreement (e.g., pilots, cabin crew, ground staff, mechanics, dispatchers, corporate employees). attributes.name: covered_employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees covered under this collective bargaining agreement at the time of ratification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full legal text of the collective bargaining agreement document.

attributes.name: duration_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the collective bargaining agreement in months from effective date to expiry date.

attributes.name: duty_hour_limit_monthly
attributes.description: Maximum number of duty hours per month allowed under this agreement for covered employees.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement becomes legally binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement expires and is no longer in force. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: flight_hour_limit_monthly
attributes.description: Maximum number of flight hours per month allowed under this agreement for flight crew members.
attributes.references: FAA Part 117 - Flight and Duty Limitations

attributes.name: furlough_recall_provisions
attributes.description: Terms governing employee furloughs (temporary layoffs) and recall procedures, including seniority order and notification requirements.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal framework or statute governing this collective bargaining agreement (e.g., Railway Labor Act, National Labor Relations Act).

attributes.name: grievance_procedure
attributes.description: Formal process for resolving disputes and grievances between employees and management as outlined in the agreement.

attributes.name: health_benefits_summary
attributes.description: Summary of health insurance and medical benefits provisions negotiated in the agreement.

attributes.name: job_security_provisions
attributes.description: Terms protecting employee job security, including no-furlough clauses, minimum fleet size commitments, and outsourcing restrictions.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or legal jurisdiction(s) where this collective bargaining agreement applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Pipe-separated list for multi-jurisdiction agreements.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to this collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union agreement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: management_signatory
attributes.description: Name and title of the airline management representative who signed the collective bargaining agreement on behalf of the company.

attributes.name: minimum_rest_hours
attributes.description: Minimum consecutive rest hours required between duty periods as specified in the agreement.
attributes.references: FAA Part 117 - Flight and Duty Limitations

attributes.name: negotiating_committee_lead
attributes.description: Name of the lead negotiator or committee chair representing the union during agreement negotiations.

attributes.name: negotiation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when formal negotiations for this collective bargaining agreement concluded.

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal negotiations for this collective bargaining agreement commenced.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this collective bargaining agreement, including special provisions or historical context.

attributes.name: pay_scale_structure
attributes.description: Description of the compensation structure defined in the agreement, including base pay scales, step progressions, and longevity increases.

attributes.name: ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when the union membership voted to approve and ratify the collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: retirement_benefits_summary
attributes.description: Summary of pension, 401(k), and other retirement benefit provisions negotiated in the agreement.

attributes.name: scope_clause
attributes.description: Provisions defining the scope of work that must be performed by union members versus contractors or other carriers (critical for protecting union jobs).

attributes.name: seniority_bidding_rules
attributes.description: Description of seniority-based bidding procedures for schedules, routes, bases, and equipment assignments as defined in the agreement.

attributes.name: union_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collective bargaining agreement (draft, negotiation, ratification, active, expired, terminated, suspended). attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Standardized abbreviation or code for the union (e.g., ALPA for Air Line Pilots Association, AFA for Association of Flight Attendants, IAM for International Association of Machinists, AMFA for Aircraft Mechanics Fraternal Association).

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the labor union or staff association that is party to this agreement (e.g., Air Line Pilots Association, Association of Flight Attendants).

attributes.name: union_signatory
attributes.description: Name and title of the union representative who signed the collective bargaining agreement on behalf of the union membership.

products.name: grievance
products.description: Transactional entity recording formal employee grievances, disciplinary actions, and labour relations cases filed within the airline. Captures grievance type (disciplinary, harassment, unfair treatment, CBA violation, safety concern), filing date, employee reference, respondent (manager/department), union representation flag, case status (open, under investigation, resolved, escalated to arbitration), resolution date, outcome, and any financial settlement. Supports labour relations management and legal compliance.
products.reference: SAP HR Case Management / Labour Relations Case

attributes.name: grievance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee grievance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: grievance_assigned_investigator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR or labor relations staff member assigned to investigate the grievance.

attributes.name: grievance_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who filed the grievance. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: arbitration_date
attributes.description: Date when the arbitration hearing took place, if applicable.

attributes.name: arbitration_decision
attributes.description: Summary of the arbitrators binding decision, if arbitration occurred.

attributes.name: arbitration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance was escalated to external arbitration. True if arbitration was invoked, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Labor Relations Best Practices, ILO Convention 87

attributes.name: arbitrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the neutral third-party arbitrator assigned to the case, if arbitration occurred.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grievance case. Tracks progression from filing through resolution or arbitration.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the grievance case was formally closed and no further action is pending. Marks the end of the grievance lifecycle.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement was executed as part of the resolution. True if confidentiality agreement exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grievance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to supporting documentation, evidence, or investigation reports stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee formally filed the grievance with the airline. This is the principal business event timestamp for the grievance lifecycle.

attributes.name: financial_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Monetary settlement amount paid to the employee as part of the grievance resolution, if applicable. Null if no financial settlement.

attributes.name: grievance_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the grievance as provided by the employee. Contains the facts, circumstances, and specific complaint details.

attributes.name: grievance_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique case number assigned to the grievance for tracking and reference purposes. Format: GRV-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: grievance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grievance based on the nature of the complaint. CBA = Collective Bargaining Agreement.
attributes.references: Labor Relations Best Practices, ILO Convention 87

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident or event that led to the grievance occurred. May differ from filing date.

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation was completed and findings were documented.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal investigation of the grievance commenced.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grievance record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: legal_counsel_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external legal counsel was engaged by either party during the grievance process. True if legal counsel was involved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the grievance based on severity, urgency, and potential impact. Critical priority typically assigned to safety concerns or legal risks.

attributes.name: related_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the airline policy, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), or Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) clause cited in the grievance.

attributes.name: requested_remedy
attributes.description: The resolution or corrective action requested by the employee. Examples: reinstatement, back pay, policy change, disciplinary action reversal.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the grievance was formally resolved, either through internal resolution, settlement, or arbitration decision.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the grievance case. Upheld means the grievance was found valid and remedy granted; denied means grievance was not substantiated.

attributes.name: resolution_summary
attributes.description: Detailed summary of the resolution, including findings, corrective actions taken, and rationale for the decision.

attributes.name: respondent_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or division of the respondent. Examples: Flight Operations, Cabin Crew, Ground Handling, Maintenance.

attributes.name: respondent_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager, supervisor, or department against whom the grievance is filed.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
