products.name: staff_travel_entitlement
products.description: Master entity defining the staff travel concession entitlements granted to employees and their eligible nominees (spouse, dependants, parents) as part of the airline's employee benefit programme. Captures employee reference, entitlement type (ID90 standby, ID50 confirmed, ZED interline, rebate coupon), eligible nominees, annual allocation (number of trips or sectors), used allocation, carry-forward rules, eligibility tier (based on grade and tenure), and applicable interline partner agreements. Distinct from the loyalty FFP domain.
products.reference: IATA Staff Travel / ID90 / ZED Agreement

attributes.name: staff_travel_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the staff travel entitlement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who holds this travel entitlement. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: advance_booking_days_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in advance that staff travel can be booked under this entitlement. Null if no maximum advance booking restriction applies.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Booking Rules

attributes.name: advance_booking_days_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance that staff travel must be booked under this entitlement. Null if no minimum advance booking requirement applies.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Booking Rules

attributes.name: annual_allocation_sectors
attributes.description: Number of flight sectors (individual flight segments) allocated to the employee per calendar year under this entitlement. Null if allocation is measured in trips instead of sectors.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Allocation

attributes.name: annual_allocation_trips
attributes.description: Number of round trips or one-way trips allocated to the employee per calendar year under this entitlement. Null if allocation is measured in sectors instead of trips.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Allocation

attributes.name: blackout_dates_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether blackout dates (peak travel periods where staff travel is restricted) apply to this entitlement. True if blackout restrictions apply, false if entitlement is exempt from blackout dates.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Blackout Periods

attributes.name: cabin_class_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum cabin class the employee is entitled to book under this entitlement. Economy restricts to economy class only; business allows up to business class; first allows all classes including first; any indicates no restriction.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Cabin Entitlements

attributes.name: carry_forward_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused allocation from the current year can be carried forward to the next calendar year. True if carry-forward is permitted, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Allocation Rules

attributes.name: carry_forward_limit_sectors
attributes.description: Maximum number of unused sectors that can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Null if no carry-forward is allowed or if measured in trips.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Allocation Rules

attributes.name: carry_forward_limit_trips
attributes.description: Maximum number of unused trips that can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Null if no carry-forward is allowed or if measured in sectors.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Allocation Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this entitlement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base fare for staff travel bookings under this entitlement. For example, 90.00 represents a 90% discount (ID90), 50.00 represents a 50% discount (ID50).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this travel entitlement becomes valid and can be used for booking staff travel.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this travel entitlement remains valid. Nullable for open-ended entitlements that remain valid until employment termination or policy change.

attributes.name: eligibility_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification determining the level of travel benefits based on employee grade, tenure, and position. Higher tiers receive more generous allocations and priority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|tier_4|executive|management|operational|probationary — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Benefits

attributes.name: entitlement_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for this entitlement record, used for operational reference and tracking.

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: Type of staff travel concession granted. ID90 standby (90% discount standby), ID50 confirmed (50% discount confirmed), ID75 standby (75% discount standby), ZED interline (Zonal Employee Discount for interline travel), rebate coupon (fixed rebate voucher), positive space (confirmed seat), staff leisure (personal travel), staff business (official business travel). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ID90_standby|ID50_confirmed|ID75_standby|ZED_interline|rebate_coupon|positive_space|staff_leisure|staff_business — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic scope restriction applied to this entitlement. None indicates no restriction; domestic_only limits to domestic flights; regional limits to specific regions; international allows international travel; specific_routes limits to designated route list.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Restrictions

attributes.name: interline_partner_agreements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA airline codes representing interline partner airlines where this entitlement can be used for ZED or reciprocal staff travel. Example: BA,LH,AF,QF. Null if entitlement is restricted to own airline only.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this entitlement record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: maximum_nominees_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of eligible nominees (spouse, dependants, parents) who can be registered under this entitlement. Null if no limit applies.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Nominees

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the HR administrator or system user who last modified this entitlement record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: nominee_dependants_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees dependent children are eligible to use this travel entitlement as nominees. True if dependants are eligible, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Nominees

attributes.name: nominee_parents_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees parents are eligible to use this travel entitlement as nominees. True if parents are eligible, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Nominees

attributes.name: nominee_spouse_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees spouse or domestic partner is eligible to use this travel entitlement as a nominee. True if spouse is eligible, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Nominees

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or remarks related to this travel entitlement. May include information about special approvals, exceptions, or restrictions.

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the staff travel policy under which this entitlement was granted. Used for tracking policy changes over time and ensuring compliance with the applicable policy version.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Policy Versioning

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Boarding priority level assigned to staff travel bookings under this entitlement when traveling standby. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for waitlist sequencing when flights are overbooked.

attributes.name: remaining_allocation_sectors
attributes.description: Number of sectors remaining in the annual allocation available for future bookings. Calculated as annual_allocation_sectors minus used_allocation_sectors.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Tracking

attributes.name: remaining_allocation_trips
attributes.description: Number of trips remaining in the annual allocation available for future bookings. Calculated as annual_allocation_trips minus used_allocation_trips.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Tracking

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Fixed service charge amount levied per booking or per sector for administrative processing of staff travel under this entitlement. Null if no service charge applies.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Charges

attributes.name: service_charge_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the service charge amount. Example: USD, EUR, GBP. Null if no service charge applies.

attributes.name: staff_travel_entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the travel entitlement. Active entitlements can be used for booking; suspended entitlements are temporarily blocked; expired entitlements have passed their validity period; revoked entitlements are permanently cancelled.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Administration

attributes.name: taxes_fees_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether airport taxes, fuel surcharges, and government fees are waived for staff travel bookings under this entitlement. True if taxes and fees are waived, false if employee must pay taxes and fees.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Charges

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining agreement or union contract that governs this travel entitlement. Null if entitlement is not governed by a union agreement.

attributes.name: used_allocation_sectors
attributes.description: Number of sectors from the annual allocation that have been consumed year-to-date. Updated after each completed staff travel booking.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Tracking

attributes.name: used_allocation_trips
attributes.description: Number of trips from the annual allocation that have been consumed year-to-date. Updated after each completed staff travel booking.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy - Staff Travel Tracking

products.name: medical_compliance
products.description: Tracks HR compliance status and administrative records for employee medical certificates, referencing crew.medical_certificate as the SSOT for the actual aviation medical certificate. Records HR follow-up actions, expiry notifications, and fitness-for-duty administrative decisions.

attributes.name: medical_certificate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aviation medical certificate record in crew.medical_certificate, which is the system of record (SSOT) for the actual medical certificate. This compliance record tracks HR administrative follow-up and fitness-for-duty decisions related to that certificate.

attributes.name: primary_medical_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee whose medical compliance is being tracked. Links to workforce.employee.

attributes.name: tertiary_medical_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the HR system user who last modified this compliance record, providing audit trail for compliance actions and determinations.

attributes.name: certificate_class
attributes.description: Class of aviation medical certificate required for the employee's role (Class 1 for airline transport pilots, Class 2 for commercial pilots, Class 3 for private pilots, cabin crew medical, or air traffic controller medical).

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current medical certificate expires. Denormalized from crew.medical_certificate for HR operational convenience and expiry notification workflows.

attributes.name: compliance_record_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique identifier for this HR medical compliance administrative record, used for tracking and reference in HR systems.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current HR compliance status of the employee's medical certification from an administrative and fitness-for-duty perspective. Reflects HR follow-up actions and administrative decisions, distinct from the certificate validity status in crew.medical_certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: compliant|non_compliant|pending_review|expired|waiver_granted|under_investigation|remediation_required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: crew_scheduling_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently eligible for crew scheduling and flight duty assignment based on their medical compliance status. Used by crew scheduling systems to filter available crew.

attributes.name: fitness_determination_date
attributes.description: Date when the fitness-for-duty determination was made by HR or occupational health, establishing the current operational status.

attributes.name: fitness_for_duty_status
attributes.description: HR administrative determination of the employee's fitness to perform safety-critical duties based on medical compliance status. This is an HR operational flag that may trigger crew scheduling restrictions.

attributes.name: follow_up_action_required
attributes.description: HR administrative follow-up action required to maintain or restore medical compliance status. Tracks the next step in the compliance workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|renewal_required|medical_exam_scheduled|documentation_submission|fitness_assessment|management_review|grounding_recommended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: follow_up_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the required follow-up action was completed by the employee or HR, resolving the compliance issue.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the required follow-up action must be completed to maintain compliance status and avoid operational impact (e.g., crew scheduling restrictions).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory authority or aviation medical examiner (AME) that issued the medical certificate or waiver (e.g., FAA, EASA, national civil aviation authority).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 1, FAA Part 67, EASA Part-MED

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the regulatory authority that issued the medical certificate.

attributes.name: last_medical_exam_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent aviation medical examination. Denormalized from crew.medical_certificate for HR tracking and scheduling of next exam.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this medical compliance record was last updated, reflecting the most recent HR review, status change, or follow-up action.

attributes.name: next_medical_exam_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must complete their next aviation medical examination to maintain certificate validity and compliance status.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from HR regarding medical compliance status, follow-up actions, communications with employee, or special circumstances. Confidential HR administrative information.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method used by HR to notify the employee of medical compliance requirements, expiry warnings, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when HR sent expiry notification or compliance reminder to the employee regarding their medical certificate renewal or compliance action required.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this medical compliance record was first created in the HR system, marking the start of HR administrative tracking for this compliance event.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical compliance event was reported to the regulatory authority, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical compliance event requires reporting to regulatory authorities (e.g., FAA, EASA) due to safety implications, certificate suspension, or fitness determination.

attributes.name: restrictions_description
attributes.description: Description of any operational restrictions or limitations placed on the employee's duties due to medical compliance status or fitness-for-duty assessment (e.g., no night flights, no long-haul, ground duties only).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the HR reviewer last assessed this medical compliance record and updated the compliance status or fitness determination.

attributes.name: scheduling_restriction_end_date
attributes.description: Date when crew scheduling restrictions are expected to be lifted, subject to compliance restoration and fitness clearance.

attributes.name: scheduling_restriction_start_date

attributes.name: union_notification_date

attributes.name: union_notification_required_flag

attributes.name: waiver_conditions

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag

attributes.name: superseded_medical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on medical_compliance (superseded_medical_compliance_id)

products.name: enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between employee and benefit_plan. It captures the employee's election of a specific benefit plan with coverage tier, contribution amounts, enrollment dates, and life event triggers. Each record links one employee to one benefit_plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship. Supports open enrollment, qualifying life events, and historical tracking of benefit elections.. Existence Justification: Benefit enrollment is a core HR business process where employees actively elect multiple benefit plans (health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement) and the airline offers each plan to thousands of employees. The business manages enrollments as operational records with coverage tiers, contribution amounts, enrollment dates, life event triggers, and status tracking. HR and benefits administrators create, modify, and terminate enrollments during open enrollment periods and qualifying life events.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: position_budget
products.description: This association product represents the budgeting allocation between budget_plan and position. It captures the planned headcount (FTE) and salary costs for each position within each budget plan, supporting multi-year workforce planning, scenario analysis, and labor cost forecasting aligned with fleet expansion and route network changes. Each record links one budget_plan to one position with budgeted amounts, approval status, and variance tracking that exist only in the context of this planning relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline workforce planning, a single budget plan (annual budget, rolling forecast, scenario plan) allocates budgeted FTE and salary amounts to hundreds or thousands of positions across the organizational structure. Conversely, a single position appears in multiple budget plans simultaneously—the FY2025 annual budget, the Q2 rolling forecast, and the fleet expansion scenario plan may all contain different budgeted amounts for the same Captain position. The business actively manages these position budget allocations as discrete planning records with approval workflows, variance tracking, and scenario-specific assumptions.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: position_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the position budget allocation record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the budget plan. Each position budget allocation belongs to exactly one budget plan (annual, rolling forecast, scenario plan, etc.).

attributes.name: workforce_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the position being budgeted. Each position budget allocation references exactly one authorized position in the organizational structure.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this position budget allocation within the budget approval workflow. Values: draft, submitted, approved, rejected, revised. Enables position-level budget approval tracking within the overall plan.

attributes.name: budget_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or assumptions specific to this position budget allocation (e.g., 'assumes 3-month vacancy', 'includes type rating training cost', 'contingent on fleet expansion approval'). Provides context for budget reviewers and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budgeted_fte
attributes.description: The planned FTE allocation for this position within this budget plan. May differ from the position's base FTE allocation to reflect hiring plans, vacancy assumptions, or scenario planning (e.g., 0.50 FTE budgeted for a 1.00 FTE position due to expected vacancy).

attributes.name: budgeted_salary_amount
attributes.description: The total salary cost budgeted for this position within this budget plan, including base salary, allowances, and statutory benefits. Denominated in the budget plan's currency. Used for labor cost forecasting and OPEX planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position budget allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and planning cycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The start date from which this position budget allocation is effective within the budget plan. Supports phased hiring plans or mid-year position activations.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The end date through which this position budget allocation remains effective within the budget plan. Null for allocations that span the entire plan horizon. Supports scenario planning for position phase-outs or transfers.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this position budget allocation applies. Supports multi-year planning where a position may have different budgeted amounts across fiscal years within the same budget plan.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position budget allocation record was last updated. Used for change tracking during iterative budget cycles.

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: variance_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum allowable absolute monetary deviation between budgeted and actual salary costs for this position within this plan before triggering management review. May differ from the plan-level variance threshold to reflect position criticality or cost materiality.

products.name: category_responsibility
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of employees to procurement categories with specific roles and authorization levels. It captures the operational responsibility structure for category management, including primary managers, backup coverage, technical specialists, and approval authorities. Each record links one employee to one procurement category with role-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In airline procurement operations, multiple employees are assigned to each procurement category with distinct roles (primary manager, backup manager, technical specialist, finance controller, approver, technical advisor), and employees typically manage multiple categories across the spend taxonomy. The business actively manages these assignments for workload distribution, vacation coverage, approval routing, and succession planning. This is an operational assignment process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this employee's responsibility for this category became active. Used for tracking assignment history and determining current responsibilities. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this employee's responsibility for this category ends or ended. Null for current active assignments. Supports rotation planning and historical tracking. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The specific role this employee performs for this category. Values: primary_manager (lead category manager), backup_manager (coverage during absence), technical_specialist (technical expertise for specifications), finance_controller (financial oversight), approver (approval authority), technical_advisor (advisory role). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: workload_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the employee's time allocated to this category (0.00 to 100.00). Used for workload balancing and capacity planning when employees manage multiple categories.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Supply chain and procurement management including vendor sourcing, purchase orders, parts inventory, fuel procurement contracts, material management, supplier performance, and strategic sourcing for MRO parts, catering, and ground services

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, vendors, and service providers engaged by the airline across all procurement categories — MRO parts suppliers, fuel suppliers, catering providers, ground service contractors, IT vendors, and consumables suppliers. Captures vendor legal name, DUNS number, IATA vendor code, vendor type classification (MRO, fuel, catering, ground services, IT, general), tax identification numbers, country of incorporation, registered address, primary contact details, payment terms, preferred currency, credit limit, vendor tier (strategic, preferred, approved, conditional), certification status (ISO 9001, AS9100, EASA Part-145 approval), blacklist flag, onboarding date, and last performance review date. This is the SSOT for all supplier identity and master data within the procurement domain.
products.reference: IATA Vendor Master / SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: as9100_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds current AS9100 aerospace quality management system certification, critical for MRO parts suppliers.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account number for electronic funds transfer and payment processing.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the vendor's primary payment account.

attributes.name: bank_swift_code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the vendor's bank for international wire transfers and cross-border payments.

attributes.name: blacklist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is currently blacklisted or suspended from doing business with the airline due to performance, compliance, or ethical violations.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the vendor is legally incorporated or registered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts payable balance allowed for this vendor before additional purchases require approval, expressed in the vendor's preferred currency.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business entity identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: easa_part145_approved
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Part-145 Approval Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds EASA Part-145 approval for aircraft maintenance organization, required for MRO service providers operating in EU jurisdictions.

attributes.name: faa_repair_station_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Repair Station Certification Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds FAA repair station certification under 14 CFR Part 145, required for MRO service providers operating in US jurisdictions.

attributes.name: iata_vendor_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Vendor Code
attributes.description: IATA-assigned alphanumeric code identifying the vendor within the aviation industry supply chain, used for standardized procurement and settlement.

attributes.name: iso9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds current ISO 9001 quality management system certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance review or scorecard assessment conducted for this vendor.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the vendor as it appears on incorporation documents and contracts.

attributes.name: minority_owned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise for diversity and inclusion reporting.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor was officially onboarded and approved to begin supplying goods or services to the airline.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from invoice date within which payment is due to the vendor, as agreed in the master vendor agreement.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the vendor's preferred currency for invoicing and payment transactions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the vendor for procurement communications and order management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the vendor organization for procurement and operational matters.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number of the vendor's business contact, including country and area codes.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's official registered business address as recorded with the incorporation authority.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's official registered business address, typically containing suite, floor, or building details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: small_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor qualifies as a small business under applicable regulatory definitions for procurement diversity programs.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The primary tax identification number issued by the vendor's country of tax residence, used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: The commercial or trading name under which the vendor operates, if different from legal name.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or GST registration number for vendors operating in jurisdictions requiring VAT registration, used for tax invoice validation.

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor relationship: active (approved and operational), inactive (no longer doing business), suspended (temporarily blocked), pending_approval (undergoing onboarding review).

attributes.name: vendor_tier
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the vendor based on business relationship strength, volume, and criticality: strategic (top-tier partners with long-term agreements), preferred (high-volume reliable suppliers), approved (qualified suppliers meeting minimum standards), conditional (suppliers under probation or limited approval).

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the vendor based on the category of goods or services provided: MRO (Maintenance Repair and Overhaul parts suppliers), fuel (aviation fuel suppliers), catering (inflight and lounge catering providers), ground_services (ground handling and airport service contractors), IT (information technology and software vendors), consumables (general supplies and consumables).

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL of the vendor for reference and supplier portal access.

attributes.name: parent_vendor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vendor (parent_vendor_id)

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Master transactional record for all purchase orders issued by the airline to vendors across all procurement categories — aircraft parts, fuel, catering supplies, ground handling services, MRO consumables, and general goods and services. Captures PO number, PO type (standard, blanket, framework, emergency AOG), vendor reference, buyer ID, procurement category, cost centre, GL account, total PO value, currency, exchange rate, payment terms, delivery address (station/base), requested delivery date, PO status (draft, approved, sent, partially received, fully received, closed, cancelled), approval workflow status, approval authority level, and sourcing event reference. The authoritative transactional record for all committed procurement spend.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO) / IATA AHM

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order. Primary key for the purchase order entity.

attributes.name: primary_purchase_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement buyer or purchasing agent responsible for creating and managing this purchase order.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Purchase orders have procurement_category (STRING) which should be normalized to procurement_category_id FK for proper spend classification, category management, and reporting. Remove procurement_cate

attributes.name: sourcing_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_event. Business justification: Purchase orders often result from sourcing events (RFQ/RFP). Currently uses sourcing_event_reference (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding sourcing_event_id FK normalizes this re

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Purchase orders are often placed against supply contracts (call-off orders). Currently uses contract_reference (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding supply_contract_id FK normali

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier to whom this purchase order is issued. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: The highest approval authority level required for this purchase order based on value thresholds and procurement policy. Determines routing through approval hierarchy.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the purchase order in the approval workflow. Tracks progression through multi-level approval hierarchy based on purchase order value and authority limits.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order received final approval and became authorized for transmission to the vendor.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the purchase order was cancelled. Used for root cause analysis of procurement process issues and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order was cancelled before completion. Used for tracking procurement process failures and vendor performance issues.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order was closed after all goods/services were received and invoiced. Marks the end of the purchase order lifecycle.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the vendor in their purchase order acknowledgment. May differ from requested date based on vendor lead times and capacity.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center to which this purchase order expenditure is charged. Used for internal financial allocation and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order record was first created in the procurement system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase order value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Defines the currency in which the vendor will be paid.

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Full physical address where the goods or services are to be delivered. Includes street address, city, postal code, and country. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: delivery_address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery location type. Station for airport locations, base for crew/operational bases, maintenance facility for MRO hangars, warehouse for central stores, headquarters for corporate offices, vendor managed for consignment inventory.

attributes.name: delivery_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or station code where goods or services are to be delivered. Used for logistics planning and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied at the time of purchase order creation for converting vendor currency to airline base currency. Used for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this purchase order will be posted upon receipt and invoice processing. Ensures proper financial classification.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for delivery. Examples: EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free on Board), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special requirements, or comments related to this purchase order. May include delivery instructions, quality requirements, or vendor-specific notes.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines when payment is due and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: The date when the purchase order was officially created and issued. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the purchase order, used across procurement systems and vendor communications. Typically follows airline-specific numbering convention.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. Tracks the order from creation through approval, transmission to vendor, receipt of goods/services, and final closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|acknowledged|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order type. Standard for one-time purchases, blanket for recurring purchases against a contract, framework for multi-release agreements, emergency AOG (Aircraft on Ground) for urgent aircraft parts, contract release for call-offs from master agreements, spot for ad-hoc market purchases.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the purchase order. AOG (Aircraft on Ground) critical for emergency aircraft parts, urgent for time-sensitive needs, high for important but not critical, routine for standard procurement.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the airline requests delivery of the goods or completion of services. Used for supply chain planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: requisition_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the internal purchase requisition(s) that originated this purchase order. Links operational demand to procurement execution.

attributes.name: sent_to_vendor_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order was transmitted to the vendor via EDI, email, or vendor portal. Marks the start of vendor fulfillment cycle.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Method of transportation for delivery of goods. AOG charter for emergency aircraft parts requiring immediate air charter, air freight for expedited delivery, sea freight for bulk shipments, ground for domestic transport, courier for small packages, vendor delivery for supplier-arranged transport.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to this purchase order, including VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the purchase order, including all line items and charges, before taxes. Represents the committed spend amount.

attributes.name: total_po_value_including_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Purchase Order (PO) Value Including Tax
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the purchase order including all taxes. This is the final committed amount payable to the vendor.

attributes.name: blanket_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on purchase_order (blanket_purchase_order_id)

products.name: po_line
products.description: Individual line item within a purchase order representing a single material, part, or service being procured. Captures PO line number, material number (linked to part master), item description, unit of measure, ordered quantity, unit price, line total value, delivery schedule date, goods receipt quantity, invoice quantity, open quantity, line status (open, partially delivered, fully delivered, cancelled), storage location, aircraft type applicability, ATA chapter code for parts, and hazardous material flag. Enables granular tracking of multi-line procurement transactions and three-way matching (PO line vs goods receipt vs invoice line).
products.reference: SAP MM PO Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee or user who requested this material or service. Links the procurement line to the originating purchase requisition and requestor.

attributes.name: material_part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record. Identifies the specific part, component, consumable, or service being procured on this line.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.part_master. Business justification: PO lines reference materials/parts that should link to part_master for normalization. Currently uses material_number, manufacturer_part_number, and vendor_material_number (STRING) which are denormaliz

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: PO lines currently have material_group (STRING) which appears to be a category/classification reference. Should normalize to procurement_category_id FK for proper spend classification, category manage

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Structure

attributes.name: aircraft_type
attributes.description: The aircraft type or model for which this material or part is applicable. Critical for MRO parts procurement to ensure compatibility with specific fleet types (e.g., B737, A320, B787).
attributes.references: ICAO Aircraft Type Designators, IATA Aircraft Type Codes

attributes.name: ata_chapter
attributes.description: The ATA chapter code classifying the aircraft system or component category for this part. Standard aviation maintenance classification system (e.g., 32 for landing gear, 71 for powerplant).
attributes.references: ATA Spec 100 Aircraft System Codes, ATA iSpec 2200

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center to which this procurement line will be charged. Enables departmental or functional cost allocation for expense items, services, or consumables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this purchase order line record was first created in the system. Audit field for tracking line creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary values on this line. Typically inherited from the PO header but may differ for specific line items in multi-currency scenarios.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this purchase order line has been marked for deletion or cancellation. Soft-delete mechanism to preserve audit trail while removing line from active processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Management

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or requested delivery date for this line item. Represents when the material or service is expected to be received or performed.

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: The acceptable over-delivery or under-delivery tolerance as a percentage of the ordered quantity. Allows for minor quantity variances without requiring PO amendments.

attributes.name: final_invoice_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the final invoice has been received and processed for this line, and no further invoices are expected. Signals readiness for line closure.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this procurement expense will be posted. Enables financial classification and cost allocation for non-stock items or direct expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: goods_receipt_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a goods receipt transaction is required before invoice processing for this line. Enforces three-way matching for physical materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt-Based Invoice Verification

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross value of this line item including all taxes, surcharges, and fees. Represents the final line total that contributes to the overall PO value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this material is classified as hazardous or dangerous goods. Triggers special handling, storage, and transportation requirements per IATA DGR.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: The Incoterms rule governing the transfer of risk, costs, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for this line item. Defines delivery terms and logistics obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether invoice verification is required for this line. Controls whether the line participates in invoice matching and payment processing.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items in the PO document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line. Tracks progression from open through delivery to closure or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Status Management

attributes.name: long_text
attributes.description: Detailed description of the material or service, including specifications, technical requirements, or special instructions for this procurement line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this purchase order line record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to line item details.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: The total net value of this line item before taxes and surcharges. Calculated as quantity_ordered multiplied by unit_price, adjusted for any line-level discounts.

attributes.name: open_quantity
attributes.description: The remaining quantity still to be delivered on this purchase order line. Calculated as quantity_ordered minus quantity_received. Indicates outstanding procurement commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The plant or facility code where the material will be received or the service will be performed. In aviation context, may represent maintenance base, hub station, or warehouse location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master, IATA Airport Codes

attributes.name: quantity_invoiced
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity that has been invoiced by the vendor against this purchase order line. Used for three-way matching and invoice verification.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service units ordered on this purchase order line. Expressed in the unit of measure specified for this line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of material that has been received against this purchase order line through goods receipt transactions. Used for three-way matching (PO vs GR vs invoice).

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being procured on this line. Provides human-readable context for the line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The specific storage location or warehouse bin within the plant where the material will be stocked upon receipt. Enables precise inventory placement for MRO parts and consumables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount applicable to this purchase order line. Includes VAT, GST, sales tax, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and material tax classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Calculation, IATA BSP Tax Rules

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous substance classification for dangerous goods. Required for HAZMAT materials to comply with international shipping and handling regulations.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IATA DGR

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Examples include EA (each), KG (kilogram), LT (liter), HR (hour), or aviation-specific units like FH (flight hours) or FC (flight cycles).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, IATA ULD Standards

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of measure for this line item. Expressed in the currency specified on the purchase order header.

attributes.name: parent_po_line_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on po_line (parent_po_line_id)

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record capturing the physical receipt of goods or confirmation of service delivery against a purchase order. Captures GR document number, PO reference, vendor delivery note number, receiving station (airport/MRO base), receiving date and time, received quantity per line, unit of measure, batch number, serial numbers for rotable parts, condition on receipt (serviceable, unserviceable, damaged), inspection required flag, quarantine flag, storage location, received by employee ID, and GR status (posted, reversed, under inspection). Triggers inventory update and enables three-way matching for invoice verification. Critical for MRO parts traceability and airworthiness documentation.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO / MSEG) / EASA Part-145 traceability

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt transaction. Primary key for the goods receipt record.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.part_master. Business justification: Goods receipts reference materials/parts that should link to part_master for normalization. Currently uses material_number and material_description (STRING) which are denormalized. Adding part_master_

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Goods receipts are against specific PO line items, not just the header. Currently uses po_line_item_number (INT) which is a line sequence number within the PO, not a FK. Adding po_line_id FK enables d

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which goods or services are being received. Links GR to originating procurement document.

attributes.name: received_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or receiving clerk who physically accepted and recorded the goods receipt. Provides accountability.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier delivering the goods or services. Links to vendor master data for supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: airworthiness_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for parts requiring airworthiness documentation. Mandatory for aviation-critical components per EASA/FAA regulations.
attributes.references: EASA Part 145 Maintenance Organization Approvals, FAA 14 CFR Part 43

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer batch or lot number for the received goods. Critical for quality control, recalls, and traceability in MRO operations.

attributes.name: certificate_of_conformance_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued certificate number confirming that parts meet specified requirements. Required for quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: condition_on_receipt
attributes.description: Physical and functional condition of goods upon receipt. Determines whether parts can be immediately used or require inspection, repair, or disposal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt record was first created in the database. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount. Enables multi-currency procurement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_note_date
attributes.description: Date on the vendor delivery note or packing slip. Used for lead time calculation and delivery performance analysis.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the goods receipt document. Used for cross-system reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt document. Tracks progression from initial posting through inspection to final completion or reversal.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods require quality inspection before being released to stock. True triggers inspection workflow.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification tracking.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code indicating the type of inventory transaction. Standard codes include 101 for GR against PO, 122 for return delivery.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the receiving clerk. Captures discrepancies, damage observations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: po_line_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order for which goods are being received. Enables line-level matching for three-way verification.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods are placed in quarantine status pending inspection or resolution of quality issues. Blocks inventory usage.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of goods received and accepted. Used for inventory update and variance analysis against PO quantity.

attributes.name: receiving_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when goods were physically received at the station. Used for lead time analysis and supplier performance metrics.

attributes.name: receiving_station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code or MRO base code where goods were physically received. Critical for inventory location tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when goods receipt was recorded in the system. Business event timestamp for the GR transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing a goods receipt. Used when GR is cancelled due to errors, returns, or quality rejection.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods receipt was reversed or cancelled. Null if GR has not been reversed.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized rotable parts and high-value components. Mandatory for airworthiness tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which time-sensitive materials such as chemicals, sealants, or perishables are no longer usable. Triggers inventory aging alerts.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Specific warehouse or storage location code within the receiving station where goods are placed. Enables bin-level inventory tracking.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way matching process comparing PO, GR, and invoice. Matched status enables automatic invoice payment approval.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: contract_renewal_eligible_flag

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_reference

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: evaluation_date

attributes.name: evaluation_notes

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date

attributes.name: order_fill_rate_percent

attributes.name: overall_performance_score

attributes.name: performance_tier

attributes.name: price_compliance_rate_percent

attributes.name: quality_rejection_rate_percent

attributes.name: sla_target_aog_response_hours

attributes.name: sla_target_on_time_delivery_percent

attributes.name: sla_target_quality_rejection_percent

attributes.description: Contracted SLA target (maximum acceptable) for quality rejection rate percentage.

attributes.name: total_order_value_amount

attributes.name: total_orders_evaluated

attributes.name: trend_versus_prior_period

attributes.name: vendor_development_program_flag

attributes.name: prior_vendor_performance_id
