products.name: procurement_category
products.description: Reference master defining the airline's procurement category taxonomy used to classify all spend, contracts, and sourcing activities. Captures category code, category name, parent category code (for hierarchy), category level (1=family, 2=class, 3=commodity), UNSPSC code, category description, category owner (lead buyer), annual spend estimate, strategic importance (strategic, leverage, bottleneck, non-critical — Kraljic matrix quadrant), sourcing strategy (single source, dual source, competitive tender, catalogue), preferred vendor count, and active flag. Enables spend analytics, category management, and strategic sourcing planning across MRO, fuel, catering, ground services, and general procurement.
products.reference: UNSPSC / IATA Procurement Category Framework

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement category. Primary key.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the category is currently active and available for use in procurement transactions. False for retired or obsolete categories.

attributes.name: annual_spend_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total annual spend (in base currency) for this category. Used for category prioritization and strategic sourcing planning.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum organizational level required to approve purchases in this category based on spend thresholds and strategic importance.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the procurement category within the taxonomy. Used as business key for reporting and integration.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the category scope, including typical items, services, and materials classified under this category.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category: 1=Family (top level), 2=Class (mid level), 3=Commodity (leaf level). Supports drill-down analytics.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the procurement category (e.g., Aircraft Spare Parts, Jet Fuel, Catering Services).

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of regulatory, safety, or quality compliance requirements applicable to this category (e.g., EASA Part 145 for MRO parts, FAA certification for avionics, ISO 9001 for catering).

attributes.name: contract_renewal_cycle_months
attributes.description: Typical contract renewal cycle in months for this category. Used for proactive sourcing planning and contract lifecycle management.

attributes.name: cost_center_default
attributes.description: Default cost center code for financial postings related to this category. Can be overridden at transaction level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this category definition became active and available for use in procurement transactions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this category definition expires or is retired. Null for categories with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: gl_account_default
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code for expenses in this category. Supports automated financial posting and spend analytics.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this category record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent strategic review or spend analysis for this category. Used to track category management governance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average procurement lead time in days from requisition to delivery for items in this category. Used for inventory planning and demand forecasting.

attributes.name: minimum_order_value
attributes.description: Minimum order value (in base currency) required for purchases in this category. Used to enforce procurement efficiency and reduce transaction costs.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next strategic category review. Supports proactive category management and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_count
attributes.description: Target number of preferred or approved vendors for this category. Supports supplier rationalization and risk management.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall supply risk rating for the category based on supplier concentration, geopolitical factors, market volatility, and criticality to operations.

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Preferred sourcing approach for this category: single_source (one supplier), dual_source (two suppliers for redundancy), competitive_tender (RFx process), catalogue (pre-negotiated catalog), framework_agreement (call-off contract), spot_buy (ad-hoc purchase).

attributes.name: strategic_importance
attributes.description: Kraljic matrix classification indicating the strategic importance and supply risk of the category: strategic (high impact, high risk), leverage (high impact, low risk), bottleneck (low impact, high risk), non-critical (low impact, low risk).

attributes.name: sustainability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category has specific sustainability or environmental sourcing requirements (e.g., sustainable aviation fuel, carbon offset programs, eco-friendly catering supplies).

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code for items in this category (e.g., standard VAT, reduced rate, exempt). Used for automated tax calculation.

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: Eight-digit UNSPSC classification code aligning the category to global commodity taxonomy for cross-industry benchmarking and reporting.

attributes.name: parent_procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on procurement_category (parent_procurement_category_id)

products.name: approved_vendor_list
products.description: Association master record defining the approved vendor list (AVL) — the authoritative list of vendors approved to supply specific parts, materials, or services within defined procurement categories. Captures AVL entry ID, vendor reference, part number or procurement category, approval status (approved, conditional, suspended, delisted), approval date, approval expiry date, approval authority, qualification basis (audit passed, OEM authorization, regulatory approval, historical performance), quality system certification required flag, certification reference, geographic scope (global, regional, station-specific), and last review date. Critical for MRO parts procurement compliance with EASA Part-145 and FAA AC 00-56 supplier approval requirements.
products.reference: EASA Part-145 / FAA AC 00-56 / IATA ISAGO

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved vendor list entry. Primary key for the AVL record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: AVL entries require formal approval by engineering, quality, or procurement managers per EASA/FAA regulations. Tracks who authorized vendor for specific part numbers. Essential for audit trails, regul

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Approved vendor list entries should link to procurement_category for proper category classification. Currently uses procurement_category_code (STRING) which is denormalized. Adding procurement_categor

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor approved to supply parts, materials, or services. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor was approved for this part or procurement category. Represents the effective start of the approval.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor approval expires and must be renewed. Null indicates indefinite approval subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the vendor for this part or category. Approved = fully authorized; Conditional = approved with restrictions; Suspended = temporarily not authorized; Delisted = permanently removed; Pending Review = under evaluation; Expired = approval period lapsed.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent quality audit conducted on the vendor. Null if no audit has been conducted.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: The most recent quality audit score for the vendor, typically expressed as a percentage (0-100). Used to track vendor quality performance and compliance. Null if no audit has been conducted.

attributes.name: conditional_approval_restrictions
attributes.description: Detailed description of any restrictions or conditions attached to the approval. Applicable when approval_status is conditional. May include quantity limits, usage restrictions, or additional oversight requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the approved vendor list entry was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: delisting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor was permanently delisted from the approved vendor list. Null if never delisted.

attributes.name: delisting_reason
attributes.description: The reason for permanently removing the vendor from the approved vendor list. Applicable when approval_status is delisted. May include severe quality failures, fraud, bankruptcy, or regulatory sanctions.

attributes.name: easa_part145_approved_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Part-145 Approved Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds EASA Part-145 approval for maintenance organization. True = EASA Part-145 approved; False = not approved. Required for MRO parts suppliers in EASA jurisdictions.

attributes.name: faa_repair_station_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Repair Station Certificate Number
attributes.description: The FAA-issued repair station certificate number for the vendor. Unique identifier for the repair station certification.

attributes.name: faa_repair_station_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Repair Station Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds FAA repair station certification. True = FAA certified repair station; False = not certified. Required for certain MRO parts suppliers in FAA jurisdictions.
attributes.references: FAA 14 CFR Part 145 Repair Station Certification

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Specific geographic restrictions or limitations on the approval. May list countries, regions, or station codes where the vendor is approved or restricted. Null if no restrictions apply.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope of the vendor approval. Global = approved for all airline operations worldwide; Regional = approved for specific regions (e.g., EMEA, APAC); Station Specific = approved only for specific airport stations; Country Specific = approved for operations in specific countries.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the approved vendor list entry was last updated or modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent periodic review or re-evaluation of the vendors approved status. Used to track compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard procurement lead time in days from order placement to delivery for this vendor and part combination. Used for materials planning and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required by the vendor for this part or category. Expressed in the parts unit of measure. Null if no minimum applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review or re-evaluation of the vendors approved status. Ensures timely compliance with review cycles.

attributes.name: oem_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is authorized by the original equipment manufacturer to supply the part or material. True = OEM authorized; False = not OEM authorized. Critical for airworthiness compliance.
attributes.references: FAA AC 00-56 Voluntary Industry Distributor Accreditation Program

attributes.name: oem_authorization_reference
attributes.description: The reference number, certificate ID, or documentation reference for the OEM authorization. May include distributor agreement numbers or OEM approval letters.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The specific part number or material code that the vendor is approved to supply. May be an OEM part number, airline internal part number, or industry standard part number.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is designated as a preferred or strategic supplier for this part or category. True = preferred vendor; False = standard approved vendor. Preferred vendors may receive priority in sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: qualification_basis
attributes.description: The primary basis or reason for approving the vendor. Audit Passed = vendor passed quality audit; OEM Authorization = authorized by original equipment manufacturer; Regulatory Approval = holds required regulatory certifications; Historical Performance = proven track record; Quality Certification = holds ISO/AS certifications; Technical Evaluation = passed technical capability assessment.

attributes.name: quality_certification_reference
attributes.description: The certification number, certificate ID, or reference to the vendors quality system certification (e.g., ISO 9001:2015 certificate number, AS9100 registration number).

attributes.name: quality_system_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to maintain a quality management system certification (e.g., ISO 9001, AS9100) as a condition of approval. True = certification required; False = not required.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the vendor approval. May include procurement guidance, quality notes, or historical context.

attributes.name: sole_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is the sole approved source for this part or category. True = sole source (no alternatives); False = multiple sources available. Critical for supply chain risk management.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendors approval was suspended. Null if never suspended or currently not suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: The reason for suspending the vendors approval. Applicable when approval_status is suspended. May include quality issues, delivery failures, regulatory non-compliance, or pending investigation.

attributes.name: superseded_approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on approved_vendor_list (superseded_approved_vendor_list_id)

products.name: spend_record
products.description: Consolidated procurement spend record capturing actual committed and invoiced spend by vendor, category, cost centre, and period. Captures spend record ID, fiscal year, fiscal period, vendor reference, procurement category, cost centre, GL account, PO reference, invoice reference, spend type (PO-backed, non-PO, contract-backed), spend amount, currency, local currency equivalent, payment status, and sourcing channel (contracted, spot, catalogue, p-card). Provides the procurement-layer spend visibility record distinct from finance.general_ledger accounting entries — focused on category management, savings tracking, and supplier spend concentration analysis.
products.reference: IATA Procurement Spend Analytics / SAP MM Spend Analysis

attributes.name: spend_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement spend record. Primary key for the spend_record product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee ID of the person who approved the procurement spend. Used for compliance monitoring and delegation of authority validation.

attributes.name: primary_spend_requisitioner_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee ID of the person who initiated the procurement requisition. Used for spend authorization audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Spend records have procurement_category (STRING) which should be normalized to procurement_category_id FK for proper spend classification, category analytics, and reporting. Remove procurement_categor

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Spend records reference purchase orders for spend classification and tracking. Currently uses po_number (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding purchase_order_id FK normalizes this

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Spend records reference supply contracts for contract spend tracking and compliance monitoring. Currently uses contract_reference (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding supply_con

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier associated with this spend record, enabling supplier spend concentration analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Spend records reference vendor invoices for spend classification and payment tracking. Currently uses invoice_number (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding vendor_invoice_id FK no

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: The aircraft tail number or registration associated with this spend record, if the spend is aircraft-specific (e.g., MRO parts, fuel uplift). Enables aircraft-level cost tracking.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division within the airline that incurred this spend (e.g., Flight Operations, Maintenance, Catering, Ground Services). Enables business unit spend analysis and chargeback.

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: The organizational cost centre code to which this spend is allocated, enabling departmental spend tracking and budget accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this spend record was first created in the procurement system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the spend amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to this spend record, including early payment discounts, volume discounts, or negotiated rebates. Used for savings tracking and supplier performance evaluation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to the local reporting currency at the time of the transaction.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the spend was recorded, enabling period-over-period analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the spend was recorded, used for annual financial reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code under which this spend is recorded in the financial accounting system, linking procurement spend to financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts, GAAP, IFRS

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods or services were received and accepted by the airline. Critical for three-way match validation (PO, goods receipt, invoice).

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor invoice was issued. Used for invoice aging analysis and payment terms calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number associated with this spend record, linking the spend to the actual invoice document for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this spend record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The spend amount converted to the airline's reporting currency (typically USD) for consolidated financial reporting and cross-border spend analysis.

attributes.name: maverick_spend_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this spend was executed outside of approved procurement channels or contracts (maverick spend). True indicates non-compliant procurement requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: net_spend_amount
attributes.description: The net spend amount after applying discounts and before tax. Represents the actual cost to the airline for procurement analytics.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was made to the vendor for this spend record. Used for cash flow analysis and payment terms compliance tracking.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the spend record (e.g., Pending, Approved, Paid, Overdue, Disputed, Cancelled). Used for cash flow management and accounts payable tracking.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with this spend record, if the spend is PO-backed. Enables traceability to the original procurement authorization.

attributes.name: savings_amount
attributes.description: The calculated savings amount achieved through strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, or competitive bidding compared to baseline or market rates. Used for procurement performance measurement.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The sourcing channel through which the procurement was executed (e.g., Contracted, Spot, Catalogue, P-Card, Emergency). Enables analysis of procurement compliance and strategic sourcing effectiveness.

attributes.name: spend_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the spend in the transaction currency. Represents the actual committed or invoiced amount for this procurement transaction.

attributes.name: spend_date
attributes.description: The date on which the spend was incurred or committed. This is the primary business event timestamp for spend recognition and period allocation.

attributes.name: spend_type
attributes.description: Classification of the spend based on the procurement method used (e.g., PO-backed, Non-PO, Contract-backed, P-Card, Spot). Critical for compliance monitoring and maverick spend identification.

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: The three-letter IATA airport code of the station where the spend was incurred, if applicable. Enables location-based spend analysis for ground operations and station services.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) included in the spend amount. Used for tax reporting and reclaim analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_spend_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on spend_record (reversal_spend_record_id)

products.name: ground_service_order
products.description: Transactional record for ground handling and airport service orders placed with contracted ground service providers (GSPs) for specific aircraft turnarounds or station operations. Captures service order number, ground handler (vendor reference), station (airport IATA code), flight leg reference, aircraft registration, service type (ramp handling, passenger handling, baggage handling, aircraft cleaning, lavatory service, water service, GPU provision, pushback), contracted service level, ordered service start time, actual service start time, actual service end time, service completion status (completed, partial, failed, cancelled), service quality score, penalty trigger flag, and contract reference. Distinct from airport.ramp_service_order which is the operational dispatch record — this is the procurement-layer commercial service order.
products.reference: IATA SGHA (Standard Ground Handling Agreement) / AHM 810

attributes.name: ground_service_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ground service order. Primary key for this procurement-layer commercial service order record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ground service orders (ramp, cleaning, deicing) require station manager or ground ops supervisor approval before vendor execution. Essential for cost control, SLA enforcement, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Ground service orders are placed against supply contracts with ground handling vendors. Currently uses contract_reference (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding supply_contract_id

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted ground service provider (GSP) fulfilling this service order.

attributes.name: actual_service_end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground service provider completed or terminated service delivery.

attributes.name: actual_service_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground service provider commenced service delivery on the aircraft or at the gate.

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: Tail number or registration mark of the aircraft receiving ground services for this turnaround.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ground service order was approved for placement with the vendor.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of why this ground service order was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., flight cancellation, vendor unavailability, operational change).

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ground service order was cancelled.

attributes.name: contracted_service_level
attributes.description: Service level agreement tier contracted for this order, defining performance standards and response times.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which this ground service order expense is allocated for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ground service order record was first created in the procurement system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this order.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service order is under dispute due to service quality issues, billing discrepancies, or contract disagreements.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of the reason for dispute if the dispute flag is set, including details of service failures or billing errors.

attributes.name: flight_leg_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight leg (flight number and date) for which ground services are ordered. Format: carrier code + flight number + dash + date (YYYYMMDD).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting this ground service order expense in the financial system.

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor invoice document associated with this ground service order for payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ground service order record was last updated in the procurement system.

attributes.name: order_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ground service order was placed with the vendor.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ground service order in the procurement workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|confirmed|dispatched|in_progress|completed|partial|failed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_value_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted value of this ground service order before adjustments, taxes, or penalties.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment processing for this ground service order.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty amount assessed against the vendor for this service order due to SLA breaches or quality failures.

attributes.name: penalty_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service order triggered contractual penalty clauses due to non-performance, delays, or quality failures.

attributes.name: scheduled_service_start_time
attributes.description: Contracted or planned start time for ground service delivery, typically aligned with aircraft arrival or turnaround schedule.

attributes.name: service_completion_status
attributes.description: Operational completion status indicating whether the ground service provider successfully delivered the ordered services.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from actual service start to actual service end.

attributes.name: service_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this ground service order, used in vendor communications and invoicing.

attributes.name: service_quality_score
attributes.description: Quantitative quality rating (0.00 to 100.00) assigned to the vendor's service delivery performance for this order, based on timeliness, completeness, and adherence to standards.

attributes.name: service_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the specific services included in this order, including any special requirements or non-standard tasks.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Category of ground handling service ordered: ramp handling, passenger handling, baggage handling, aircraft cleaning, lavatory service, water service, GPU (Ground Power Unit) provision, or pushback. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ramp_handling|passenger_handling|baggage_handling|aircraft_cleaning|lavatory_service|water_service|gpu_provision|pushback — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor met the contracted service level agreement performance standards for this order.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special handling instructions, non-standard requirements, or operational notes communicated to the ground service provider.

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code identifying the station where ground services are to be performed.

attributes.name: turnaround_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the operational aircraft turnaround event that this procurement service order supports.

attributes.name: amended_ground_service_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ground_service_order (amended_ground_service_order_id)

products.name: vendor_audit
products.description: Vendor qualification audit and assessment record capturing formal on-site or remote audits conducted against approved vendors and prospective suppliers. Captures audit reference number, vendor reference, audit type (initial qualification, periodic surveillance, for-cause, re-qualification), audit scope (quality system, safety, financial, regulatory compliance, ISAGO, AS9100), audit date, audit lead (internal auditor or third-party), audit location, overall audit result (pass, conditional pass, fail), number of major findings, number of minor findings, number of observations, corrective action required flag, corrective action deadline, re-audit required flag, re-audit date, and audit report document reference. Supports EASA Part-145 and FAA supplier approval compliance.
products.reference: EASA Part-145 / IATA ISAGO / FAA AC 00-56

attributes.name: vendor_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor audit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Vendor audits (EASA Part-145, FAA repair station compliance) require internal audit lead assignment. Quality assurance or procurement employees lead audits. Tracks accountability for audit findings, c

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being audited. Links to the vendor master record in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual or committee with authority to approve the audit results and make vendor qualification decisions based on the audit outcome. Examples: Director of Procurement, Quality Assurance Manager, Vendor Qualification Board.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the individual who formally approved the audit report and vendor qualification decision. Nullable if audit is not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the audit report was formally approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Nullable if audit is not yet approved.

attributes.name: audit_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the audit, including auditor fees, travel expenses, and third-party certification body charges. Used for procurement budget tracking and vendor management cost analysis.

attributes.name: audit_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the audit cost amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The principal date on which the audit was conducted or commenced. For multi-day audits, this represents the start date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: audit_duration_days
attributes.description: Total duration of the audit in days, including fieldwork and on-site activities. Calculated as the difference between audit_end_date and audit_date plus one, or manually entered for complex audits. Supports fractional days for half-day audits.

attributes.name: audit_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the audit fieldwork was completed. Nullable for single-day audits. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: audit_lead_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization employing the audit lead. May be the airline's internal audit department, a third-party certification body, or a regulatory authority.

attributes.name: audit_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the audit was conducted. May include vendor facility address, city, country, or 'Remote' for virtual audits conducted via video conference and document review.

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: Method by which the audit was conducted: on-site (physical presence at vendor facility), remote (virtual audit via video and document review), or hybrid (combination of on-site and remote activities).

attributes.name: audit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique audit reference number assigned by the auditing organization or system. Used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: audit_report_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal audit report document stored in the document management system. Enables retrieval of the full audit report with detailed findings, evidence, and recommendations.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit scope covering areas such as quality system, safety management, financial stability, regulatory compliance, ISAGO (IATA Safety Audit for Ground Operations), AS9100 (aerospace quality management), environmental management, or specific operational processes. Free-text field capturing the full scope statement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, IATA ISAGO Standards Manual

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit: scheduled (audit planned but not yet started), in_progress (audit fieldwork underway), completed (audit finished and report issued), cancelled (audit cancelled before completion), or report_pending (fieldwork complete, report being finalized).

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on its purpose: initial qualification (first-time vendor approval), periodic surveillance (scheduled recurring audit), for-cause (triggered by incident or complaint), re-qualification (renewal after suspension or expiry), special audit (focused scope), or desktop review (document-only assessment).
attributes.references: EASA Part-145 Subpart D, FAA AC 00-56B

attributes.name: auditor_team_size
attributes.description: Number of auditors in the audit team, including the lead auditor and any supporting auditors or technical experts. Used for resource planning and audit cost allocation.

attributes.name: certification_standard
attributes.description: The specific certification standard or framework against which the vendor was audited. Examples: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, EASA Part-145, FAA Part 145, IATA ISAGO, ISO 14001 (environmental), OHSAS 18001 (occupational health and safety).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, EASA Part-145, IATA ISAGO

attributes.name: corrective_action_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the vendor must submit and implement corrective actions to address audit findings. Nullable if no corrective actions are required. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor is required to submit a corrective action plan to address findings identified during the audit. True if corrective actions are required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor audit record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor audit record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformities identified during the audit. Major findings represent significant deviations from requirements that could impact safety, quality, or regulatory compliance and typically require immediate corrective action.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformities identified during the audit. Minor findings represent isolated or less significant deviations that do not pose immediate risk but require corrective action within a defined timeframe.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic surveillance audit based on the audit frequency defined in the vendor qualification program. Typically set at 12, 24, or 36 months from the current audit date depending on vendor risk tier and regulatory requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: observations_count
attributes.description: Number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted during the audit. Observations are not non-conformities but represent areas where the vendor could enhance processes or practices.

attributes.name: overall_audit_result
attributes.description: Final outcome of the audit: pass (vendor meets all requirements), conditional pass (vendor approved subject to corrective actions within specified timeframe), fail (vendor does not meet requirements and is not approved), or pending (audit report under review, final decision not yet issued).

attributes.name: re_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the follow-up re-audit to verify corrective action effectiveness. Nullable if no re-audit is required or not yet scheduled. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: re_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a follow-up re-audit is required to verify closure of findings and effectiveness of corrective actions. True if re-audit is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority under whose standards the audit was conducted. Examples: EASA (European Union Aviation Safety Agency), FAA (Federal Aviation Administration), IATA (International Air Transport Association), or national civil aviation authorities.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, notes, or context related to the audit. May include special circumstances, audit challenges, vendor cooperation level, or follow-up actions beyond standard corrective action plans.

attributes.name: follow_up_vendor_audit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vendor_audit (follow_up_vendor_audit_id)

products.name: contract_price_schedule
products.description: Detailed pricing schedule record attached to a supply contract defining the agreed unit prices, volume tiers, and price adjustment mechanisms for specific materials, parts, or services. Captures price schedule line ID, supply contract reference, material number or service code, description, unit of measure, base unit price, currency, volume tier breakpoints and corresponding tier prices, price validity start and end dates, price escalation index (CPI, PPI, fuel index), escalation frequency, escalation cap percentage, discount percentage, and price schedule status (active, superseded, expired). Enables accurate PO pricing, contract compliance checking, and price variance analysis.
products.reference: SAP MM Contract Pricing (EKKO/EKPO) / IATA Procurement

attributes.name: contract_price_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract price schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this price schedule line for use in procurement operations.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.part_master. Business justification: Contract price schedules reference materials/parts that should link to part_master for normalization. Currently uses material_number and manufacturer_part_number (STRING) which are denormalized. Addin

attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_contract_price_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer contract price schedule record that replaces this one, enabling price history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent supply contract to which this price schedule is attached.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price schedule line was approved and became available for use in purchase orders.

attributes.name: base_unit_price
attributes.description: The agreed unit price for the material or service at the base volume tier, before any volume discounts, escalations, or adjustments are applied.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract price schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price schedule (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All prices in this schedule line are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Additional discount percentage applied to the unit price, typically for early payment, volume commitments, or promotional periods. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: escalation_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the price can increase in a single escalation period, protecting the buyer from excessive price volatility. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10% cap).

attributes.name: escalation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which price escalation adjustments are applied based on the selected index.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) defining the delivery terms, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between buyer and seller for this price schedule line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the material or service covered by this price schedule line, including specifications, grade, and any special characteristics.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract price schedule record was last updated, supporting audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order placement to expected delivery for items ordered under this price schedule line.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum quantity that can be ordered under this price schedule line in a single purchase order. Nullable if no maximum applies.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered for this price schedule line to be valid. Orders below this quantity may not be accepted or may incur surcharges.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional pricing terms, special conditions, or clarifications related to this price schedule line.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code applicable to purchases under this price schedule (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). May override contract-level payment terms.

attributes.name: price_escalation_index_type
attributes.description: The type of economic index used for automatic price escalation adjustments. CPI=Consumer Price Index, PPI=Producer Price Index, FUEL=fuel price index (critical for aviation), LABOR=labor cost index, CUSTOM=custom index, NONE=no escalation.
attributes.references: IATA Economic Indices, Bureau of Labor Statistics

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price schedule line expires and is no longer valid for new purchase orders. Nullable for open-ended pricing agreements.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price schedule line becomes effective and can be used for purchase order pricing.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the contract price schedule, used for ordering and referencing specific pricing entries.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price schedule line. ACTIVE=currently in use, SUPERSEDED=replaced by newer schedule, EXPIRED=validity period ended, SUSPENDED=temporarily inactive, PENDING=awaiting approval.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service covered by this price schedule line (e.g., ground handling, catering, maintenance services). Mutually exclusive with material_number for service-based contracts.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the applicable tax rate and tax type (VAT, GST, sales tax) for purchases under this price schedule line.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for pricing and ordering (e.g., EA=each, KG=kilogram, LT=liter, HR=hour, GL=gallon). Aligns with IATA and ISO standards for aviation materials and services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|LT|GL|HR|PC|MT|FT|M|BOX|PAL — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_part_number
attributes.description: The vendor's own part number or service code for this item, used for cross-referencing and order communication.

attributes.name: volume_tier_1_breakpoint
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for the first volume tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for tier 1 pricing.

attributes.name: volume_tier_1_price
attributes.description: The unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the volume tier 1 breakpoint.

attributes.name: volume_tier_2_breakpoint
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for the second volume tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for tier 2 pricing.

attributes.name: volume_tier_2_price
attributes.description: The unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the volume tier 2 breakpoint.

attributes.name: volume_tier_3_breakpoint
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for the third volume tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for tier 3 pricing.

attributes.name: volume_tier_3_price
attributes.description: The unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the volume tier 3 breakpoint.

attributes.name: superseded_contract_price_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on contract_price_schedule (superseded_contract_price_schedule_id)

products.name: mro_exchange_order
products.description: Transactional record for MRO component exchange and loan transactions with approved repair vendors and component pool operators. Captures exchange order number, order type (exchange, loan, borrow, repair-and-return), vendor reference, component part number, component serial number (outgoing), component serial number (incoming), aircraft registration, work order reference, dispatch date, expected return date, actual return date, exchange fee, loan fee per day, maximum loan period, currency, component condition (serviceable, unserviceable), airworthiness release document reference, and order status (open, component dispatched, awaiting return, closed, overdue). Critical for rotable component pool management and AOG recovery.
products.reference: SPEC 2000 Chapter 6 / ATA MSG-3 / EASA Part-145

attributes.name: mro_exchange_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Exchange Order ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MRO component exchange or loan transaction record.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.part_master. Business justification: MRO exchange orders reference aircraft components that should link to part_master for normalization. Currently uses component_part_number and component_description (STRING) which are denormalized. Add

attributes.name: primary_mro_requested_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance engineer or planner who initiated this exchange order request.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved repair vendor or component pool operator executing this exchange or loan transaction.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the replacement serviceable component was physically received and accepted into inventory.

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: Tail number or registration identifier of the aircraft requiring the component exchange, critical for traceability and airworthiness compliance.

attributes.name: airworthiness_release_document
attributes.description: Reference number of the EASA Form 1 / FAA Form 8130-3 or equivalent airworthiness release certificate accompanying the incoming serviceable component.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exchange order was formally approved and authorized for vendor dispatch.

attributes.name: ata_chapter
attributes.description: Two-digit ATA chapter code classifying the aircraft system to which this component belongs (e.g., 32 for Landing Gear, 71 for Power Plant).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why this exchange order was cancelled before completion, if applicable.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exchange order was closed after successful receipt and acceptance of the replacement component.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exchange order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this exchange order (exchange fee, loan charges).

attributes.name: dispatch_date
attributes.description: Date when the outgoing component was physically dispatched to the vendor or repair station.

attributes.name: exchange_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged by the vendor or pool operator for the component exchange transaction, excluding loan or rental charges.

attributes.name: exchange_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this MRO exchange or loan transaction, used for vendor communication and tracking.

attributes.name: expected_return_date
attributes.description: Contractually agreed or estimated date by which the replacement serviceable component is expected to be received.

attributes.name: incoming_condition
attributes.description: Airworthiness condition classification of the replacement component received: serviceable, overhauled, repaired, or as-new.

attributes.name: incoming_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the serviceable replacement component received from the vendor or component pool.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exchange order record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: loan_fee_per_day
attributes.description: Daily rental or loan fee charged for the temporary use of the replacement component from the pool, applicable for loan-type orders.

attributes.name: maximum_loan_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the component can be on loan before mandatory return or conversion to outright purchase, per pool agreement terms.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, special handling instructions, or operational context related to this exchange transaction.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exchange order: open (initiated), component-dispatched (outgoing sent), awaiting-return (incoming expected), closed (completed), overdue (past expected return), or cancelled.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction type: exchange (swap serviceable for unserviceable), loan (temporary use), borrow (receive from pool), repair-and-return (send for repair), outright-purchase, or consignment.

attributes.name: outgoing_condition
attributes.description: Airworthiness condition classification of the component being sent out: serviceable, unserviceable, repairable, beyond-economic-repair, or time-expired.

attributes.name: outgoing_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the unserviceable or time-expired component being sent out to the vendor for exchange or repair.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification for this exchange: routine (planned maintenance), urgent (expedited), AOG (aircraft on ground - highest priority), or critical.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Transportation method used for dispatching and receiving components: air-freight, ground, courier, or hand-carry (for AOG situations).

attributes.name: total_loan_charges
attributes.description: Cumulative loan fees accrued based on the actual loan duration and daily rate, calculated at order closure.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number for the outgoing or incoming component shipment, enabling real-time logistics visibility.

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Vendor's internal reference or tracking number for this exchange transaction, used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: work_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order or Aircraft on Ground (AOG) event that triggered this component exchange requirement.

attributes.name: return_mro_exchange_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mro_exchange_order (return_mro_exchange_order_id)

products.name: repair_order
products.description: Transactional record for component and part repair orders placed with approved repair stations (Part-145 AMOs) for unserviceable rotable and repairable parts. Enables MRO cost control and component traceability.

attributes.name: repair_order_id

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance manager or authorized approver who approved the repair order and associated cost.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.part_master. Business justification: Repair orders reference aircraft components that should link to part_master for normalization. Currently uses component_part_number (STRING) which is denormalized. Adding part_master_id FK enables pro

attributes.name: primary_repair_requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance engineer or planner who initiated the repair order request.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Repair orders reference purchase orders for procurement tracking and invoice reconciliation. Currently uses purchase_order_reference (STRING) which is a denormalized business reference. Adding purchas

attributes.name: removal_flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: Component removals triggering repair orders occur on specific flights where defects are discovered. Airlines track removal events for reliability analysis, warranty claims (proving in-service failure)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved repair station or Part-145 Approved Maintenance Organization (AMO) performing the repair work.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: Date the repaired component was actually received back from the vendor. Used to calculate actual turnaround time and vendor on-time delivery performance.

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: Tail number or registration of the aircraft from which the component was removed, enabling traceability back to the specific aircraft.

attributes.name: airworthiness_certificate_type
attributes.description: Type of airworthiness release certificate issued by the repair station, indicating the regulatory authority under which the repair was certified.

attributes.name: airworthiness_release_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the airworthiness release certificate issued by the repair station upon completion of work. May be an FAA Form 8130-3 (Authorized Release Certificate), EASA Form 1 (Authorized Release Certificate), or JAA Form One depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: ata_chapter
attributes.description: ATA iSpec 2200 chapter code classifying the aircraft system to which the component belongs (e.g., 32 for Landing Gear, 71 for Power Plant).

attributes.name: ber_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the component was declared beyond economical repair by the vendor, meaning the repair cost exceeds the threshold value or replacement cost.

attributes.name: ber_threshold_value
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable repair cost threshold for this component. If actual repair cost exceeds this value, the component is declared BER and a replacement is procured instead.

attributes.name: component_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the individual component unit being repaired. Enables full traceability of the specific rotable or repairable part throughout its lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the repair order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the repair cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispatch_date
attributes.description: Date the unserviceable component was shipped to the repair vendor. Marks the start of the repair turnaround time (TAT) measurement.

attributes.name: fault_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the defect, malfunction, or reason the component was removed from service and requires repair. Captured from maintenance logs or pilot reports.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the repair order record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions to the vendor, or internal notes regarding the repair order.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency classification for the repair order: AOG (Aircraft on Ground - highest priority), critical (fleet impact), high (near-term need), normal (standard turnaround), or low (non-urgent).

attributes.name: promised_return_date
attributes.description: Date the repair vendor committed to return the serviceable component. Used for planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date the component was removed from the aircraft and tagged as unserviceable, prior to being dispatched for repair.

attributes.name: removal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for component removal (e.g., scheduled maintenance, unscheduled failure, preventive action, modification). Aligns with ATA Spec 2000 reason codes.

attributes.name: repair_cost_actual
attributes.description: Final invoiced cost for the completed repair work, including any additional charges for findings discovered during teardown or scope changes.

attributes.name: repair_cost_quoted
attributes.description: Initial cost estimate provided by the repair vendor for the repair work, before any additional findings or scope changes.

attributes.name: repair_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the repair order, used for tracking and communication with repair vendors.

attributes.name: repair_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the repair order: dispatched (sent to vendor), in-repair (work in progress), awaiting-parts (vendor waiting for spare parts), completed (repair finished and component returned), ber-declared (beyond economical repair), or cancelled (order terminated).

attributes.name: repair_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the technical specification, service bulletin, or Component Maintenance Manual (CMM) section governing the repair work to be performed.

attributes.name: repair_station_certificate_number
attributes.description: Regulatory certificate number of the Part-145 repair station performing the work, issued by EASA, FAA, or other civil aviation authority.

attributes.name: repair_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance action being performed on the component: overhaul (complete disassembly and rebuild), repair (corrective action), test (functional verification), modification (design change), inspection (scheduled check), or calibration (instrument adjustment).

attributes.name: replacement_part_ordered_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that a replacement part has been ordered because the original component was declared BER or the repair was not feasible.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this repair is being claimed under manufacturer or vendor warranty, potentially resulting in no-charge or reduced-cost repair.

attributes.name: warranty_reference_number
attributes.description: Warranty claim reference number provided by the manufacturer or vendor when the repair is covered under warranty terms.

attributes.name: work_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the internal maintenance work order under which the component removal and repair order were initiated.

attributes.name: rework_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on repair_order (rework_repair_order_id)

products.name: vendor_category_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification or approval of a vendor to supply goods or services within a specific procurement category. It captures the Approved Vendor List (AVL) or Qualified Supplier List (QSL) maintained by procurement teams. Each record links one vendor to one procurement category with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship, including qualification dates, performance metrics, spend limits, and category-specific terms. This is the operational record that buyers use to select qualified vendors for category-specific sourcing activities.. Existence Justification: In airline procurement operations, vendors are qualified to supply goods and services across multiple procurement categories (e.g., a vendor may be approved for both MRO parts and ground services), and each procurement category has multiple qualified vendors to ensure supply continuity and competitive sourcing. Procurement teams actively manage Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) by category, tracking qualification dates, performance ratings, spend limits, and category-specific terms. Buyers must select from the qualified vendor list when sourcing within a category, and vendor performance is evaluated separately for each category they serve.

products.name: vendor_audit_schedule
products.description: This association product represents the scheduled audit relationship between audit programs and vendors. It captures the operational audit schedule, scope, and results for each vendor under each applicable audit program. Each record links one audit_program to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit assignment, including when the audit is scheduled, what scope applies, and what results were obtained.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, multiple audit programs (IOSA, FAA ATOS, EASA, internal quality audits) apply to multiple vendors across different categories (MRO suppliers, fuel suppliers, catering, ground services). Each vendor-program combination requires its own audit schedule, scope customization, and result tracking. Compliance teams actively manage these audit schedules as operational records, assigning auditors, tracking findings, and managing corrective action plans for each vendor under each applicable program.

products.name: vendor_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization relationship between employees and vendors in the procurement process. It captures which employees are authorized to transact with which vendors, the type and level of authorization granted, spending limits, and validity periods. Each record links one employee to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship. Essential for segregation of duties, approval workflows, and procurement compliance.. attributes.name: time_to_conversion_seconds

attributes.name: unsubscribe_reason

attributes.name: utm_campaign

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: UTM content parameter used to differentiate similar content or links within the same campaign (e.g., A/B test variants).

attributes.name: utm_medium

attributes.name: utm_source

attributes.name: prior_campaign_response_id
